hindi: मेरी भी सहमति — बिना शब्द जोड़े समर्थन
definition: typed agreement; adds your vote without adding words
example: +1 to shipping Thursday and sleeping on Friday.

hindi: वार्षिक नियामक रिपोर्ट — अमेरिकी सूचीबद्ध कंपनी का विस्तृत सालाना विवरण
definition: annual report that listed American companies file with securities regulators, covering audited financials, business description and risk factors
example: Legal added four new pages of risk factors to the 10-K, one of which was, essentially, the weather.

hindi: तिमाही नियामक रिपोर्ट — अमेरिकी सूचीबद्ध कंपनी का तीन-माही वित्तीय विवरण
definition: quarterly report that listed American companies file with securities regulators, containing unaudited financials and management discussion
example: The 10-Q footnotes told the story the earnings call had carefully skipped.

hindi: पूर्वनिर्धारित शेयर बिक्री योजना — अंदरूनी व्यक्ति की पहले से तय ट्रेडिंग व्यवस्था
definition: prearranged trading schedule letting company insiders sell shares automatically, providing defense against insider trading accusations
example: His 10b5-1 plan sold shares the week before the profit warning, and the timing still needed a long explanation.

hindi: दस-गुना इंजीनियर — दस के बराबर बताया जाने वाला (प्रायः मिथकीय) डेवलपर
definition: a supposedly ten-times-more-productive developer, part legend, part hiring myth
example: He's a 10x engineer: ten times the code, ten times the incidents.

hindi: दो-गुणा-दो खाका — दो पैमानों पर बँटे चार खानों वाला चार्ट
definition: a chart splitting options into four quadrants along two axes, used to compare, sort and prioritise choices visually
example: Every strategy problem can be solved with a 2x2 matrix, provided you choose the axes after the answer.

hindi: विहंगम दृष्टि — बहुत ऊँचाई से मोटा-मोटा नज़ारा
definition: an executive-level overview with no details
example: Give me the 30,000-foot view before the details.

hindi: चौतरफा मूल्यांकन — बॉस, साथी और अधीनस्थ सबकी राय
definition: feedback collected from your manager, peers, and reports all at once
example: The 360 review confirmed everyone likes him except the people he manages.

hindi: तृतीय-पक्ष लॉजिस्टिक्स — भंडारण और ढुलाई बाहरी कंपनी को सौंपना
definition: third-party logistics; an outside company that handles warehousing, fulfilment and shipping on behalf of the seller
example: Our 3PL assures us the missing pallet is somewhere inside the building.

hindi: सेवानिवृत्ति बचत में नियोक्ता का मिलान — कर्मचारी के योगदान के बराबर कंपनी का योगदान
definition: the employer contribution to an American retirement savings account, matching employee contributions up to a percentage of salary
example: Not contributing enough to get the full 401(k) match is the one free lunch people still skip.

hindi: स्वतंत्र शेयर मूल्यांकन — कर्मचारी विकल्पों का प्रयोग मूल्य तय करने वाला आकलन
definition: an independent valuation of common stock that sets the strike price for employee options under American rules
example: The new 409A came in low, which HR announced as good news for everyone except the investors.

hindi: कर-योग्य उचित मूल्यांकन — कर्मचारी विकल्पों की कीमत तय करने वाला स्वतंत्र आकलन
definition: an independent appraisal of common stock fair market value that sets the strike price for employee stock options
example: The 409A valuation came in at a fifth of the headline price, which HR called a perk and finance called Tuesday.

hindi: कार्यस्थल-व्यवस्था के पाँच चरण — छाँटो, सजाओ, साफ़ करो, मानक बनाओ, बनाए रखो
definition: sort, set in order, shine, standardise, sustain; the lean method for keeping workspaces organised, clean and consistent
example: After the 5S audit, every tool had a taped outline and nobody could find anything.

hindi: तात्कालिक नियामक सूचना — किसी बड़ी घटना पर अमेरिकी कंपनी की अनिवार्य फ़ाइलिंग
definition: filing that listed American companies must submit within days to disclose material events like executive departures or acquisitions
example: The CFO's departure went out as an 8-K at six on a Friday, which is its own kind of message.

hindi: 80/20 नियम — 20% मेहनत से 80% नतीजा मिलने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that most results come from a minority of effort
example: Apply the 80/20 rule: ship the top three features.

hindi: जल्दी कर भुगतान का चुनाव — अमेरिका में शेयर मिलते ही उन पर कर चुकाने का विकल्प
definition: a United States filing letting founders and early employees settle income taxes on restricted shares at grant, within thirty days
example: Missing the 83(b) election deadline is the most expensive thing a founder can forget to post.

hindi: आठ-बिंदु ग्रिड — सभी दूरियाँ आठ के गुणकों में
definition: a spacing system where every margin and size is a multiple of eight points for consistency
example: The 8pt grid holds firm across the app except on one screen built in a hurry at 13 points.

hindi: 996 काम व्यवस्था — सुबह 9 से रात 9, हफ़्ते में 6 दिन
definition: working from nine in the morning until nine at night, Monday through Saturday, a punishing schedule that originated in Chinese technology startups
example: The founder called it 'startup energy'; the team called it 996 with free snacks.

hindi: 996 दिनचर्या — सुबह नौ से रात नौ, हफ़्ते में छह दिन काम
definition: an extreme working schedule of nine in the morning until nine at night, six days every week, born in Chinese tech
example: The founder called it a 996 schedule; the team called it the reason nobody had seen daylight since March.

hindi: @ से नाम लेकर बुलाना — सूचना पहुँचाना
definition: to name someone with @ so they get a notification
example: @mention the owner directly or the request dies in the channel.

hindi: शीर्ष श्रेणी का कर्मचारी — सबसे सक्षम, उच्च प्रदर्शन वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a top-performing employee in the highest talent tier, whom companies aim to hire and retain
example: Every hiring manager wants only A-players, and every A-player wants a different hiring manager.

hindi: ए/ए परीक्षण — दो एक-जैसे संस्करणों से टेस्टिंग सिस्टम की जांच
definition: an experiment comparing identical versions to verify the testing setup itself
example: The A/A test found a winner, which is the bad news.

hindi: ए/बी परीक्षण — दो संस्करण दिखाकर बेहतर चुनने का प्रयोग
definition: an experiment showing users two versions to see which performs better
example: The A/B test says the ugly button wins; design is grieving.

hindi: सुगम्यता का संक्षिप्त रूप — a और y के बीच ग्यारह अक्षर
definition: shorthand for accessibility: a, eleven letters, y
example: The a11y audit found forty issues, starting with the gray-on-gray text.

hindi: पाइरेट मेट्रिक्स — अधिग्रहण, सक्रियण, प्रतिधारण, रेफ़रल, राजस्व का ढांचा
definition: acquisition, activation, retention, referral, revenue; the pirate metrics funnel
example: We adopted AARRR because saying it in planning is the best part.

hindi: खाता-आधारित विपणन — चुनिंदा कंपनियों पर केंद्रित अभियान
definition: account-based marketing — targeting a specific list of companies with personalized campaigns
example: ABM means the ad only stalks the twelve companies we actually want.

hindi: मेरे पद से ऊपर — यह फ़ैसला मेरे अधिकार क्षेत्र का नहीं
definition: describes a decision or question belonging to someone more senior, beyond your authority or responsibility
example: Whether we rename the company is above my pay grade; whether we rename this variable is not.

hindi: पहली नज़र का क्षेत्र — बिना स्क्रॉल किए दिखने वाला हिस्सा
definition: the part of a page visible without scrolling
example: Everyone wants their feature above the fold; the fold disagrees.

hindi: बिना सूचना ग़ायब होना — इस्तीफ़ा दिए बिना नौकरी छोड़ देना
definition: an Indian English human resources sense meaning to stop coming to work entirely without resigning or serving notice
example: He absconded on Tuesday, but his calendar still accepts meetings.

hindi: फ़रार — बिना इस्तीफ़ा या सूचना के काम पर आना बंद करना
definition: in Indian English, describing an employee who stops attending work without resigning or answering attempts at contact
example: HR marked him absconding on the day his vacation autoreply finally expired.

hindi: त्वरित निहितीकरण — विदाई या अधिग्रहण पर शेयर समय से पहले मिल जाना
definition: unvested equity becoming owned early, typically triggered by termination after an acquisition or negotiated exit
example: Accelerated vesting is why the founders smiled through the acquisition announcement and everyone else didn't.

hindi: त्वरक कार्यक्रम — स्टार्टअप्स को पूँजी, मार्गदर्शन और मंच देने वाला
definition: a fixed-term program that gives startups money, mentorship, and a demo day
example: The accelerator took seven percent and gave us unlimited coffee and deadlines.

hindi: स्वीकृति मानदंड — कहानी पूर्ण मानने की जाँच-शर्तें
definition: the testable conditions a story must meet to be accepted as complete
example: No acceptance criteria, no story; that's the theory anyway.

hindi: पहुँच समीक्षा — कौन किस सिस्टम तक पहुँच रखता है, इसकी नियमित जाँच
definition: periodic check where managers confirm which employees should still keep access to each system
example: The access review asked him to certify forty people's permissions, so he clicked approve forty times.

hindi: संयोग से बना मैनेजर — अच्छे काम के इनाम में बिना प्रशिक्षण मैनेजर बना दिया गया
definition: a strong individual contributor promoted into people management without training, interest or preparation for leading others
example: The accidental manager still writes all the code and schedules one-on-ones for never.

hindi: ग्राहक खाता — एक कंपनी और उससे जुड़े सारे सौदे
definition: a customer company and everything related to selling to it
example: She inherited the account along with three years of unanswered emails.

hindi: देय राशि — कंपनी पर विक्रेताओं का बक़ाया
definition: money the company owes its vendors and suppliers
example: Accounts payable says the check is coming; vendors call it folklore.

hindi: प्राप्य राशि — ग्राहकों से आनी बाक़ी रक़में
definition: money customers owe the company
example: Our accounts receivable is aging like it's in a cellar.

hindi: आय-वर्धक — ऐसा सौदा जो खरीदार की प्रति-शेयर कमाई बढ़ाए
definition: describing a deal expected to increase the acquirer's earnings per share after closing
example: The merger was accretive in year three, which the board agreed was practically tomorrow.

hindi: उपार्जन — सेवा मिल गई पर बिल न आया खर्च पहले दर्ज करना
definition: recording an expense or revenue in the period it was incurred, before the invoice or payment arrives
example: Finance chased everyone for accruals because the consultants never invoice before quarter-end.

hindi: उपार्जित प्रविष्टियाँ — जो खर्च या आय हो चुकी पर नकद अभी नहीं आया-गया
definition: expenses or revenue recorded in the period they were incurred or earned, before any invoice arrives or payment changes hands
example: The vendor still hasn't billed us, so the consulting fees sit in accruals and haunt every month-end.

hindi: प्राप्ति की पुष्टि — मिल गया, पढ़ लिया
definition: to acknowledge a message — received and read, action to follow
example: Please ack the incident so we know someone's on it.

hindi: विज्ञापन बिक्री लागत — मार्केटप्लेस पर बिक्री के मुकाबले विज्ञापन खर्च का प्रतिशत
definition: advertising cost of sales; marketplace advertising spend shown as a percentage of the sales those advertisements generated
example: Our ACoS is fine, the product is just selling mostly to people who clicked the advertisement.

hindi: टीम पाने के लिए पूरी कंपनी खरीदना — उत्पाद अक्सर बंद
definition: buying a company mainly for its people, then shelving its product
example: The acqui-hire kept the engineers; the app got a sunset email.

hindi: वेतन जितना काम — तनख़्वाह से ज़्यादा ज़िम्मेदारी न उठाने का रवैया
definition: doing only the work your salary actually covers, declining unpaid extra effort beyond the role and title
example: Asked to lead a second team for no raise, he chose to act his wage and forward the job description.

hindi: अमल में लाना — बात को काम में बदलना
definition: to turn an item into actual work, in manager dialect
example: Great points; who's going to action them?

hindi: कार्य बिंदु — मीटिंग से निकला, किसी को सौंपा गया काम
definition: a task assigned in a meeting, with an owner and theoretical deadline
example: The meeting produced nine action items and no decisions.

hindi: कार्रवाई आवश्यक — पढ़ना नहीं, करना है
definition: subject-line warning that this email contains actual work
example: Subject says action required, so it might survive Monday's inbox purge.

hindi: निष्कर्ष-शीर्षक — स्लाइड का ऐसा शीर्षक जो पूरा संदेश कह दे
definition: a slide headline written as a full-sentence conclusion stating the takeaway, rather than a label naming the topic
example: 'Revenue' is a label; 'Revenue fell because pricing did' is an action title, and also bad news.

hindi: करने लायक़ — जिस पर सीधे कार्रवाई हो सके
definition: specific enough to act on
example: Interesting data, but give me one actionable takeaway.

hindi: कार्रवाई-योग्य मापदंड — जो साफ बताए कि आगे क्या करना है
definition: a measure tied clearly enough to behavior that it guides decisions
example: An actionable metric tells you what to fix; ours tell us moods.

hindi: सक्रियण — नए उपयोगकर्ता को पहली बार असली फायदा मिलना
definition: the moment a new user first experiences the product's core value
example: Activation is defined as three actions, chosen by vote.

hindi: सक्रिय निवेशक — हिस्सेदारी लेकर कंपनी में बदलाव का दबाव डालने वाला
definition: an investor who buys a significant stake to pressure the board into changes such as cost cuts, spin-offs or sales
example: The activist investor's open letter arrived on Monday; the sudden enthusiasm for share buybacks arrived on Tuesday.

hindi: गतिविधि पहचान — सेंसर से समझना कि व्यक्ति क्या कर रहा है
definition: classifying what a person is physically doing from sensor or camera data
example: Activity recognition logged vacuuming as cardio; users have never been happier.

hindi: काम-अनुसार बैठक — काम के प्रकार के हिसाब से अलग जगह चुनना
definition: an office design where people choose different shared spaces for each task instead of owning a fixed desk
example: Under activity-based working I have a focus pod, a collaboration zone and nowhere to keep my mug.

hindi: वास्तविक आँकड़े — बजट के विपरीत, सचमुच हुई आय और खर्च
definition: real recorded results for revenue and spending in a period, as opposed to budgeted or forecast figures
example: The plan said growth; the actuals said 'let's discuss offline'.

hindi: वार्षिक अनुबंध मूल्य — एक वर्ष की अनुबंध-राशि
definition: annual contract value — what a customer's contract is worth per year
example: The ACV looks great if you ignore the free first year.

hindi: कॉल-पश्चात कार्य — बातचीत के बाद नोट्स और टिकट अपडेट का समय
definition: after-call work; the time an agent spends after a customer conversation writing notes, tagging tickets and updating records
example: ACW is where the agent types 'customer was very patient' through gritted teeth.

hindi: विज्ञापन-थकान — एक ही विज्ञापन बार-बार देखने से लोगों की घटती प्रतिक्रिया
definition: declining audience response after people repeatedly view the same advertisement, raising costs and lowering clicks
example: Ad fatigue set in by Wednesday; the audience was twelve thousand people and we had one video.

hindi: तात्कालिक माँग — नियमित रिपोर्ट से बाहर का अचानक आया डेटा अनुरोध
definition: an unplanned, one-time request for numbers or analysis that falls outside the regular reports and usually arrives urgently
example: The analytics roadmap is solid, assuming zero ad hoc requests from the leadership team.

hindi: अतिरिक्तता — वह प्रभाव जो इस हस्तक्षेप के बिना नहीं होता
definition: the extent to which a programme, grant or carbon project produces impact that would not have happened anyway without that funding
example: The auditor questioned the additionality of planting trees in a forest that was already growing.

hindi: निकटवर्ती क्षेत्र — मौजूदा कारोबार से सटा नया बाज़ार या उत्पाद
definition: a neighbouring market, customer segment or product close enough to the core business to enter using existing strengths
example: The client called the pet-food business an adjacency, since it was adjacent to having spare warehouse space.

hindi: समायोजित परिचालन मुनाफ़ा — चुनी हुई लागतें हटाकर दिखाई गई कमाई
definition: operating earnings after management excludes costs it classes as unusual, such as restructuring, stock compensation or acquisition expenses
example: Adjusted EBITDA excludes the restructuring charge, which we have now taken for five consecutive years.

hindi: प्रशासक अधिकार — अपने लैपटॉप पर सॉफ़्टवेयर डालने की अनुमति
definition: permission to install software and change settings on your work laptop, usually withheld from employees
example: Without admin rights, updating the printer driver is a three-day project with a ticket number.

hindi: अपनाना — उपयोगकर्ताओं का किसी फ़ीचर या उत्पाद को इस्तेमाल में लेना
definition: the extent to which users start using a product or feature
example: Feature adoption is at four percent, led by the team that built it.

hindi: वास्तुकला निर्णय अभिलेख — कोई तकनीकी फ़ैसला क्यों लिया गया, इसका छोटा लिखित रिकॉर्ड
definition: architecture decision record; a short written document recording one technical design decision, its context and consequences
example: Nobody remembers why we chose this database, but the ADR says it seemed like a good idea at the time.

hindi: बड़ों की निगरानी — युवा संस्थापकों के साथ लाया गया अनुभवी अधिकारी
definition: an experienced executive brought in, often by investors, to manage a startup alongside young founders
example: The board wanted adult supervision, so now the founders need approval to order pizza.

hindi: विज्ञापन-लेख — खबर जैसा दिखने वाला सशुल्क प्रचार
definition: paid advertisement written and designed to resemble an editorial article, usually labelled as promotion
example: The advertorial quoted three experts, all of whom worked for the client.

hindi: पैरोकार ग्राहक — सबके सामने उत्पाद की सिफ़ारिश करने वाला
definition: a customer who publicly recommends your product without being paid to
example: She's such an advocate we should probably put her on payroll.

hindi: खाता कार्यकारी — सौदे चलाने और बंद करने वाला विक्रेता
definition: account executive — the salesperson who runs deals and closes them
example: The AE takes the meeting; the SDR who booked it gets a shout-out.

hindi: जहाँ तक मैं देख पा रहा हूँ — सीमित जानकारी पर आधारित राय
definition: as far as I can tell; hedge giving your understanding based on what you have checked so far
example: AFAICT nothing is broken, which is exactly what he said before the outage.

hindi: जहाँ तक मुझे पता है — पक्का दावा नहीं
definition: as far as I know — true to my knowledge, with an escape hatch
example: AFAIK nobody owns that dashboard anymore.

hindi: सहबद्ध विपणन — दूसरों को हर बिक्री पर कमीशन देकर उत्पाद बिकवाना
definition: paying outside publishers or creators commission for each sale arriving through their tracked referral links
example: Affiliate marketing is booming, mostly among coupon sites claiming credit for customers already at checkout.

hindi: समानता से समूह बनाना — शोध नोट्स को विषयों में छाँटना
definition: clustering research notes or sticky notes into related groups to find patterns and themes
example: Affinity mapping produced nine clusters, one of which was simply labelled 'misc, but angry'.

hindi: संकेत-गुण — रूप से ही उपयोग का तरीका बताने वाला गुण
definition: a design cue that suggests how something should be used
example: Flat buttons lost their affordance; users no longer know what's clickable.

hindi: कीबोर्ड से दूर — जवाब में देरी होगी
definition: away from keyboard — not at the desk, replies will lag
example: AFK for lunch; ping me only if production is on fire.

hindi: पुराना टिकट — तय समय से अधिक दिनों तक खुला पड़ा टिकट
definition: support ticket that has stayed open longer than the target resolution window, usually flagged on dashboards for managers
example: The oldest aged ticket in the queue has outlasted two support directors.

hindi: एजेंसी — डिज़ाइन, विज्ञापन जैसी सेवाएँ देने वाली बाहरी फर्म
definition: an external firm hired for services like design, marketing, or recruiting
example: We paid the agency six figures for a logo we redrew internally.

hindi: एजेंट — औज़ार लेकर कई क़दमों में काम निपटाने वाला एआई
definition: an AI system that plans and takes multi-step actions using tools, not just answers
example: The support agent resolved the refund, rescheduled the class, and cc'd nobody.

hindi: एजेंटों की भीड़ — बिना निगरानी के बढ़ते एआई एजेंट
definition: uncontrolled growth of automated agents across teams, with nobody tracking which ones exist, what they access or who owns them
example: We found forty bots in the audit; agent sprawl is the new spreadsheet sprawl.

hindi: स्वायत्त-कर्मी — लक्ष्य तक ख़ुद कई क़दम उठाने वाला
definition: acting with autonomy across multiple steps and tools to reach a goal
example: The roadmap says 'agentic' four times; the demo still books the wrong gym slot.

hindi: कृत्रिम सामान्य बुद्धि — अधिकांश मानवीय कामों में सक्षम काल्पनिक एआई
definition: artificial general intelligence; a hypothetical AI matching humans across most cognitive work
example: AGI timelines dominate lunch; the sprint board remains unmoved.

hindi: एजाइल — छोटे चक्रों में लचीले ढंग से काम करने की कार्यप्रणाली
definition: of software delivery done in short iterative cycles with frequent feedback rather than one big plan
example: We're agile now, which mostly means the meetings have new names.

hindi: बकाया-अवधि रिपोर्ट — बकाया चालानों को दिनों के हिसाब से बांटने वाली रिपोर्ट
definition: report grouping unpaid customer or supplier invoices by how many days overdue they are
example: The aging report's ninety-plus column is where optimism about certain clients goes to rest.

hindi: वार्षिक आम बैठक — साल में एक बार होने वाली शेयरधारकों की अनिवार्य बैठक
definition: annual general meeting; the yearly shareholder meeting where directors are elected, accounts presented and resolutions voted
example: The AGM lasted forty minutes, thirty of which were one shareholder asking about the canteen.

hindi: अहा क्षण — जब उपयोगकर्ता को उत्पाद की असली कीमत समझ आ जाए
definition: the instant a new user first grasps why the product matters
example: We moved the aha moment earlier; onboarding now takes only forty minutes.

hindi: औसत निपटान समय — एक ग्राहक-संपर्क पर लगने वाला औसत समय
definition: average handle time; the mean duration an agent spends on a single customer contact, including talking, hold time and wrap-up work
example: Management cut AHT by thirty seconds, mostly by removing the part where agents say goodbye.

hindi: एआई अभिशासन — संस्था में एआई के उपयोग पर नीतियाँ और निगरानी
definition: the policies, reviews, and accountability that control how an organization uses AI
example: AI governance now has its own committee, calendar, and acronym-filled charter.

hindi: एआई साक्षरता — एआई की क्षमता और सीमा की बुनियादी समझ
definition: baseline understanding of what AI can, cannot, and should not do
example: AI literacy training is mandatory now, mostly so people stop pasting secrets into chatbots.

hindi: एआई आदेश — कर्मचारियों को एआई इस्तेमाल करने का ऊपर से निर्देश
definition: a leadership directive requiring staff to adopt artificial intelligence tools, sometimes tracked in performance reviews
example: After the AI mandate, every status update began with 'the assistant and I'.

hindi: बैठक का मशीनी लिपिक — मीटिंग रिकॉर्ड कर सारांश बनाने वाला बॉट
definition: an automated meeting attendee that records, transcribes and summarises calls, often joining before the humans arrive
example: Three AI notetakers joined the call, so the meeting had more bots than decision makers.

hindi: एआई कचरा — हर जगह पटा घटिया मशीनी कंटेंट
definition: low-quality machine-generated content flooding feeds, inboxes, and search results
example: The blog's traffic died after two months of AI slop; who could have guessed.

hindi: एआई दिखावा — असर से ज़्यादा प्रदर्शन वाली एआई पहल
definition: visible artificial intelligence initiatives staged for executives or investors that change little about how work gets done
example: Every team demoed a chatbot at the offsite; the AI theater got a standing ovation and zero users.

hindi: एआई का मुलम्मा — साधारण उत्पाद को एआई वाला बताकर बेचना
definition: overstating how much artificial intelligence a product really contains, to impress buyers, investors or the board
example: Calling the if-statement a reasoning engine was AI washing, but the press release loved it.

hindi: एआई आवरण — दूसरों के मॉडल पर चढ़ाया पतला उत्पाद-ख़ोल
definition: a product that is mostly a thin interface over someone else's model
example: 'Just an AI wrapper', says the competitor with the identical AI wrapper.

hindi: एआई-प्रथम — शुरुआत से ही एआई को केंद्र में रखकर डिज़ाइन
definition: designing products and workflows around AI capabilities from the start, not bolting them on
example: Going AI-first means the app plans your training week before you open it.

hindi: एआई-निर्मित — इंसान नहीं, मॉडल का बनाया हुआ
definition: produced by a model rather than a person, ideally labeled as such
example: The AI-generated meal plans are fine; the AI-generated motivational poetry was a mistake.

hindi: एआई-जन्मा — शुरुआत से ही एआई के इर्द-गिर्द बना
definition: built from the start around artificial intelligence rather than adding model features onto an older product later
example: The startup calls itself AI-native, meaning it was founded eleven months ago.

hindi: एआई-चालित — मार्केटिंग का ठप्पा कि उत्पाद में एआई है
definition: a marketing label claiming artificial intelligence drives a product, regardless of how much of the product actually relies on it
example: The toaster is now AI-powered, which mostly means the box is more expensive.

hindi: एआई-सुरक्षित — जिसे एआई आसानी से न कर सके
definition: describing roles, skills or businesses considered safe from replacement or disruption by artificial intelligence
example: Every career talk now ends with someone asking which roles are AI-proof.

hindi: संकेत-सहित पहचान — नाम दिखाने पर ब्रांड पहचान लेना
definition: the share of surveyed people who recognise a brand when shown its name or logo in a list, a softer measure than recall
example: Aided awareness is ninety percent, which mostly proves people can read a logo.

hindi: हवाई सुरक्षा — वरिष्ठ द्वारा टीम को आलोचना और दख़ल से बचाना
definition: protection a senior leader gives a team or project against criticism, interference or political attack from elsewhere
example: I'll give you air cover with finance; just ship something before they find the invoice.

hindi: बोलने का समय — मीटिंग में किसे कितना बोलने को मिला
definition: the share of speaking time each person gets during a meeting or discussion
example: He took ninety percent of the airtime and then asked why nobody else contributed.

hindi: चेतावनियों से थकान — इतनी चेतावनियाँ कि असली ख़तरा भी अनदेखा होने लगे
definition: numbness that sets in when engineers receive so many noisy alerts that they start ignoring the important ones
example: Alert fatigue set in around the fortieth page about a disk that was fine.

hindi: चेतावनियों की बौछार — एक ही गड़बड़ी से एक साथ सैकड़ों चेतावनियाँ आ जाना
definition: a flood of alerts firing together, usually because one underlying failure triggers every downstream monitoring check at once
example: The alert storm made it impossible to tell which of the two hundred pages was the actual problem.

hindi: संरेखण — एआई के व्यवहार को मानवीय मंशा और मूल्यों से मिलाना
definition: making an AI system's behavior match human intent and values
example: Alignment question of the week: should the coach push harder or protect your knees?

hindi: पूर्ण सभा — पूरी कंपनी की बैठक
definition: a meeting for the entire company
example: The all-hands announced record growth and a hiring freeze.

hindi: प्रारंभिक परीक्षण संस्करण — अधूरा, भीतरखाने आज़माने लायक रूप
definition: an early, rough version tested internally or by the brave
example: The alpha crashes on launch, which technically prevents all other bugs.

hindi: वैकल्पिक पाठ — चित्र का शब्दों में वर्णन, जो देख न सकें उनके लिए
definition: the written description of an image for those who can't see it
example: The alt text says 'image123.png', which is technically a description.

hindi: हमेशा सौदा पक्का करो — हर बातचीत को बिक्री की ओर मोड़ने का सेल्स मंत्र
definition: the sales mantra that every conversation with a prospect should push steadily toward a signed contract
example: He took always be closing literally and tried to upsell the caterer at the team lunch.

hindi: सदा-उपलब्ध — हर घड़ी संपर्क की अपेक्षा
definition: expected to be reachable at any hour
example: Always-on culture means the phone buzzes on the beach too.

hindi: कुछ भी पूछो सत्र — नेतृत्व से खुले सवाल
definition: ask me anything; an open question session with a leader
example: The CTO's AMA filled with anonymous questions in one minute.

hindi: धन-शोधन निरोध — अवैध पैसे को वैध बनाने से रोकने के नियम
definition: anti-money laundering; the regulations and monitoring controls that detect and report suspicious financial transactions and illicit funds
example: The AML system flagged the founder's own wire transfer, which compliance considered a good sign.

hindi: किश्तों में बाँटना — लागत को समय के साथ फैलाना
definition: to spread a cost over time
example: We amortize the rewrite's cost across every roadmap it delayed.

hindi: वैकल्पिक न्यूनतम कर — विकल्प प्रयोग पर लगने वाला छिपा अमेरिकी कर
definition: alternative minimum tax; an American parallel calculation that can bill employees taxation for exercising incentive options they cannot sell
example: She exercised her options in April and met the AMT in the following April.

hindi: विश्लेषण में जड़ता — इतना सोचना कि फ़ैसला ही न हो
definition: overthinking that prevents any decision
example: Six spreadsheets later, analysis paralysis won again.

hindi: निर्धारित दफ़्तर-दिवस — सब साथ आने का दिन
definition: a designated weekday when hybrid teammates come in together
example: Tuesday is anchor day, so book the good conference room early.

hindi: मुख्य आधार निवेशक — बड़ा चेक जो बाकी निवेशकों को आकर्षित करे
definition: an investor committing a large early check that signals confidence and attracts other investors into the round
example: Once the anchor investor signed, the funds that had passed twice suddenly found room in their calendars.

hindi: पहला आँकड़ा रखना — मोलभाव में पहली कीमत से पूरी बातचीत की दिशा तय करना
definition: stating the first number in a negotiation so every later offer gets measured against that starting price
example: She opened at triple the list price, which she called anchoring and finance called optimism.

hindi: रोक-रस्सी — समस्या दिखते ही उत्पादन रोकने का संकेत
definition: a signal any worker can pull to stop the production line when spotting a defect or problem
example: The new hire pulled the andon cord on day one and was promptly promoted to hero.

hindi: किस्सा-आँकड़ा — कहानियों को डेटा की तरह पेश करना
definition: anecdotes dressed up and presented as data
example: Three customer emails is anecdata, not a trend, per the data team.

hindi: देवदूत निवेशक — शुरुआती स्टार्टअप में अपना पैसा लगाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an individual who invests personal money in very early startups
example: Our first angel investor was the founder's old boss, oddly forgiving.

hindi: बाज़ार का मनोबल — निवेश को चलाने वाला भावनात्मक आत्मविश्वास या डर
definition: the emotional confidence or fear driving investment decisions beyond rational calculation
example: Nothing in the numbers changed; the animal spirits simply woke up after lunch.

hindi: टिप्पणी-अंकन — डेटा पर लेबल, नोट या श्रेणियाँ जोड़ना
definition: adding labels, notes, or categories to data for training or evaluation
example: The annotation guidelines run forty pages, mostly about what counts as a rep.

hindi: विसंगति — सामान्य पैटर्न से अनपेक्षित भटकाव
definition: an unexpected deviation from the normal pattern in data
example: The anomaly was a bot; the celebration was genuine.

hindi: विसंगति पहचान — सामान्य ढर्रे से हटी चीज़ें अपने-आप पकड़ना
definition: automatically spotting data points that deviate from the normal pattern
example: Anomaly detection flagged your heart rate spike; turns out it was just leg day.

hindi: अनामीकरण — डेटा से पहचान बताने वाले सुराग़ हटाना
definition: stripping data of anything that could identify the person behind it
example: Anonymization first, analysis second — the research team never sees names, just squats.

hindi: विकास-दिशा खाका — नए/पुराने बाज़ार और उत्पाद से विकास के चार रास्ते
definition: a growth-strategy grid comparing existing and novel products against existing and novel markets to choose between penetration, development and diversification
example: The Ansoff matrix put the new venture in the diversification box, also known as the expensive box.

hindi: पहले उत्तर — बात की शुरुआत निष्कर्ष से करना
definition: communicating by stating the recommendation or conclusion upfront, then providing the supporting reasoning only as needed
example: She briefed the CEO answer first, so the meeting ended in four minutes and the remaining fifty were spent defending it.

hindi: हिस्सेदारी सुरक्षा शर्त — घटी क़ीमत के दौर में निवेशक का बचाव
definition: a term protecting investors' stakes if the company later raises at a lower price
example: The anti-dilution clause seemed harmless until the down round arrived.

hindi: कुप्रथा — आम पर हानिकारक समाधान-शैली
definition: a common solution that reliably causes more problems than it solves
example: We documented the anti-pattern, right after shipping it.

hindi: कोई प्रगति? — काम कहाँ तक पहुँचा
definition: the polite prod asking where the thing you promised is
example: Any update? The client asked me, so I'm asking you.

hindi: अन्य विषय — एजेंडा के अंत में बची हुई कोई भी बात
definition: any other business; the final agenda slot for topics not listed, where surprises often appear
example: Under AOB, someone casually announced the office was moving.

hindi: वार्षिक परिचालन योजना — अगले साल का स्वीकृत बजट और लक्ष्य दस्तावेज़
definition: annual operating plan; the approved yearly budget and targets that every later forecast gets measured against
example: The AOP was signed in December and quietly abandoned in February.

hindi: औसत ऑर्डर मूल्य — हर ऑर्डर की औसत रकम
definition: average order value
example: Free shipping raised AOV and quietly ate the margin.

hindi: सहायक प्रोडक्ट मैनेजर — प्रोडक्ट मैनेजमेंट का शुरुआती पद
definition: associate product manager; entry-level product management role, often a rotational program for recent graduates learning the craft
example: The APM rewrote the strategy doc on day three, which was brave.

hindi: मूल्यांकन चक्र — सालाना समीक्षा और वेतन-वृद्धि का दौर
definition: in Indian English, the yearly performance review season that decides ratings, salary hikes and promotions
example: Everyone becomes remarkably visible in the month before the appraisal cycle.

hindi: मंज़ूरी शृंखला — फ़ैसले के लिए ज़रूरी अनुमतियों की कतार
definition: the sequence of people who must approve something
example: The approval chain has six links and one person on vacation.

hindi: स्वीकृत विक्रेता सूची — जिन आपूर्तिकर्ताओं से खरीद की अनुमति है
definition: the official register of suppliers that procurement has vetted and approved, which teams must purchase from
example: The tool you want is great, but it isn't on the approved vendor list, so it doesn't exist.

hindi: अमूर्त ढाँचों में खोया इंजीनियर — इतना सामान्य डिज़ाइन कि असल समस्या छूट जाए
definition: an engineer who designs abstract, overly general systems far removed from solving the actual practical problem
example: The architecture astronaut proposed a plugin framework for our two-field login form.

hindi: प्रति उपयोगकर्ता औसत राजस्व — हर उपयोगकर्ता से औसत कमाई
definition: average revenue per user
example: ARPU rose because the free users left, which is one way.

hindi: वार्षिक आवर्ती राजस्व — सालाना दोहराई जाने वाली सब्सक्रिप्शन कमाई
definition: annual recurring revenue; subscription revenue normalized to a yearly figure
example: ARR is up; please do not annualize last Tuesday.

hindi: जैसा चर्चा हुई — पिछली बातचीत का हवाला
definition: invoking an earlier conversation so its outcome counts as agreed
example: As discussed, the demo moves to Thursday.

hindi: के अनुसार — दफ़्तरी हवाला
definition: according to — office formalese for citing a source or agreement
example: As per policy, travel above economy needs a director's blessing.

hindi: जल्द से जल्द — फ़ौरन चाहिए
definition: as soon as possible — urgent, but the deadline is your problem
example: Need the signed copy ASAP; the courier leaves at four.

hindi: अग्रिम प्रेषण सूचना — माल पहुँचने से पहले उसका पूरा ब्यौरा भेजना
definition: advance shipping notice; the electronic message telling a receiver exactly what is arriving, when and in which cartons
example: The ASN promised twenty cartons; the truck delivered nineteen and a shrug.

hindi: ऐप-बाज़ार अनुकूलन — ऐप की खोज और डाउनलोड बढ़ाने के लिए उसके पन्ने में सुधार
definition: app store optimisation; improving application store titles, keywords, screenshots and ratings to increase organic downloads
example: ASO meant rewriting the subtitle eleven times and begging support to reply to one-star reviews.

hindi: हस्तांतरण खंड — अनुबंध किसी और को सौंपने के नियम
definition: the provision controlling whether a party may transfer its contract rights and obligations to another company, often after an acquisition
example: The acquirer found forty contracts whose assignment clause required customer consent, which is how integration got a fourth quarter.

hindi: सहायक — सवालों के जवाब देने और काम निपटाने वाला संवादी एआई
definition: a conversational AI product that answers questions and completes tasks for users
example: Users tell the assistant things they'd never tell their trainer, starting with the truth.

hindi: धारणा-चित्रण — किन मान्यताओं पर उत्पाद टिका है, उन्हें जोखिम के हिसाब से छाँटना
definition: a discovery exercise listing the beliefs a product idea depends on, then ranking them by importance and evidence to test first
example: Assumption mapping revealed the whole plan rested on customers reading onboarding emails.

hindi: मानकर चलना — ऐसे बात करना जैसे ग्राहक ख़रीद चुका है
definition: a closing technique where the seller speaks as though the buyer has already agreed, asking only about details
example: The assumptive close fell apart when he asked which invoice address and they asked which product.

hindi: असमकालिक — सबकी एक-साथ मौजूदगी के बिना
definition: done without needing everyone present at the same time
example: Let's make the status update async and cancel the call.

hindi: लिखित दैनिक अपडेट — मीटिंग के बजाय चैट में रोज़ का प्रगति-संदेश
definition: daily standup replaced by written progress updates posted in a chat channel rather than a live meeting
example: The async standup says everyone is on track, written between nine and eleven in four different timezones.

hindi: असमकालिक-प्रथम — पहले लिखित संवाद, फिर बैठक
definition: defaulting to written, non-simultaneous communication before booking meetings
example: Async-first means the doc goes out before any invite does.

hindi: क्षमता पूरी — अब और काम लेने की गुंजाइश नहीं
definition: saying you have no remaining time or energy to take on additional work right now
example: She said she was at capacity, and her manager heard 'please add a stretch goal'.

hindi: जोखिम में — समयसीमा चूकने की आशंका वाला
definition: in danger of missing its date, the polite word before slipping
example: The launch is at risk, which everyone heard as late.

hindi: छँटनी के खतरे में — ब्रिटिश उपयोग में संभावित निकासी की औपचारिक सूचना
definition: in British usage, employees formally told their roles may be eliminated, pending consultation
example: Being at risk of redundancy meant three weeks of meetings about whether he'd have meetings.

term: at the end of the day
hindi: आख़िरकार — सब जोड़-घटाकर असल बात
definition: when everything is considered; signals a conclusion is coming
example: At the end of the day, someone still has to ship it.

hindi: बिना कारण बताए नौकरी समाप्त की जा सकने वाली व्यवस्था
definition: employment either side can end at any time, for almost any reason
example: The handbook celebrates loyalty; page two explains at-will employment.

hindi: जनसंचार विज्ञापन — टीवी, रेडियो, अख़बार जैसे व्यापक माध्यम
definition: above the line; mass-media advertising such as television, radio, print and cinema that builds broad awareness rather than targeting individuals
example: The ATL budget went on one cricket-match slot, and the whole office watched it together.

hindi: एक-काम वाला कमिट — ऐसा बदलाव जो सिर्फ़ एक तार्किक काम करे और अकेले पलटा जा सके
definition: a commit containing exactly one logical change, small enough to review, understand and revert on its own
example: Please make atomic commits; 'fixed stuff' touching ninety files is not one idea.

hindi: आणविक डिज़ाइन — अणु से पेज तक घटक जोड़ने की पद्धति
definition: building UIs from small parts up: atoms, molecules, organisms, pages
example: Atomic design is great until someone asks what an organism is.

hindi: आवेदन ट्रैक करने वाला सॉफ्टवेयर — रिज़्यूमे छाँटने की प्रणाली
definition: applicant tracking system; software that stores, filters, and often rejects resumes
example: Tailor the resume keywords or the ATS will never let a human see it.

hindi: इसके साथ संलग्न — भारतीय औपचारिक ईमेल में संलग्नक की सूचना
definition: formal Indian English email phrase announcing an attachment, as in 'please find attached herewith'
example: Please find attached herewith the file, he wrote, attaching nothing.

hindi: श्रेय-निर्धारण — किस चैनल या कदम से नतीजा आया, यह तय करना
definition: deciding which touchpoint gets credit for a conversion
example: Attribution says the blog did it; the blog was down that week.

hindi: श्रेय अवधि — क्लिक या दर्शन के बाद कितने दिनों तक बिक्री का श्रेय विज्ञापन को मिले
definition: the number of days after an advertisement click or view during which a later conversion still counts toward that advertisement
example: Stretch the attribution window to ninety days and suddenly every campaign we ever ran was profitable.

hindi: कर्मचारियों का धीरे-धीरे स्वाभाविक रूप से छोड़ते जाना
definition: the gradual loss of employees who leave and aren't always replaced
example: No layoffs needed; attrition and a hiring freeze did it quietly.

hindi: दर्शक टिकाव — वीडियो में कितने लोग कब तक बने रहे
definition: percentage of viewers still watching at each moment of a video, showing where audiences drop away
example: The audience retention graph fell off a cliff at the exact second the sponsor segment began.

hindi: लेखापरीक्षा समिति — वित्तीय रिपोर्टिंग और ऑडिटरों की निगरानी करने वाली बोर्ड समिति
definition: the board committee of independent directors that oversees financial reporting, internal controls and the external auditors
example: The audit committee asked why revenue spiked on the last day of every quarter, and finance asked for more time.

hindi: जाँच-निशान — किसने कब क्या किया, इसका रिकॉर्ड
definition: a record of who did what and when
example: The audit trail shows exactly who deleted the audit trail.

hindi: सम्वर्धन — इंसान की जगह लेने के बजाय उसका काम बेहतर बनाना
definition: using AI to make people better at their jobs rather than replace them
example: The pitch says augmentation, not automation — the trainers remain cautiously optimistic.

hindi: स्वीकार्य उपयोग नीति — कंपनी के टूल कैसे इस्तेमाल हों, इसके नियम
definition: acceptable use policy; the company rules on permitted usage of its tools and systems, now including which information staff may paste into chatbots
example: The AUP says no client data in chatbots, which everyone learned after pasting client data into chatbots.

hindi: ब्रांड की अपनी सस्ती प्रति — पेटेंट ख़त्म होने पर कंपनी का ही जेनेरिक
definition: a cheaper generic version of a branded drug launched by the patent holder itself to capture share after exclusivity expires
example: Nothing says we saw the generics coming like launching our own authorized generic the same morning.

hindi: स्वतः रद्दीकरण — चेक-इन न होने पर आरक्षण अपने-आप छूट जाना
definition: automatic cancellation of a room or desk booking when nobody checks in within a few minutes of the start
example: Auto-release freed the room just as the VP arrived, now standing outside a meeting he booked.

hindi: स्वचालन — बिना इंसानी हाथ लगाए काम पूरा करवाना
definition: having software do a task end to end without a person in it
example: We automated the weekly progress email; unsubscribes automated themselves shortly after.

hindi: प्रमाणित ज़िम्मेदार कंपनी — सामाजिक-पर्यावरणीय मानकों पर खरी उतरी प्रमाणित कंपनी
definition: a company certified by the nonprofit B Lab as meeting verified standards of social and environmental performance, transparency and legal accountability to stakeholders
example: Becoming a B Corp took two years of paperwork and one very long argument about the vending machines.

hindi: व्यवसाय-से-व्यवसाय — कंपनियों को बेचना, आम उपभोक्ता को नहीं
definition: business-to-business; selling to companies rather than consumers
example: We went B2B because companies complain less and pay more.

hindi: व्यवसाय-से-उपभोक्ता — सीधे आम ग्राहकों को बेचना
definition: business-to-consumer; selling directly to individual customers
example: B2C means millions of tiny customers and one very loud app store.

hindi: व्यावसायिक सहयोगी अनुबंध — अमेरिकी स्वास्थ्य डेटा संभालने वाले वेंडर का अनुबंध
definition: business associate agreement; the contract required under HIPAA before a vendor may handle protected health information for a healthcare customer
example: The hospital loved our product but not our lack of a BAA.

hindi: उत्तरार्ध-भारी — साल की कमाई ज़्यादातर आख़िरी छह महीनों में
definition: describing an annual plan expecting most revenue or profit during the second half of the fiscal year
example: The plan is back-half loaded, which means the first half is officially someone else's problem.

hindi: लगातार बैठकें — बिना अंतराल एक के बाद एक
definition: scheduled with no gap between meetings
example: I'm back-to-back until four; can this be async?

hindi: अंत में भारी हिस्सेदारी — ज़्यादातर शेयर अंतिम वर्षों में मिलना
definition: a vesting schedule that releases small slices of granted equity early and the largest portions in the final years
example: With back-weighted vesting, year one pays for lunch and year four pays for the house.

hindi: ठंडे बस्ते में डालना — काम टालकर पीछे रखना
definition: to postpone something indefinitely without officially killing it
example: We backburnered the redesign; the burner has a waiting list.

hindi: आधिकारिक संदर्भों के बाहर चुपचाप राय जुटाना
definition: to quietly gather opinions on a candidate outside their offered references
example: The official references were great, but someone backchanneled a former teammate.

hindi: गए हुए कर्मचारी की जगह नई भर्ती
definition: a hire made to replace someone who left, not to grow the team
example: She quit in March; the backfill was approved in September.

hindi: बैकलॉग — बचे हुए कामों की प्राथमिकता-क्रम सूची
definition: the ordered list of all work a team intends to do someday
example: It's in the backlog, right between hope and never.

hindi: बैकलॉग सँवारना — कार्य-सूची छाँटने और क्रम देने की बैठक
definition: a session to clean up, estimate, and reorder backlog items
example: Backlog grooming ran long, so the backlog remains ungroomed.

hindi: प्रस्ताव से पीछे हटना — स्वीकृति के बाद उम्मीदवार का न आना
definition: in Indian English, a candidate withdrawing after accepting an offer, usually for a better competing offer
example: Recruiting now plans for a twenty percent backout rate and offers accordingly.

hindi: पुराने संस्करण में लाना — नए कोड का सुधार पुराने समर्थित संस्करण पर भी लगाना
definition: to copy a correction or security patch from the current codebase into an older supported version customers still use
example: We backported the security patch to four versions, including one sales promised was retired.

hindi: सहायक स्लाइड — मुख्य प्रस्तुति के पीछे रखी विस्तृत स्लाइड
definition: a detailed supporting slide kept in the appendix, shown only when someone questions the numbers on a main slide
example: The CFO skipped the main deck and went straight to backup slide sixty-three.

hindi: पिछड़ा-संगत — पुराने संस्करणों के साथ बिना तोड़े चलने वाला
definition: still working with older versions, data, or clients
example: It's backwards compatible with everything except our oldest customer.

hindi: संदिग्ध ऋण प्रावधान — न वसूल हो सकने वाली राशि के लिए अलग रखा अनुमान
definition: an estimated amount set aside against receivables the company expects never to collect from customers
example: We raised the bad debt reserve after the client's CFO stopped answering emails and changed his LinkedIn to 'open to work'.

hindi: कार्ड रिकॉर्ड — प्रवेश कार्ड से निकले उपस्थिति आँकड़े
definition: attendance records pulled from office access card swipes, used to measure occupancy and track office attendance
example: Badge data proved I was in the office Tuesday; it could not prove I did anything there.

hindi: कार्ड से हाज़िरी — दफ़्तर के गेट पर कार्ड स्वाइप कर उपस्थिति दर्ज करना
definition: swipe your access card at the office entrance so the system records your attendance toward the return-to-office policy
example: Remember to badge in before the coffee, or the attendance report thinks you worked from home.

hindi: सर्वोत्तम और अंतिम पेशकश — बातचीत के आख़िर में विक्रेता का आख़िरी, सबसे कम भाव
definition: best and final offer; the last revised price a shortlisted vendor submits when procurement asks for final bids
example: Their BAFO was final in the sense that they sent two more after it.

hindi: आमने-सामने मूल्यांकन — कई विक्रेताओं की सीधी तुलना
definition: a head-to-head evaluation where a customer trials competing vendors
example: We're in a bake-off against two rivals and the customer's intern's side project.

hindi: मोटा अनुमान — लगभग कितना होगा, का अंदाज़ा
definition: a rough estimate
example: Ballpark the cost; nobody will hold you to it, officially.

hindi: वेतन-सीमा — किसी स्तर के लिए तय न्यूनतम-अधिकतम दायरा
definition: the salary range attached to a given level or role
example: HR loved the work, but the raise would exceed the band.

hindi: पट्टी-मरहम — मर्ज़ नहीं, बस लक्षण ढकने वाला इलाज
definition: a superficial patch that covers the symptom while the disease continues
example: Another band-aid fix; the wound underneath now has its own team.

hindi: काम की गुंजाइश — और काम लेने की क्षमता
definition: spare capacity to take on more work
example: I'd love to help, but I have zero bandwidth this week.

hindi: विज्ञापन-अंधापन — लोगों का वेबसाइट पर विज्ञापन जैसी दिखने वाली हर चीज़ को अनदेखा कर देना
definition: visitors habitually ignoring anything on screen that looks like advertising, including important messages placed there
example: Banner blindness explains why nobody saw the outage notice styled exactly like a promotion.

hindi: बजट, अधिकार, ज़रूरत, समयसीमा — लीड परखने की कसौटी
definition: budget, authority, need, timeline — a checklist for qualifying leads
example: It passed BANT except budget, authority, and timeline.

hindi: भर्ती-गुणवत्ता की रक्षा करने वाला तटस्थ इंटरव्यूअर
definition: an interviewer from outside the team empowered to veto hires to protect quality
example: Everyone said yes except the bar raiser, so it was no.

hindi: मूल अनुमान — सबसे संभावित मान्यताओं पर बना पूर्वानुमान
definition: the central forecast built on the most likely assumptions, against which upside and downside scenarios are compared
example: The base case assumed thirty percent growth, which made the downside case merely heroic.

hindi: मूल मॉडल — फ़ाइन-ट्यूनिंग से पहले का कच्चा प्रशिक्षित मॉडल
definition: a pretrained model before fine-tuning or safety training shapes it for a product
example: The base model knows everything about deadlifts and nothing about being polite.

hindi: आधार रेखा — बदलाव से पहले का स्तर, तुलना का आधार
definition: the starting measurement any change gets compared against
example: Impressive growth, until someone asked what the baseline was.

hindi: आधार अंक — प्रतिशत का सौवाँ हिस्सा, दरों और मार्जिन की इकाई
definition: one hundredth of a percentage point, the standard unit finance uses when quoting interest rates, yields and margins
example: Finance spent an hour debating twenty-five basis points and five minutes on the reorg.

hindi: समझौते का सबसे अच्छा विकल्प — सौदा न होने पर आपके पास बचा सबसे अच्छा रास्ता
definition: best alternative to a negotiated agreement; the fallback option that decides how hard each side can push in negotiation
example: Their BATNA was a spreadsheet and an intern, so we held firm on price.

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धा-पत्रक — प्रतिद्वंद्वी के विरुद्ध बिक्री तर्क
definition: a cheat sheet telling reps how to sell against a specific competitor
example: The battlecard says never mention them first; the prospect always mentions them first.

hindi: यथावत कार्य — पहल से अलग, नियमित चालू काम
definition: business as usual; the routine work that continues regardless of initiatives
example: That's BAU, so it gets no ticket, no glory, no end.

hindi: छुपी प्रतिलिपि भेजना — औरों को दिखे बिना
definition: to copy someone invisibly; recipients cannot see they were included
example: Moving the vendor to bcc so we can speak freely.

hindi: वृद्धि-हिस्सेदारी खाका — बाज़ार वृद्धि और हिस्सेदारी पर उत्पादों का वर्गीकरण
definition: a growth-share chart sorting business units by market growth and relative market share into stars, cash cows, question marks and dogs
example: On the BCG matrix, his pet project landed firmly among the dogs, so the axes were redrawn.

hindi: व्यवसाय विकास प्रतिनिधि — ठंडे संपर्क से अवसर बनाने वाला
definition: business development representative — like an SDR, usually focused on outbound prospecting
example: Ask three companies the difference between BDR and SDR; get four answers.

hindi: अग्रिम मोर्चा बाज़ार — पहले छोटा बाज़ार जीतो, फिर फैलो
definition: the small first market you dominate before expanding outward
example: Our beachhead market is dentists in Pune; the world comes later.

hindi: हिसाब-किताब वाला — ख़र्च पर नज़र रखने वाले वित्त-कर्मी का व्यंग्य नाम
definition: a mildly rude nickname for a finance person focused on costs
example: The bean counters found the unused licenses before we did.

hindi: दबाव-भरा प्रस्ताव — इतनी ऊँची बोली कि बोर्ड के लिए ठुकराना कठिन हो
definition: an unsolicited takeover offer priced so generously that the target's board struggles to refuse it publicly
example: The bear hug letter was warm, public and timed to arrive before the earnings call.

hindi: उम्मीद से बेहतर, अनुमान ऊँचा — नतीजे आगे निकलना और आगे का लक्ष्य बढ़ाना
definition: reporting results above forecast and raising the future forecast in the same announcement
example: A beat and raise quarter makes finance heroes, and next year's targets impossible.

hindi: व्यवहारिक साक्षात्कार — पिछले अनुभवों से भविष्य का आचरण परखना
definition: an interview asking candidates to describe past situations to predict future workplace behavior
example: The behavioral interview asked for a time he handled conflict, and he described this interview process.

hindi: घंटी वक्र — रेटिंग को तय अनुपात में बाँटने की व्यवस्था
definition: the practice of fitting employee performance ratings to a normal distribution, capping the number who receive high ratings
example: 'You were great, but the bell curve was full,' said the manager, shrugging at statistics.

hindi: तामझाम — ज़रूरी नहीं, दिखावटी अतिरिक्त सुविधाएँ
definition: attractive extra features that are not essential
example: Ship the basics first; bells and whistles can wait.

hindi: रेखा के नीचे — परिचालन मुनाफ़े के बाद दर्ज होने वाली मदें
definition: in accounting, items recorded after operating profit, such as interest, taxes and one-time gains or losses
example: Leadership was delighted to learn the lawsuit settlement sits below the line.

hindi: बिना प्रोजेक्ट के प्रतीक्षारत कर्मचारी-समूह
definition: staff between projects, kept employed but unassigned
example: Two months on the bench taught him every conference room's name.

hindi: खाली-बैठक नियम — बिना प्रोजेक्ट बैठे कर्मचारी की अधिकतम अवधि तय करने वाली नीति
definition: in Indian English, company rule capping how many days an unassigned, unbilled employee may stay without project allocation before exit proceedings start
example: Nobody reads the bench policy until day forty-five, when it suddenly becomes gripping literature.

hindi: मानक — तुलना के लिए उद्योग या प्रतिस्पर्धी का स्तर
definition: an external reference point used to judge whether your numbers are good
example: We beat the industry benchmark once we picked a different industry.

hindi: सर्वोत्तम स्थिति — संभव पर अनिश्चित सौदों की पूर्वानुमान श्रेणी
definition: forecast category for deals that could close this quarter if things break well, but aren't promised
example: Best case is where deals go to be optimistic without anyone being held accountable.

hindi: श्रेष्ठ तरीक़ा — आज़माया हुआ मानक तरीक़ा
definition: the accepted standard way of doing something, wherever it was actually proven
example: Code review before merge is best practice, even on Fridays.

hindi: परीक्षण-पूर्व संस्करण — सीमित दर्शकों के लिए लगभग-तैयार रूप
definition: a nearly finished version released to a limited audience for testing
example: It's been in beta for three years; commitment issues, probably.

hindi: पृष्ठभूमि सत्यापन — शिक्षा, पिछली नौकरियों और रिकॉर्ड की जाँच
definition: background verification; Indian English for checking a newly hired employee's education, employment history and records
example: The BGV vendor called his college, which asked why anyone still cared.

hindi: बड़ा, साहसी, दुस्साहसी लक्ष्य — दस-तीस साल का प्रेरक दीर्घकालिक ध्येय
definition: big hairy audacious goal; a bold, long-range company ambition meant to unify effort for a decade or more
example: The BHAG is to redefine global logistics; the quarterly goal is to fix the login page.

hindi: व्यावसायिक समझ — डेटा से रिपोर्ट और डैशबोर्ड बनाकर फ़ैसलों में मदद करने का काम
definition: business intelligence; the tools, dashboards and reporting teams that turn company data into information for business decisions
example: Ask the BI team, they'll build a dashboard, and then you'll export it to Excel anyway.

hindi: पूर्वाग्रह — झुके हुए डेटा से सीखी गई व्यवस्थागत नाइंसाफ़ी
definition: systematic unfairness a model learns from skewed training data
example: The model assumed all lifters are 25-year-old men — bias straight from the training data.

hindi: कर्म-प्रवृत्ति — ज़्यादा विचार के बजाय सोच-समझकर जल्दी क़दम उठाना
definition: principle that speed matters and many decisions are reversible, so teams should act without waiting for perfect information
example: Bias for action, she said, scheduling a meeting to plan the kickoff meeting.

hindi: कीचड़ का गोला — बिना किसी ढाँचे का लिथड़ा हुआ सिस्टम
definition: a system with no discernible architecture, just accumulated mud
example: The architecture diagram is honest: one big ball of mud.

hindi: एक-झटके में — सब कुछ एक साथ जारी करना
definition: launching everything to everyone at once, no stages, no retreat
example: We chose a big bang release, and the name proved apt.

hindi: एक साथ सारी हानि — बुरे साल में सभी घाटे व कटौतियाँ एक बार में दर्ज करना
definition: taking every possible loss, write-down and charge in a single already-weak period so future results look stronger
example: The new CEO's first quarter was a big bath, conveniently making every later quarter look heroic.

hindi: चार बड़ी फ़र्में — डेलॉइट, पीडब्ल्यूसी, ईवाई और केपीएमजी
definition: the four largest accounting and professional services firms: Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG
example: Every Big Four firm pitched the audit, and every deck had the same stock photo.

hindi: केंद्रीय रचनात्मक विचार — पूरा अभियान जिस एक सोच पर टिका हो
definition: the single central creative concept that unifies every execution of a campaign across channels and makes the message memorable
example: The agency's big idea was a hashtag, which we were told would carry the entire budget.

hindi: बड़ी तस्वीर — ब्योरों से ऊपर उठकर समग्र नज़रिया
definition: the overall view above the details
example: Zoom out to the big picture before we argue button colors.

hindi: बड़ा पत्थर — तिमाही का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण भारी काम
definition: one of the few large priorities a team commits to first
example: Migrations are this quarter's big rock; everything else is gravel.

hindi: एकमुश्त धमाका रिलीज़ — सब कुछ एक साथ जारी करना
definition: shipping everything at once instead of incrementally, maximizing suspense and risk
example: The big-bang release went fine, if you don't count the outage.

hindi: छोटी बात पर लंबी बहस — बड़े मुद्दे छोड़ तुच्छ विवरण पर अटकना
definition: debating trivial details at length while the hard decisions go untouched
example: An hour of bikeshedding over the function name, zero minutes on the data model.

hindi: बिल-योग्य — ग्राहक से वसूला जा सकने वाला समय या काम
definition: chargeable to a client, as in billable hours
example: For the agency, listening to our complaints is billable.

hindi: शुल्क-योग्य घंटे — वे घंटे जिनका पैसा ग्राहक से वसूला जाता है
definition: hours of consultant work charged to a client, the basic unit of consulting revenue and staff performance
example: He logged forty billable hours and one unbillable nervous breakdown.

hindi: प्रति घंटा शुल्क दर — एक कर्मचारी के काम के लिए ग्राहक से ली जाने वाली रकम
definition: hourly or monthly amount charged to the client for each engineer, usually several times what that engineer is actually paid
example: He found out his billing rate once and has never looked at his payslip the same way.

hindi: चालान राशि — किसी अवधि में ग्राहकों को भेजे गए बिलों का कुल जोड़
definition: total amount invoiced to customers during a period, sitting between signed bookings and recognised revenue
example: Billings spiked in December because we asked everyone to prepay, not because anyone loved us more.

hindi: आधार अंक — प्रतिशत का सौवाँ हिस्सा, बोलचाल में
definition: basis points, spoken; hundredths of a percentage point used for rates, spreads and fees
example: Traders argue over two bips with more passion than most people bring to their weddings.

hindi: आधा-आधा खोजना — इतिहास बाँटते हुए बिगाड़ने वाला कमिट पकड़ना
definition: to find the commit that broke things by halving the history repeatedly
example: Two hundred commits, eight bisect steps, one guilty one-liner.

hindi: कोड का क्षय — अनछुआ कोड समय के साथ खुद बिगड़ना
definition: the gradual decay of untouched code as the world changes around it
example: Nobody edited it for five years; the bit rot did.

hindi: पाक्षिक या सप्ताह में दो बार — अर्थ पूछकर तय करें
definition: every two weeks, or twice a week; always confirm which
example: Our biweekly sync collapsed because nobody agreed what biweekly meant.

hindi: प्रमाणित गुणवत्ता-विशेषज्ञ — सुधार परियोजनाओं का नेतृत्व करने वाला वरिष्ठ जानकार
definition: a certified six sigma expert who leads process improvement projects full time and mentors green belts
example: Our black belt can reduce any defect except the length of his own slide decks.

hindi: काला हंस — अप्रत्याशित, दुर्लभ घटना जिसका असर विशाल हो
definition: a rare, unpredictable event with extreme impact that falls outside every normal forecast and planning assumption
example: The risk register listed forty threats and missed the black swan, as risk registers traditionally do.

hindi: व्यापार प्रतिबंध अवधि — नतीजों से पहले कर्मचारियों के शेयर सौदों पर रोक
definition: window before earnings releases when insiders and employees are barred from trading company shares
example: Blackout period starts Monday, which is when everyone suddenly remembers their unvested kitchen renovation.

hindi: दोषारोपण संस्कृति — गलती पर व्यक्ति को दोषी ठहराने वाला कार्य-माहौल
definition: a workplace where mistakes lead to finding someone to punish, which teaches engineers to hide problems instead of reporting them
example: In a blame culture, the fastest way to fix an incident is to never mention it.

hindi: दोषमुक्त — व्यक्ति नहीं, प्रक्रिया पर केंद्रित समीक्षा
definition: focused on systems rather than individuals when reviewing a failure
example: It's a blameless post-mortem, so please stop looking at Dave.

hindi: दोष-मंथन — समस्या सुलझाने के बजाय यह तय करना कि ग़लती किसकी थी
definition: a meeting or discussion spent assigning blame for a failure rather than solving the underlying problem
example: The incident review turned into blamestorming by slide three.

hindi: खुला क्रय आदेश — तय अवधि में बार-बार की ख़रीद के लिए एक बड़ा स्वीकृत आदेश
definition: a single purchase order covering repeated purchases from the same supplier over a period, capped at an approved ceiling
example: Put it on the blanket PO; that's what the blanket is for, covering things.

hindi: प्रभाव का दायरा — किसी गड़बड़ी या बदलाव से कितने उपयोगकर्ता और सिस्टम प्रभावित होंगे
definition: the scope of users, systems and services affected when a change, failure or mistake goes wrong in production
example: We limited the blast radius to one region, which was, unfortunately, the busy one.

hindi: जोखिम भरी अत्याधुनिकता — इतनी नई तकनीक कि घाव दे जाए
definition: technology so new it is unstable and risky
example: We chose the bleeding edge and bled accordingly.

hindi: काम-छुट्टी मेल — व्यावसायिक यात्रा के साथ निजी छुट्टी के दिन जोड़ना
definition: adding personal leisure days to a business trip, with the company paying the travel and you paying the extra hotel nights
example: His Lisbon conference was two days; his bleisure extension was nine.

hindi: मिश्रित अधिग्रहण लागत — सभी स्रोतों से आए ग्राहकों पर औसत खर्च
definition: customer acquisition cost averaged across paid and organic customers together, which flatters paid channel performance
example: Blended CAC looks healthy because word of mouth is quietly subsidising the Instagram budget.

hindi: पहचान-रहित भर्ती — नाम, फ़ोटो आदि छिपाकर उम्मीदवार परखना
definition: screening candidates with names, photos and schools removed to reduce interviewer bias
example: After blind hiring began, the team stopped hiring exclusively people from the manager's college.

hindi: बिजली-रफ़्तार विस्तार — दक्षता छोड़कर बाज़ार पर तेज़ क़ब्ज़ा
definition: prioritizing extreme speed over efficiency to dominate a market before rivals do
example: Blitzscaling sounded great until we saw the cloud bill.

hindi: समय आरक्षित करना — कैलेंडर पर जगह रोकना
definition: to reserve calendar time so nothing can be scheduled over it
example: Block off Friday afternoon or the calendar wolves will take it.

hindi: बड़ी कमाऊ दवा — सालाना अरबों की बिक्री वाली दवा
definition: in pharma, a single drug earning more than a billion dollars in annual sales and anchoring company revenue
example: The forecast turned a promising molecule into a blockbuster somewhere between tab three and tab seven.

hindi: अवरुद्ध — बाधा के कारण रुका हुआ
definition: unable to proceed until someone or something else moves first
example: I'm blocked on legal, which is a permanent state of being.

hindi: बाधा — वह चीज़ जो काम आगे नहीं बढ़ने देती
definition: anything that prevents work from moving forward
example: My only blocker is waiting on the API team's review.

hindi: नीला सागर — बिना प्रतिस्पर्धा वाला नया बाज़ार
definition: an uncontested market space created by offering something novel, where competitors are irrelevant because nobody else serves it yet
example: We found a blue ocean, then learned it was empty because nobody wanted to pay.

hindi: नीला सागर रणनीति — प्रतिस्पर्धा से दूर नया, अछूता बाज़ार बनाना
definition: strategy of creating uncontested market space instead of competing head-on in crowded existing markets
example: Our blue ocean strategy lasted until three competitors read the same book.

hindi: नीला-हरा परिनियोजन — दो जुड़वाँ वातावरणों में झट अदला-बदली
definition: using two identical environments and switching traffic between them for zero-downtime releases
example: Blue-green deploys, so we can panic and switch back instantly.

hindi: खुले आसमान की सोच — हर बंदिश हटाकर कल्पना करना
definition: idea generation with no practical constraints
example: The blue-sky session produced a jetpack and no budget.

hindi: अचानक मिला सौदा — बिना मेहनत आया ग्राहक
definition: an unexpected deal that lands with little or no effort from sales
example: A bluebird signed through the website; the AE added it to his forecast retroactively.

hindi: निष्कर्ष सबसे पहले — मुख्य बात ऊपर
definition: bottom line up front — the conclusion first, the story after
example: BLUF: we're over budget; details and excuses in the doc.

hindi: निदेशक मंडल प्रस्तुति — मंडल की बैठक के लिए तैयार स्लाइडों का पुलिंदा
definition: the slide presentation management prepares for each board meeting, summarising results, risks and decisions requested from directors
example: The board deck went through eleven versions, and the only slide anyone discussed was the appendix.

hindi: निदेशक मंडल पर्यवेक्षक — बैठक में आने वाला पर बिना वोट वाला निवेशक प्रतिनिधि
definition: an investor representative who attends board meetings and reads board materials but cannot vote on decisions
example: The board observer had no vote and somehow still had the most questions.

hindi: बैठक-पूर्व दस्तावेज़ पुलिंदा — बैठक से पहले निदेशकों को भेजे जाने वाले सारे काग़ज़ात
definition: the bundle of papers, reports and draft resolutions circulated to directors before a board meeting, common in British and Indian English
example: The board pack ran to four hundred pages, so the directors read the first four and the last one.

hindi: मंडल नवीनीकरण — पुराने निदेशकों की जगह नए अनुभव वाले सदस्य लाना
definition: the deliberate replacement of long-serving directors with fresh members to update skills, diversity and independence
example: The board refresh added two new directors, bringing the average tenure down from geological to merely historic.

hindi: निदेशक मंडल में स्थान — निवेश के बदले मिली निदेशक की कुर्सी
definition: a director position on the company board that a lead investor negotiates as part of leading a financing round
example: He took less money from the second fund because it came without another board seat.

hindi: असंभव बीड़ा उठाना — ज़रूरत से कहीं बड़ा काम छेड़ देना
definition: to attempt something impossibly broad instead of a focused task
example: Support ten languages at launch? Let's not boil the ocean.

hindi: साँचा-कोड — बार-बार दोहराया जाने वाला ज़रूरी पर नीरस कोड
definition: repetitive standard code you must write before anything interesting happens
example: Two hundred lines of boilerplate to print hello.

hindi: जोड़ अधिग्रहण — मुख्य कारोबार में जुड़ने वाली छोटी कंपनी ख़रीदना
definition: small company purchase that plugs directly into an existing business line, adding products, customers or capabilities
example: It was pitched as a bolt-on acquisition and integrated like a hostile takeover.

hindi: सामग्री सूची — किसी उत्पाद में लगने वाले हर पुर्ज़े की सूची
definition: bill of materials; the complete structured list of parts, components and quantities needed to build one product
example: Engineering changed the design and forgot the BOM, so procurement ordered the old screws.

hindi: बोनस गुणक — प्रदर्शन के अनुसार बोनस घटाने-बढ़ाने वाला कारक
definition: a factor applied to the target bonus, based on company or individual performance ratings, that scales the final payout
example: The company multiplier came in at 0.7, which leadership described as a stretch opportunity.

hindi: बोनस कोष — पूरे समूह के बोनस हेतु तय कुल राशि
definition: the total money set aside for bonuses across a company or team, later divided among individual employees
example: The bonus pool shrank after the offsite, which the offsite itself did not help.

hindi: मांग-पुस्तिका निर्माण — IPO में निवेशकों के ऑर्डर जुटाकर कीमत तय करना
definition: the process where underwriters collect investor orders to gauge demand and set an offering price
example: The book build was oversubscribed by lunchtime, and by dinner everyone claimed they had predicted it.

hindi: माँग-आधारित मूल्य निर्धारण — निवेशकों की बोली से निर्गम मूल्य तय करना
definition: the process of collecting institutional bids to discover demand and set the offering price, common in Indian listings
example: Three days of book building, and the entire office refreshed the subscription figures like cricket scores.

hindi: ग्राहक-सूची — किसी विक्रेता के ज़िम्मे के सारे खाते
definition: the set of accounts and revenue a salesperson manages
example: He guards his book of business like a dragon with a CRM login.

hindi: मिली माँग बनाम बिक्री का अनुपात — नए ऑर्डर और भेजे गए बिलों की तुलना
definition: ratio of orders received to revenue billed during a period; readings above parity signal growing future demand
example: Book-to-bill dipped below one, and so did the mood in the sales channel.

hindi: अनुबंधित मूल्य — ग्राहकों द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित सौदों की कुल राशि
definition: total value of contracts customers signed during a period, regardless of when the revenue is billed or recognised
example: Bookings were a record, so naturally sales asked why their commission cheques weren't also a record.

hindi: प्रमुख निर्गम प्रबंधक — निर्गम की मांग-पुस्तिका और आवंटन संभालने वाला बैंक
definition: the lead underwriting bank managing the order book and allocations for a securities offering
example: Six banks were named joint bookrunner, which mostly meant six logos on the cover.

hindi: तार्किक खोज — AND/OR/NOT जोड़कर उम्मीदवार प्रोफ़ाइल छाँटना
definition: a sourcing query combining keywords with AND, OR and NOT to find matching candidate profiles
example: Her boolean search string was longer than the job description itself.

hindi: छोड़कर फिर लौटा कर्मचारी — अक्सर बेहतर वेतन पर
definition: someone who left the company and later returned, usually at a higher band
example: The boomerang employee got in eighteen months what loyalty never paid.

hindi: मैदान में मौजूदगी — मौक़े पर असल काम करते लोग
definition: people physically present doing the actual work
example: The dashboard says fine; boots on the ground disagree.

hindi: बिना निवेशकों के, अपनी कमाई और बचत से कंपनी खड़ी करना
definition: to build a company using personal savings and revenue instead of outside investors
example: We bootstrapped for four years before taking a single rupee of funding.

hindi: ऊब से थकावट — बहुत कम या अर्थहीन काम से होने वाली मानसिक थकान
definition: exhaustion and disengagement caused by chronically dull, meaningless or insufficient work rather than too much work
example: His boreout was so advanced that he volunteered to update the org chart. Twice.

hindi: निगरानी सॉफ़्टवेयर — कर्मचारियों के स्क्रीन, कीस्ट्रोक और गतिविधि पर नज़र रखने वाला प्रोग्राम
definition: employee monitoring software that tracks remote workers' screens, keystrokes, applications and activity levels
example: The bossware flagged him as idle during the one hour he spent thinking.

hindi: अड़चन — जहाँ काम अटककर धीमा हो जाता है
definition: the single point where work piles up and slows everything
example: Approvals are the bottleneck, not engineering.

hindi: शुद्ध लाभ — सारे ख़र्च के बाद बची असल कमाई
definition: net profit after all costs; also, the thing that finally matters
example: Free snacks vanished the moment the bottom line went red.

hindi: कीप का निचला हिस्सा — ख़रीद के क़रीब पहुँचे ग्राहक
definition: the late stage where prospects compare vendors and are ready to buy
example: Bottom of funnel content: the pricing page and a well-timed discount.

hindi: नीचे से ऊपर अनुमान — हर टीम के अंदाज़ों को जोड़कर बना पूर्वानुमान
definition: a forecast built by adding together detailed estimates from individual teams, accounts or products
example: The bottom-up forecast added up to twice the target, because every team rounded hope upward.

hindi: ईमेल लौट आना — डिलीवर न हो पाना
definition: to fail delivery and return to sender, as email does
example: My mail to the client bounced; someone check that address.

hindi: बाउंस दर — एक ही पेज देखकर लौट जाने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: the share of visitors who leave after viewing a single page
example: The landing page bounce rate suggests the landing is the problem.

hindi: स्काउट नियम — जिस कोड को छुएँ, उसे पहले से थोड़ा बेहतर हालत में छोड़ें
definition: the principle of leaving any code you touch slightly cleaner than you found it
example: He applied the boy scout rule to a one-line fix and the pull request touched sixty files.

hindi: उपलब्धि-डायरी — अपने कामों का लगातार रखा गया लेखा
definition: a running personal record of achievements and wins, kept so that reviews and promotion cases practically write themselves
example: She opened her brag document in December and found only one line: 'survived Q2.'

hindi: प्रतिभाशाली लोगों का संस्था छोड़कर जाना
definition: the exodus of skilled people, taking expertise with them
example: After the equity repricing, the brain drain emptied the senior bench.

hindi: ब्रांड-सक्रियता — लोगों को ब्रांड से सीधे जोड़ने वाला आयोजन
definition: an event, experience or promotion designed to make people interact with a brand directly, widely used in Indian English marketing for on-ground campaigns
example: The brand activation in the mall drew huge crowds, mostly for the free samosas.

hindi: ब्रांड-संरचना — मूल ब्रांड और उप-ब्रांडों का आपसी ढाँचा
definition: the structure describing how a company's parent brand, product brands and sub-brands relate, including naming rules and visual hierarchy
example: Brand architecture got complicated once every product manager wanted their own logo.

hindi: ब्रांड जागरूकता — लोगों को कंपनी का नाम पता होना
definition: how many people recognize your company exists, independent of buying anything
example: The billboard is for brand awareness, which is hard to measure and easy to invoice.

hindi: ब्रांड सौदा — प्रचार के बदले क्रिएटर को ब्रांड से भुगतान
definition: paid agreement where a brand compensates a creator to feature or promote its product in their content
example: The brand deal paid for the new camera, which is now featured in every video as a subtle thank-you.

hindi: ब्रांड की साख-पूँजी — नाम भर से मिलने वाला अतिरिक्त मूल्य
definition: the extra value customers grant a product purely because of the brand name, measured through loyalty, premium pricing and trust
example: Brand equity is what lets us charge double for the same bottle of water with a nicer label.

hindi: ब्रांड दिशानिर्देश — लोगो, रंग और आवाज़ के प्रयोग-नियम
definition: rules for using a company's logo, colors, and voice
example: Marketing rejected the mockup for violating brand guidelines, specifically the blue.

hindi: ब्रांड का स्वास्थ्य — जागरूकता, पसंद और भरोसे की समग्र स्थिति
definition: an overall read on how strong a brand is, combining awareness, consideration, preference, sentiment and loyalty metrics from tracking research
example: Brand health looks fine on the slide, provided nobody reads the comments.

hindi: ब्रांड-असर में बढ़त — अभियान से धारणा में आया मापा गया सुधार
definition: the measured increase in awareness, recall, consideration or favourability caused by a campaign, compared against an unexposed control group
example: The brand lift study shows people now remember the jingle, though not the product.

hindi: ब्रांड-स्तंभ — पहचान के मूल गुण जिन पर सब संदेश टिकते हैं
definition: the three to five core attributes or values that define what a brand stands for and that all messaging should support
example: Our brand pillars are innovation, trust and simplicity, which is also everyone else's.

hindi: ब्रांड-पहरेदार — दिशानिर्देश लागू करवाने वाली टीम
definition: the brand or design team that reviews materials and enforces logo usage, colours, typography and voice rules across the company
example: The brand police returned the deck because the logo had three millimetres too little breathing room.

hindi: ब्रांड का वचन — ग्राहक को हर बार मिलने वाले अनुभव का आश्वासन
