definition: the core commitment a brand makes to customers about the experience or benefit they can always expect from it
example: The brand promise is effortless, a word the checkout flow has never heard.

hindi: ब्रांड की याद — बिना संकेत ब्रांड का नाम याद आना
definition: the ability of people to remember and name a brand when prompted only by the product category, measured through awareness surveys
example: Brand recall is strong: everyone remembers the talking mascot and nobody remembers what we sell.

hindi: ब्रांड का नवीनीकरण — पहचान में हल्का बदलाव, पूरा रीब्रांड नहीं
definition: a modest update to logo, colours, typography or messaging that modernises a brand without replacing its core identity or name
example: The brand refresh cost six months and turned the blue slightly bluer.

hindi: ब्रांड-सुरक्षा — विज्ञापन को हानिकारक सामग्री के पास दिखने से बचाना
definition: practices and tools that stop a brand's advertisements from appearing beside harmful, offensive or controversial content that could damage its reputation
example: Brand safety flagged the placement after our cheerful yoghurt ad ran beside a disaster documentary.

hindi: ब्रांड की प्रमुखता — खरीद के क्षण में ब्रांड का ध्यान आना
definition: how readily a brand comes to mind in buying situations, the recall-driven measure of mental availability that marketers track alongside awareness
example: Brand salience matters, she said, while struggling to remember our tagline.

hindi: ब्रांड-निगरानी सर्वे — समय के साथ धारणा मापने वाला नियमित अध्ययन
definition: a recurring survey that measures awareness, consideration, perception and preference over time, so marketing can spot shifts in brand health
example: The brand tracker moved one point, and the team drafted a press release about momentum.

hindi: ब्रांड की बोली — लेखन का स्थायी व्यक्तित्व और लहजा
definition: the consistent personality a brand uses across all writing, defining word choice, humour, formality and attitude in every channel
example: Our brand voice is playful and approachable, according to the forty-page legal review of it.

hindi: एक-नाम घराना — सब उत्पाद मूल ब्रांड के नाम तले
definition: a brand architecture where every product carries the parent brand name, so the master brand carries all recognition and reputation
example: As a branded house, one bad product review now counts against the entire company.

hindi: अभी लौटता हूँ — थोड़ी देर की दूरी
definition: be right back — briefly away from the keyboard
example: BRB, the doorbell and the deploy finished at the same time.

hindi: उल्लंघन — अनुबंध तोड़ना या डेटा में सेंध
definition: a violation of a contract, or unauthorized access to data
example: Legal asked if it's an 'incident' or a 'breach'; big difference.

hindi: पथ-सूत्र — पेज तक पहुँचने का रास्ता दिखाती कड़ियाँ
definition: the trail of links showing where you are in a site's hierarchy
example: Six levels deep, the breadcrumb is the only adult in the room.

hindi: सौदा-भंग शुल्क — सौदा टूटने पर एक पक्ष द्वारा दूसरे को दिया जाने वाला भुगतान
definition: a payment one party owes the other if an agreed merger collapses for specified reasons
example: The break fee was large enough that walking away needed its own board approval and its own bankers.

hindi: बिल्ड तोड़ना — ऐसा बदलाव करना कि सबका काम रुक जाए
definition: to land a change that fails compilation or tests for everyone
example: He broke the build and left for lunch, a bold career move.

hindi: आपातकालीन खाता — संकट में ही इस्तेमाल होने वाला सर्वाधिकार लॉगिन
definition: emergency administrator login kept sealed for outages, used only when normal access fails, then audited
example: The break-glass account password lived in a sealed envelope, and the envelope lived in a drawer nobody could unlock.

hindi: तोड़ने वाला बदलाव — जो मौजूदा उपयोग अचानक बिगाड़ दे
definition: a change that stops existing users or code from working
example: It's a minor release with one tiny breaking change, define minor.

hindi: उप-समूह चर्चा — बड़ी बैठक से निकला छोटा दल
definition: a small subgroup discussion split off from a larger session
example: Each breakout reports back with its top two ideas.

hindi: स्क्रीन सीमा बिंदु — जिस चौड़ाई पर लेआउट बदलता है
definition: a screen width at which a responsive layout rearranges itself, such as switching to single column
example: The tablet breakpoint was designed for, discussed at length, and never actually tested.

hindi: अलविदा ईमेल — जवाब न देने वाले ग्राहक को आख़िरी संदेश
definition: a final outreach message telling an unresponsive prospect the seller will stop following up, often prompting replies
example: Six follow-ups got silence; the breakup email got a reply within minutes asking why we were leaving.

hindi: सम्मेलन-लाइन — समूह कॉल की साझा लाइन
definition: a shared conference line people join for a group call
example: Incident's open; everyone relevant is on the bridge.

hindi: आपात सामूहिक कॉल — बड़ी गड़बड़ी के दौरान सबको जोड़े रखने वाली खुली फ़ोन या वीडियो बैठक
definition: an open conference line that engineers, managers and vendors join and stay on throughout a major production incident
example: Forty people joined the bridge call, and thirty-eight of them were there to ask for an update.

hindi: पुल दौर — अगले पड़ाव तक पहुँचने के लिए छोटा अंतरिम निवेश
definition: a small interim raise meant to reach the next milestone or round
example: This is our second bridge round; the other side remains under construction.

hindi: बेमंज़िल पुल — ऐसी अंतरिम फ़ंडिंग जिसके बाद अगला राउंड आता ही नहीं
definition: interim financing meant to reach the next round that instead only delays an inevitable shutdown or distressed sale
example: Third bridge in eighteen months; even the investors started calling it the bridge to nowhere.

hindi: प्रतिभाशाली पर विषैला सहकर्मी — काम में अव्वल, व्यवहार में टीम के लिए घातक
definition: a highly skilled employee whose abrasive, toxic behaviour damages the team more than their talent helps it
example: Our brilliant jerk shipped the feature in a weekend and three people to other teams by Monday.

hindi: व्यापक भारित औसत — डाउन राउंड में निवेशक कीमत का संतुलित समायोजन
definition: the standard, founder-friendlier anti-dilution formula, adjusting investor conversion price by averaging across all outstanding shares
example: Everyone relaxed when the term sheet said broad-based weighted average and not the other thing.

hindi: सबको एक साथ संदेश — व्यापक घोषणा
definition: to send one message to everyone at once
example: We'll broadcast the maintenance window on Monday morning.

hindi: अपना टिफ़िन सत्र — लंच के साथ अनौपचारिक प्रस्तुति
definition: an informal talk held over a bring-your-own lunch
example: Her brown bag on debugging outdrew the all-hands.

hindi: पुरानी ज़मीन — मौजूदा पुराने सिस्टम की बाध्यताओं में होने वाला
definition: developed on top of an existing system, inheriting all its constraints and history
example: It's brownfield work: every change negotiates with code from 2011.

hindi: व्यावसायिक उत्तरदायित्व एवं स्थिरता रिपोर्ट — सेबी द्वारा अनिवार्य भारतीय ESG प्रकटीकरण
definition: business responsibility and sustainability report; mandatory Indian listed company disclosure covering environmental, social and governance performance
example: The BRSR deadline is the only time the plant manager asks sustainability how many litres we use.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष प्रचार — दुकान, आयोजन, सैंपलिंग जैसे लक्षित माध्यम
definition: below the line; targeted, often direct marketing such as events, in-store promotion, sampling, direct mail and activations, common in Indian English agency usage
example: The BTL plan is a kiosk in the mall, staffed by the interns on weekends.

hindi: वैसे — बात-बात में एक और बात
definition: by the way — a side note smuggled into the conversation
example: BTW, the third-floor printer works again, allegedly.

hindi: बजट रोक — नए ख़र्चों पर अस्थायी पाबंदी
definition: a temporary halt on new spending
example: The budget freeze arrived one day before my conference request.

hindi: बजट स्वामी — किसी बजट के खर्च का ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति
definition: the person accountable for spending within a particular budget and explaining any variance against it
example: As budget owner, she was thrilled to learn she owned a cost she had never heard of.

hindi: खर्च की रफ़्तार — महीने भर में विज्ञापन बजट बराबर खर्च होने की निगरानी
definition: monitoring how quickly advertising spend is being used so the monthly budget lasts the full period
example: Budget pacing failed and the entire quarterly spend was gone by the twelfth of month one.

hindi: अंतराल — बैठकों के बीच साँस भर की जगह
definition: a gap left between meetings to breathe, travel, or think
example: I keep a fifteen-minute buffer so my brain can change context.

hindi: आरक्षित अतिरिक्त कर्मचारी — ज़रूरत पड़ने पर काम संभालने के लिए रखा गया
definition: in Indian English, an extra unbilled engineer kept on a project as backup against attrition, leave or sudden client demand
example: He was the buffer resource right up until the day he became the entire team.

hindi: बग बैश — सब मिलकर एक सत्र में दोष खोजना
definition: a group session where everyone hunts bugs in the same build
example: The bug bash found forty issues, three of them new.

hindi: बिल्ड सिपाही — बारी-बारी से टूटे बिल्ड और असफल परीक्षणों पर नज़र रखने वाला इंजीनियर
definition: the engineer on a rotating duty who watches the shared build, chasing down broken builds and failing tests
example: The build cop reverted your commit before you finished your coffee.

hindi: सबके सामने बनाना — उत्पाद की प्रगति, आँकड़े और गलतियाँ खुलेआम साझा करना
definition: sharing a startup's product progress, revenue numbers and mistakes openly online while building it
example: He decided to build in public, so the whole internet watched the database migration fail live.

hindi: निर्माण जाल — असर की जगह बस फ़ीचर गिनते रहने में फँसी कंपनी
definition: the state of a company measuring progress by features shipped rather than customer value delivered, mistaking output for outcomes
example: The roadmap had thirty features and zero goals, a textbook build trap with a Gantt chart.

hindi: बनाएँ या ख़रीदें — ख़ुद बनाने और वेंडर से लेने के बीच फ़ैसला
definition: the recurring decision between developing a capability internally or purchasing it from a vendor
example: The build vs buy debate lasted so long the vendor was acquired.

hindi: बनाओ-मापो-सीखो — छोटा बनाकर, नापकर, सीखकर अगला कदम तय करने का चक्र
definition: the lean startup feedback loop of shipping a small experiment, measuring customer response and learning before the next iteration
example: We nailed build and skipped straight past measure and learn, as is tradition.

hindi: शीर्ष बैंक समूह — दुनिया के सबसे बड़े निवेश बैंक
definition: the largest global investment banks, which lead the biggest deals and dominate advisory fee rankings
example: The bulge bracket pitch had nine bankers in the room and one who knew the client's name.

hindi: चाबुक प्रभाव — ग्राहक माँग का छोटा बदलाव सप्लाई चेन में बढ़ता जाना
definition: small shifts in consumer demand amplifying into wild swings in orders further upstream along the supply chain
example: One viral video, a bullwhip effect later, and the supplier built a new factory for a fad.

hindi: संस्करण बढ़ाना — वर्ज़न नंबर एक पायदान ऊपर करना
definition: to increment a version number, often the entire change
example: The commit just bumps the version; the courage is implied.

hindi: इसे फिर ऊपर ला रहा हूँ — अनदेखे की याद
definition: the standalone message that lifts an ignored request back to the top
example: Bumping this; still blocked on the access request.

hindi: भार दर — वेतन पर लगने वाला अतिरिक्त ऊपरी खर्च प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage added to base salary to cover benefits, payroll taxes and overhead in a fully loaded cost
example: Finance applied a burden rate of forty percent, and suddenly the contractor looked cheap.

hindi: पूँजी खर्च की रफ़्तार — कंपनी हर महीने कितना पैसा जला रही है
definition: the speed at which a company spends its cash, usually measured monthly
example: Our burn rate doubled the month we hired three VPs.

hindi: बर्नडाउन चार्ट — बचे काम को समय के साथ घटते दिखाता ग्राफ
definition: a graph of remaining work versus time, ideally sloping to zero
example: Our burndown chart is flat, which is one kind of consistency.

hindi: जलता मंच — बदलाव इतना ज़रूरी कि रुकना ही सबसे बड़ा जोखिम
definition: a crisis framing used to convince staff that staying with the current business is riskier than painful change
example: Leadership announced a burning platform, then asked everyone to keep doing exactly the same things more efficiently.

hindi: लगातार काम के तनाव से पूरी थकान — शरीर और मन दोनों की
definition: exhaustion and detachment from prolonged unmanaged work stress
example: The wellness webinar on burnout was scheduled over lunch.

hindi: बर्नअप चार्ट — पूर्ण कार्य और कुल दायरा दिखाता ग्राफ
definition: a graph of completed work climbing toward total scope, which keeps climbing too
example: The burnup chart shows scope growing faster than progress.

hindi: बस फ़ैक्टर — कितने लोगों के जाते ही प्रोजेक्ट ठप हो जाए
definition: how many people could be hit by a bus before the project stalls
example: Our bus factor is one, and that one is on vacation.

hindi: व्यावसायिक औचित्य — ख़र्च के पक्ष में तर्क और आँकड़े
definition: the justification, with numbers, for spending money on something
example: Write the business case; 'it's cool' isn't a column in Excel.

term: buy the rumor, sell the news
hindi: अफ़वाह पर खरीदो, ख़बर पर बेचो — उम्मीद में खरीदकर घोषणा होते ही बेचना
definition: buying on expectations before announcements, then selling once the expected news arrives
example: Classic buy the rumor, sell the news: shares soared all week, then fell the minute the launch went live.

hindi: सहमति — योजना के लिए लोगों की रज़ामंदी और साथ
definition: agreement and support from the people you need
example: Without engineering buy-in, the roadmap is fan fiction.

hindi: क्रेता पक्ष — निवेश खरीदने वाले फंड, PE फर्म और प्रबंधक
definition: describing investors who purchase companies or securities, such as funds, private equity firms and asset managers
example: He left banking for the buy-side and discovered weekends, then discovered quarterly letters.

hindi: शेयर पुनर्खरीद — कंपनी का अपने ही शेयर वापस ख़रीदना
definition: company repurchasing its own shares from the market, reducing share count and boosting earnings per share
example: The buyback lifted earnings per share nicely, just as it lifted the executives' bonus targets.

hindi: ख़रीदार का काल्पनिक चित्रण — मार्केटिंग योजना के लिए
definition: a fictional profile of a typical buyer, complete with invented name and worries
example: Meet 'Ops Manager Priya,' a persona who somehow reads all our emails.

hindi: निकासी पैकेज — स्वेच्छा से जाने के बदले दी गई रकम
definition: payment offered to employees who agree to leave voluntarily, used to avoid formal layoffs
example: The buyout package came with a deadline shorter than the benefits presentation.

hindi: बजट बनाम वास्तविक — तय बजट और असल खर्च की तुलना रिपोर्ट
definition: budget versus actuals; the recurring report comparing the approved budget against actual spending and revenue
example: The monthly BvA showed travel under budget, mostly because nobody was allowed to travel.

hindi: अपना एआई ख़ुद लाओ — कर्मचारियों का निजी एआई टूल दफ़्तर के काम में लगाना
definition: bring your own artificial intelligence; employees using personal chatbot subscriptions for company work because official tools trail behind
example: IT is still evaluating vendors, so the whole marketing team runs on BYOAI.

hindi: अपना उपकरण लाओ नीति — निजी फ़ोन या लैपटॉप पर दफ़्तर का काम
definition: bring your own device; policy letting employees use personal phones or laptops for company work
example: The BYOD policy was generous until he read that IT could remotely wipe his holiday photos.

hindi: परिवर्तन सलाहकार बोर्ड — उत्पादन में बड़े बदलावों को मंज़ूरी देने वाली समिति
definition: change advisory board; a committee that reviews and approves risky production changes before engineers are allowed to deploy them
example: The fix took ten minutes to write and nine days to get through CAB.

hindi: ग्राहक अधिग्रहण लागत — एक ग्राहक जोड़ने का औसत खर्च
definition: customer acquisition cost; what you spend to win one customer
example: Our CAC assumes the founder's time is free, which it is not.

hindi: लय — बैठकों या रिलीज़ की नियमित आवृत्ति
definition: the regular rhythm of meetings, releases, or reports
example: We meet on a weekly cadence to discuss the biweekly cadence.

hindi: लाभ-चयन योजना — उपलब्ध लाभों में से अपनी पसंद चुनना
definition: a benefits scheme letting employees choose among options such as insurance, childcare or wellness allowances, often paid before taxes
example: The cafeteria plan offered nine options, and the actual cafeteria still served the same dal.

hindi: चक्रवृद्धि वार्षिक वृद्धि दर — कई सालों की औसत सालाना बढ़त
definition: compound annual growth rate over multiple years
example: The five-year CAGR looks smooth; the five years were not.

hindi: कैलेंडर-लेखा — बेकार बैठकों की छँटाई
definition: reviewing recurring meetings and cutting the ones that earn nothing
example: A calendar audit freed six hours; nobody noticed the deletions.

hindi: कैलेंडर दिवालियापन — सारी आवर्ती मीटिंगें एक साथ रद्द कर नए सिरे से शुरू करना
definition: cancelling every recurring meeting at once, then re-adding only those people actually miss
example: After calendar bankruptcy, only three meetings came back and nobody noticed the rest.

hindi: कैलेंडर की जोड़-तोड़ — व्यस्त समयों में बैठक फिट करना
definition: the puzzle of fitting meetings into everyone's packed calendars
example: Finding an hour for six people is pure calendar Tetris.

hindi: प्रबंधकों की बंद बैठक जहाँ रेटिंग आपस में तय होती है
definition: the closed-door meeting where managers align ratings across teams
example: Her rating changed in calibration, in a room she wasn't in.

hindi: क्रिया-आह्वान — उपयोगकर्ता से अगला कदम कराने वाला बटन या संदेश
definition: the button or line that tells users what to do next
example: The page has six calls to action, so effectively none.

hindi: ऊँट स्टार्टअप — लंबे सूखे में भी टिकने वाली, संतुलित विकास वाली कंपनी
definition: a resilient startup that balances growth with survival, able to endure long funding droughts without dying
example: Our board stopped asking for a unicorn and started praising us as a camel startup, which is how we knew the round wasn't coming.

hindi: कैमरा-चालू संस्कृति — कॉल पर वीडियो की अपेक्षा
definition: a workplace norm expecting video enabled on calls
example: Camera-on culture met its match on Friday afternoons.

hindi: परिसर नियुक्ति — कॉलेज में जाकर छात्रों की भर्ती
definition: in Indian English, companies recruiting final-year students directly through college placement drives
example: Campus placement season means ten slide decks about culture and one about the salary.

hindi: मुसीबतों का पिटारा — छेड़ते ही उलझनें निकलने वाला मुद्दा
definition: an issue that unleashes endless complications once opened
example: Asking who owns that database opened a can of worms.

hindi: क्या स्क्रीन दिख रही है — स्क्रीन साझा करने के बाद प्रस्तुतकर्ता की पुष्टि
definition: question every presenter asks after starting screen sharing on a video call, checking that attendees see the shared window
example: Can you see my screen, he asked, while sharing his inbox to forty people.

hindi: दोहरा नहीं पाए — रिपोर्ट की गई गड़बड़ी इंजीनियर के यहाँ दोबारा पैदा नहीं हुई
definition: an engineer's verdict that a reported defect could not be reproduced, often closing the ticket
example: Marked can't repro, reopened by the customer, marked can't repro, escalated to the CEO.

hindi: कैनरी रिलीज़ — पहले थोड़े उपयोगकर्ताओं पर आज़माई गई
definition: a release sent to a small slice of users first to catch problems early
example: The canary died at 2%, rollback initiated.

hindi: उम्मीदवार अनुभव — भर्ती प्रक्रिया में उम्मीदवार से कैसा बर्ताव हुआ
definition: the overall impression applicants form of the hiring process, from communication and scheduling through rejection
example: The candidate experience survey went out to everyone we never replied to.

hindi: तैयार उत्तर — बार-बार पूछे जाने वाले प्रश्नों का पहले से लिखा जवाब
definition: prewritten support reply saved for common customer questions, inserted with a single click and lightly personalised by the agent
example: The canned response began 'I completely understand your frustration' and then proved otherwise.

hindi: आत्म-भक्षण — पैसे वाले विज्ञापन से वही ग्राहक ख़रीदना जो वैसे भी मुफ़्त आते
definition: paid advertising or new products capturing customers who would have arrived anyway through organic or existing channels
example: Turning off branded search tested the cannibalization theory, and sales did not notice at all.

hindi: स्वामित्व तालिका — कंपनी में किसका कितना हिस्सा है
definition: the ledger of who owns what percentage of a company
example: The cap table has more names than our customer list.

hindi: सुधारात्मक और निवारक कार्रवाई — दोष ठीक करना और दोबारा न होने देना
definition: corrective and preventive action; the formal quality process fixing a defect and changing systems so it never recurs
example: The CAPA form is forty pages long, which is itself a recurring defect.

hindi: क्षमता — टीम के पास उपलब्ध वास्तविक कार्य-समय
definition: how much work a team can actually take on in a period
example: We have capacity for this, assuming nobody takes vacation or breathes.

hindi: क्षमता निर्माण — संस्थाओं की दीर्घकालिक कार्य-शक्ति बढ़ाना
definition: funding, training or support that strengthens an organisation's skills, systems and leadership so it can deliver programmes better over time
example: The capacity building workshop taught three hundred people a template none of them have time to fill.

hindi: क्षमता नियोजन — उपलब्ध समय से काम का मिलान
definition: matching planned work against the hours a team realistically has
example: Capacity planning assumes forty focused hours; the calendar disagrees.

hindi: पूंजीगत ख़र्च — दीर्घकालिक संपत्ति पर एकमुश्त निवेश
definition: capital expenditure; big one-time spending on long-lived assets
example: Buying our own servers is capex nobody wants to defend.

hindi: पूँजी का बँटवारा — पैसा निवेश, अधिग्रहण या शेयरधारकों में कहाँ लगे
definition: management deciding where company cash goes among investment, acquisitions, dividends, buybacks and debt repayment
example: Capital allocation was discussed for an hour; the answer was buybacks, again.

hindi: पूँजी बाज़ार दिवस — निवेशकों को मध्यम अवधि की रणनीति और वित्तीय लक्ष्य बताने का आयोजन
definition: scheduled event where company leadership presents medium-term strategy and financial targets to investors and analysts, common in Europe
example: Capital markets day had eleven speakers, forty slides each, and one target anybody remembered.

hindi: पूंजी संरचना — कर्ज़ और इक्विटी की परतें, भुगतान वरीयता के क्रम में
definition: the layers of debt and equity funding a company, ranked by who gets repaid first
example: Common equity sits at the bottom of the capital stack, right where the founders were sitting.

hindi: पूंजीकृत करना — खर्च को संपत्ति मानकर कई सालों में फैलाना
definition: to record a cost as an asset spread over future years instead of an expense this year
example: If we capitalize the engineering work, this year's profit looks better and nobody writes different code.

hindi: हथियार डालना — निराश निवेशकों की सामूहिक घबराहट भरी बिकवाली
definition: the final panicked selling when discouraged investors give up, often marking a price bottom
example: When the last holdout on the team finally agreed to rewrite it, we called it capitulation and ordered pizza.

hindi: स्वामित्व वाला अपतटीय केंद्र — बाहरी वेंडर की जगह विदेशी कंपनी का अपना भारतीय दफ़्तर
definition: older name for a global capability centre: a foreign company owning its Indian office instead of outsourcing internal work to vendors
example: The captive centre hired back the vendor's best engineers, which the vendor took personally.

hindi: आंतरिक कार्बन कटौती — अपनी ही आपूर्ति-श्रृंखला में उत्सर्जन घटाने का निवेश
definition: funding emission reductions inside the company's own supply chain rather than buying external offsets
example: Carbon insetting sounds like a typo until the cocoa farmers' new solar dryers show up in the report.

hindi: कार्ड वर्गीकरण अभ्यास — उपयोगकर्ता से सामग्री समूहबद्ध करवाने की शोध-विधि
definition: a research method where users group topics into categories that make sense
example: The card sort proved users don't think in our org chart.

hindi: पदोन्नति की सीढ़ी — स्तर-दर-स्तर अपेक्षाओं का ढांचा
definition: the documented progression of levels and expectations in a role
example: The career ladder has eight rungs and a wait list.

hindi: करियर रोकने वाला क़दम — ऐसी चाल जो तरक्की बिगाड़ दे
definition: an action, often embarrassing or political, likely to damage someone's reputation and promotion prospects
example: Correcting the CEO's arithmetic during the all-hands was brave and a career-limiting move.

hindi: अंधानुकरण — बिना समझे रस्में दोहराना कि शायद काम करें
definition: copying practices ritually without understanding why they worked elsewhere
example: We adopted their whole setup cargo-cult style, microservices and all.

hindi: मुनाफ़े में हिस्सा — फ़ंड की कमाई से VC साझेदारों का अंश
definition: carried interest; the share of fund profits that VC partners keep
example: Carry is why partners smile at exits and shrug at salaries.

hindi: शेष कार्य — पिछले स्प्रिंट से अगले में लुढ़का काम
definition: work that rolls from one sprint into the next, unfinished
example: This story is carry-over from three sprints ago; it commutes.

hindi: आगे ले जाया गया बजट — बचा बजट अगले साल में जोड़ने की अनुमति
definition: unspent budget formally allowed to roll into the next fiscal year rather than returned
example: Finance approved the carryforward, which is the rarest phrase in any budget meeting.

hindi: अधूरी ख़रीद — सामान टोकरी में डालकर बिना भुगतान किए चले जाना
definition: shoppers adding products to their online basket, then leaving before checkout, usually tracked as recovery rate
example: Cart abandonment spiked the day finance insisted shipping costs appear only on the final page.

hindi: अलग निकालना — समय, बजट या दायरे का हिस्सा सुरक्षित रखना
definition: to reserve a portion of time, budget, or scope
example: Carve out two hours weekly for the work meetings displaced.

hindi: नीचे तक पहुँचाना — जानकारी क्रमवार टीमों तक भेजना
definition: to pass information down the org chart, level by level
example: Please cascade the new policy to your teams by Friday.

hindi: श्रृंखलाबद्ध विफलता — एक हिस्से की गड़बड़ी से एक के बाद एक दूसरे हिस्सों का गिरना
definition: a failure where one broken service overloads its neighbours, which then fail in turn and spread the outage across systems
example: One slow cache became a cascading failure that took out checkout, search and, somehow, the lunch menu.

hindi: बदलाव का तर्क — क्यों मौजूदा ढर्रा अब नहीं चलेगा, इसका प्रमाण
definition: the opening argument of a transformation deck explaining why the current business model must change, usually backed by threatening numbers
example: The case for change was twelve slides long; the change itself was a new org chart.

hindi: प्रकरण साक्षात्कार — व्यावसायिक समस्या को बोलकर हल करवाने वाला साक्षात्कार
definition: consulting recruitment interview where candidates solve a business problem aloud, structuring and calculating live
example: In the case interview she estimated the entire tennis ball market without once seeing a tennis ball.

hindi: ग्राहक सफलता की कहानी — आँकड़ों समेत विस्तृत उदाहरण
definition: a marketing story showing how a customer used the product and got results
example: Every case study ends in '40% improvement,' regardless of what was measured.

hindi: नकद रूपांतरण चक्र — माल पर खर्च से ग्राहक के भुगतान तक के दिन
definition: days between paying suppliers for inventory and collecting cash from customers, calculated from inventory, receivable and payable days
example: Our cash conversion cycle is ninety days, meaning we finance every customer for a full quarter out of kindness.

hindi: आकस्मिक अवकाश — छोटे निजी कामों के लिए मिलने वाली छुट्टी
definition: an Indian English category of short, unplanned leave days allowed for personal errands, separate from sick leave
example: He used his last casual leave on the one Friday nothing was scheduled.

hindi: गिरता चाकू पकड़ना — तेज़ी से गिरते भाव में जल्दबाज़ी से खरीदना
definition: buying into a sharply falling price too early, hoping to time the bottom, and taking losses
example: He wanted to acquire the struggling competitor now; the board said no thanks to catching a falling knife.

hindi: हालचाल बैठक — दो लोगों की अनौपचारिक बातचीत वाली मीटिंग
definition: an informal meeting between colleagues to share updates and discuss work without fixed agenda
example: A calendar invite titled 'catch-up' from your manager's manager ruins any weekend.

hindi: श्रेणी निर्माण — नया बाज़ार वर्ग गढ़कर उसका अगुवा बनना
definition: inventing and naming a new market category so you can lead it
example: We're not losing to competitors; we're doing category creation, says marketing.

hindi: कारण-आधारित विपणन — बिक्री को किसी सामाजिक उद्देश्य से जोड़ना
definition: marketing campaigns linking product sales to donations or support for a charitable cause, benefiting both the brand and the charity
example: The cause marketing promise was one rupee per bottle, which the charity is still waiting to receive.

hindi: प्रतिलिपि में जोड़ना — जानकारी के लिए साथ रखना
definition: to copy someone on an email so they see it without being addressed
example: Cc my manager so nobody asks for proof later.

hindi: अनिवार्य परिवर्तनीय वरीयता शेयर — भारतीय स्टार्टअप निवेश का मानक साधन
definition: compulsorily convertible preference shares; the standard instrument for Indian venture rounds, preferred shares that must eventually convert into equity shares
example: The foreign fund insisted on CCPS, the founders nodded, and the chartered accountant quietly doubled his estimate.

hindi: ग्राहक डेटा प्लेटफ़ॉर्म — हर स्रोत से ग्राहक का डेटा एक जगह जोड़ने वाला सॉफ़्टवेयर
definition: customer data platform; marketing software that collects customer behaviour data from every channel and merges it into unified customer profiles
example: We bought a CDP to unify customer data and now have one more place it disagrees.

hindi: सौ प्रतिशत — पूरी तरह, बिना किसी संदेह के
definition: an Indian English phrase meaning completely or fully, often expressing total certainty or complete effort
example: I am cent percent sure it will be delivered, he said, ninety percent of the way through the sprint.

hindi: नराश्व कंपनी — सौ मिलियन डॉलर सालाना आवर्ती आय पार करने वाली सॉफ़्टवेयर कंपनी
definition: a software startup that has crossed one hundred million dollars in annual recurring revenue, rarer than valuation milestones
example: Unicorn is a valuation; centaur is revenue, which is why the CFO only celebrates one of them.

hindi: उत्कृष्टता केंद्र — किसी विशेषज्ञता के लिए बना केंद्रीय दल
definition: a central team that owns expertise, standards and best practices in one capability and supports the rest of the organisation
example: The analytics center of excellence had excellent standards and two people to enforce them across forty teams.

hindi: उत्पाद का सीईओ — प्रोडक्ट मैनेजर की ज़िम्मेदारी (बिना अधिकार) का वर्णन
definition: a popular description of the product manager as owning a product's success, usually without authority over the people building it
example: I'm the CEO of the product, meaning I own the outcome and approve nothing.

hindi: अनुष्ठान — स्क्रम की नियत बैठकों में से एक
definition: any of scrum's recurring meetings, named without irony
example: Four ceremonies per sprint, attendance devout, faith varying.

hindi: ग्राहक प्रयास अंक — समस्या सुलझाने में ग्राहक को कितनी मेहनत लगी
definition: customer effort score; a survey metric measuring how much effort customers needed to resolve their problem or complete a task
example: Our CES survey took seven questions to ask whether things were easy.

hindi: विचार-शृंखला — अंतिम उत्तर से पहले क़दम-दर-क़दम तर्क लिखवाना
definition: prompting a model to show its step-by-step reasoning before the final answer
example: Ask for chain of thought and suddenly the calorie math almost adds up.

hindi: चुनौतीपूर्ण बिक्री — ग्राहक की सोच को चुनौती देकर नई दृष्टि बेचना
definition: selling approach where reps teach customers fresh insight, tailor the message and push back on assumptions
example: She ran the Challenger sale so hard the customer challenged her straight out of the building.

hindi: चलता है — कम गुणवत्ता को भी स्वीकार कर लेने का रवैया
definition: an Indian English borrowing describing a casual attitude of accepting mediocre quality or shortcuts as good enough
example: The chalta hai build shipped Friday; the Monday hotfix did not share its attitude.

hindi: पैरवी करना — किसी विचार का खुलकर समर्थन करना
definition: to publicly back an idea and push it through resistance
example: She championed the accessibility work until it finally shipped.

hindi: बदलाव थकान — लगातार पुनर्गठन और नई पहलों से कर्मचारियों की थकावट
definition: employee exhaustion and cynicism caused by relentless reorganizations, new initiatives and shifting priorities
example: Change fatigue is when the fourth transformation program gets a slower eye-roll than the third.

hindi: परिवर्तन प्रबंधन — संगठन में बदलाव को सुनियोजित ढंग से अपनाने की प्रक्रिया
definition: structured practice of preparing, supporting and communicating with people so an organisational change actually sticks
example: The change management plan was an email titled 'exciting news' sent at 6 pm Friday.

hindi: नियंत्रण परिवर्तन — अधिग्रहण या स्वामित्व बदलने पर लागू होने वाली शर्तें
definition: contract terms triggered when a company is acquired or its ownership shifts, often allowing termination or accelerating vesting
example: The change of control clause meant the biggest customer could walk the day the acquisition closed.

hindi: परिवर्तन अनुरोध — तय दायरे में औपचारिक बदलाव की माँग
definition: a formal ask to alter agreed scope, schedule, or budget
example: That tiny tweak is a change request; here's form CR-114.

hindi: बदलाव-सूची — हर रिलीज़ में क्या बदला, उसका बहीखाता
definition: the file recording what changed in each release
example: The changelog says 'minor fixes'; the diff says 12,000 lines.

hindi: साझा चैट कक्ष — एक विषय की जगह
definition: a shared chat space organized around one topic, in theory
example: Take the lunch debate to the random channel, please.

hindi: चैनल टकराव — सीधी बिक्री टीम और भागीदारों में एक ही ग्राहक पर झगड़ा
definition: friction when direct sellers and reseller partners compete for the same customer or deal
example: Channel conflict peaked when our rep and our partner sent the customer competing quotes on the same morning.

hindi: अराजकता अभियांत्रिकी — जानबूझकर तोड़कर मज़बूती परखना
definition: deliberately breaking production to prove the system survives failures
example: Chaos engineering, or as finance calls it, self-inflicted outages.

hindi: शुल्क संकेत — वह कोड जिस पर घंटे दर्ज होकर ग्राहक से वसूले जाते हैं
definition: project code consultants enter against their hours so client work gets billed correctly
example: Nobody would give him a charge code, so the internal training was technically his hobby.

hindi: आंतरिक शुल्क वसूली — दूसरे विभाग की सेवा का खर्च उसी विभाग के बजट पर डालना
definition: billing an internal department for the shared services or infrastructure costs it actually consumes
example: The chargeback for cloud storage finally convinced marketing to delete its forty copies of the brand video.

hindi: चार्ट का कचरा — ग्राफ़ में बेवजह की सजावट जो आँकड़ों को धुँधला करे
definition: needless decoration in a chart, such as three-dimensional effects, heavy gridlines and clip art, that distracts from the data
example: Strip the chart junk and the pie chart reveals it was only ever two slices.

hindi: पीछे पड़कर जवाब माँगना — बार-बार तक़ाज़ा
definition: to repeatedly follow up until someone finally responds
example: I'll chase finance about the reimbursement again on Monday.

hindi: चैटबॉट — उपयोगकर्ताओं से लिखित बातचीत करने वाला प्रोग्राम
definition: a program that converses with users by text, now usually LLM-powered
example: The chatbot handles password resets so humans can handle actual feelings.

hindi: निवेश राशि का आकार — एक निवेशक आमतौर पर एक सौदे में कितना लगाता है
definition: the typical amount a particular investor or fund commits to a single company in one financing round
example: Their check size was too small to lead and too large to ignore, so they got a pro rata and a strong opinion.

hindi: चुनिंदा उठाना — किसी शाखा से एक ख़ास कमिट ही लेना
definition: to copy one specific commit onto another branch, leaving the rest behind
example: Just cherry-pick the fix, not the seventeen commits around it.

hindi: चेस्टरटन की बाड़ — जब तक वजह न समझो, हटाओ मत
definition: the principle of never removing something until you know why it was put there
example: He deleted the weird check; Chesterton's fence and prod explained why it existed.

hindi: मुर्गी-अंडा समस्या — विक्रेता बिना ख़रीदार नहीं, ख़रीदार बिना विक्रेता नहीं
definition: a marketplace dilemma where sellers wait for buyers and buyers wait for sellers
example: We solved the chicken-and-egg problem by paying the chickens, briefly.

hindi: ग्राहक-छीजन — उपयोगकर्ताओं का सेवा छोड़ते जाना
definition: the loss of customers who stop using or paying
example: Churn is our fastest-growing metric, which is the wrong kind of growth.

hindi: छीजन दर — किसी अवधि में सेवा छोड़ने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage of customers lost over a given period
example: The churn rate is five percent monthly, described internally as sturdy.

hindi: ग्राहक छूटने का ख़तरा — नवीनीकरण न होने की आशंका
definition: the likelihood a customer will cancel instead of renewing
example: They asked how to export all their data; the CSM logged it as churn risk.

hindi: सतत एकीकरण, सतत वितरण — कोड को अपने-आप जाँचकर जारी करने की स्वचालित प्रक्रिया
definition: continuous integration, continuous delivery; an automated pipeline that builds, tests and deploys code changes on every merge
example: Our CI/CD pipeline is fully automated, except for Rakesh, who presses the button.

hindi: गोपनीय सूचना ज्ञापन — खरीदारों को दी जाने वाली कंपनी की विस्तृत पुस्तिका
definition: confidential information memorandum; the detailed selling document describing a company's business, financials and growth plans
example: Seventy pages of CIM, and the only slide the buyer read was the adjusted EBITDA bridge.

hindi: बाद में लौटना — बिना फ़ैसला किए चर्चा टालने का विनम्र तरीक़ा
definition: to return to a topic later; often a polite way to end a discussion without deciding
example: Let's circle back next week — and it was never spoken of again.

hindi: परिचालित प्रस्ताव — बिना बैठक के काग़ज़ घुमाकर लिया गया बोर्ड निर्णय
definition: a board decision passed by circulating a written resolution for signatures instead of holding a meeting, common in Indian English
example: The directors approved it by circular resolution, which meant the company secretary chased signatures across four timezones.

hindi: वर्गीकारक — इनपुट को श्रेणियों में बाँटने वाला मॉडल
definition: a model that sorts inputs into categories rather than generating text
example: A tiny classifier decides squat versus deadlift before the fancy models wake up.

hindi: धारा/खंड — अनुबंध का एक विशेष प्रावधान
definition: a specific provision within a contract
example: There's a clause saying they own everything we sketch on napkins.

hindi: वापसी प्रावधान — दिए गए शेयर या बोनस को वापस लेने का अधिकार
definition: a provision letting the company reclaim granted shares, bonuses or proceeds after misconduct or broken conditions
example: The clawback clause was on page forty, right where nobody reads during a celebration.

hindi: साफ़ मेज़ नीति — जाते समय कोई काग़ज़ या गोपनीय चीज़ मेज़ पर न छोड़ना
definition: rule requiring employees to clear confidential papers, notes and devices from desks before leaving
example: The clean desk policy is strictly enforced, which is why the password sticky note now lives under the keyboard.

hindi: ग्राहक साक्षात्कार — प्रोजेक्ट पर लेने से पहले ग्राहक द्वारा ली गई परीक्षा
definition: in Indian English, an interview conducted by the client before accepting a vendor's engineer onto their project
example: He cleared four internal rounds and then the client round asked him about Kubernetes for no reason.

hindi: ग्राहक कार्यालय — ग्राहक का दफ़्तर जहाँ सलाहकार हफ़्ते भर काम करते हैं
definition: the client's office where consultants physically work during a project, often away from home
example: At the client site, the team room had no windows but excellent views of the pantry.

hindi: ग्राहक-सम्मुख — ऐसी भूमिका या काम जो सीधे ग्राहक से जुड़ा हो
definition: describes roles, work or documents that directly interact with clients rather than staying internal
example: Anything client-facing gets three reviews; the internal memo got autocorrect.

hindi: वेस्टिंग की पहली सीमा — आमतौर पर एक साल, उससे पहले कुछ नहीं
definition: the first vesting milestone, typically one year, before which you get nothing
example: The layoff came three weeks before her cliff, coincidentally.

hindi: संक्रमण योजना — कम-कार्बन भविष्य तक पहुँचने का कंपनी का ठोस रोडमैप
definition: company document showing how strategy, capital spending and operations will shift toward emission targets
example: The climate transition plan commits capital to decarbonization, conditional on technology that has not been invented.

hindi: अनुबंध जीवनचक्र प्रबंधन — अनुबंध बनाने से नवीनीकरण तक की निगरानी की प्रणाली
definition: contract lifecycle management; the software and process tracking contracts from drafting and approval through obligations, renewal and expiry
example: The CLM system sent a renewal alert, straight into a mailbox owned by someone who left.

hindi: सौदा पक्का करना — ग्राहक से हस्ताक्षर तक पहुँचना
definition: to get a prospect to sign and become a customer
example: He can close anything except his forty-seven browser tabs.

hindi: समापन योजना — सौदा पूरा करने के लिए बचे कदमों की सूची
definition: seller's written sequence of remaining approvals, meetings and paperwork needed before signature
example: His close plan read 'step one: customer signs', which the deal review found insufficiently detailed.

hindi: बात पूरी करना — सबको नतीजा बताकर सिलसिला ख़त्म करना
definition: to follow up so everyone involved knows the outcome
example: Close the loop with support once the fix ships.

hindi: हारा हुआ सौदा — ग्राहक ने मना कर दिया
definition: marked as a deal that died; usually blamed on pricing, timing, or gravity
example: Closed-lost reason: 'went with competitor.' Actual reason: nobody followed up for six weeks.

hindi: जीता हुआ सौदा — ग्राहक ने हस्ताक्षर कर दिए
definition: marked as a deal that signed; the happiest status in the CRM
example: She rang the gong for every closed-won deal, so we moved the gong.

hindi: सह-संस्थापक — साथ मिलकर कंपनी शुरू करने वाला साझेदार
definition: a partner who starts the company alongside you and shares the risk
example: Choosing a co-founder is like marriage, but the divorce needs a cap table.

hindi: सह-बिक्री अधिकार — संस्थापक शेयर बेचे तो निवेशक भी अपना हिस्सा बेच सकें
definition: an investor right to sell a proportional slice of their shares whenever founders sell shares to a third party
example: The founder's quiet secondary sale was less quiet once three funds invoked their co-sale right.

hindi: समाप्ति-तिथि मिलाना — नए लाइसेंसों की अवधि मौजूदा अनुबंध की नवीनीकरण तिथि से जोड़ना
definition: aligning added licences or products so they share the existing contract's renewal date and billing cycle
example: We co-termed the new seats, so every renewal problem now arrives on the same day.

hindi: भीतरी मार्गदर्शक — ग्राहक कंपनी का वह व्यक्ति जो अंदर की जानकारी देता है
definition: a friendly insider at a prospect company who shares internal information and guidance but lacks power to approve the purchase
example: Our coach told us the budget was approved, then asked if we were hiring.

hindi: कार्य दिवस की समाप्ति तक — दफ़्तरी शाम की मियाद
definition: close of business — end of the working day, formally dressed
example: Legal needs the signatures by COB Thursday.

hindi: नौकरी छूटने के बाद स्वास्थ्य बीमा जारी रखने का अमेरिकी प्रावधान — पूरी प्रीमियम स्वयं भरनी पड़ती है
definition: consolidated omnibus budget reconciliation act; American provision letting departing employees keep employer health insurance by paying the full premium themselves
example: The COBRA quote made unemployment feel like a luxury subscription.

hindi: तिलचट्टा कंपनी — कम ख़र्च में हर संकट झेलकर ज़िंदा रहने वाली कंपनी
definition: a frugal startup built to survive funding droughts, keeping costs tiny and staying alive through any downturn
example: The unicorns laid off half their staff; the cockroach startup next door just renewed its lease on the same four desks.

hindi: कोड पुरातत्व — पुराने कोड की परतें खोदकर इतिहास समझना
definition: excavating old code and history to understand why things are the way they are
example: Code archaeology found the answer: a 2013 commit titled 'temporary'.

hindi: कोड फ़्रीज़ — रिलीज़ से पहले बदलावों पर रोक
definition: a period before release when no new changes may land
example: The code freeze starts Monday, so everything is merging tonight.

hindi: कोड गोल्फ़ — कम-से-कम अक्षरों में समाधान लिखने का खेल
definition: the sport of solving a problem in the fewest possible characters
example: Nice code golf; now write the readable version for the rest of us.

hindi: कोड मज़दूर — बिना सोच-विचार सौंपे टुकड़े टाइप करने वाला (स्व-व्यंग्य)
definition: self-deprecating term for a developer treated as a typing machine, not a thinker
example: Requirements final, no questions, code monkey just types.

hindi: कोड स्वामी — कोड के किसी हिस्से के लिए ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति या टीम, जिसकी स्वीकृति अनिवार्य है
definition: the person or team formally responsible for a part of the codebase, whose approval is required on changes to it
example: The code owner for this folder left in 2022, so every review now waits for a ghost.

hindi: कोड समीक्षा — मर्ज से पहले सहकर्मी की जाँच
definition: peer inspection of a change before it merges
example: The code review had one comment: LGTM. It was 4,000 lines.

hindi: कोड की बदबू — गहरी गड़बड़ी का सतही संकेत
definition: a surface symptom in code that hints at a deeper design problem
example: A 900-line function is not a code smell, it's a code stench.

hindi: विशेषज्ञता केंद्र — किसी क्षमता का केंद्रीय विशेषज्ञ दल
definition: centre of excellence; central specialist team that owns expertise, methods and standards for one capability
example: The analytics CoE had excellent standards and a six-week queue.

hindi: हाज़िरी-कॉफ़ी — दफ़्तर छूकर निकल लेना
definition: badging into the office briefly, then leaving to work elsewhere
example: Anchor days created a coffee badging economy by 10 a.m.

hindi: कॉफ़ी वार्ता — परिचय बढ़ाने की अनौपचारिक गपशप
definition: an informal get-to-know-you conversation over coffee
example: Set up a coffee chat with the new designer this week.

hindi: कॉफ़ी लॉटरी — रिमोट सहकर्मियों को अनौपचारिक बातचीत के लिए बेतरतीब जोड़ियों में मिलाना
definition: pairing remote colleagues randomly each week for informal social video chats across teams
example: Coffee roulette matched me with the CFO, and we discussed the weather for thirty very careful minutes.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक भार — स्क्रीन समझने में लगने वाली मानसिक मेहनत
definition: the mental effort a design demands from its user
example: Nine badges, three banners, one popup: the cognitive load is the feature.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक पड़ताल — नए उपयोगकर्ता की नज़र से हर चरण जाँचना
definition: an expert review stepping through tasks as a first-time user would, asking whether each action is obvious
example: The cognitive walkthrough stalled at step two, which was also where the users stalled.

hindi: बेची गई वस्तुओं की लागत — बिक्री से सीधे जुड़ा खर्च
definition: cost of goods sold; the direct costs of producing whatever the company sold, subtracted from revenue to reach gross profit
example: Engineering wants the hosting bill in R&D; finance insists it belongs in COGS, and gross margin hangs on the outcome.

hindi: समूह — एक ही समय या तरीके से जुड़े उपयोगकर्ताओं का बैच
definition: a group of users bundled by start date or behavior for comparison
example: The January cohort still loves us; February never really did.

hindi: समूह विश्लेषण — एक ही समय जुड़े ग्राहकों के व्यवहार की समय के साथ तुलना
definition: analysis that groups customers by when they signed up or first purchased, then tracks each group's retention and behaviour over time
example: The cohort analysis showed January's users stayed loyal, mostly because January's users were our employees.

hindi: सिक्के से चलने वाला — जो केवल कमीशन या पैसे के लिए ही प्रेरित होता है
definition: describes salespeople or employees motivated almost entirely by commission, bonuses and direct financial incentives
example: Sales is coin-operated: change the commission plan on Monday and the pipeline changes by Tuesday.

hindi: जीवन-यापन समायोजन — महँगाई के हिसाब से वेतन बढ़ाना
definition: cost of living adjustment; a salary increase matching inflation, unrelated to performance
example: The finance team called it a raise; everyone else recognised a COLA wearing a costume.

hindi: बिना पूर्व परिचय फ़ोन — अनजान संभावित ग्राहक को सीधा कॉल
definition: an unsolicited sales phone call to someone who has never heard of you
example: Twenty cold calls, nineteen voicemails, one wrong number — a solid Tuesday.

hindi: बिना परिचय भेजा ईमेल — अनजान संभावित ग्राहक को
definition: an unsolicited sales email to a stranger, ideally personalized beyond their first name
example: His cold email opened with 'Hope you're well' and closed with a calendar link.

hindi: शीत आरंभ — नए उपयोगकर्ता का डेटा न होने से सिफ़ारिशों की मुश्किल
definition: the struggle to serve good predictions for brand-new users or items with no data
example: Day-one users get the cold start special: three generic workouts and a questionnaire.

hindi: ठंडी शुरुआत की समस्या — बिना उपयोगकर्ताओं के उत्पाद बेकार लगना
definition: the struggle of launching a product that is only useful once many people use it
example: The cold start problem, explained: our chat app has three users, all employees.

hindi: बिना संदर्भ हस्तांतरण — ग्राहक को बिना जानकारी दिए दूसरे विभाग भेज देना
definition: transferring customers to another agent or department without introduction or context, forcing them to explain everything again
example: After the third cold transfer, the customer could recite their account number in their sleep.

hindi: बिक्री सामग्री — ब्रोशर, डेक और परिचय दस्तावेज़
definition: the decks, one-pagers, and brochures sales leaves behind with prospects
example: The rep asked for updated collateral, meaning the deck from before the rebrand.

hindi: सह-स्थित — एक ही दफ़्तर में साथ
definition: working physically together in the same office
example: The pilot team is colocated; everyone else joins the stream.

hindi: गिनती पूरी करने वाला विक्रेता — जिसे सिर्फ़ तुलना के लिए बुलाया गया हो
definition: a vendor invited into a buying process only to fill the comparison spreadsheet, with no real chance of winning
example: The RFP asked for our pricing within an hour, which is how we learned we were column fodder.

hindi: अस्पष्टता में सहज — बिना साफ़ निर्देश या प्रक्रिया के काम कर पाने की अपेक्षा
definition: job-listing language asking candidates to work without clear direction, defined roles, documented process or stable priorities
example: The role asked for someone comfortable with ambiguity, which explained why nobody could tell me what the role was.

hindi: आदेश-नियंत्रण शैली — ऊपर से निर्देश, नीचे से पालन वाला कठोर प्रबंधन
definition: a top-down management style where decisions come from senior leaders and teams execute orders with little autonomy
example: We moved away from command and control, announced the CEO, effective as soon as he approved it.

hindi: सेनापति का उद्देश्य — आदेश के पीछे का मक़सद ताकि टीम ख़ुद सही निर्णय ले सके
definition: military-derived practice of stating the purpose and desired outcome of a task so teams can adapt without further orders
example: The commander's intent was clear: ship by Friday, and please stop asking what ship means.

hindi: बिक्री पर कमीशन — सौदे के अनुपात में कमाई
definition: the percentage of a deal's value paid to the salesperson who closed it
example: Nothing focuses the mind like commission on a seven-figure deal.

hindi: कमीशन की बेचैनी — सेल्सकर्मी की उतावली जिसे ग्राहक तुरंत भाँप लेता है
definition: the visible desperation of a salesperson chasing commission, which prospects sense and which scares deals away
example: He followed up three times before lunch, and the buyer could smell the commission breath through email.

hindi: पक्का सौदा — वह सौदा जिसे विक्रेता इस तिमाही बंद होने की गारंटी देता है
definition: an opportunity placed in the commit forecast category, which the sales representative personally guarantees will close this quarter
example: Nothing ages a sales manager like a commit deal that goes quiet on the thirtieth.

hindi: प्रतिबद्ध ख़र्च — अनुबंध के तहत विक्रेता पर न्यूनतम राशि ख़र्च करने का वादा
definition: a contractual promise to spend a minimum amount with a vendor over a term, usually exchanged for discounts
example: We have committed spend left in December, which is how the team got new laptops and a mysterious service.

hindi: संचार प्रमुख — घटना के दौरान ग्राहकों और अधिकारियों को जानकारी देने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the person during an incident who writes updates for customers, executives and support while engineers focus on fixing
example: The comms lead translated 'we have no idea' into 'we are actively investigating'.

hindi: वेतन-पैकेज — तनख्वाह, बोनस और इक्विटी का कुल
definition: compensation; shorthand for everything a job pays you
example: The mission is inspiring, but let's discuss comp.

hindi: प्रतिपूरक अवकाश — छुट्टी वाले दिन काम करने के बदले मिली छुट्टी
definition: compensatory off; Indian English term for leave granted in exchange for working weekends or public holidays
example: He earned a comp off for the Sunday release and spent it fixing the Sunday release.

hindi: पारिश्रमिक समीक्षा — वेतन, बोनस और इक्विटी की नियमित जाँच
definition: the periodic process where managers and human resources revisit salaries, bonuses and equity against performance and market data
example: Comp review is when your manager finally learns what you are paid.

hindi: तुलनात्मक वेतन अनुपात — वेतन को बैंड के मध्य बिंदु से भाग
definition: an employee's salary divided by the midpoint of their salary range, showing whether they are paid below or above market
example: HR says her compa-ratio is 0.82, which is a polite decimal for underpaid.

hindi: निर्णायक घटना — जो ख़रीद को टालने न दे
definition: a deadline or trigger forcing the customer to buy now rather than someday
example: No compelling event, no deal — 'someday' is not a close date.

hindi: पारिश्रमिक समिति — अधिकारियों के वेतन और प्रोत्साहन तय करने वाली बोर्ड समिति
definition: the board committee that sets executive salaries, bonuses and equity awards, and designs incentive plans
example: The compensation committee benchmarked the CEO against peers, carefully selecting peers who were paid more.

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धी जानकारी — प्रतिद्वंद्वियों की गतिविधि की ख़बर
definition: gathered knowledge about competitors' products, pricing, and moves
example: Competitive intel: their changelog, their job postings, and one very chatty prospect.

hindi: प्रतिद्वंद्वी का ग्राहक छीनना — दूसरे विक्रेता के मौजूदा ग्राहक को अपनी ओर करना
definition: a deal secured by displacing a competitor already installed at the customer, usually rewarded with extra commission
example: The competitive takeout earned him a bonus, a trophy and a very cold email from his former colleague.

hindi: अनुपालन — नियम-क़ानूनों के मुताबिक़ चलना
definition: conforming to laws, regulations, and internal policies
example: Compliance says the spreadsheet of passwords has to go.

hindi: घटक पुस्तकालय — तैयार UI हिस्सों का साझा संग्रह
definition: a collection of prebuilt UI pieces teams assemble screens from
example: Check the component library before building yet another custom dropdown.

hindi: संकुचित कार्य-सप्ताह — कम दिनों में लंबे घंटे काम करके पूरा सप्ताह निपटाना
definition: working the full weekly hours across fewer days, such as four ten-hour days
example: The compressed workweek gave us Fridays off and Thursdays that end sometime after dinner.

hindi: तुलनीय कंपनियाँ — समान कंपनियों के मूल्यांकन गुणकों से तुलना
definition: comparable companies analysis; valuing a business using trading multiples of similar listed peers
example: The comps set was chosen with great rigour, meaning everyone trading below twelve times was excluded.

hindi: अभिकलन क्षमता — मॉडल चलाने की प्रोसेसिंग ताक़त, यानी बड़ा ख़र्च
definition: processing power for training and running models, usually measured in money
example: The new feature is approved pending compute; so, approved in spirit.

hindi: गणना-संसाधन निधि — जीपीयू और मॉडल ख़र्च के लिए तय राशि
definition: money reserved for graphics processors and model usage, rationed between teams like office space
example: Our compute budget ran out in March, so April's roadmap is a spreadsheet.

hindi: कंप्यूटर दृष्टि — चित्रों और वीडियो को समझने वाला एआई
definition: AI that understands images and video — detecting objects, people, and movement
example: Computer vision counts your reps through the front camera, judgment included at no charge.

hindi: संबंधित — जिस व्यक्ति या टीम से मामला जुड़ा हो
definition: an Indian English adjective placed before a noun to mean the relevant person, team or department responsible
example: Please contact the concerned team, whose identity is known only to the concerned team.

hindi: हाथ से चलाया न्यूनतम उत्पाद — सॉफ़्टवेयर की जगह टीम ख़ुद सेवा देकर माँग परखती है
definition: a minimum viable product delivered manually by the team, serving early customers by hand to validate demand before automating
example: Our AI scheduling assistant is a concierge MVP, which is to say it's Priya.

hindi: निजी मार्गदर्शित शुरुआत — विशेषज्ञ द्वारा ग्राहक को व्यक्तिगत रूप से सेटअप करवाना
definition: personalised customer onboarding where a dedicated specialist configures the product and guides customers through setup personally
example: Concierge onboarding for the pilot customer consumed the entire implementation team for a quarter.

hindi: विश्वास अंतराल — असली मान जिस दायरे में होने की संभावना है
definition: the range within which the true value plausibly falls
example: The confidence interval includes zero, which the summary slide omits.

hindi: विश्वास अंक — मॉडल अपने अनुमान पर कितना आश्वस्त है, उसका मान
definition: a number showing how sure a model is about its own prediction
example: It labeled the movement 'burpee, probably' with a confidence score of 0.51.

hindi: स्थायीकरण — परिवीक्षा के बाद नौकरी पक्की होना
definition: an Indian English term for an employee's formal move from probation to permanent status after review
example: Her confirmation letter arrived eight months after her confirmation date.

hindi: शर्मिंदा कर मनाना — मना करने के विकल्प को अपमानजनक शब्द देना
definition: a dark pattern wording the decline option to guilt users, like 'No thanks, I hate saving money'
example: Legal flagged the confirmshaming, so 'No, I enjoy paying full price' became 'Maybe later'.

hindi: संक्षिप्त चर्चा-बैठक — किसी विषय पर बात करने के लिए तय की गई छोटी मीटिंग
definition: in Indian English, a short meeting or call arranged to discuss something specific, as in 'let's set up a connect'
example: Let's have a quick connect tomorrow, he said, and sent an invite for two hours.

hindi: विश्लेषकों का औसत अनुमान — बाज़ार की साझा उम्मीद
definition: average analyst forecast for company revenue or earnings, against which quarterly results are judged a beat or miss
example: Earnings rose forty percent, but consensus wanted forty-two, so the stock fell.

hindi: सहमति कार्यसूची — बिना चर्चा एक साथ पारित होने वाले नियमित विषय
definition: a bundle of routine board items approved together in one vote, without individual discussion, to save meeting time
example: Someone slipped the auditor change into the consent agenda, where it passed between the coffee and the croissants.

hindi: परिणामी क्षति — सीधे नुकसान से आगे की अप्रत्यक्ष हानि
definition: indirect losses such as lost profits or lost business that flow from a breach, usually excluded from liability in contracts
example: Their lawyer excluded consequential damages, which covered roughly everything we were actually worried about.

hindi: विचार-सूची — खरीदने से पहले ग्राहक जिन ब्रांडों को तौलता है
definition: the short list of brands a customer seriously evaluates before a purchase, which marketing tries to enter before the final decision
example: We are not losing deals; we are simply not in the consideration set.

hindi: स्थिर मुद्रा आधार — विनिमय दर का असर हटाकर नतीजे
definition: financial results restated as though foreign exchange rates had stayed fixed, isolating underlying business performance
example: In constant currency we grew nicely, which is comforting until you convert it to dollars.

hindi: रचनात्मक बर्ख़ास्तगी — हालात इतने बिगाड़ना कि कर्मचारी ख़ुद इस्तीफ़ा दे
definition: legal term for an employer making conditions so intolerable that resigning becomes effectively forced
example: Moving his desk into the stairwell was, his lawyer argued, constructive dismissal.

hindi: परामर्श अवधि — छँटनी से पहले कानूनी रूप से अनिवार्य बातचीत का समय
definition: legally required window, especially in Britain and Europe, for discussing proposed layoffs with affected staff
example: The consultation period consulted everyone and changed nothing, precisely as scheduled.

hindi: सलाहकार की तरह बेचना — पहले सुनना, समझना, फिर सुझाव देना
definition: a selling method where the seller acts like an advisor, asking questions and understanding needs before recommending anything
example: Consultative selling means listening for forty minutes before recommending the thing you were always going to recommend.

hindi: संपर्क दर — प्रति ग्राहक या प्रति ऑर्डर सहायता संपर्कों की संख्या
definition: number of support contacts relative to customers or orders, used to judge whether products generate avoidable support demand
example: The contact rate spiked the morning after the redesign that nobody asked for.

hindi: सामग्री समीक्षा — सारे प्रकाशित लेखों की गिनती और परख
definition: systematic inventory reviewing every published page and article to decide what to keep, update, merge or delete
example: The content audit found eleven pages titled Getting Started, none of them agreeing.

hindi: सामग्री कार्यसूची — कब कौन-सी पोस्ट छपेगी, इसकी तय योजना
definition: shared schedule planning which posts, videos and articles publish on which dates and channels
example: The content calendar had forty posts planned and zero people assigned to write them.

hindi: सामग्री का क्षय — पुराने लेखों का ट्रैफिक धीरे-धीरे गिरना
definition: gradual decline in search traffic and rankings for older published articles as they grow outdated
example: Content decay is when the 2019 guide still says to download the Flash plugin.

hindi: सामग्री डिज़ाइन — उपयोगकर्ता की ज़रूरत से शब्द और जानकारी गढ़ना
definition: designing the words, structure and information in a product around user needs, not merely writing copy
example: Content design cut the help page from nine hundred words to forty, and the tickets dropped.

hindi: सामग्री कारखाना — सर्च ट्रैफिक के लिए थोक में बना सस्ता लेखन
definition: website or operation mass-producing cheap, poor-quality articles designed purely to capture search traffic and advertising revenue
example: The competitor outranks us with a content farm that has published four hundred posts about the same keyword.

hindi: सामग्री द्वारा प्रचार — उपयोगी लेखों से ग्राहक खींचना
definition: publishing useful content to attract buyers instead of interrupting them with ads
example: Content marketing: a blog post about spreadsheets that ends in a demo link.

hindi: सामग्री निगरानी — हानिकारक या अनुचित सामग्री को छानकर रोकना
definition: filtering harmful or inappropriate content from what users and models produce
example: Content moderation caught the gym-selfie captions before they reached the community feed.

hindi: सामग्री नवीनीकरण — पुराने लेख को अपडेट कर फिर से चमकाना
definition: updating an older published article with current facts and keywords to recover its search traffic and rankings
example: The content refresh changed the year in the title and nothing else, and somehow it worked.

hindi: सामग्री का पुनः उपयोग — एक चीज़ को कई रूपों में बदलना
definition: turning one piece of content, such as a webinar, into clips, posts, articles and newsletters for other channels
example: Thanks to content repurposing, one forty-minute webinar became six months of LinkedIn posts.

hindi: संदर्भ अभियांत्रिकी — मॉडल को दिखने वाली हर जानकारी की सोची-समझी व्यवस्था
definition: designing everything a model sees — instructions, documents, history — not just the prompt
example: Prompt engineering is out; context engineering is the same job with a better title.

hindi: संदर्भ-बदलाव — कामों के बीच कूदने की मानसिक लागत
definition: the mental cost of jumping between unrelated tasks or meetings
example: Four ten-minute gaps aren't focus time; they're context switching.

hindi: संदर्भ खिड़की — मॉडल एक बार में जितना पाठ ध्यान में रख सकता है
definition: the maximum amount of text a model can consider at one time
example: The chat history blew past the context window, so it forgot your knee injury.

hindi: संदर्भ में अवलोकन — उपयोगकर्ता को उसके काम की जगह पर देखना
definition: research observing and interviewing users in their real work setting while they perform actual tasks
example: The contextual inquiry revealed the accountants print our dashboard and annotate it with a pen.

hindi: निरंतर खोज — हर हफ़्ते ग्राहकों से बात करके उत्पाद के फ़ैसले लेना
definition: the product habit of talking with customers every week and running small experiments continuously rather than doing research once
example: Continuous discovery means weekly customer calls, not one survey in 2022.

hindi: अनुबंध से स्थायी — पहले ठेके पर, फिर स्थायी नियुक्ति की संभावना
definition: describing a role that starts as a fixed-term contract with possible conversion to permanent employment
example: It was contract-to-hire, with the emphasis, eighteen months later, still firmly on contract.

hindi: योगदान मार्जिन — प्रति बिक्री, परिवर्तनीय लागत घटाकर बची कमाई
definition: revenue per sale minus its variable costs
example: Contribution margin is positive, excluding the discounts that made the sale.

hindi: नियंत्रण समूह — जिन्हें बदलाव नहीं दिखता, तुलना के लिए
definition: the users who see no change, providing the comparison baseline
example: The control group outperformed the feature, which nobody put on the slide.

hindi: जो बस में है उसे सँभालो — बाहरी हालात छोड़ अपने काम पर ध्यान
definition: management rallying cry to focus on costs, execution and pricing because external economic conditions cannot be changed
example: Sales fell thirty percent, so leadership asked everyone to control the controllables, starting with travel.

hindi: रूपांतरण — विज़िटर का ग्राहक या इच्छित कार्य में बदल जाना
definition: a user completing the action you wanted, like signing up or paying
example: We celebrate every conversion; there is time, there are so few.

hindi: परिवर्तन छूट — नोट या SAFE निवेशक को अगले राउंड की कीमत पर छूट
definition: the percentage reduction below the next priced round that convertible note or SAFE holders receive when their investment converts
example: A twenty percent conversion discount felt small until the round priced and the angels quietly became the third-largest holders.

hindi: रूपांतरण दर — इच्छित कार्य पूरा करने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage of users who complete a desired action
example: The conversion rate improved after we removed the survey about conversion.

hindi: परिवर्तनीय ऋणपत्र — बाद के दौर में शेयरों में बदलने वाला क़र्ज़
definition: a loan that converts into equity at a future priced round
example: The convertible note kept us alive until the Series A priced it.

hindi: कॉनवे का नियम — सिस्टम का ढाँचा संगठन के ढाँचे की नक़ल करता है
definition: systems mirror the communication structure of the organizations that build them
example: Four teams, four half-compatible APIs, Conway's law undefeated.

hindi: छिपा भंडार — अच्छे समय में अधिक प्रावधान रखकर बाद में मुनाफ़ा सजाना
definition: reserves overstated during strong periods and quietly released later to smooth earnings, a practice regulators prohibit
example: The auditor wanted to know why the reserves always shrank exactly when the quarter looked soft, which is how cookie jar reserves get found.

hindi: काम पर दावा करने वाला — जो काम अपने नाम कर लेता है पर करता नहीं
definition: someone who claims ownership of tasks or projects early, then never actually delivers the work
example: The cookie licker has had that ticket assigned since March, just to keep anyone else from touching it.

hindi: जूठा करके छोड़ना — काम पर दावा ठोककर उसे न करना, ताकि कोई और भी न कर सके
definition: claiming ownership of work or projects without delivering them, which blocks colleagues from taking them
example: Twelve tickets assigned to him since spring: less a backlog, more cookie licking.

hindi: सह-चालक — इंसान के साथ काम करता, सुझाव देता एआई सहायक
definition: an AI assistant that works alongside a person, suggesting rather than replacing
example: The copilot drafts the training plan; the human coach still takes the blame.

hindi: शब्द-संग्रह दस्तावेज़ — स्क्रीन के सारे लिखित पाठ एक जगह
definition: a document collecting every piece of interface text for a feature, reviewed separately from the visuals
example: Legal edited the copy deck, which nobody told the designers, who shipped the old words.

hindi: कॉपी-पेस्ट कोड — बिना समझे चिपकाया दोहराव भरा कोड
definition: code duplicated by paste, bugs included, understanding not included
example: The same bug fixed in four places, thanks, copy-pasta.

hindi: मूल दक्षता — संस्था की सबसे मज़बूत क़ाबिलियत
definition: what an organization is genuinely best at
example: Payments is our core competency; the chatbot was a detour.

hindi: मुख्य घंटे — जब सबका उपलब्ध रहना तय है
definition: agreed hours when everyone is reachable for collaboration
example: Outside core hours, expect answers tomorrow, not tonight.

hindi: मुख्य अद्यतन — सर्च इंजन की रैंकिंग प्रणाली में बड़ा बदलाव
definition: major search engine change to its ranking system that reshuffles which websites appear for search results
example: After the core update, the SEO team spent a week refreshing dashboards and their resumes.

hindi: सह-संबंध बनाम कारण — साथ-साथ बदलना वजह होना नहीं है
definition: the reminder that two metrics moving together proves nothing
example: Ice cream sales track our churn; correlation versus causation, hopefully.

hindi: लागत बँटवारा — साझा खर्च को विभागों में बाँटना
definition: distributing shared overhead costs across departments using a formula, whether or not they consumed them
example: Cost allocation put a slice of the CEO's jet on the support team's budget.

hindi: लागत से बचाव — जो खर्च होने वाला था पर नहीं हुआ, उसे बचत गिनना
definition: claiming savings from spending that was projected but never happened, rather than reducing current costs
example: Procurement reported millions in cost avoidance, none of which appeared anywhere in the actual budget.

hindi: लागत केंद्र — ऐसा विभाग जो कमाता नहीं, सिर्फ़ ख़र्च करता है
definition: a department that spends money without directly generating revenue
example: Call us a cost center again and watch the servers go down.

hindi: खर्च पर अनुशासन — ख़र्च को सख़्ती से काबू में रखना
definition: management tightly controlling spending and hiring to protect margins, praised by investors when revenue growth slows
example: Cost discipline arrived the same week as the new corporate jet.

hindi: देरी की लागत — किसी फ़ीचर को टालने से होने वाला राजस्व या मूल्य का नुकसान
definition: the revenue or value lost for every week a feature ships late, used to prioritize backlog work by urgency
example: She put a cost of delay on the integration, and suddenly finance wanted it yesterday.

hindi: लागत अनुकूलन — खर्च घटाना, अक्सर छँटनी सहित
definition: cutting company spending, often including layoffs, described as tuning rather than shrinking
example: Cost optimization began with the snacks and ended with the snack team.

hindi: प्रति भर्ती लागत — एक कर्मचारी भर्ती करने का कुल ख़र्च
definition: a recruiting metric totaling advertising, agency, recruiter and interview costs divided by hires made
example: Finance calculated our cost per hire and quietly suggested the referral bonus was a bargain.

hindi: लागत कटौती — खर्च को व्यवस्थित ढंग से स्थायी रूप से घटाना
definition: a structured programme to permanently remove operating costs, often through process changes, procurement savings and headcount reduction
example: The cost takeout target was forty million, and the first cut was the office coffee.

hindi: ईमेल से काम चल जाता — बेवजह बुलाई बैठक पर कटाक्ष
definition: said of a meeting that added nothing beyond its written summary
example: Forty minutes, no decisions: that could have been an email.

hindi: क़ानूनी सलाहकार — कंपनी के वकील
definition: the company's lawyers, as in 'check with counsel'
example: Run the scraper idea past counsel before you run the scraper.

hindi: सलाह देकर बाहर — विनम्रता से नौकरी छोड़ने के लिए कहा जाना
definition: politely told by a consulting firm to leave because promotion is unlikely, under up-or-out promotion-or-exit rules
example: He was counseled out with six months' notice and a surprisingly warm farewell deck.

hindi: प्रति-मापदंड — मुख्य आँकड़े के दुरुपयोग को पकड़ने वाला जोड़ीदार आँकड़ा
definition: a paired metric that catches the damage of over-optimizing the main one
example: Clicks went up; the counter metric noticed the clickbait.

hindi: इस्तीफे पर रोकने के लिए मौजूदा कंपनी का बेहतर प्रस्ताव
definition: a raise your employer suddenly finds when you try to resign
example: The counteroffer matched the new salary he'd been denied at review time.

hindi: कम शर्तों वाला — ऋणदाताओं की सुरक्षा-शर्तें बहुत कम रखने वाला कर्ज़
definition: describing loans with few maintenance covenants, giving borrowers freedom and lenders fewer early warnings
example: The loan was so covenant-lite that the only remaining requirement was to answer the phone.

hindi: ग्राहक-संबंध बैंकर — किसी उद्योग या ग्राहकों से रिश्ता संभालने वाला बैंकर
definition: a banker who owns client relationships within an industry or region, bringing product specialists into deals
example: The coverage banker's main deliverable was lunch, and it was excellent.

hindi: काउबॉय कोडिंग — नियम-प्रक्रिया दरकिनार, सीधे बदलाव ठोकना
definition: coding without process, review, or fear, changes ride straight to production
example: Cowboy coding on prod again, at least wear the hat.

hindi: प्रति-अधिग्रहण लागत — एक ग्राहक या कार्रवाई पाने में लगा विज्ञापन खर्च
definition: cost per acquisition; the advertising spend needed to win one paying customer, signup or other conversion
example: Finance asked why CPA doubled; marketing asked why finance was reading the dashboard.

hindi: प्रति क्लिक लागत — हर क्लिक के लिए चुकाई जाने वाली राशि
definition: cost per click; the price an advertiser pays each time someone clicks an online advertisement, common in search and social campaigns
example: Our CPC tripled overnight, which coincides with the competitor bidding on our company name.

hindi: प्रति-इंस्टॉल लागत — ऐप के एक डाउनलोड पर खर्च हुआ विज्ञापन पैसा
definition: cost per install; the advertising spend needed to earn one mobile application download or installation
example: We celebrated a record-low CPI, then learned most installs were deleted within the hour.

hindi: प्रति-लीड लागत — एक संभावित ग्राहक का संपर्क पाने का खर्च
definition: cost per lead; the advertising spend needed to capture one prospect's contact details through forms
example: CPL is fantastic, provided nobody checks whether any of those leads ever answered a phone.

hindi: प्रति हज़ार दर्शन लागत — हज़ार बार विज्ञापन दिखाने का खर्च
definition: cost per mille; the price an advertiser pays for one thousand impressions of an advertisement, the standard unit for buying display media
example: The CPM was wonderfully cheap, because the placements were inside a game nobody plays.

hindi: शिल्प-कौशल — बारीकियों में झलकने वाली कारीगरी
definition: the care and skill visible in a product's details
example: You can feel the craft in this screen and the deadline in the next.

hindi: ज़बरन तनुकरण — नई शर्तों से पुराने निवेशकों का हिस्सा बेहद घटाना
definition: a punitive financing where incoming investors impose terms that severely dilute existing shareholders who cannot or will not invest
example: The cram-down arrived dressed as a lifeline, and the seed investors read the math twice before signing.

hindi: आठ झटपट खाके — आठ मिनट में आठ विचार बनाने का अभ्यास
definition: a sketching exercise where each person draws eight rough ideas in eight minutes to generate options quickly
example: By sketch five of crazy eights, most of the room was drawing the same button with more confidence.

hindi: कॉरपोरेट अचल संपत्ति — कंपनी के दफ़्तर और इमारतें संभालने वाला विभाग
definition: corporate real estate; the function managing company offices, leases and buildings as a business portfolio
example: CRE announced the office move with a floor plan and a promise that the coffee machine is coming too.

hindi: रचनात्मक निर्देश-पत्र — अभियान का लक्ष्य, दर्शक और मुख्य संदेश
definition: a short document telling the creative team or agency the campaign objective, target audience, single-minded message, deliverables and mandatory elements
example: The creative brief asked for bold and disruptive, then attached twelve mandatory legal disclaimers.

hindi: विज्ञापन-थकान — बार-बार दिखने से असर घटना
definition: declining performance of an advertisement after audiences have seen it too many times, signalling that fresh creative work is needed
example: Creative fatigue set in by week two, though the team had been tired of the advert since week zero.

hindi: रचनाकार अर्थव्यवस्था — स्वतंत्र क्रिएटरों की कमाई पर टिका बाज़ार
definition: the business of independent creators earning money from audiences through sponsorships, subscriptions, merchandise and platform payouts
example: Every startup pitch this year is a tool for the creator economy, sold to people who have no budget.

hindi: श्रेय हथियाना — दूसरों के काम का श्रेय ख़ुद ले लेना
definition: an attempt to claim credit for work, ideas or results that colleagues actually delivered
example: Announcing the launch in the all-hands before the team did was a textbook credit grab.

hindi: समालोचना सत्र — साथियों से डिज़ाइन पर खुली, बेबाक राय
definition: a structured session where designers get candid feedback from peers
example: Bring thick skin to crit; the feedback is about the work, mostly.

hindi: क्रांतिक पथ — कार्यों की वह शृंखला जो कुल अवधि तय करती है
definition: the chain of dependent tasks that determines the project's minimum duration
example: Design review is on the critical path, so everyone suddenly cares.

hindi: पूर्ण प्रतिक्रिया पत्र — नियामक द्वारा दवा अभी मंज़ूर न करने की सूचना
definition: complete response letter; formal regulatory notice that a drug application cannot be approved yet, listing deficiencies to resolve
