example: The press release described the CRL as 'a clear path forward', which is one way to spell rejection.

hindi: ग्राहक-संबंध प्रबंधन सॉफ़्टवेयर — संपर्कों और सौदों का रिकॉर्ड
definition: customer relationship management software — the database of every contact, deal, and broken promise
example: If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen; it's not in the CRM.

hindi: ग्राहक रिकॉर्ड स्वच्छता — ग्राहक प्रबंधन प्रणाली के आँकड़े सही और ताज़ा रखना
definition: keeping customer relationship management records accurate, with current stages, amounts, contacts and close dates
example: CRM hygiene week revealed eleven deals scheduled to close on the same date: last Tuesday.

hindi: रूपांतरण दर अनुकूलन — वेबसाइट सुधार कर ज़्यादा आगंतुकों को ग्राहक बनाना
definition: conversion rate optimisation; systematically testing website and funnel changes so more visitors complete purchases or signups
example: The CRO team changed the button colour and presented it as a strategic transformation.

hindi: आंतरिक शुल्क लगाना — एक विभाग की लागत दूसरे विभाग पर डालना
definition: to bill one internal department or entity for costs or services another department provided
example: IT cross-charged us for the laptops, so our budget paid for equipment we had asked them to provide.

hindi: सीधा हस्तांतरण — आया माल बिना भंडारण के सीधे बाहर जाने वाले ट्रक में
definition: unloading inbound shipments and transferring them directly onto outbound trucks with little or no warehouse storage
example: Cross-docking works flawlessly as long as both trucks agree on what day it is.

hindi: बहु-विभागीय — कई विभागों के लोगों से बना
definition: involving people from multiple departments
example: The cross-functional team agreed on everything except everything.

hindi: संबंधित उत्पाद बेचना — मौजूदा ग्राहक को दूसरा उत्पाद
definition: to sell an existing customer a different product from the one they already use
example: They came for the analytics tool; we cross-sold the dashboard nobody asked for.

hindi: क्रंच — डेडलाइन से पहले लंबी थकाऊ काम की अवधि
definition: an intense stretch of long hours before a deadline
example: We avoid crunch by planning, and by lowering our definition of avoid.

hindi: ग्राहक संतुष्टि स्कोर — सेवा से खुशी नापने वाला सर्वे-पैमाना
definition: customer satisfaction score, usually from a quick post-interaction survey
example: CSAT is high among customers who answer surveys, a famously chill group.

hindi: ग्राहक सफलता प्रबंधक — ग्राहक को संतुष्ट और जुड़ा रखने वाला
definition: customer success manager — the person assigned to keep customers happy and renewing
example: Our CSM knows their org chart better than they do.

hindi: ग्राहक सफलता द्वारा योग्य बिक्री अवसर — मौजूदा ग्राहक से मिला अपसेल का संकेत
definition: customer success qualified lead; an expansion opportunity spotted by customer success within an existing account and passed to sales
example: Every CSQL gets passed to sales, who then introduce themselves to our customer as if meeting them for the first time.

hindi: कॉर्पोरेट सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्व — समाज और पर्यावरण के प्रति कंपनी की स्वैच्छिक या अनिवार्य पहलें
definition: corporate social responsibility; company programmes and spending aimed at community welfare and environmental causes
example: The CSR team planted two thousand saplings and one very well-lit photo opportunity.

hindi: यूरोपीय कॉर्पोरेट स्थिरता रिपोर्टिंग निर्देश — अनिवार्य और लेखा-परीक्षित ESG प्रकटीकरण
definition: corporate sustainability reporting directive; European rule requiring audited sustainability disclosures using double materiality standards
example: CSRD turned our glossy sustainability brochure into four hundred audited datapoints overnight.

hindi: कंपनी पर कुल लागत — हर मद जोड़कर बताया गया सालाना पैकेज
definition: cost to company; in Indian English, the total annual package including salary, benefits and employer contributions
example: His CTC sounded impressive until he learned it included the office coffee.

hindi: क्लिक-थ्रू दर — देखने वालों में से क्लिक करने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: click-through rate; clicks divided by impressions
example: The CTR doubled when we made the button say free.

hindi: संस्कृति में नयापन लाने वाला उम्मीदवार — फिट का सुधरा रूप
definition: hiring for what someone brings to the culture, not resemblance to it
example: We hire for culture add now, says the panel of five identical hoodies.

hindi: संस्कृति-वाहक — जो कंपनी के मूल्यों को अपने व्यवहार से जीता और फैलाता है
definition: a trusted employee who embodies the company's values and actively passes them on to newer colleagues
example: Every new hire is paired with a culture carrier, mostly so someone explains why the kitchen has a gong.

hindi: संस्कृति डेक — कंपनी के मूल्यों और काम के तरीक़ों को बताने वाली प्रस्तुति
definition: a slide presentation describing a company's values, working norms and expectations, shared with candidates and staff
example: Slide nine of the culture deck said 'no politics'; slide ten was about who reports to whom.

hindi: कंपनी की संस्कृति से मेल — कई बार 'हम जैसे लोग' का पर्दा
definition: how well a candidate matches company culture; sometimes code for 'similar to us'
example: Rejected for culture fit, which no one could define when asked.

hindi: सुधार अवधि — उल्लंघन ठीक करने के लिए दी गई मोहलत
definition: the window after written notice of a breach during which the breaching party may remedy it before termination rights kick in
example: We had a thirty-day cure period and used twenty-nine of them arguing about what counted as cured.

hindi: मुद्रा का प्रतिकूल असर — विनिमय दर से घटी हुई कमाई
definition: reported revenue or earnings reduced because foreign exchange rates moved against the company's home currency
example: Growth was twelve percent, or three percent once you subtract the currency headwind nobody mentioned first.

hindi: निजी दर्शक-समूह — अपनी ग्राहक सूची या वेबसाइट आगंतुकों से बनी विज्ञापन सूची
definition: advertising audience built from your own customer list, website visitors or application users, uploaded to platforms
example: We built a custom audience from last year's buyers and promptly showed them the discount they missed.

hindi: ग्राहक की पूरी तस्वीर — हर सिस्टम से जोड़ा गया ग्राहक का एकीकृत विवरण
definition: a unified view of a customer that combines purchases, support tickets, marketing activity and account details from every company system
example: The customer 360 took two years to build and still cannot tell us who to call.

hindi: ग्राहक यात्रा — पहली जानकारी से नवीनीकरण तक ग्राहक के सभी चरण
definition: complete sequence of stages and interactions a customer experiences with a company, from first awareness through purchase, onboarding, support and renewal
example: The customer journey map had twelve stages and every single one ended at the billing page.

hindi: ग्राहक जीवनचक्र — ग्राहक संबंध के आरंभ से अंत तक के चरण
definition: stages a customer relationship moves through, typically acquisition, onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion and eventually churn
example: We have a slide for every customer lifecycle stage except the one where they leave.

hindi: ग्राहक सफलता विभाग — ग्राहक को उत्पाद से फ़ायदा दिलाना
definition: the team that helps customers get value so they renew instead of leaving
example: Customer success called it a partnership check-in; the customer called it a sales call.

hindi: ग्राहक-केंद्रित — निर्णयों में ग्राहक की ज़रूरत को प्राथमिकता देने वाला
definition: describing companies, strategies or decisions that put customer needs first when designing products, support, processes and pricing
example: The customer-centric reorganisation moved support to a timezone where no customers live.

hindi: ग्राहक-सम्मुख — सीधे ग्राहकों से संपर्क करने वाली भूमिका या सामग्री
definition: describing roles, documents or systems that customers directly interact with, as opposed to internal-only work
example: The release notes became customer-facing the moment someone forwarded the internal draft.

hindi: कटओवर — पुरानी प्रणाली से नई पर स्विच करने का क्षण
definition: the moment of switching from the old system to the new one
example: Cutover is Saturday 2 a.m., attendance mandatory, sleep optional.

hindi: ग्राहक अनुभव — कंपनी के साथ ग्राहक का कुल अनुभव
definition: customer experience; the overall perception customers form from every interaction with a company's product, support, billing and communication
example: CX is a top priority, according to the recorded message on hold.

hindi: अपना बचाव पहले — बाद में दोष से बचने के लिए पहले से सबूत जुटाना
definition: cover your ass; defensive actions such as documenting decisions and approvals to avoid blame later
example: The fourteen-person cc list wasn't communication; it was pure CYA.

hindi: चक्रीय गिनती — पूरे गोदाम की जगह हिस्सों में नियमित माल-गिनती
definition: counting a rotating subset of warehouse inventory regularly instead of shutting down for one annual full stocktake
example: The cycle count found three hundred extra units, which somehow made accounting angrier.

hindi: चक्र समय — काम शुरू से पूर्ण होने तक की अवधि
definition: how long an item takes from started to done
example: Our cycle time is nine days, eight of which are waiting.

hindi: निदेशक-अधिकारी बीमा — निदेशकों और अधिकारियों को मुक़दमों से बचाने वाली बीमा पॉलिसी
definition: directors and officers liability insurance, which covers legal defence costs and settlements when board members get sued
example: The first question the new director asked was not about strategy but about the D&O insurance limits.

hindi: सीधे उपभोक्ता तक — बिचौलियों के बिना ग्राहक को सीधे बेचने वाले ब्रांड
definition: direct-to-consumer; brands selling straight to customers online without retailers, the common Indian English label for such startups
example: Our D2C brand cut out the middleman and replaced him with a performance-marketing bill twice his size.

hindi: चालक, अनुमोदक, योगदानकर्ता, सूचित — फ़ैसले में किसकी क्या भूमिका है, यह तय करने का ढाँचा
definition: driver, approver, contributors, informed; a decision framework assigning who drives a choice, who makes the final call and who gets consulted or told
example: The DACI listed six approvers, which explains why nothing has been approved.

hindi: अँधेरा डेटा — इकट्ठा किया गया पर कभी इस्तेमाल न हुआ डेटा
definition: information a company collects and stores routinely, such as logs and old files, but never analyses or uses
example: Ninety percent of our storage bill is dark data kept just in case someone asks.

hindi: गुप्त लॉन्च — फ़ीचर चुपचाप चालू कर असली ट्रैफ़िक पर परखना
definition: releasing a feature silently to real traffic before announcing it
example: It's been dark launched for a month; users just haven't noticed.

hindi: छलपूर्ण डिज़ाइन — उपयोगकर्ता को अनचाहे काम की ओर धकेलने वाला इंटरफ़ेस
definition: an interface design that tricks users into doing things they didn't intend
example: Hiding the cancel button behind three menus is a dark pattern, not retention.

hindi: अदृश्य साझेदारी — निजी संदेशों में साझा लिंक जिनका स्रोत न दिखे
definition: sharing that happens through private messages, email and chat applications, where analytics cannot detect the source and records visits as direct traffic
example: Dark social explains the traffic spike: someone posted our pricing page in a founders' chat group.

hindi: डैशबोर्ड — मुख्य आँकड़ों को एक जगह दिखाने वाला पैनल
definition: a single screen collecting the charts a team watches
example: We built a dashboard to track how often we check dashboards.

hindi: डेटा वर्गीकरण — जानकारी को गोपनीयता-स्तर के अनुसार चिह्नित करना
definition: labelling company documents by sensitivity, such as public, internal, confidential or restricted, controlling handling
example: Data classification made him label the lunch menu 'internal' before sharing it with the team.

hindi: डेटा की सफ़ाई — ग़लत, अधूरे और दोहराए गए रिकॉर्ड ठीक करना
definition: fixing messy data before analysis: removing duplicate records, correcting errors, filling missing values and standardising formats
example: The analysis took one afternoon; the data cleaning took the other three weeks.

hindi: डेटा नियंत्रक — जो तय करे कि निजी डेटा क्यों और कैसे उपयोग होगा
definition: the organization that decides why and how personal data is processed and carries primary legal responsibility under privacy laws
example: We're the data controller for employee records and merely the processor for customer uploads, a distinction nobody enjoyed learning.

hindi: डेटा का लोकतंत्रीकरण — कंपनी का डेटा हर कर्मचारी तक पहुँचाना
definition: making company data and reporting tools accessible to every employee, not only analysts, so teams can answer their own questions
example: Data democratization means everyone can now build a dashboard proving they were right.

hindi: डेटा शब्दकोश — हर फ़ील्ड और मेट्रिक का अर्थ बताने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: a reference document defining every field, column and metric in a dataset so everyone reads the numbers the same way
example: According to the data dictionary, active user means three different things depending on the team.

hindi: डेटा का ढेर — बिना विश्लेषण या सफ़ाई के सौंपा गया कच्चा डेटा
definition: a large raw export of records handed over without cleaning, summary or explanation, usually as an enormous spreadsheet
example: He asked for insight and received a data dump with eleven tabs and no headers.

hindi: डेटा का धुआँ — रोज़ के कामकाज के साथ अपने-आप पैदा होने वाला उप-उत्पाद डेटा
definition: the byproduct data generated automatically by everyday digital activity, such as clicks, logs and location pings, often later mined for value
example: The startup's whole pitch is monetising the data exhaust of people ordering samosas.

hindi: डेटा चक्र — उपयोग से डेटा, डेटा से बेहतर मॉडल, फिर और उपयोग
definition: a loop where product usage generates data that improves the model, attracting more usage
example: Every logged workout feeds the data flywheel; the coach gets smarter as you sweat.

hindi: डेटा शासन — डेटा के स्वामित्व, गुणवत्ता और पहुँच के नियम
definition: the policies, ownership and processes deciding who may access company data, how its quality is maintained and how it may be used
example: Data governance arrived as a forty-page policy and a form nobody has found yet.

hindi: डेटा सफ़ाईकर्मी — ज़्यादातर समय डेटा साफ़ करने में लगाने वाला विश्लेषक
definition: self-deprecating description of an analyst whose working hours mostly go into cleaning and fixing messy data rather than analysis
example: They hired a machine learning expert and turned her into the team's full-time data janitor.

hindi: डेटा अंकन — कच्चे डेटा पर सही उत्तर चिपकाने का काम
definition: tagging raw data with correct answers so models can learn from it
example: Data labeling week: watch a thousand squat videos and mark which ones hurt.

hindi: कच्चे डेटा का भंडार — हर तरह का असंसाधित डेटा एक साथ रखने की विशाल जगह
definition: a central storage repository holding huge volumes of company data in its original, unprocessed format until someone needs it
example: We poured every clickstream into the data lake, and nobody has gone swimming since.

hindi: डेटा रिसाव — गोपनीय जानकारी का बाहरी टूल में चले जाना
definition: confidential company information escaping into outside systems, especially when staff paste internal documents into public chatbots
example: The board deck summary was lovely and also a textbook case of data leakage.

hindi: डेटा की वंशावली — कोई आँकड़ा कहाँ से आया और रास्ते में कैसे बदला
definition: the traceable record of where a piece of data originated and every transformation it passed through before reaching a report
example: Nobody could explain the revenue figure because its data lineage ran through someone's personal spreadsheet.

hindi: डेटा साक्षरता — आँकड़ों, चार्टों और मेट्रिक्स को सही ढंग से पढ़ने-समझने की क्षमता
definition: the ability of employees to read, question and correctly interpret numbers, charts and metrics when making work decisions
example: The data literacy workshop began with the difference between average and median, and ended in an argument.

hindi: डेटा की खाई — ऐसा निजी डेटा जो प्रतिस्पर्धी न जुटा सकें
definition: proprietary information a company owns that competitors cannot easily copy, claimed as lasting defence against rivals
example: Our data moat, on closer inspection, was a spreadsheet anyone could scrape.

hindi: डेटा प्रवाह-मार्ग — डेटा को एक सिस्टम से दूसरे तक अपने-आप पहुँचाने वाली व्यवस्था
definition: an automated chain of jobs moving company data from source systems through cleaning steps into storage and reporting dashboards
example: Someone renamed a column upstream, and the whole data pipeline fell over before standup.

hindi: डेटा बिंदु — एक अकेला माप या उदाहरण
definition: a single measurement, or one example doing the job of many
example: Interesting data point, we say, meaning we will forget it by lunch.

hindi: डेटा विषाक्तता — प्रशिक्षण डेटा बिगाड़कर मॉडल को ग़लत सिखाना
definition: corrupting training data so a model learns wrong or malicious behavior
example: Someone bulk-logged fake workouts; call it data poisoning or call it cheating.

hindi: डेटा प्रसंस्कर्ता — जो नियंत्रक के निर्देश पर निजी डेटा संभाले
definition: an organization that handles personal data only on behalf of and under instructions from the data controller, bound by a processing agreement
example: As the data processor, we store their customer data and absorb their customer's panic.

hindi: डेटा निकालना — किसी सवाल के लिए सिस्टम से आँकड़ों का एक बार का निष्कर्षण
definition: a one-off extraction of numbers from a database or reporting system, requested to answer a specific business question
example: Can you do a quick data pull, said the director, about a question that needed four joins.

hindi: डेटा निवास — डेटा को किसी तय देश या क्षेत्र में ही रखने की शर्त
definition: a requirement that customer data be stored and processed only within specific countries or regions, often demanded by regulators or enterprise buyers
example: The bank loved the demo until they asked about data residency and we said 'the cloud'.

hindi: दस्तावेज़ कक्ष — जाँच के लिए निवेशकों से साझा गोपनीय फ़ाइलें
definition: a secure folder of company documents shared with investors during diligence
example: The data room is ready; please ignore the folder named 'misc_final_v7.'

hindi: डेटा संरक्षक — किसी डेटा सेट की गुणवत्ता और सही उपयोग का ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति
definition: the person accountable for keeping a particular dataset accurate, documented and properly used across the company
example: As data steward for the customer table, he mostly fields messages that begin with why is this wrong.

hindi: डेटा दलदल — बिना व्यवस्था का ऐसा डेटा भंडार जिसमें से कुछ काम का निकालना मुश्किल
definition: a data lake gone neglected: company data dumped into storage without documentation, ownership or quality checks, so nobody trusts or finds anything
example: The vendor sold us a data lake; three reorgs later it is a data swamp with a login page.

hindi: डेटा चित्रण — आँकड़ों को चार्ट और ग्राफ़ के रूप में दिखाना
definition: short for data visualisation: presenting numbers through charts, graphs and dashboards so patterns are easier to understand
example: The data viz was gorgeous, which made it harder to notice the numbers were wrong.

hindi: संरचित डेटा भंडार — रिपोर्टिंग के लिए साफ़-सुथरा, व्यवस्थित डेटा
definition: a central repository of cleaned, structured company data organised for reporting, dashboards and business analysis
example: The data warehouse says revenue rose; the finance spreadsheet, as always, has other views.

hindi: डेटा को साधना — बिखरे कच्चे डेटा को विश्लेषण लायक़ रूप में ढालना
definition: the messy manual work of cleaning, reshaping and combining raw data from different sources into a format ready for analysis
example: Her job title says data scientist; her calendar says eighty percent data wrangling.

hindi: डेटा-चालित — फैसले राय से नहीं, आँकड़ों से लेना
definition: making decisions primarily from data rather than opinion
example: We are data-driven, except when the data disagrees with the roadmap.

hindi: डेटा-सूचित — आँकड़े देखकर, पर अंतिम निर्णय समझ से
definition: using data as one input while leaving room for judgment
example: Data-informed means we read the dashboard and then did what we wanted.

hindi: डेटा बहुत, समझ कम — ढेरों आँकड़े पर उनसे कोई काम की बात नहीं
definition: describes an organisation that collects enormous amounts of data but draws few useful conclusions or decisions from it
example: Two hundred dashboards and no answers: textbook data-rich, insight-poor.

hindi: आँकड़ों पर अंतिम ताला — विश्लेषण से पहले ट्रायल के परिणाम स्थायी रूप से जमा करना
definition: the point when clinical trial data is finalized and frozen so statisticians can unblind and analyse results
example: Nobody takes leave the week of database lock, and nobody sleeps the week after.

hindi: दैनिक सक्रिय उपयोगकर्ता — एक दिन में उत्पाद चलाने वाले लोग
definition: daily active users; unique people who use the product in a day
example: DAU spiked Monday, mostly people trying to cancel.

hindi: पहले दिन की परिकल्पना — शुरू में ही अनुमानित उत्तर, जिसे फिर जाँचा जाए
definition: a proposed answer written at the very start of a project, which the team then spends weeks testing with analysis
example: Our day-one hypothesis survived twelve weeks of analysis, mostly because nobody wanted to redo the deck.

hindi: समय-खंड विज्ञापन — दिन के चुने हुए घंटों में ही विज्ञापन चलाना
definition: scheduling advertisements to appear only during certain hours or weekdays when customers convert best
example: Dayparting revealed our best customers buy at two in the morning, which raised other questions.

hindi: रियायती नकदी प्रवाह — भविष्य की कमाई को आज के मूल्य में बदलकर मूल्यांकन
definition: discounted cash flow; valuing a business by projecting future cash flows and discounting them back to present value
example: Change the terminal growth rate by half a point and the DCF will tell you anything you like.

hindi: ऋण पूंजी बाज़ार — बॉन्ड और कर्ज़ जारी करने वाला बैंकिंग विभाग
definition: debt capital markets; the banking group that structures and sells bonds and other debt issuance
example: DCM priced the bond in an hour, then spent a week writing the press release.

hindi: जोखिम घटाना — विफलता की आशंका पहले से कम करना
definition: to reduce a project's chance of failure by tackling the scary parts early
example: We'll de-risk the migration with a spike before committing.

hindi: बेअसर क्लिक — ऐसी जगह क्लिक जहाँ कुछ नहीं होता
definition: a click on something that looks interactive but triggers nothing, tracked as a usability failure signal
example: The dead clicks clustered on a decorative arrow that the brand team refused to remove.

hindi: मृत कोड — कभी न चलने वाला पर फिर भी पड़ा हुआ
definition: code that can never execute yet still lives in the repository
example: Half the file is dead code everyone is afraid to bury.

hindi: मृत हिस्सेदारी — कंपनी छोड़ चुके लोगों के पास पड़े शेयर
definition: meaningful ownership held by departed cofounders or inactive early holders who have stopped contributing to the company
example: Investors spotted the dead equity in five minutes: a cofounder who left in year one still owned twenty percent.

hindi: मृत भंडार — जो माल बिकता नहीं और गोदाम में पड़ा रहता है
definition: inventory that has stopped selling and sits unsold in storage, tying up cash and warehouse space
example: The limited-edition fidget spinners are now officially dead stock and unofficially office decor.

hindi: सौदा अनुमोदन दल — गैर-मानक कीमत और शर्तें मंज़ूर करने वाली टीम
definition: internal team approving non-standard pricing, discounts and contract terms before a deal is signed
example: The deal desk rejected the forty-percent discount, so the rep called it a 'strategic partnership' and resubmitted.

hindi: सौदों की धारा — निवेशक के पास आने वाले प्रस्तावों का प्रवाह
definition: the stream of investment opportunities a VC sees
example: Half their deal flow is warm intros; the other half is LinkedIn optimism.

hindi: सौदा पंजीकरण — भागीदार द्वारा अपना सौदा पहले दर्ज कराना
definition: partner claiming a specific opportunity in advance, protecting their discount and preventing channel competition
example: The reseller filed deal registration for every company in Pune, just to be safe.

hindi: सौदा समीक्षा — किसी एक बड़े सौदे की गहन जाँच
definition: focused inspection of a single large deal, testing its qualification, champion, risks and close plan
example: The deal review lasted ninety minutes and ended with everyone agreeing the customer should probably be asked.

hindi: सौदे का आकार — एक अनुबंध की कुल क़ीमत
definition: the monetary value of a single deal
example: Average deal size doubled once we stopped leading with the discount.

hindi: थकान-यात्रा — विफलता की ओर बढ़ती अंतहीन क्रंच परियोजना
definition: a doomed project kept alive by ever-longer hours and ever-lower morale
example: It's not a death march; the snacks are still good.

hindi: समीक्षा बैठक — घटना के बाद क्या-क्यों की चर्चा
definition: a meeting after an event to review what happened and why
example: Quick debrief after the client call to compare notes.

hindi: दस अरब डॉलर से अधिक मूल्य वाला निजी स्टार्टअप
definition: a private startup valued at ten billion dollars or more
example: Once you're a decacorn, analysts start asking when the IPO is.

hindi: मंद दर — लक्ष्य से कम बिक्री पर घटा हुआ कमीशन
definition: reduced commission rate applied to sales below a quota threshold, the reverse of accelerators
example: The comp plan's decelerator kicks in below half quota, where morale already lives.

hindi: निर्णयकर्ता — जिसके पास ख़रीद की अंतिम मंज़ूरी हो
definition: the person with actual authority to approve the purchase
example: Six great meetings later, we finally met the decision maker: the CFO.

hindi: प्रेज़ेंटेशन — स्लाइडों का सेट
definition: a slide presentation; where strategy goes to be admired
example: The strategy is done; now we just need the deck.

hindi: घटना घोषित करना — समस्या को औपचारिक आपात स्थिति मानकर प्रक्रिया शुरू करना
definition: to formally flag a production problem as an incident, which opens a channel, assigns roles and starts the response process
example: Nobody wanted to declare an incident on a Friday, so the outage stayed a 'blip' for three hours.

hindi: दोहराव हटाना — एक ही रिकॉर्ड की कई प्रतियों को मिटाकर एक रखना
definition: to find and remove duplicate records from a dataset, contact list or customer database so each entry appears once
example: Please dedupe the lead list before the board sees that we have 400 customers named Test.

hindi: गहन पड़ताल — किसी विषय की विस्तृत जाँच
definition: a thorough examination of a topic, promised more often than delivered
example: We'll do a deep dive on the drop-off numbers next quarter.

hindi: गहन प्रौद्योगिकी — विज्ञान की खोजों पर टिका स्टार्टअप, सिर्फ़ ऐप नहीं
definition: startups built on hard science or engineering breakthroughs, not just software
example: Deep tech means the demo is impressive and the timeline is geological.

hindi: गहन कार्य — बिना विघ्न लंबी एकाग्रता
definition: long, distraction-free concentration on cognitively demanding tasks
example: Real deep work needs mornings, not the gaps between meetings.

hindi: डीपफ़ेक — असली व्यक्ति की हूबहू नक़ली ऑडियो-वीडियो
definition: synthetic audio or video realistically impersonating a real person
example: Security training now includes spotting a deepfake of your CEO asking for gift cards.

hindi: स्वतः जीवित — मौजूदा पूँजी से ही मुनाफ़े तक पहुँचने की राह पर
definition: on track to reach profitability with current cash, no new funding needed
example: The CFO confirmed we're default alive, and everyone exhaled at once.

hindi: स्वतः मृत — बिना नए निवेश के मुनाफ़े तक न पहुँच पाना
definition: unable to reach profitability with current cash, dependent on future fundraising
example: Default dead isn't a mood, the CEO said, it's a spreadsheet.

hindi: रक्षण क्षमता — कारोबार की नक़ल कर पाना कितना कठिन है
definition: how hard a business is to copy or compete away
example: The investor's only question was defensibility; our answer was a longer pause.

hindi: स्थगित पारिश्रमिक — कमाई जो बाद के वर्षों में दी जाएगी
definition: compensation earned now but paid in later years, often for executives, sometimes forfeited when leaving before payout
example: The deferred comp arrives in 2029, conveniently after anyone could compare it to the promise.

hindi: आस्थगित राजस्व — पहले मिला पैसा जिसकी सेवा अभी देनी बाकी है
definition: customer payments received in advance for service still undelivered, held as a liability until the company earns it
example: They paid for three years upfront, which sales calls revenue and finance calls deferred revenue.

hindi: पूर्णता की परिभाषा — काम कब सचमुच पूरा माना जाए, उसकी साझा शर्तें
definition: the agreed checklist a task must satisfy before it truly counts as complete
example: By our definition of done, this is definition of almost.

hindi: तैयारी की परिभाषा — कार्य शुरू करने लायक कब है, उसकी शर्तें
definition: the criteria a backlog item must meet before a team will start it
example: It fails the definition of ready, so back to refinement it goes.

hindi: आंशिक रूप से ठप — सेवा चालू तो है पर धीमी या अधूरी
definition: describing a production service that still works but runs slower, partially broken or with some features disabled
example: The status page says degraded, which is engineering for mostly on fire.

hindi: विविधता, समानता और समावेश की संगठनात्मक पहल
definition: diversity, equity, and inclusion; programs aimed at fairer workplaces
example: The DEI report shipped annually; the numbers moved slower.

hindi: प्रबंधन की परतें हटाना — मैनेजरों की छँटनी का सौम्य नाम
definition: removing management layers; layoffs aimed specifically at managers
example: Delayering flattened the org and twelve careers.

hindi: ऊपर काम सरकाना — अपना काम मैनेजर के पाले में डालना
definition: to push your task onto your manager, the reverse of delegation
example: Asking the VP to draft the email is delegating up, champ.

hindi: कर्ज़ घटाना — कंपनी के ऋण का बोझ कम करना
definition: company reducing its debt relative to earnings, often after an expensive acquisition, to satisfy lenders and ratings agencies
example: Deleveraging is the year's top priority, which explains the frozen hiring and the unfrozen consultants.

hindi: आनंद-अनुभूति — अपेक्षा से बढ़कर खुश कर देने वाला अनुभव
definition: the small joy a product sparks by exceeding expectations
example: Confetti on task completion: delight to some, clutter to others.

hindi: प्रसन्नकारक — अनपेक्षित खुशी देने वाली छोटी खूबी
definition: an unexpected touch that charms users without being required
example: The delighter budget died in Q3, along with the animations.

hindi: पहुँच-योग्यता — ईमेल का स्पैम नहीं, इनबॉक्स तक पहुँचना
definition: the ability of email to actually reach inboxes instead of spam
example: Marketing broke deliverability, so our invoices live in spam now.

hindi: सुपुर्दगी योग्य वस्तु — तय तिथि पर सौंपा जाने वाला ठोस परिणाम
definition: a tangible piece of work owed to someone by an agreed date
example: The deliverable is a deck about the deliverable.

hindi: अंतर — दो मापों के बीच का फर्क
definition: the difference between two measurements
example: The delta between forecast and reality has its own line item now.

hindi: माँग का माहौल — ग्राहकों की खरीदारी की मौजूदा चाल
definition: current customer appetite for buying the company's products, described by executives as healthy, choppy or softening
example: The demand environment remains choppy, which is executive for 'deals keep slipping'.

hindi: माँग सृजन — ख़रीद-इच्छा पैदा करने वाली मार्केटिंग
definition: demand generation — marketing programs that create interest and pipeline, not just clicks
example: Demand gen swears the webinar sourced that deal; sales remembers it differently.

hindi: प्रदर्शन — बना हुआ काम जीवंत दिखाना
definition: a live showing of working software, powered by adrenaline and luck
example: It worked in every rehearsal, so naturally the demo gods struck.

hindi: प्रदर्शन दिवस — एक्सेलेरेटर के स्टार्टअप निवेशकों के सामने पिच करते हैं
definition: the event where accelerator startups pitch to a room of investors
example: Demo day is in two weeks, so sleep is now optional.

hindi: कमाई रोक — प्लेटफ़ॉर्म द्वारा वीडियो या चैनल से विज्ञापन आय हटाना
definition: platform removing a video's or channel's eligibility to earn advertising revenue, often for policy reasons
example: The demonetization notice cited the policy by section number and the reason by nothing at all.

hindi: दिखावटी सॉफ़्टवेयर — सिर्फ़ प्रदर्शन में चलने वाला सॉफ़्टवेयर
definition: software that works impressively in scripted demonstrations but falls apart on real customer data and workflows
example: The agent booked a flight flawlessly on stage; back at the office, the demoware booked nothing.

hindi: निर्भरता — दूसरे के काम पर टिका आपका काम
definition: work that cannot start or finish until someone else's work does
example: Our only dependency is the one team that never answers email.

hindi: निर्भरता नरक — आपस में टकराते पैकेज संस्करणों का चक्रव्यूह
definition: the maze of conflicting package versions that refuses every resolution
example: Upgraded one library, entered dependency hell, cancelled the afternoon.

hindi: तैनात करना — कोड सर्वर पर चढ़ाकर चालू करना
definition: to push code to servers and make it live
example: We deploy on Fridays because we enjoy suspense.

hindi: अप्रचलित घोषित करना — हटाने से पहले पुरानी चीज़ पर चेतावनी लगाना
definition: to mark something as obsolete and discouraged before eventually removing it
example: We deprecated that API in 2019; half the company still calls it.

hindi: प्राथमिकता घटाना — विनम्रता से किसी काम को ठंडा करना
definition: to quietly lower something's priority, often as a mercy killing
example: The feature wasn't cancelled, just deprioritized into another timeline.

hindi: पहुँच समाप्ति — जाने वाले कर्मचारी के खाते और अनुमतियाँ बंद करना
definition: removing accounts, tools and system access when an employee leaves the company or changes role
example: Deprovisioning was thorough; his badge died at noon, though his old Slack account still posts birthday reminders.

hindi: प्रतिनियुक्ति — किसी दूसरी जगह या ग्राहक के पास अस्थायी तैनाती
definition: in Indian English, temporary assignment of an employee to another location or client site, often abroad, while staying on payroll
example: His two-month deputation to London is now in its third year.

hindi: पटरी से उतारना — बैठक को विषय से भटकाना
definition: to knock a meeting off its intended topic
example: One small question derailed the entire planning session.

hindi: दायरा घटाना — समयसीमा बचाने हेतु फ़ीचर हटाना
definition: to cut features from a project so the deadline survives
example: We descoped dark mode again; it's basically a tradition now.

hindi: समिति का डिज़ाइन — सबकी राय मिलाकर बना बेस्वाद नतीजा
definition: a design shaped by too many stakeholders' opinions until it pleases nobody and commits to nothing
example: Design by committee gave the homepage four hero banners and one very tired designer.

hindi: डिज़ाइन समीक्षा बैठक — साथी डिज़ाइनरों से काम पर खुली राय
definition: a scheduled session where designers present work in progress and peers critique it against the goals
example: At design crit, three people said 'I love this' and then spent forty minutes on everything else.

hindi: डिज़ाइन ऋण — टाले गए सुधारों और असंगतियों का बढ़ता बोझ
definition: accumulated inconsistencies from shortcuts that someone must eventually fix
example: Every 'temporary' screen is design debt with compound interest.

hindi: डिज़ाइन दस्तावेज़ — निर्माण से पहले तकनीकी योजना और विकल्पों का लिखित ब्योरा
definition: a written document describing the technical design, alternatives and tradeoffs of a system before engineers build it
example: The design doc was approved on Tuesday and quietly contradicted by the code on Wednesday.

hindi: डिज़ाइन भाषा — पूरे उत्पाद में एक जैसी पहचान वाली शैली
definition: the consistent visual and interaction style that makes a product recognizable
example: Our design language is fluent on iOS and heavily accented on web.

hindi: डिज़ाइन प्रक्रिया-प्रबंधन — डिज़ाइन टीम के औज़ार और कार्यप्रवाह संभालना
definition: the practice of running a design team's tools, processes, and rituals
example: Design ops exists so designers design instead of managing license seats.

hindi: डिज़ाइन जाँच — बने हुए उत्पाद का डिज़ाइन से मिलान
definition: a designer checking the built product against the approved design for spacing, colour and behaviour mismatches
example: Design QA found fourteen spacing bugs and one engineer who swore the margins had always looked like that.

hindi: डिज़ाइन समीक्षा — काम आगे बढ़ने से पहले की जाँच बैठक
definition: a meeting where work is critiqued before it moves forward
example: The design review approved everything except the part users touch.

hindi: डिज़ाइन स्प्रिंट — पाँच दिन में समस्या से परीक्षित प्रोटोटाइप तक
definition: a five-day process from problem to tested prototype
example: The design sprint answered in five days what we'd debated for five months.

hindi: डिज़ाइन प्रणाली — पुन:प्रयोज्य घटकों और नियमों का साझा सेट
definition: a shared library of reusable components and rules for building UI
example: The design system has three button styles; the app has seventeen.

hindi: दिखावटी डिज़ाइन प्रक्रिया — असर के बिना रस्मी वर्कशॉप
definition: design rituals like workshops and sticky notes performed for show while decisions were already made elsewhere
example: The design theater ran all day; the roadmap had been locked the week before.

hindi: डिज़ाइन चिंतन — सहानुभूति और प्रोटोटाइप से समस्या सुलझाने की पद्धति
definition: a human-centered method for solving problems through empathy and prototyping
example: The design thinking workshop produced four hundred sticky notes and one decision.

hindi: डिज़ाइन टोकन — रंग, माप जैसी शैलियों का नामित, साझा मान
definition: a named value for a color, size, or spacing, reused everywhere
example: Hardcoded hex again; the design tokens weep in their JSON file.

hindi: मनचाहा रास्ता — उपयोगकर्ताओं का बनाया अनौपचारिक तरीका
definition: an unofficial workaround users invent to reach their goal when the designed flow does not serve them
example: The desire path was customers emailing support to change plans, because the settings page could not.

hindi: मेज़ आरक्षण — दफ़्तर आने से पहले ऐप में बैठने की जगह पक्की करना
definition: reserving a shared office desk ahead through a workplace booking system before coming into the office
example: Desk booking opened at nine and every window seat was gone by 9:02.

hindi: मेज़-कर्मचारी अनुपात — कर्मचारियों की तुलना में उपलब्ध मेज़ों की संख्या
definition: the number of office desks provided per employee, kept below parity when hybrid staff share desks
example: With a desk ratio of 0.6, arriving after ten is a game of musical chairs.

hindi: कौशल-क्षरण — मशीन पर निर्भरता से अपनी क्षमता घटना
definition: the gradual loss of professional skills when workers hand routine thinking to automation and stop practising it
example: Nobody on the team can write a regex without the assistant anymore; deskilling arrived quietly.

hindi: भंडार घटाना — ग्राहकों का पुराना माल ख़त्म करने तक नया ऑर्डर रोकना
definition: customers and distributors running down excess inventory instead of placing fresh orders, temporarily depressing supplier sales
example: It's destocking, not lost demand, said management for the third straight quarter.

hindi: आलोचक ग्राहक — दूसरों को उत्पाद से हतोत्साहित करने वाला
definition: an unhappy customer likely to warn others away from the product
example: One loud detractor undoes ten quiet case studies.

hindi: विकासात्मक प्रतिक्रिया — आलोचना का सौम्य नाम
definition: review euphemism for criticism, framed as guidance for growth rather than complaint
example: The developmental feedback was twelve bullets long; the praise was one.

hindi: विकास-संचालन एकीकरण — सॉफ़्टवेयर बनाने और चलाने वाली टीमों को एक साथ जोड़ने वाली कार्य-संस्कृति
definition: the practice of merging software development and operations work, so the engineers who build a service also deploy and operate it
example: We adopted DevOps, which mostly meant the developers now get the phone calls.

hindi: दूर से जुड़ना — कॉल के ज़रिए बैठक में शामिल होना
definition: to join a meeting remotely by phone or link
example: I'll dial in from the train, so forgive the tunnels.

hindi: डायरी अध्ययन — उपयोगकर्ता से हफ़्तों तक अनुभव लिखवाने की शोध-विधि
definition: research where users log their experiences over days or weeks
example: The diary study showed people use the app mostly in elevators.

hindi: बदलावों का अंतर — समीक्षा के लिए पुराने और नए कोड के बीच के बदलाव
definition: the set of changes between the old and new versions of code, shown line by line for reviewers
example: The diff is small; the consequences, less so.

hindi: विभेदक — प्रतिस्पर्धा से सचमुच अलग दिखाने वाली खूबी
definition: the thing you do that competitors genuinely don't
example: Our differentiator, per the deck, is 'caring more'.

hindi: घुमंतू कर्मी — यात्रा करते हुए रिमोट काम
definition: someone who works remotely while traveling between places
example: Our digital nomad joins from a new coastline each quarter.

hindi: ऑनलाइन दिखावा — व्यस्त दिखने के लिए हमेशा चैट पर सक्रिय और तुरंत जवाब देना
definition: staying visibly online and replying instantly to chat messages to look productive while working remotely
example: His digital presenteeism was flawless: green all day, replies in seconds, output unclear.

hindi: मशीनी कर्मचारी — कर्मचारी की तरह गिना जाने वाला स्वचालित एजेंट
definition: an automated agent or program described as a staff member, sometimes counted in headcount and capacity plans
example: The org chart now lists two digital workers, neither of whom attends standup.

hindi: हिस्सेदारी में कमी — नए शेयर जारी होने पर पुराने हिस्से का घटना
definition: the shrinking of existing owners' percentage when new shares are issued
example: Every round means dilution; we own less of something worth more, hopefully.

hindi: आय घटाने वाला — सौदे से प्रति शेयर कमाई घटना
definition: describing an acquisition, share issue or investment expected to reduce earnings per share, at least initially
example: The deal is dilutive near term, which is why the slide started in 2029.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष सूचीकरण — नए शेयर जारी किए बिना सीधे शेयर बाज़ार में सूचीबद्ध होना
definition: going public by listing existing shares straight onto an exchange, skipping underwriters and without raising fresh capital
example: We chose a direct listing to save on bank fees and spent the savings on the launch-day party.

hindi: सीधे अधीनस्थ — जो कर्मचारी सीधे आपको रिपोर्ट करता है
definition: an employee who reports directly to a given manager
example: He has nine direct reports and a calendar that proves it.

hindi: दिशा-सूचक — सांख्यिकीय रूप से पक्का नहीं, पर उम्मीद की ओर इशारा
definition: not statistically solid, but pointing the way we hoped
example: The results are directional, meaning they lost politely.

hindi: कठोर शर्तों वाला निवेश प्रस्ताव — ऊंचे मूल्यांकन के पीछे छिपी सख़्त शर्तें
definition: a term sheet whose attractive headline valuation hides investor-friendly structure such as participation, ratchets or multiple liquidation preferences
example: The dirty term sheet had the best valuation and the worst everything else.

hindi: असहमत रहो पर साथ दो — बहस के बाद फ़ैसले को पूरी ताक़त से निभाना
definition: to voice objections to a decision openly, then fully support executing it once the decision has been made
example: I disagreed and committed, and I have the calendar invites to prove both.

hindi: छूट — दाम में कटौती, प्रायः तिमाही के अंत में
definition: a price reduction used to close deals faster, especially near quarter end
example: The 'one-time' discount is now in its third consecutive renewal.

hindi: समस्या-खोज चरण — बनाने से पहले समझने का दौर
definition: the phase of learning what's worth building before building it
example: We skipped discovery, so now we're discovering in production.

hindi: प्रारंभिक जानकारी कॉल — ग्राहक की ज़रूरतें समझने के लिए
definition: an early sales call for understanding the prospect's needs, budget, and timeline
example: The discovery call discovered they have no budget until next fiscal year.

hindi: विवेकाधीन खर्च — वह खर्च जो ज़रूरी नहीं और सबसे पहले कटता है
definition: optional spending such as travel, events and training that is first to be frozen when budgets tighten
example: Discretionary spend is frozen, so the offsite is now a video call with a catered sandwich.

hindi: उथल-पुथल मचाने वाली कंपनी — पुराने उद्योग का ढर्रा बदलने वाली
definition: a company that upends an industry with a cheaper or radically different model
example: Every disruptor's deck has a slide of logos it plans to bankrupt.

hindi: आसवन — बड़े मॉडल की नक़ल में छोटा, सस्ता मॉडल तैयार करना
definition: training a small, cheap model to imitate a big, expensive one
example: Distillation gave us the big model's judgment at watch-battery prices.

hindi: बिखरा हुआ एकाश्म — माइक्रोसेवाओं के भेस में जकड़ा पुराना ढाँचा
definition: microservices so entangled they must deploy together, the worst of both worlds
example: Forty services, one release day — congratulations, a distributed monolith.

hindi: वितरित टीम — शहरों और समय-क्षेत्रों में फैली टीम
definition: a team spread across cities or timezones
example: A distributed team runs on writing, not on hallways.

hindi: वितरण सूची — समूह को एक साथ ईमेल भेजने का पता
definition: slang for a distribution list, the email address that reaches every member of a group
example: Add me to the distro, he said, and immediately started filtering it to trash.

hindi: फैलाओ फिर समेटो — पहले ढेरों विचार, फिर चुनाव
definition: generating many options widely first, then narrowing down to the strongest few, as design workshops alternate
example: We diverged beautifully and converged on the idea the director walked in with.

hindi: विविध उम्मीदवार सूची — अंतिम दौर में विविध पृष्ठभूमि वाले उम्मीदवार अनिवार्य
definition: a policy requiring candidates from underrepresented groups among the finalists before any hiring decision
example: The diverse slate rule meant the search actually looked beyond the founder's contacts.

hindi: लाभांश पुनर्पूंजीकरण — नया कर्ज़ लेकर मालिकों को विशेष लाभांश देना
definition: a private equity move where a company borrows new debt to pay owners a special dividend
example: The dividend recap returned the fund's money early and left the company a charming new interest bill.

hindi: वितरण सूची — एक पते से कई लोगों तक ईमेल
definition: distribution list; single email address that forwards every message to a whole group of people
example: He replied to the entire company DL to say 'thanks'.

hindi: डेटा रिसाव रोकथाम — संवेदनशील फ़ाइलें बाहर भेजने पर रोक
definition: data loss prevention; security tools blocking sensitive company files from leaving through email, uploads or drives
example: DLP stopped him emailing the salary sheet to his personal inbox, and flagged it to his manager for good measure.

hindi: सीधा निजी संदेश — सिर्फ़ एक व्यक्ति को
definition: direct message — a private message sent to one person
example: DM me the details instead of posting them in the channel.

hindi: परिभाषित-मापो-विश्लेषण-सुधार-नियंत्रण — सिक्स सिग्मा की पाँच-चरणीय पद्धति
definition: define, measure, analyse, improve, control; the five-phase six sigma roadmap for fixing an existing process problem
example: The project spent eight months in the measure phase of DMAIC and the problem fixed itself.

hindi: कम में ज़्यादा — कम लोग और बजट में उतना ही या ज़्यादा काम करवाना
definition: management phrasing meaning fewer people and smaller budgets must deliver the same or more work
example: After the cuts, leadership asked the team to do more with less, starting with less sleep.

hindi: परेशान न करें — सूचनाएँ मौन, ध्यान चालू
definition: the status that silences all notifications and guards your focus
example: I'm on do not disturb until the report is out.

hindi: जो आवश्यक हो कीजिए — भारतीय दफ़्तरी विनती
definition: please take the obvious required action; beloved Indian office English
example: The server is down; kindly do the needful.

hindi: ऐसे काम करो जो बड़े पैमाने पर न चलें — शुरुआत में हाथ से ग्राहक जुटाना
definition: early startup advice to recruit and serve customers manually, personally and inefficiently before building scalable systems
example: We did things that don't scale: the founder personally onboarded every user, including his mum twice.

hindi: अपना ही उत्पाद बरतना — खुद इस्तेमाल कर खामियाँ पकड़ना
definition: using your own product internally so the team feels its bugs before customers do
example: Dogfooding the new release found three bugs before lunch.

hindi: कार्यभार ग्रहण तिथि — नई नौकरी में शामिल होने का दिन
definition: date of joining; Indian English for the calendar date a newly hired employee formally starts work
example: His DOJ moved three times, twice for the notice period and once for Diwali.

hindi: सेवा के बदले अनुदान — कर्मचारी के स्वयंसेवा घंटों पर कंपनी का दान
definition: an employer programme that donates money to a charity based on the number of volunteer hours an employee logs there
example: Dollars for doers finally gave everyone a reason to fill in timesheets accurately.

hindi: पक्का पूर्ण — सचमुच समाप्त, सिर्फ़ कहने भर को नहीं
definition: actually finished, as opposed to merely declared finished
example: It's done, but is it done-done, or demo done?

hindi: दानदाता थकान — बार-बार अपीलों से दाताओं का उत्साह घटना
definition: declining willingness among donors to keep giving after repeated appeals, prolonged crises or too many simultaneous fundraising requests
example: Donor fatigue set in around the fourth urgent appeal this month, all titled Last Chance.

hindi: दाता संबंध-पोषण — दान के बाद दाता को जोड़े रखने की देखभाल
definition: the thanking, reporting and relationship work that keeps existing donors informed, appreciated and willing to give again
example: Donor stewardship means the thank-you letter goes out before the next ask, not stapled to it.

hindi: दाता-निर्देशित कोष — कर लाभ लेकर बाद में दान बाँटने वाला खाता
definition: a charitable giving account where a donor contributes money for an immediate deduction from taxable income, then recommends grants to charities over later years
example: The donor-advised fund has been advising itself to wait for about six years now.

hindi: बिंदु-मतदान — सीमित वोटों से प्राथमिकता चुनना
definition: prioritizing options by letting everyone place limited votes
example: After dot voting, the boring option won, as it should.

hindi: बिंदुवार रूपरेखा — मुख्य बिंदुओं और उप-बिंदुओं वाला संक्षिप्त खाका
definition: outline of a presentation's storyline as headline points with supporting sub-points, reviewed before slides
example: The partner rewrote the dot-dash on a napkin, and the napkin became the deck.

hindi: अनौपचारिक रिपोर्टिंग संबंध — बिना सीधी अधीनता के जवाबदेही
definition: an informal reporting relationship alongside one's actual manager
example: She reports to Priya, with a dotted line to the platform director.

hindi: दोहरा कमीशन — एक ही सौदे पर दो टीमों को भुगतान
definition: paying commission twice, to separate sellers or teams, for the same deal to prevent territory fights
example: Finance discovered the double comp when the deal paid out more commission than it earned margin.

hindi: दोहरा हीरा मॉडल — फैलाओ-सिकोड़ो दो बार की डिज़ाइन प्रक्रिया
definition: a design model: diverge and converge on the problem, then the solution
example: We did the double diamond, though ours looked more like one confused circle.

hindi: दांव दोगुना करना — विरोध के बावजूद और ज़ोर लगाना
definition: to commit harder to a position despite pushback
example: Metrics dipped, so naturally we doubled down.

hindi: दोहरी महत्ता — कंपनी पर पर्यावरण का असर और पर्यावरण पर कंपनी का असर, दोनों देखना
definition: assessing both how sustainability issues affect company finances and how company activities affect people and environment
example: Double materiality means the risk team and the activists finally have to read the same spreadsheet.

hindi: दोहरी बुकिंग — एक ही समय दो बैठकें
definition: scheduled in two meetings at the same time
example: I'm double-booked at two; I'll lurk in one on mute.

hindi: और गहराई में जाना — किसी बिंदु को विस्तार से देखना
definition: to examine a point in more detail
example: Can we double-click on that revenue dip?

hindi: दोतरफ़ा सिफ़ारिश-इनाम — बुलाने वाले और आने वाले दोनों को इनाम देने वाली योजना
definition: referral scheme rewarding both the existing customer who invites and the friend who signs up
example: The double-sided referral worked brilliantly until two accounts belonging to one person referred each other forty times.

hindi: दोहरा-ट्रिगर त्वरण — बिक्री और नौकरी जाने दोनों पर शेयर तुरंत वेस्ट
definition: immediate vesting of unvested shares only when an acquisition happens and the holder is also terminated afterwards
example: Double-trigger acceleration is the clause that makes the acquirer think twice about the post-deal layoff spreadsheet.

hindi: प्रश्न — किसी बात पर स्पष्टीकरण की ज़रूरत
definition: an Indian English usage meaning a question or point needing clarification, rather than disbelief
example: I have one small doubt, he said, opening a forty-minute redesign of the architecture.

hindi: घटे मूल्य का दौर — पिछले दौर से कम वैल्यूएशन पर निवेश
definition: a funding round at a lower valuation than the previous one
example: The down round hurt egos more than it hurt the balance sheet.

hindi: उम्मीदवार को उसके मौजूदा स्तर से नीचे रखना
definition: to hire someone at a lower level than they held elsewhere
example: They down-leveled her at hiring, then praised her for exceeding expectations.

hindi: सस्ता विकल्प देना — ग्राहक खोने के बजाय छोटा प्लान
definition: to offer a cheaper plan rather than lose the customer entirely
example: We downsold them to the starter plan; it beats a cancellation email.

hindi: आगे निर्भर — वे टीमें या सिस्टम जो आपके काम या बदलाव पर निर्भर हैं
definition: describing the teams, services or consumers that depend on your code and feel the effects of your changes
example: We renamed one field and every downstream team filed a ticket within the hour.

hindi: डेटा प्रसंस्करण अनुबंध — ग्राहक के निजी डेटा को संभालने की शर्तें
definition: data processing agreement; the contract addendum governing how a vendor handles, secures and deletes the personal data it processes for a customer
example: Procurement won't sign until we send the DPA, which our DPA template says we'll send once they sign.

hindi: डिजिटल व्यक्तिगत डेटा संरक्षण अधिनियम — भारत का निजता कानून
definition: digital personal data protection; India's privacy statute governing consent, processing and breach duties for personal data, discussed as the DPDP Act in Indian English
example: After the DPDP briefing, every product manager in Bengaluru discovered a sudden passion for consent banners.

hindi: डेटा संरक्षण प्रभाव आकलन — जोखिम भरे डेटा उपयोग से पहले का निजता मूल्यांकन
definition: data protection impact assessment; a documented privacy risk review required before launching processing likely to harm individuals
example: The feature was ready in two sprints; the DPIA was ready in two quarters.

hindi: बकाया देय दिवस — आपूर्तिकर्ताओं को भुगतान करने में लगने वाले औसत दिन
definition: days payable outstanding; the average number of days the company takes to settle supplier invoices
example: Treasury stretched DPO to sixty days, and procurement started getting very chilly supplier emails.

hindi: आपदा से उबरना — बड़ी विफलता के बाद सिस्टम और डेटा को फिर से चालू करने की योजना
definition: disaster recovery; the plans, backup systems and procedures for restoring services and data after a major failure or regional outage
example: Our DR plan was excellent in theory, since nobody had ever tried it.

hindi: अधूरा पुल अनुरोध — समीक्षा से पहले शुरुआती राय के लिए खोला गया अधूरा बदलाव
definition: a pull request opened early and marked unfinished, shared for feedback before it is ready for formal review
example: It's been a draft PR since March, which is less a draft and more a lifestyle.

hindi: साथ घसीटने का अधिकार — बहुमत बिक्री करे तो अल्पमत शेयरधारक भी बेचने को बाध्य
definition: a term sheet clause letting majority shareholders force minority shareholders to join a company sale on the same terms
example: The drag-along meant the angel who hated the acquisition got to sell anyway, grumbling all the way to the bank.

hindi: खींच-साथ अधिकार — बहुमत की बिक्री में अल्पांश को भी बेचना पड़े
definition: rights letting majority shareholders force minority holders to join an approved sale on identical terms
example: Drag-along rights mean your vote counts, right up until it's needed.

hindi: शिखर से गिरावट — किसी निवेश का ऊँचाई से निचले बिंदु तक का नुकसान
definition: the decline in value from a portfolio's peak to its lowest point before recovering
example: The fund's drawdown was described in the investor letter as a character-building period.

hindi: सपनों की कंपनी — ऊँचे पैकेज वाली, जिसके लिए पहले से चयनित छात्र भी आवेदन कर सकें
definition: in Indian English campus placements, a high-paying employer that students already holding offers are still permitted to apply to
example: Placed already, he was still allowed to sit for the dream company, which felt like a second life.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष उत्तरदायी व्यक्ति — निर्णय या परिणाम का एकल स्वामी
definition: directly responsible individual; the single named owner of an outcome
example: Every project needs a DRI, preferably one who knows they're the DRI.

hindi: विचलन — समय के साथ डेटा बदलने से मॉडल की सटीकता घटना
definition: gradual decay in model accuracy as real-world data changes over time
example: New year, new gym crowd, new movement patterns — hello, drift.

hindi: तह तक जाना — आँकड़ों की बारीकी में उतरना
definition: to move from summary to detail, usually in data
example: Let's drill down into why signups dropped in March.

hindi: सूचना की बाढ़ झेलना — एक साथ बहुत कुछ सीखना-समझना
definition: to absorb an overwhelming amount of information at once
example: Week one is drinking from the firehose; week two, swimming.

hindi: क्रमिक ईमेल शृंखला — तयशुदा अंतराल पर स्वचालित संदेश
definition: an automated email series sent on a schedule to warm up leads
example: Day 14 of the drip campaign: 'Just circling back one last time.'

hindi: आगे बढ़ाना — पहल की कमान लेकर मंज़िल तक ले जाना
definition: to push an initiative forward as its main force
example: Someone must drive this, or it drives itself into a ditch.

hindi: अचानक आ धमकना — बिना बताए डेस्क पर आकर काम माँगना
definition: an unscheduled interruption where someone appears at your desk or chat asking something urgent
example: One drive-by at four o'clock rewrote my entire evening.

hindi: राह चलते बदलाव — किसी दूसरी टीम के कोड में बिना संदर्भ भेजा गया छोटा बदलाव
definition: a quick pull request made to another team's code by someone passing through, often without context or follow-up
example: A drive-by PR renamed our config key, and the author has since been unreachable.

hindi: कारक-आधारित योजना — बिक्री, ग्राहक जैसे मूल कारकों से वित्तीय योजना बनाना
definition: planning where financial forecasts are calculated from operational drivers such as customers, prices and headcount
example: Driver-based planning is elegant until someone asks what drives the drivers.

hindi: चैट में डाल दो — मीटिंग की चैट में लिंक या जानकारी भेजना
definition: asking someone to post a link, document or detail into the video call's text chat
example: Drop it in the chat, said everyone, and the chat vanished when the call ended.

hindi: सीधी आपूर्ति — विक्रेता बिना माल रखे, सप्लायर सीधे ग्राहक को भेजे
definition: selling products that the supplier ships directly to customers, so the seller never holds physical inventory
example: His drop shipping empire consists of a laptop, a storefront and a lot of apology emails.

hindi: अटल अंतिम तिथि — जिसके बाद कोई मोहलत नहीं
definition: the truly final deadline after which there is no more slipping
example: The drop-dead date is Friday, the third Friday it's been.

hindi: दोहराव मत करो — हर तर्क एक ही जगह रहे (don't repeat yourself)
definition: don't repeat yourself; every piece of logic should live in exactly one place
example: The code is DRY; the meeting explaining it repeated everything twice.

hindi: बिना लगाई पूँजी — सही सौदे के इंतज़ार में रखा फ़ंड
definition: committed fund money not yet invested, waiting for the right deal
example: They claim record dry powder, yet every pitch ends in 'not right now.'

hindi: सूखी पदोन्नति — बिना वेतन बढ़े सिर्फ़ पद का बदलना
definition: a promotion bringing a grander title and more responsibility but without any salary increase
example: The dry promotion came with a longer email signature and a longer workday.

hindi: पूर्वाभ्यास — असली से पहले पूरी प्रक्रिया का अभ्यास
definition: a full rehearsal of a launch or demo before the real thing
example: The dry run failed, which is technically what dry runs are for.

hindi: डेटा विषय पहुँच अनुरोध — व्यक्ति द्वारा अपनी सारी जानकारी माँगना
definition: data subject access request; a person's legal demand to receive copies of all personal data a company holds about them
example: The ex-employee's DSAR returned every Slack message mentioning him, including the ones about his DSAR.

hindi: बकाया बिक्री दिवस — ग्राहकों से पैसा वसूलने में लगने वाले औसत दिन
definition: days sales outstanding; the average number of days customers take to settle invoices after a sale
example: DSO hit seventy days because our biggest client treats net-30 as an opening bid.

hindi: दैनिक स्थिति रिपोर्ट — रोज़ किए गए काम का लिखित ब्यौरा
definition: daily status report; evening email summarising tasks completed, pending work and blockers, sent to managers or clients
example: His DSR said 'analysis in progress' for the ninth consecutive day.

hindi: दोहरी करियर सीढ़ी — प्रबंधन और विशेषज्ञ दोनों राह
definition: a career framework offering parallel promotion tracks for managers and individual contributors of equal seniority
example: The dual ladder exists so engineers can reach senior levels without ever approving expenses.

hindi: दोहरा स्रोत — जोखिम घटाने हेतु एक ही चीज़ दो विक्रेताओं से लेना
definition: splitting purchases of the same item between a primary and a second supplier so a single supplier failure cannot halt operations
example: After the outage, dual sourcing went from 'too expensive' to 'why didn't we'.

hindi: द्वि-वर्गीय शेयर — संस्थापकों के शेयरों को अधिक मताधिकार
definition: a share structure giving founders' stock extra voting rights so they keep control after listing
example: Dual-class shares meant shareholders could voice concerns and the founder could note them.

hindi: दोहरी पटरी एजाइल — खोज और निर्माण एक साथ, दो अलग धाराओं में
definition: an agile practice running product discovery and delivery in parallel tracks, validating ideas while engineers build already validated work
example: In dual-track agile, discovery runs a sprint ahead, and delivery runs a sprint behind on sleep.

hindi: पूरी तैयारी — सब कुछ क्रम से सजा लेना
definition: everything organized and ready before acting
example: Get your ducks in a row before the audit.

hindi: जुगाड़ू टेप — असल समाधान की जगह अस्थायी जोड़-गाँठ
definition: whatever improvised patchwork keeps the system together instead of a proper fix
example: The integration is duct tape with a service-level agreement.

hindi: गहन जाँच-पड़ताल — निवेश से पहले कंपनी के दावों की पड़ताल
definition: the deep investigation of a company's numbers, legal state, and claims before investing
example: Due diligence found the spreadsheet where 'projected' meant 'imagined.'

hindi: रज़ाई दिवस — बिना बीमारी का कारण बताए अचानक ली गई छुट्टी (ब्रिटिश चलन)
definition: a short-notice paid day off, common in British workplaces, taken without needing any illness or reason
example: She booked a duvet day and treated the product launch as something happening to other people.

hindi: डेवलपर अनुभव — डेवलपरों के लिए औज़ार, प्रक्रियाएँ और काम करना कितना सहज है
definition: developer experience; how easy and pleasant the tools, documentation and workflows are for the engineers using them
example: DX improved dramatically once the build stopped taking long enough for lunch.

hindi: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक खोज — मुकदमे में ईमेल व डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड जुटाना और सौंपना
definition: the collection, review and handover of emails, chat messages and digital documents as evidence during litigation
example: Everyone got more polite on Slack the week e-discovery started.

hindi: कर्मचारी सहायता कार्यक्रम — कंपनी द्वारा दी जाने वाली गोपनीय परामर्श और सहायता सेवा
definition: employee assistance program; a confidential employer-paid service offering counselling and support for personal or work problems
example: The EAP number was on the burnout slide, right after the new quarterly targets.

hindi: अग्रिम उपलब्धता — आधिकारिक विमोचन से पहले चुनिंदा प्रवेश
definition: letting select users in before the official launch
example: Early access means paying to be a tester, framed as a privilege.

hindi: अग्रणी उपयोगकर्ता — नई चीज़ सबसे पहले आज़माने वाला ग्राहक
definition: a customer who tries new products first and forgives their rough edges
example: Our early adopters file bugs with more love than most people file taxes.

hindi: शीघ्र प्रयोग — निहित होने से पहले ही विकल्प खरीद लेना
definition: buying stock options before they vest, usually to start capital-gains holding clocks while the strike price stays cheap
example: He early exercised everything, which was either genius or a donation, depending on next year.

hindi: मद के लिए चिह्नित करना — रक़म ख़ास काम हेतु अलग रखना
definition: to set money aside for a specific purpose
example: That money was earmarked for training, not the offsite karaoke.

hindi: अर्जित प्रचार — बिना भुगतान मिली मीडिया कवरेज
definition: press coverage and mentions you didn't pay for
example: One viral customer tweet earned more media than the entire launch budget.

hindi: अनुमान से बेहतर कमाई — नतीजे विश्लेषकों की अपेक्षा से ऊपर
definition: quarterly results that come in above the analyst consensus estimate for revenue or earnings
example: We posted an earnings beat of one cent, delivered entirely courtesy of a lower forecast tax rate.

hindi: नतीजों पर निवेशक वार्ता — तिमाही परिणामों पर विश्लेषकों से सवाल-जवाब
definition: quarterly conference call where executives present financial results and answer analyst questions
example: The earnings call Q&A lasted twenty minutes, fifteen of them spent not answering the margin question.

hindi: अनुमान से कम कमाई — नतीजे विश्लेषकों की अपेक्षा से नीचे
definition: quarterly results that come in below the analyst consensus estimate for revenue or earnings
example: The earnings miss was blamed on timing, weather and, for the first time, a leap year.

hindi: अर्जन-आधारित भुगतान — अधिग्रहण के बाद लक्ष्य पूरे होने पर मिलने वाला हिस्सा
definition: part of an acquisition price paid later only if the acquired business hits agreed revenue or milestone targets
example: The earnout depends on hitting targets set by the people who now control our roadmap.

hindi: छिपा तोहफ़ा — सॉफ़्टवेयर में छुपाया गया मज़ेदार रहस्य
definition: a hidden joke or feature tucked into software for those who find it
example: The 404 page plays snake, our finest easter egg.

hindi: सबसे कठिन काम पहले — दिन की शुरुआत सबसे अप्रिय काम से करना
definition: productivity habit of tackling the hardest, most dreaded task first thing each morning before anything else
example: I meant to eat the frog today, but the frog had a meeting invite attached.

hindi: ब्याज व कर से पहले की कमाई — मूल व्यवसाय का परिचालन मुनाफ़ा
definition: earnings before interest and taxes; operating profit from the core business, before financing costs and taxes
example: EBIT is fine; it's everything below it that keeps the treasurer awake.

hindi: ब्याज, कर, मूल्यह्रास व परिशोधन से पहले की कमाई — परिचालन मुनाफ़े का लोकप्रिय पैमाना
definition: earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization; operating profit before financing costs, taxes and non-cash asset charges, the headline profit measure in most finance reviews
example: Our EBITDA looks wonderful, provided nobody asks about the interest, the taxes or the servers.

hindi: कार्यकारी व्यावसायिक समीक्षा — वरिष्ठ ग्राहक अधिकारियों के साथ मूल्य समीक्षा बैठक
definition: executive business review; a periodic meeting with a customer's senior leaders reviewing value delivered, goals and future plans
example: The EBR deck had forty slides of value delivered and one small slide titled 'known issues'.

hindi: इक्विटी पूंजी बाज़ार — शेयर जारी करने वाला बैंकिंग विभाग
definition: equity capital markets; the banking group that structures and sells share offerings such as IPOs
example: ECM had the market window open for exactly three days and wanted the client ready yesterday.

hindi: आर्थिक निर्णयकर्ता — जिसके पास बजट की चाबी हो
definition: the person who actually controls the budget for the purchase
example: Everyone loved the demo; none of them was the economic buyer.

hindi: अपेक्षित कुल पैकेज — नई नौकरी में उम्मीदवार की माँगी गई वार्षिक सैलरी
definition: expected cost to company; Indian English hiring term for the annual salary package a candidate asks for in a new role
example: Current CTC, expected CTC, notice period: the holy trinity of every recruiter call.

hindi: किनारे का मामला — दुर्लभ या चरम स्थिति जो कोड तोड़ दे
definition: an unusual input or situation at the boundary of what the code expects
example: Works perfectly, except for the edge case of a user with no email.

hindi: एज अनुमान — क्लाउड के बजाय पास की डिवाइस पर मॉडल चलाना
definition: running model predictions on local devices instead of cloud servers
example: Edge inference keeps rep counting alive in basement gyms with zero bars.

hindi: असाधारण आम बैठक — किसी तात्कालिक निर्णय के लिए बुलाई गई विशेष शेयरधारक बैठक
definition: extraordinary general meeting; a shareholder meeting called between annual meetings to approve urgent matters such as mergers
example: Calling an EGM for the merger meant three weeks of notice and three weeks of rumours.

hindi: अत्यावश्यक-महत्त्वपूर्ण तालिका — कामों को ज़रूरत और महत्त्व के चार खानों में बाँटना
definition: prioritisation grid sorting tasks by urgency and importance into four boxes: do, schedule, delegate or delete
example: Her Eisenhower matrix had everything in urgent-important and one lonely item under delete: lunch.

hindi: उद्यम लाइसेंस अनुबंध — पूरी कंपनी के लिए एक बड़ा, बहु-वर्षीय सॉफ़्टवेयर सौदा
definition: enterprise license agreement; a large multi-year software deal granting organisation-wide licences for a negotiated fixed price
example: The ELA covers everything the vendor sells, including products we have never heard of.

hindi: अति-संक्षिप्त परिचय — लिफ़्ट जितने समय में पूरा प्रस्ताव
definition: a summary of what you do, short enough to deliver during an elevator ride
example: His elevator pitch requires a building with at least ninety floors.

hindi: ऐसे समझाइए जैसे मैं पाँच साल का हूँ — बेहद सरल व्याख्या माँगना
definition: explain like I'm five; request for a very simple explanation of complex technical material without jargon
example: The VP asked for an ELI5 on the architecture and still wanted it in slides.

hindi: पुनर्नियुक्ति योग्य — पूर्व कर्मचारी को दोबारा रखा जा सकता है
definition: status flag marking a former employee the company would hire again, checked during reference calls
example: His file said eligible for rehire, which he took as the nicest thing HR ever wrote.

hindi: विशिष्ट सलाहकार फर्म — बिना ऋण-कारोबार की प्रतिष्ठित M&A सलाहकार कंपनी
definition: a small, prestigious advisory firm focused on mergers and restructuring, without lending or trading businesses
example: The elite boutique had forty people, one office and a fee larger than the bulge bracket's.

hindi: इंजीनियरिंग मैनेजर — इंजीनियरों की टीम का प्रबंधक
definition: engineering manager; the person responsible for an engineering team's people and delivery
example: Ask your EM to raise it in the next skip-level.

hindi: ईमेल दिवालियापन — सारे पुराने ईमेल बिना पढ़े छोड़ देना
definition: declaring a backlog of unread email unmanageable and deleting or archiving it without replying
example: After three weeks off, she declared email bankruptcy and nobody noticed.

hindi: प्रकाशन रोक — तय समय से पहले ख़बर न छापने की शर्त
definition: an agreement that journalists hold a story until an agreed date and time
example: The embargo lifts at 9 a.m., so expect a leak by 7.

hindi: एम्बेडिंग — अर्थ को संख्याओं में बदलना ताकि मिलती-जुलती चीज़ें पास आएँ
definition: a list of numbers representing meaning, so similar things sit near each other
example: Per the embeddings, 'leg day' and 'regret' are basically neighbors.

hindi: आपात बदलाव — सामान्य मंज़ूरी छोड़कर तुरंत किया गया सिस्टम सुधार
definition: urgent production system change that skips normal approval, justified afterwards through paperwork and review
example: It became an emergency change the moment someone realised the board would not meet until Tuesday.

hindi: इमोजी प्रतिक्रिया — बिना शब्दों का जवाब
definition: a one-tap emoji response that replaces a whole reply
example: Mark attendance with an emoji reaction, not forty replies.

hindi: भावनात्मक श्रम — काम के लिए भावनाओं को संभालने और दबाने का अनदेखा परिश्रम
definition: the unpaid effort of managing feelings at work, staying cheerful, calming colleagues or absorbing difficult customers
example: Handling the client's tantrum was emotional labor; logging it in the timesheet was fiction.

hindi: पैनल में शामिल करना — किसी विक्रेता को स्वीकृत आपूर्तिकर्ताओं की सूची में दर्ज करना
definition: the formal process, so named in Indian English, of vetting a supplier and adding it to an organisation’s approved vendor panel
example: Empanelment took four months, by which time the project it was for had been cancelled.

hindi: सहानुभूति मानचित्र — उपयोगकर्ता क्या सोचता, कहता, करता है उसका खाका
definition: a chart of what users think, feel, say, and do
example: The empathy map says users feel anxious; the error messages aren't helping.

hindi: साम्राज्य-निर्माता — अपनी टीम, बजट और रिपोर्टों को बढ़ाने में लगा मैनेजर
definition: a manager focused on growing headcount, budget and territory to increase personal power rather than results
example: The empire builder now has forty reports and still no shipped product.

hindi: साम्राज्य-निर्माण — अपनी टीम, हेडकाउंट और बजट बढ़ाकर दफ़्तरी सत्ता जमाना
definition: growing your own headcount, budget and territory to accumulate organisational power rather than serve business needs
example: His empire building reached the point where his team had its own reorg.

hindi: नियोक्ता छवि — काम की जगह के रूप में कंपनी की साख
definition: the company's reputation as a workplace among the skilled people it hopes to recruit
example: Our employer brand is a careers page of beanbags and a review site of resignations.

hindi: रिक्त अवस्था — डेटा न होने पर स्क्रीन का दिखने वाला रूप
definition: what a screen shows when there's no data in it yet
example: The empty state just says 'No items', which helps nobody.

hindi: खोखला सूट — बड़ा पद और आत्मविश्वास, पर ठोस ज्ञान या योगदान नहीं
definition: an executive who looks and sounds impressive but offers little substance, expertise or real contribution
example: The empty suit spoke for thirty minutes and said the word 'synergy' more times than anything else.

hindi: घुमावदार रास्ता — तय प्रक्रिया या अधिकारी को चकमा देकर सीधे मंज़ूरी पाना
definition: a manoeuvre that bypasses the normal approval process or responsible person to get a decision elsewhere
example: Buying the tool on a corporate card was an end run around procurement.

hindi: जुड़ाव — उपयोगकर्ता उत्पाद कितना और कितनी गहराई से चलाते हैं
definition: how much and how often users actually interact with the product
example: Engagement doubled once we counted opening the app as engagement.

hindi: नियुक्ति पत्र — परियोजना का दायरा, शुल्क और शर्तें तय करने वाला पत्र
definition: formal letter defining a consulting project's scope, fees, timing and terms before client work starts
example: The engagement letter said six weeks; the client's calendar said something more ambitious.

hindi: परियोजना प्रबंधक — ग्राहक परियोजना और टीम का रोज़ का संचालन करने वाला
definition: consultant who runs a client project daily, managing the team, workplan and client relationship
example: The engagement manager promised the client Friday and promised the team it was fine.

hindi: कर्मचारी संतुष्टि का स्कोर — 'क्या आप यहाँ काम करने की सलाह देंगे'
definition: employee net promoter score; whether staff would recommend working there
example: The eNPS dropped nine points, so leadership scheduled a fun event.

hindi: बड़ी कंपनियों का वर्ग — हज़ारों कर्मचारियों वाले ग्राहक
definition: the largest customer segment, with big budgets, long sales cycles, and longer security reviews
example: Enterprise deals: nine months of meetings, one signature, champagne.

hindi: कारोबारी दिन की समाप्ति — दिन ख़त्म होने से पहले तक की समय-सीमा
definition: end of business; deadline meaning before the working day closes, usually in the sender's timezone
example: EOB, she said, without mentioning which of the six timezones on the thread she meant.

hindi: दिवसांत — आज का कार्य-दिवस समाप्त होने तक
definition: end of day; a deadline whose time zone is negotiable
example: I'll have it by EOD, somewhere on Earth.

hindi: संदेश समाप्त — पूरी बात विषय-पंक्ति में ही, ईमेल खोलने की ज़रूरत नहीं
definition: end of message; subject-line tag saying the whole email lives there and the body is empty
example: Subject: Lunch moved to 1pm EOM — the most efficient email he sent all quarter.

hindi: तिमाही के अंत तक — तिमाही बंद होने की घड़ी
definition: end of quarter — when deals, targets, and tempers all close at once
example: Sales wants every contract countersigned by EOQ.

hindi: नियोक्ता-प्रतिनिधि — विदेशी कर्मचारियों को कानूनी रूप से नियुक्त करने वाली बाहरी कंपनी
definition: employer of record; a third-party company that legally employs remote international staff on your behalf, handling payroll and compliance
example: We hired our first engineer in Portugal through an EOR, so technically her boss is a company none of us has met.

hindi: सप्ताह के अंत तक — शुक्रवार की मियाद
definition: end of week — due by Friday, usually late Friday
example: Draft by EOW works; nobody reads it before Monday anyway.

hindi: एपिक — कई कहानियों में बँटा बड़ा कार्यखंड
definition: a large body of work broken down into many smaller stories
example: The login epic is now old enough to attend kindergarten.

hindi: प्रति शेयर आय — कुल मुनाफ़ा बाँटकर हर शेयर के हिस्से की कमाई
definition: earnings per share; company profit divided by outstanding shares, the headline figure analysts compare against forecasts
example: EPS beat by a penny, which the buyback delivered and the business did not.

hindi: कंपनी में हिस्सेदारी — वेतन के बदले मिले शेयर या विकल्प
definition: ownership in the company, granted as shares or options
example: The salary was low, but the equity was described as life-changing.

hindi: हिस्सेदार साझेदार — फ़र्म के मुनाफ़े में हिस्सा पाने वाला मालिक-साझेदार
definition: partner who owns part of a professional services firm and shares directly in its profits
example: Once he became an equity partner, the coffee budget suddenly became a personal matter.

hindi: स्वामित्व हिस्सा — कंपनी में किसी की मिल्कियत का प्रतिशत
definition: the ownership percentage someone holds in a company
example: The advisor wants a two percent equity stake for one monthly call.

hindi: समान पृष्ठभूमि के कर्मचारियों का स्वैच्छिक समूह
definition: employee resource group; a volunteer community for employees with shared identity
example: The ERG got a logo, a channel, and no budget.

hindi: त्रुटि बजट — कितनी विफलता स्वीकार्य है, उसकी तय सीमा
definition: the agreed amount of failure a service may spend before feature work stops
