example: We spent the quarter's error budget in one enthusiastic afternoon.

hindi: त्रुटि अवस्था — गड़बड़ी होने पर स्क्रीन क्या दिखाती है
definition: the designed screen or message shown when something fails, explaining what happened and what to do
example: The error state was never designed, so users met a raw stack trace with considerable poise.

hindi: ऊपर पहुँचाना — मामला वरिष्ठों तक ले जाना
definition: to raise an issue to higher management when normal channels stall
example: If legal doesn't reply by Friday, we escalate and pray.

hindi: शिकायत-वृद्धि तालिका — समस्या न सुलझने पर किस-किस स्तर पर किसे संपर्क करें, इसकी सूची
definition: common in Indian English: a table naming whom to contact, level by level, when a vendor issue stays unresolved
example: We reached level three of the escalation matrix and found it was the same person's personal mobile.

hindi: एस्केलेशन मार्ग — समस्या ऊपर पहुँचाने की तय शृंखला
definition: the agreed chain of people to alert when something goes badly enough
example: The escalation path is documented; the willingness to use it is not.

hindi: आगे बढ़ाने का क्रम — जवाब न मिलने पर चेतावनी किसके पास आगे जाए, इसका तय नियम
definition: the configured order in which an unanswered alert moves from the primary on-call engineer to backups and then managers
example: The escalation policy worked perfectly: it paged the director, who paged everyone else.

hindi: बाहर पहुँचाया गया — निकाले जाने के बाद सुरक्षा के साथ दफ़्तर से विदा
definition: walked from the building by security or a manager immediately after termination, access already revoked
example: She was escorted out holding a cardboard box and the office plant she'd kept alive for years.

hindi: पर्यावरण, सामाजिक और शासन — कंपनी को इन तीन कसौटियों पर परखने का ढाँचा
definition: environmental, social and governance; the criteria investors use to assess sustainability, labour practices and board oversight
example: The ESG report had more photographs of trees than the company had planted.

hindi: कर्मचारी शेयर विकल्प योजना — कर्मचारियों को कंपनी में हिस्सेदारी देने की व्यवस्था
definition: employee stock option plan; the company's employee equity scheme, and in Indian English also the everyday word for the stock options themselves
example: The offer letter mentioned ESOPs three times and the vesting schedule never.

hindi: विकल्प पुनर्खरीद — कंपनी द्वारा कर्मचारियों के निहित विकल्प नकद में वापस खरीदना
definition: in Indian English, a company repurchasing vested employee stock options for cash, giving staff early liquidity before any exit
example: The ESOP buyback paid for a car, which the finance team called 'the retention strategy working'.

hindi: कर्मचारी शेयर खरीद योजना — वेतन से छूट पर कंपनी के शेयर ख़रीदना
definition: employee stock purchase plan; payroll deductions buying company shares at a discount, usually fifteen percent, on fixed purchase dates
example: The ESPP is the only investment strategy in the office that finance actually endorses.

hindi: अनुमानित समय — काम पूरा होने का संभावित वक़्त
definition: estimated time of arrival; when something should be done, allegedly
example: The ETA on the fix is soon, a proud engineering unit of time.

hindi: निकालना, बदलना, लोड करना — डेटा को स्रोत से उठाकर साफ़ करके गोदाम में डालने की प्रक्रिया
definition: extract, transform, load; the routine data pipeline that pulls records from source systems, cleans and reshapes them, then loads them into the warehouse
example: The dashboard is wrong again because the overnight ETL job quietly failed at 2 a.m.

hindi: अंतिम-उपयोक्ता लाइसेंस — सॉफ़्टवेयर उपयोग की क्लिक-स्वीकृत शर्तें
definition: end-user license agreement; the terms you click through to use software
example: The EULA forbids benchmarks, which tells you about the benchmarks.

hindi: उद्यम मूल्य — इक्विटी और शुद्ध कर्ज़ मिलाकर कंपनी का कुल मूल्य
definition: enterprise value; equity value plus debt minus cash, the whole-business price used in valuation multiples
example: The buyer liked the EV multiple and hated it again once they saw the pension deficit.

hindi: मूल्यांकन — मॉडल की क्षमता नापने की व्यवस्थित परीक्षा
definition: a structured test measuring how well a model performs on a task
example: No launch until the evals pass; vibes are not a test suite.

hindi: प्रचारक — किसी तकनीक या उत्पाद का जोशीला समर्थक
definition: a person paid to promote enthusiasm for a product or technology
example: Our developer evangelist gave the same demo at nine conferences.

hindi: इवेंट ट्रैकिंग — हर क्लिक और कार्य को नाम देकर दर्ज करना
definition: recording each user action as a named event for analysis
example: Event tracking captures everything except why.

hindi: सदाबहार खंड — अनुबंध को लगातार अपने आप नवीनीकृत रखने की शर्त
definition: a contract provision renewing the agreement indefinitely, period after period, until either party sends formal cancellation notice
example: The evergreen clause kept that vendor in our budget longer than two CFOs.

hindi: सदाबहार सामग्री — जो सालों तक प्रासंगिक और खोजी जाती रहे
definition: articles and videos that stay relevant and keep attracting search traffic for years after publishing
example: Our evergreen content still ranks; our trend piece on last summer's meme does not.

hindi: सदा-खुला पद — जो भरने के बाद भी खुला रहता है
definition: a requisition kept permanently open because the company hires steadily for that same role
example: It's an evergreen req, so every good backend engineer who applies goes straight into the loop.

hindi: पेटेंट को हरा रखना — छोटे बदलावों से दवा का एकाधिकार आगे खींचना
definition: extending patent protection on an existing drug through minor reformulations, dosages or delivery devices before generic competition arrives
example: The extended-release tablet was sold as innovation and budgeted as evergreening.

hindi: कर्मचारी मूल्य प्रस्ताव — कंपनी कर्मचारियों को बदले में क्या देती है
definition: employee value proposition; the pitch explaining what employees gain by working at the company
example: The new EVP promised growth, flexibility and purpose, in that order of decreasing evidence.

hindi: अपेक्षा से बेहतर — समीक्षा की ऊँची रेटिंग
definition: the performance rating above meets expectations, signalling strong results and usually a larger bonus
example: He got exceeds expectations and a two-percent raise, which exceeded nobody's expectations.

hindi: क्रियान्वित करना — योजना को अमल में लाना
definition: to carry out a plan; also to formally sign a contract
example: Strategy was the easy part; now someone has to execute.

hindi: कार्यकारी सत्र — प्रबंधन को बाहर भेजकर केवल निदेशकों की बैठक
definition: the part of a board meeting held without management present, so directors can speak candidly
example: When the board asked for an executive session, the CFO spent twenty minutes in the corridor rereading the notice period clause.

hindi: कार्यकारी प्रायोजक — सौदे को ऊपर से समर्थन देने वाला
definition: a senior leader on the customer side who backs the project and unblocks it
example: The project survived reorg number three because the executive sponsor did.

hindi: नौकरी छोड़ने के बाद विकल्प भुनाने की समय-सीमा
definition: the deadline after leaving to buy your vested options or lose them
example: The 90-day exercise window turned quitting into a five-figure decision.

hindi: निकास — अधिग्रहण या IPO से निवेशकों का पैसा वसूल होना
definition: the event where investors and founders cash out, via acquisition or IPO
example: Every pitch ends with an exit slide nobody reads aloud.

hindi: विदा होते कर्मचारी से आख़िरी औपचारिक बातचीत
definition: the final chat where departing employees are finally asked for honest feedback
example: The exit interview collected truths that would have been career-limiting last month.

hindi: निकास गुणक — बिक्री मूल्य राजस्व या लाभ का कितना गुना
definition: the sale price expressed as a multiple of revenue or earnings, used to compare acquisitions and investor returns
example: The banker quoted a twelve-times exit multiple, which assumed a buyer with twelve times our optimism.

hindi: आगे के अवसर — परामर्श छोड़कर मिलने वाली बेहतर नौकरियाँ
definition: attractive corporate, startup or investment jobs available to consultants after leaving their firm
example: He joined for the learning, he said, and discussed exit opportunities from week two.

hindi: निकास दर — अवधि के अंत में चल रही आय या खर्च की गति
definition: the revenue or spending pace at the close of a period, annualized to show where the next period starts
example: The annual numbers were soft, but the exit rate let everyone call it momentum.

hindi: निकास वितरण क्रम — बिक्री की रकम किस क्रम में किसे मिलेगी
definition: the model showing the order in which sale proceeds flow through the preference stack to each shareholder class
example: The exit waterfall turned a celebrated hundred-million acquisition into a modest bonus for the people who built it.

hindi: मौजूदा ग्राहक से अधिक आय — सीटें या उपयोग बढ़ना
definition: additional revenue from an existing customer through more seats, usage, or products
example: Expansion revenue is sales you don't have to cold call for.

hindi: शीघ्र कराना — किसी कार्य को कतार से आगे निकालना
definition: to rush one item past all queues and WIP limits
example: Everything marked expedite now waits in the expedite queue.

hindi: ख़र्च कंपनी के खाते डालना — भुगतान-वापसी हेतु दर्ज करना
definition: to charge a cost to the company for reimbursement
example: Can I expense the good coffee, or just the sad kind?

hindi: अनुभव प्रमाण-पत्र — सेवा अवधि और पद की पुष्टि
definition: in Indian English, the employer-issued certificate stating an employee's role, designation and dates of service
example: The experience letter summarised four years of heroics as 'worked here, conduct satisfactory.'

hindi: प्रयोग — बदलाव का असर नापने वाला नियंत्रित परीक्षण
definition: a controlled test of a change against a baseline before committing to it
example: Legal approved the experiment; users remain unaware they are in one.

hindi: विशेषज्ञ संपर्क-जाल — शुल्क पर उद्योग जानकारों से बातचीत करवाने वाली सेवा
definition: paid service connecting consultants and investors with industry specialists for short research calls
example: The expert network found a former plant manager, who charged more per hour than the partner.

hindi: व्याख्येयता — मॉडल के फ़ैसले की वजह बता पाने की क्षमता
definition: the ability to say why a model made a particular decision
example: Legal wants explainability: 'the model felt like it' won't survive an audit.

hindi: बहुत छोटी समय-सीमा वाला नौकरी-प्रस्ताव — दबाव की रणनीति
definition: a job offer with a short deadline designed to prevent shopping around
example: The exploding offer gave her 48 hours to decide the next four years.

hindi: निर्यात नियंत्रण — कुछ तकनीक या सॉफ़्टवेयर विदेश भेजने पर सरकारी पाबंदी
definition: government rules restricting which technology, software, encryption and hardware may be shipped or shared with certain countries
example: The launch in twelve new countries became nine once export control weighed in.

hindi: विस्तार दौर — पिछले राउंड की शर्तों पर अतिरिक्त पैसा जुटाना
definition: additional money raised on the previous round's terms, usually to stretch runway before the next milestone
example: Nobody calls it a bridge anymore; it's an extension round, which sounds like a victory lap.

hindi: पूर्ण ज़िम्मेदारी — हर नतीजे की ज़िम्मेदारी ख़ुद लेना, बहाने नहीं
definition: leadership philosophy where leaders accept total responsibility for their team's outcomes, including failures caused by others
example: In the spirit of extreme ownership, he owned the launch and delegated the outage.

hindi: आँखों वाला इमोजी — 'मैं देख रहा हूँ' का संकेत
definition: chat reaction signalling you have seen a message and are looking into it
example: He reacted with the eyes emoji, which is not the same as doing anything.

hindi: नज़र डालने का अनुरोध — समीक्षा की माँग
definition: a request for someone to review or watch something
example: Can I get eyes on the pricing page before it ships?

hindi: एफ़-आकार पढ़ना — पन्ने पर आँखों का एफ़ जैसा चलना
definition: the typical reading path where users scan across the page top, then down the left edge
example: Thanks to the F-pattern, nobody read the paragraph on the right explaining the price change.

hindi: आमने-सामने — वीडियो या फ़ोन के बजाय व्यक्तिगत रूप से मिलना
definition: face to face; an in-person meeting between colleagues, clients or partners rather than a remote call
example: The client insisted on an F2F, so we flew nine hours to watch the same slides.

hindi: हाज़िरी का प्रदर्शन — मैनेजर और नेतृत्व के सामने दफ़्तर में दिखाई देने का समय
definition: hours spent visibly present in front of managers and leadership, often rewarded at promotion time more than actual output
example: He schedules his face time carefully: arrives after the director, leaves after the director.

hindi: संचालक — बैठक को पटरी पर रखने वाला
definition: the person who runs a meeting and keeps it on track
example: A good facilitator ends the debate before minute fifty.

hindi: जल्दी असफल होना — सस्ते में आज़माओ, जल्दी सीखो
definition: to test ideas cheaply and abandon failures early
example: We failed fast on the chatbot, and no one mourned.

hindi: विकल्प पर स्विच — मुख्य सिस्टम रुकने पर काम अपने-आप बैकअप सिस्टम पर चले जाना
definition: the switch of live traffic from a failing primary system to a standby backup, either automatically or by hand
example: The failover worked in four seconds; noticing it needed four hours.

hindi: संतुलित प्रस्तुति — दवा के फ़ायदों के साथ जोखिम भी बराबर बताना
definition: regulatory requirement that drug promotion presents risks and side effects with prominence comparable to the claimed benefits
example: The agency made the benefits huge, so fair balance made the side effects huge, and now the banner is mostly text.

hindi: निष्पक्षता राय — बैंक का प्रमाण कि सौदे की कीमत शेयरधारकों के लिए उचित है
definition: a bank's formal letter stating a deal price is financially fair to shareholders, protecting the board
example: The fairness opinion arrived promptly, fairly priced at several million dollars.

hindi: प्रतीकात्मक यात्रा — रिमोट दिन की शुरुआत-अंत की सैर
definition: a deliberate walk or ride bookending the remote workday
example: A fake commute around the block keeps work out of dinner.

hindi: छद्म द्वार परीक्षण — बिना बनी सुविधा का बटन दिखाकर माँग नापना
definition: a button for an unbuilt feature, measuring demand by clicks
example: The fake door got record clicks and one very awkward sales call.

hindi: मिथ्या सकारात्मक — जो सही है उसे ग़लती से समस्या बताना
definition: when a system flags something that is actually fine
example: The fall detector's false positives mean sitting down dramatically now alerts your family.

hindi: किसान विक्रेता — मौजूदा ग्राहकों को सँभालने और बढ़ाने वाला
definition: salesperson focused on growing and renewing existing customer accounts rather than prospecting for others
example: The farmer inherited the hunter's accounts along with several promises nobody wrote down.

hindi: तेज़ अनुकरणकर्ता — दूसरों की ग़लतियों से सीखकर नक़ल करने वाली कंपनी
definition: a company that lets pioneers make the mistakes, then copies what works
example: Being a fast follower means our roadmap is their changelog.

hindi: तेज़ रफ़्तार माहौल — नौकरी विज्ञापनों में लगातार बदलाव और भारी काम का संकेत
definition: job-listing language describing constant change, shifting priorities and heavy workload, often meaning understaffed and chaotic
example: 'Fast-paced environment' meant the roadmap changed twice before my laptop arrived.

hindi: तेज़ रास्ते पर डालना — सामान्य प्रक्रिया छोड़ प्राथमिकता से कराना
definition: to speed something past the normal process
example: The CEO's pet feature got fast-tracked past three reviews.

hindi: पहले संपर्क में समाधान — दोबारा संपर्क के बिना समस्या सुलझ जाना
definition: first contact resolution; the share of customer problems resolved completely during the first interaction without follow-up contacts
example: FCR looks wonderful when the customer gives up after the first contact.

hindi: फ़ीचर भराव — इतने फ़ीचर कि उत्पाद भारी और उलझा हुआ हो जाए
definition: a product overloaded with rarely used features, making it heavier, harder to learn and costlier to maintain
example: The settings page now scrolls for a full minute, which is how you know feature bloat has arrived.

hindi: फ़ीचर शाखा — किसी एक फ़ीचर पर काम के लिए मुख्य शाखा से अलग बनाई गई शाखा
definition: a separate branch created from the main branch to develop one feature before merging it back
example: Her feature branch is called 'quick-fix' and is eleven weeks old.

hindi: विशेषताओं की तुलना — प्रतिद्वंद्वियों से आमने-सामने तालिका
definition: a chart comparing your product's features against competitors', authored by the winner
example: In our feature comparison we have all the checkmarks; funny how that works.

hindi: सुविधा-अतिवृद्धि — धीरे-धीरे जुड़ती अनचाही सुविधाओं की सूजन
definition: the slow accumulation of features nobody asked for
example: The settings page is a museum of feature creep.

hindi: फ़ीचर अभियांत्रिकी — कच्चे डेटा से मॉडल के काम की जानकारी गढ़ना
definition: turning raw data into meaningful inputs a model can actually learn from
example: Good feature engineering turned raw accelerometer noise into 'that was a jumping jack'.

hindi: फ़ीचर कारख़ाना — परिणाम देखे बिना बस फ़ीचर बनाते जाने वाली टीम
definition: a product organization that measures success by features shipped rather than customer outcomes, shipping output without checking impact
example: We're a feature factory: forty launches this year and nobody can say which one mattered.

hindi: फ़ीचर स्विच — कोड में लगा टॉगल जिससे सुविधा चालू-बंद हो
definition: a runtime toggle that turns a feature on or off without redeploying
example: Relax, it's behind a feature flag nobody has turned on. Probably.

hindi: फ़ीचर रोक — रिलीज़ से पहले नए फ़ीचर बंद, सिर्फ़ फ़िक्स
definition: a period before release when only fixes, not new features, may land
example: Feature freeze starts Monday, so everyone is merging tonight.

hindi: सुविधा क़ब्रिस्तान — बंद की जा चुकी सुविधाओं की सामूहिक स्मृति
definition: the collective memory of features that shipped and were quietly removed
example: Add it to the feature graveyard, next to the social feed of 2021.

hindi: सुविधा समता — दो संस्करणों में एक जैसी सुविधाएँ होना
definition: when two products or platforms offer the same feature set
example: The Android app reaches feature parity right after iOS ships something new.

hindi: सुविधा अनुरोध — ग्राहक द्वारा उत्पाद में नई क्षमता की माँग
definition: customer suggestion asking for additional product functionality, logged by support and passed to product teams for possible prioritisation
example: The feature request was logged, tagged, prioritised and then lovingly archived.

hindi: आदेश-पालक टीम — ऊपर से तय फ़ीचर बस बनाकर देने वाली टीम
definition: a product team handed a roadmap of features to build, measured on delivery rather than on solving customer problems
example: As a feature team, our discovery process is reading the ticket the director wrote.

hindi: संघीय अधिगम — डेटा डिवाइस पर ही रहे, सीख साझा मॉडल में जाए
definition: training a shared model across users' devices without their raw data ever leaving
example: Federated learning lets the sleep model improve without anyone's sleep leaving their phone.

hindi: प्रतिक्रिया चक्र — उपयोगकर्ता की प्रतिक्रिया से तंत्र का लगातार सुधार
definition: user corrections and outcomes flowing back to improve the system continuously
example: Every thumbs-down on a suggested workout feeds the feedback loop — keep them coming.

hindi: फ़ीडबैक सैंडविच — आलोचना को दो तारीफ़ों के बीच रखना
definition: delivering criticism wedged between a pair of compliments to soften it, a technique most recipients quickly learn to decode
example: Great slides, the project failed, great slides: a feedback sandwich with very thin bread.

hindi: महसूस-महसूस किया-पाया — आपत्ति को सहानुभूति और दूसरों के अनुभव से सँभालना
definition: an objection handling script: acknowledge how the buyer feels, note others felt similarly, explain what those customers found
example: He used feel-felt-found so often that customers started finishing the sentence for him.

hindi: अल्प-उदाहरण — प्रॉम्प्ट में दो-चार नमूने देकर मॉडल को राह दिखाना
definition: giving a model a handful of examples in the prompt to guide its output
example: Three few-shot examples fixed what two pages of instructions couldn't.

hindi: न्यासीय कर्तव्य — दूसरों के धन और हित को अपने हित से ऊपर रखने का कानूनी दायित्व
definition: the legal obligation of directors and officers to act in the company's and shareholders' best interests, above their own
example: Legal reminded the board of its fiduciary duty, which is why the CEO's cousin's catering bid was politely declined.

hindi: जागीर — किसी मैनेजर का अपना बंद इलाका जिसमें बाहरी दख़ल मना है
definition: a department or team a manager controls as private territory, guarding its headcount and resisting outside influence
example: Data engineering is less a team than a fiefdom with a ticket queue for visitors.

hindi: क्षेत्रीय बिक्री — ग्राहकों से आमने-सामने मिलकर बिक्री
definition: selling through in-person customer visits and meetings, usually reserved for large enterprise accounts
example: Field sales insists the deal needed a dinner in Singapore, and the expense report agrees.

hindi: पहले आया पहले गया — पुराना माल पहले निकालना
definition: first in, first out; shipping or using the oldest inventory before newer stock, essential for perishable goods
example: FIFO was the policy, but the newest pallets were closest to the door.

hindi: पूर्ति दर — तुरंत भंडार से पूरे हुए ऑर्डरों का प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage of customer orders or units shipped immediately from available stock without backorders or stockouts
example: Our fill rate looks heroic because we quietly delisted everything we kept running out of.

hindi: वित्तीय खरीदार — मुनाफ़े हेतु कंपनी खरीदने वाला निवेश फ़र्म
definition: a private equity or investment firm acquiring a business for financial returns rather than product combination
example: The financial buyer loved our margins and wanted to discuss improving them, starting with headcount.

hindi: समय निकालना — साझा ख़ाली स्लॉट खोजकर बैठक रखना
definition: to locate a mutually free slot and schedule it
example: Let's find time next week to walk through the proposal.

hindi: लाने, संभालने, करने वाले — फ़र्म में काम के तीन स्तर
definition: the three professional services firm roles: winning clients, managing client relationships, and doing the actual work
example: Three years in, he could finally tell he was a grinder who minded the finders.

hindi: सूक्ष्म-समायोजन — अपने डेटा पर पूर्व-प्रशिक्षित मॉडल को और तराशना
definition: further training a pretrained model on your own data for a specific task
example: After fine-tuning on our workout logs, it finally stopped calling burpees 'burples'.

hindi: आपात नाटक — अचानक अत्यावश्यक बना दिया गया काम
definition: a sudden urgent scramble, frequently for something that wasn't urgent
example: Friday's fire drill was cancelled Monday, as fire drills often are.

hindi: आपात बिक्री — मजबूरी में सस्ते दाम पर कंपनी बेचना
definition: selling a company or its assets fast and cheap, usually under distress
example: The 'strategic acquisition' was a fire sale with better fonts.

hindi: आग बुझाना — योजना छोड़ लगातार आपात समस्याएँ निपटाना
definition: constantly handling urgent breakages instead of planned work
example: This quarter's roadmap was 10% features, 90% firefighting.

hindi: अनौपचारिक संवाद — नेता से खुली बातचीत का सत्र
definition: an informal interview-style session with a leader or guest
example: The CEO's fireside chat was cozy until the layoff question.

hindi: पहला समापन — राउंड के शुरुआती निवेशकों का पैसा औपचारिक रूप से आना
definition: the initial completion of a financing where committed investors fund while the round stays open for later investors
example: They announced the full round at first close and spent two months hoping the rest would actually wire.

hindi: बाज़ार में सबसे पहले उतरने वाली कंपनी
definition: the earliest company in a market, hoping the head start becomes an advantage
example: We're the first mover, which mostly means we make the first mistakes.

hindi: पहली बार में सही — बिना दोबारा काम किए सही बनी इकाइयों का प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage of units completing a process correctly the first time, without rework, repair or scrap
example: First pass yield hit ninety-nine percent once quality stopped checking.

hindi: पहला मरीज़ शामिल — ट्रायल में पहले प्रतिभागी का नामांकन
definition: the milestone when the first participant enrolls or receives treatment in a clinical trial, starting the study clock
example: First patient in was celebrated with cake, which was optimistic given enrolment for the other four hundred.

hindi: मूल सिद्धांतों से सोचना — मान्यताएँ हटाकर समस्या को बुनियादी तथ्यों से दोबारा गढ़ना
definition: reasoning that strips a problem down to basic facts and rebuilds the solution without inherited assumptions or analogies
example: He reasoned from first principles and rediscovered, at great length, the process we already had.

hindi: पहली प्रतिक्रिया का समय — ग्राहक को पहला उत्तर मिलने में लगा समय
definition: support metric measuring elapsed time between a customer opening a ticket and receiving the first human reply
example: Our first response time is four minutes, because the first response is 'thanks, looking into it'.

hindi: पहला क्लिक परीक्षण — उपयोगकर्ता सबसे पहले कहाँ क्लिक करता है
definition: a usability test measuring where users click first when attempting a task, predicting overall task success
example: The first-click test showed everyone heading for the logo, which, regrettably, did nothing.

hindi: अपनी तरह की पहली — बिल्कुल नए तंत्र से काम करने वाली दवा
definition: describing a drug that treats a condition through a mechanism no approved medicine has used before
example: Every asset in the pipeline is first-in-class until a competitor publishes their poster.

hindi: प्रथम-पक्ष डेटा — कंपनी द्वारा अपने ग्राहकों से सीधे जुटाई गई जानकारी
definition: customer information your company collects directly through its own products, website and purchases, with consent
example: Every strategy deck now says first-party data, usually above a newsletter signup form.

hindi: प्रथम-संपर्क श्रेय — बिक्री का पूरा श्रेय ग्राहक के पहले संपर्क को
definition: attribution model giving full conversion credit to the first touchpoint that introduced the customer to the brand
example: First-touch attribution is how the podcast sponsorship team keeps its budget.

hindi: वित्त वर्ष — कंपनी का लेखा वर्ष, कैलेंडर वर्ष से अलग हो सकता है
definition: a company's twelve-month accounting period, not always January to December
example: Our fiscal year starts in February, confusing everyone annually.

hindi: सफ़ाई और निखार — अंतिम छोटी बारीकियाँ ठीक करना
definition: the final layer of small details, alignment and consistency that makes a product feel carefully made
example: Fit and finish was scheduled for 'after launch', which is also where it still lives.

hindi: अनुकूलता साक्षात्कार — व्यक्तित्व, नेतृत्व और अनुभव की कहानियों वाला साक्षात्कार
definition: consulting interview segment about personal experiences, leadership stories and motivation, alongside the case
example: He aced the case interview, then spent the fit interview explaining why he'd quit rowing.

hindi: आकार-दूरी नियम — बड़ा और पास लक्ष्य जल्दी छुआ जाता है
definition: the principle that bigger, closer targets are faster to click, cited when sizing buttons
example: Citing Fitts's law, she made the 'Delete account' button smaller and further away.

hindi: पाँच शक्तियाँ — उद्योग की प्रतिस्पर्धा परखने का पोर्टर का ढाँचा
definition: the Michael Porter framework judging industry attractiveness through rivalry, supplier power, buyer power, substitutes and threat of fresh market entrants
example: The five forces slide concluded that competition exists, which the sales team could have told them for free.

hindi: पाँच नौ — 99.999% उपलब्धता का स्वप्निल लक्ष्य
definition: 99.999% availability, about five minutes of downtime a year, mostly aspirational
example: We promise five nines; the fine print counts differently.

hindi: पाँच क्यों — बार-बार 'क्यों' पूछकर मूल कारण खोजना
definition: a root-cause technique of asking why repeatedly until the real cause surfaces
example: Five whys in, the root cause was the deadline itself.

hindi: पाँच सेकंड परीक्षण — पहली झलक में क्या याद रहा
definition: showing users a screen for five seconds, then asking what they remember, to test first impressions
example: In the five-second test, most people remembered the stock photo and nobody remembered the product.

hindi: आगे बढ़कर सुधारो — रोलबैक नहीं, नया फ़िक्स तुरंत भेजो
definition: shipping a new fix instead of rolling back the broken release
example: Too late to roll back; we fix forward and pray.

hindi: निश्चित मूल्य अनुबंध — पूरे प्रोजेक्ट की पहले से तय कीमत
definition: services contract where the vendor delivers agreed scope for a fixed price, absorbing any effort overrun at its own cost
example: Scope creep on a fixed bid is how a profitable deal becomes a case study.

hindi: जड़ सोच — यह मानना कि क्षमता जन्मजात है और बदलती नहीं
definition: belief that talent and abilities are innate and unchangeable, which makes people avoid challenges and feedback
example: In calibration, "fixed mindset" has become the polite way to say someone disagreed with the manager.

hindi: स्थिर वेतन — हर महीने पक्का मिलने वाला वेतन हिस्सा
definition: the guaranteed portion of compensation, excluding bonuses and incentives; commonly used in Indian English when comparing offers
example: Look at the fixed pay, the recruiter said, as if the rest were decorative.

hindi: ध्यान दिलाना — संभावित समस्या की ओर इशारा करना
definition: to mark something for attention before it becomes a problem
example: Just flagging that the demo environment is down again.

hindi: अस्थिर — कभी पास कभी फेल होने वाला (टेस्ट)
definition: failing intermittently without any code change, eroding trust in the tests
example: It's not broken, it's flaky, we rerun it until it agrees.

hindi: कम पदानुक्रम वाला संगठन — प्रबंधन की परतें न्यूनतम
definition: a company with few management layers, in theory reducing hierarchy
example: We're a flat organization, which means everyone reports to the founder's mood.

hindi: समान मूल्य का दौर — वैल्यूएशन न बढ़ी न घटी
definition: a round at the same valuation as before, neither victory nor disaster
example: We're calling the flat round 'stability' in the investor update.

hindi: सपाट हो जाना — आँकड़े की बढ़त का पूरी तरह रुक जाना
definition: to stop growing entirely
example: Signups flatlined in June and the word pivot entered the chat.

hindi: लचीला कार्यस्थल — बिना तय मालिक की साझा मेज़ें और कमरे
definition: shared office desks and rooms that nobody owns, booked or used flexibly by whoever comes into the office
example: The old finance floor became flex space, which mostly means nobody can find the stapler.

hindi: लचीला समय — कर्मचारी को अपने काम के शुरू और ख़त्म होने के घंटे चुनने की छूट
definition: arrangement letting employees choose their own start and finish times around shared core hours
example: Flextime means you may start whenever you like, provided you attend the nine o'clock call.

hindi: नौकरी छोड़ने की कगार पर खड़ा कर्मचारी
definition: an employee judged likely to quit soon
example: Updating your title on professional networks flags you as a flight risk.

hindi: सुरक्षा की ओर पलायन — डर में निवेशकों का सुरक्षित संपत्तियों में पैसा ले जाना
definition: investors moving money from risky assets into safer holdings like bonds, cash or gold during fear
example: The flight to safety in our team was everyone suddenly volunteering for the maintenance roadmap.

hindi: विज्ञापन-चक्र निर्धारण — प्रसारण को अवधियों में बाँटना
definition: scheduling advertising in bursts of activity separated by periods of silence, rather than spending evenly across the whole year
example: Flighting means we go dark in August, which the competition calls opportunity.

hindi: विदेशी पुनर्गठन — भारतीय स्टार्टअप की मूल कंपनी को विदेश में स्थानांतरित करना
definition: restructuring so a startup's parent company is incorporated abroad, typically Delaware or Singapore, to attract foreign investors
example: The flip to Delaware took nine months, two law firms and one founder's entire patience.

hindi: न्यूनतम कीमत — जिससे नीचे बिना विशेष मंज़ूरी के बेचना मना है
definition: the lowest approved price a salesperson may quote before the discount must be escalated for special approval
example: We never go below the floor price, except at quarter end, when the floor becomes a suggestion.

hindi: उतार-चढ़ाव विश्लेषण — पिछली अवधि की तुलना में बड़े बदलावों की व्याख्या
definition: explaining significant changes in account balances between periods, usually any movement above a defined threshold
example: The flux analysis asked why travel doubled; the answer was one offsite in Goa.

hindi: फ्लाईव्हील — हर चक्कर से अगला आसान बनाता स्व-चालित विकास
definition: a compounding cycle where each turn makes the next one easier
example: Every strategy doc has a flywheel; ours is still hand-cranked.

hindi: उचित बाज़ार मूल्य — किसी शेयर का आधिकारिक आँका गया मूल्य
definition: fair market value; the official price assigned to shares, driving option strike prices and employee taxation
example: The FMV of our common stock is a number both sacred and entirely theoretical.

hindi: एकाग्रता कक्ष — अकेले बिना शोर काम करने का छोटा कमरा
definition: a small quiet office room for solo concentrated work or private calls, away from open floor noise
example: Someone booked the focus room from nine to six to hold one fifteen-minute call.

hindi: एकाग्र-कार्य समय — बिना बाधा काम हेतु सुरक्षित घंटे
definition: calendar time protected for uninterrupted individual work
example: My focus time got eaten by a quick sync again.

hindi: आगामी परियोजना — मौजूदा काम से निकली उसी ग्राहक की अगली परियोजना
definition: additional paid project from an existing client, usually sold during or right after current work
example: Every recommendation in the final report conveniently required a follow-on.

hindi: सूर्य-अनुगामी — समय-क्षेत्रों में चौबीसों घंटे काम सौंपना
definition: handing work across timezones so it continues around the clock
example: Support runs follow-the-sun, so tickets never sleep.

hindi: अनुवर्ती संपर्क की लय — तय अंतराल पर याद दिलाना
definition: the scheduled rhythm of emails and calls after first contact
example: Our follow-up cadence is polite persistence every three business days.

hindi: पिछली बात याद दिलाना — जवाब की विनम्र तलाश
definition: returning to an unanswered request, politely and relentlessly
example: Following up on my note from last week — any thoughts?

hindi: छूट जाने का डर — दूसरों के मुनाफ़े को देखकर बिना सोचे निवेश करना
definition: fear of missing out; buying into rising prices or trends because everyone else seems to be profiting
example: Our AI roadmap was built on careful research and roughly ninety percent FOMO.

hindi: फ़ू-बार — उदाहरणों में काम आने वाले परंपरागत नकली नाम
definition: the traditional placeholder name used in code examples everywhere
example: The tutorial's foobar shipped to production as an actual table name.

hindi: मूल्यांकन पट्टी चार्ट — विभिन्न तरीकों से निकले मूल्य-दायरों का चित्र
definition: a horizontal bar chart comparing valuation ranges from different methods, used to frame a price
example: The football field showed the offer inside every range, after some creative stretching of the bars.

hindi: अपने पैर पर गोली — ऐसी सुविधा जिससे खुद का नुकसान आसान हो
definition: a feature or API that makes it dangerously easy to hurt yourself
example: A delete-all endpoint with no confirmation is a loaded footgun.

hindi: संदर्भ के लिए — पृष्ठभूमि की जानकारी
definition: prefacing background information that explains the ask
example: For context, this is the third redesign this year.

hindi: नज़र में रहने हेतु — जानकारी में रखना
definition: shared so people can't later say they didn't know
example: Adding your manager for visibility, not for escalation. Yet.

hindi: दैवीय-घटना खंड — बाढ़, युद्ध जैसी अनहोनी पर दायित्व से छूट
definition: a clause excusing obligations during extraordinary events like disasters
example: The vendor cited force majeure; the outage cited their intern.

hindi: ज़बरदस्ती धकेलना — साझा इतिहास पर अपना संस्करण थोप देना
definition: overwriting shared git history with your own version, teammates' work be damned
example: He force pushed to main; we speak of him in past tense.

hindi: बाध्य वितरण — तय प्रतिशत कर्मचारियों को कम रेटिंग देना अनिवार्य
definition: rating system requiring fixed percentages of employees in each performance band, guaranteeing some receive poor ratings
example: Forced distribution meant someone on a team of four stars had to become a two.

hindi: पूर्वानुमान — भविष्य की आय-ख़र्च का अनुमान
definition: a prediction of future revenue, costs, or demand
example: The forecast assumes every deal closes; the pipeline giggles.

hindi: पूर्वानुमान बैठक — इस तिमाही कितना राजस्व आएगा, इसका वादा
definition: weekly sales meeting where managers state expected quarter revenue, deal by deal, to leadership
example: On the forecast call, the region moved its number up, down, and back up within four minutes.

hindi: शाखा बनाना — प्रोजेक्ट की प्रति लेकर अपनी अलग राह चलना
definition: to copy a project and develop it independently
example: They forked the project after one argument about tabs.

hindi: टीम विकास की अवस्थाएँ — बनना, टकराना, तालमेल बैठाना, फिर प्रदर्शन करना
definition: stages of team development where members meet, clash, settle shared norms and finally perform well together
example: After forming, storming, norming, the reorg sent us straight back to forming.

hindi: स्वीकृत दवा-सूची — बीमा जिन दवाओं का भुगतान करता है
definition: the list of drugs an insurer, pharmacy benefit manager or hospital agrees to cover, arranged in tiers that determine patient costs
example: We won approval in March and formulary placement sometime after the heat death of the universe.

hindi: क़िले जैसी मज़बूत वित्तीय स्थिति — भरपूर नकदी और कम कर्ज़
definition: company finances with plentiful cash and little debt, able to withstand downturns and fund acquisitions
example: We have a fortress balance sheet, the CFO said, declining the team's request for monitors.

hindi: भविष्य संबंधी कथन — अनुमानों पर क़ानूनी चेतावनी
definition: legally disclaimed management predictions about future results, introduced with a safe harbor warning at every earnings call
example: Forty seconds of forward-looking statements, then forty minutes of carefully unfalsifiable optimism.

hindi: आधार मॉडल — जिस पर कई उत्पाद बनते हैं, ऐसा बहु-उद्देश्यीय मॉडल
definition: a large general-purpose model that many downstream products build on
example: We don't train foundation models; we rent one and add squats.

hindi: संस्थापक — कंपनी को शून्य से शुरू करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: someone who starts a company and carries it from idea to reality
example: The founder does sales, support, hiring, and occasionally, sleep.

hindi: संस्थापक का सीधे हर स्तर में दखल देने वाला प्रबंधन
definition: a founder bypassing management layers to run details directly
example: Founder mode returned, and with it, 11 p.m. design reviews.

hindi: संस्थापक शेयर — शुरुआत में संस्थापकों को मिले सस्ते सामान्य शेयर
definition: common shares issued to founders at incorporation for almost nothing, usually subject to reverse vesting
example: His founder shares cost a hundred dollars, which he mentions at every all-hands.

hindi: संस्थापक सिंड्रोम — बढ़ती कंपनी में भी हर फ़ैसला ख़ुद रखने की संस्थापक की ज़िद
definition: a founder's inability to delegate authority as the company grows, keeping every decision centralised
example: Founder's syndrome is a 400-person company where the font on the lunch menu still needs CEO sign-off.

hindi: संस्थापक-हितैषी — शर्तों में संस्थापकों का पक्ष लेने वाला निवेशक
definition: describes investors whose terms and behavior favor founders, at least on paper
example: They're founder-friendly right up until the board vote.

hindi: संस्थापक द्वारा बिक्री — शुरुआती दौर में ख़ुद ग्राहक जुटाना
definition: the early phase when founders personally sell because nobody else can yet
example: Founder-led sales means the CEO still answers the demo requests himself.

hindi: संस्थापक-बाज़ार मेल — संस्थापक के अनुभव और समस्या का तालमेल
definition: the match between a founder's background and the problem they are solving
example: A dentist building dental software — investors love that founder-market fit.

hindi: संस्थापक इंजीनियर — शुरुआती दौर में जुड़ा, कम वेतन और ज़्यादा इक्विटी वाला पहला इंजीनियर
definition: one of the first engineers hired at an early startup, typically trading salary for larger equity and broad ownership
example: As founding engineer she owned the backend, the frontend, the office Wi-Fi and the coffee machine.

hindi: चार-दिवसीय सप्ताह — वेतन घटाए बिना हफ़्ते में चार दिन काम
definition: a working schedule of four days a week, usually at full salary, to improve wellbeing and retention
example: The four-day week pilot worked beautifully, apart from Friday becoming the day for 'quick calls'.

hindi: वित्तीय योजना एवं विश्लेषण — बजट, पूर्वानुमान और प्रदर्शन-विश्लेषण करने वाली वित्त टीम
definition: financial planning and analysis; the finance team that builds budgets, forecasts and explains variances to leadership
example: FP&A sent the forecast template back for the third time, now with conditional formatting.

hindi: मुक्त नकद प्रवाह — पूंजीगत खर्च के बाद बची असली नकदी
definition: operating cash flow minus capital expenditure; the actual cash left after running and maintaining the business
example: The income statement says profitable; free cash flow says please don't order new laptops.

hindi: खाली/व्यस्त स्थिति — कैलेंडर में कौन कब उपलब्ध है
definition: the shared calendar view showing when colleagues are available or booked, without revealing what their meetings are about
example: Her free/busy showed one open slot this month, and I took it.

hindi: फ़्री-प्रीमियम मॉडल — मुफ़्त संस्करण, उन्नत सुविधाओं के पैसे
definition: a model offering a free tier and charging for premium features
example: Freemium works: millions use it free, and hundreds pay for it.

hindi: आवृत्ति सीमा — एक व्यक्ति को विज्ञापन दिखाने की अधिकतम गिनती
definition: a limit on how many times the same person sees an advertisement within a given period, to prevent annoyance and wasted spend
example: Someone forgot the frequency cap, so the finance director saw our banner ninety times before lunch.

hindi: नया स्नातक कर्मचारी — बिना अनुभव के पहली नौकरी करने वाला
definition: an Indian English term for a recent graduate hired with no prior work experience, usually in large campus batches
example: The freshers finished training on Friday and were deployed to production on Monday.

hindi: रुकावट — उपयोगकर्ता के काम को धीमा करने वाली हर बाधा
definition: anything that makes a task harder or slower for the user
example: Every extra signup field adds friction, and friction costs conversions.

hindi: अड़चन डायरी — उत्पाद इस्तेमाल करते हुए हर परेशानी दर्ज करना
definition: a running record written while using a product, noting every confusing, slow or annoying moment
example: The CEO's friction log from setting up his own account became the next quarter's roadmap.

hindi: शुक्रवार का डिप्लॉय — सप्ताहांत से ठीक पहले उत्पादन में बदलाव भेजना, जिसे जोखिम भरा माना जाता है
definition: releasing code to production on a Friday, widely avoided because failures spill into the weekend
example: The Friday deploy went fine, said nobody on the on-call rota on Saturday.

hindi: दोस्ताना याद-दिहानी — हर बार कम दोस्ताना
definition: a reminder that gets less friendly each time it is sent
example: Third friendly reminder: the survey closes tonight.

hindi: परिजनों से पहला निवेश — भरोसे के आधार पर जुटाई शुरुआती रक़म
definition: the informal first money raised from people who trust the founder personally
example: The friends and family round made Diwali dinners slightly more formal.

hindi: आगे दौड़ना — ग्राहक के बड़े ऑर्डर की जानकारी से पहले ख़ुद सौदा करना
definition: trading ahead of known upcoming orders to profit from the expected price move
example: Using the client's pipeline to time your own trades is front-running, and compliance has read the emails.

hindi: अग्रणी मॉडल — किसी समय का सबसे सक्षम और सबसे बड़ा मॉडल
definition: one of the largest, most capable models available at a given moment
example: Do we need a frontier model to count push-ups? Finance says no.

hindi: झागदार — बाज़ार या मूल्यांकन जो अत्यधिक महँगे और बुलबुले जैसे लगें
definition: describing markets or valuations that look inflated, speculative and close to bubble territory
example: Valuations feel frothy when a slide deck with no product raises more than we did with revenue.

hindi: जमा हुआ मध्य स्तर — बदलाव रोकने वाला मध्य प्रबंधन
definition: middle management layers that resist or quietly stall change initiatives coming from senior leadership
example: The transformation deck reached the frozen middle and has not been seen since.

hindi: पूर्णकालिक कर्मचारी — हेडकाउंट गिनने की इकाई
definition: full-time equivalent; a unit for counting employees in headcount math
example: The project needs three FTEs; we have one and an intern.

hindi: रिकॉर्ड के लिए — बाद में काम आने वाली बात दर्ज करना
definition: for the record; phrase stating something clearly in writing so there is proof later
example: FTR, I raised this risk in April — typed with the calm of someone saving screenshots.

hindi: पहली बार का अनुभव — नए उपयोगकर्ता के शुरुआती पल
definition: first-time user experience; everything a new user sees and does during their earliest sessions
example: The FTUE had five tooltips, two modals and a survey before the user could see the product.

hindi: डर, अनिश्चितता और संदेह — प्रतिस्पर्धी के विरुद्ध आशंका फैलाना
definition: fear, uncertainty, and doubt — spreading scary vagueness about a competitor
example: Their rep is spreading FUD about our uptime; our status page disagrees.

hindi: पूर्ण एवं अंतिम निपटान — विदाई पर बकाया वेतन और देय राशि का अंतिम हिसाब
definition: in Indian English, the final payout after leaving, settling pending salary, leave encashment and deductions
example: His full and final settlement arrived forty-five days later, minus the cost of a lost mouse.

hindi: पूर्ण लागत वसूली — अनुदान में परियोजना के साथ संस्था के साझा खर्च भी शामिल करना
definition: pricing grants and contracts to cover a fair share of organisational overhead and support costs, not only direct project expenses
example: The funder admired our full cost recovery budget and then capped overhead at five percent.

hindi: पूर्ण मूल्य-समायोजन — सस्ते राउंड पर निवेशक की कीमत सीधे नई कीमत तक गिराना
definition: the harshest anti-dilution protection, resetting an investor's conversion price to the lower price of any later down round
example: One full ratchet and a bad quarter later, the founders owned roughly the office plants.

hindi: पूर्ण-चक्र विक्रेता — शुरुआत से हस्ताक्षर तक सौदा खुद चलाने वाला
definition: account executive who prospects, qualifies, demos and closes deals personally, without separate development reps
example: As a full-cycle AE he books his own meetings, runs his own demos and blames only himself.

hindi: पूर्ण-स्तरीय — फ्रंटएंड से डेटाबेस तक सब सँभालने वाला
definition: covering every layer from user interface to database
example: Full-stack means the bug is always yours.

hindi: पूर्ण तनुकृत — सभी ऑप्शन और परिवर्तनीय साधन जोड़कर गिना गया हिस्सा
definition: counting ownership as though every option, warrant, note and SAFE had already converted into shares
example: He owned ten percent, just not on a fully diluted basis, which is the only basis that pays.

hindi: पूर्णतः निष्पादित — सभी पक्षों द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित अनुबंध
definition: describing a contract signed by every required party, making it binding and ready to file
example: Sales celebrated at the verbal yes; finance waited for the fully executed copy.

hindi: संपूर्ण लागत — वेतन के साथ लाभ, कर, जगह आदि जोड़कर असली खर्च
definition: total cost of an employee or resource including salary, benefits, taxes, equipment and office overhead
example: Your salary is one number; your fully loaded cost is the one finance quotes when approving headcount.

hindi: फ़ंक्शन आह्वान — मॉडल का सीधे कोड या एपीआई चलाना
definition: a model invoking predefined code or APIs instead of just writing text
example: With function calling, the assistant actually books the class instead of describing booking.

hindi: निवेश का सूखा — जब वेंचर पूँजी मिलना लंबे समय तक कठिन हो
definition: a prolonged period when venture money becomes scarce and cautious
example: During the funding winter, 'growth at all costs' quietly became 'profitability.'

hindi: फ़नल — पहले संपर्क से खरीद तक चरण-दर-चरण घटती उपयोगकर्ता संख्या
definition: the narrowing path users take from first touch to conversion
example: The funnel leaks at step two, like every funnel ever.

hindi: फ़नल विश्लेषण — किस चरण पर उपयोगकर्ता छूटते हैं, इसकी जांच
definition: studying where users abandon each step of a flow
example: Funnel analysis found the leak: step one.

hindi: अवैतनिक अनिवार्य अवकाश — नौकरी बची, वेतन रुका
definition: unpaid mandatory leave that keeps you employed but not paid
example: The furlough was billed as temporary, like most permanent things.

hindi: काम का भविष्य — तकनीक से बदलते कामकाज पर कॉर्पोरेट चर्चा
definition: the corporate conversation about how technology, remote arrangements and automation will reshape jobs and offices
example: The future of work panel ran forty minutes over, which felt like the present of work.

hindi: भविष्य-सुरक्षित बनाना — आगे के बदलावों के लिए तैयार रखना
definition: to design something so later changes will not break it; aspirational
example: We future-proofed the API right up until next quarter.

hindi: जो भी इसका मोल हो — राय, मानना आपकी मर्ज़ी
definition: for what it's worth — input offered gently, take it or leave it
example: FWIW, the customer asked for exactly this last year.

hindi: आपकी कार्रवाई के लिए — करना आपको है
definition: for your action — this one you actually have to do
example: Marked FYA because the last three FYIs were ignored.

hindi: आपकी जानकारी के लिए — जवाब ज़रूरी नहीं
definition: for your information — no reply needed, just know this
example: FYI, the client saw the staging site before we did.

hindi: आपकी सादर जानकारी के लिए — विनम्रता से दी गई सूचना, कोई कार्रवाई अपेक्षित नहीं
definition: for your kind information; Indian English email phrase sharing information politely, needing no action
example: FYKI, the server has been down since Tuesday, sent Thursday.

hindi: आपकी आवश्यक कार्रवाई के लिए — इस पर काम करना है
definition: for your necessary action; Indian English email tag forwarding something the recipient must now handle
example: The forward said only FYNA, which is how the whole project became hers.

hindi: आपके संदर्भ के लिए — केवल जानकारी हेतु
definition: for your reference — background material, no action expected
example: FYR, last quarter's audit notes before tomorrow's review.

hindi: आपकी स्थिति-जानकारी के लिए — संदर्भ समझने हेतु सूचना
definition: for your situational awareness; label on information shared so recipients understand context, needing no action
example: FYSA: the client is angry — the only context anyone needed before the call.

hindi: सामान्य उपलब्धता — बीटा के बाद उत्पाद सभी ग्राहकों के लिए जारी
definition: general availability; the release stage where a product or feature becomes available to all customers after beta, with full support
example: It's been 'two weeks from GA' for a full quarter.

hindi: सामान्यतः स्वीकृत लेखा सिद्धांत — अमेरिका के मानक लेखा नियम
definition: generally accepted accounting principles; the standard United States rulebook governing how companies record and report financial results
example: Under GAAP we lost money; under the slide the CEO presented, we had an excellent year.

hindi: पासा पलटने वाला — हालात बदल देने वाली चीज़
definition: something that transforms the situation; applied weekly to minor features
example: The new export button was announced as a game changer.

hindi: अभ्यास दिवस — जानबूझकर गड़बड़ी पैदा कर टीम की तैयारी जाँचने का नियोजित दिन
definition: a planned exercise where engineers deliberately break production systems to rehearse incident response and test recovery procedures
example: The game day went smoothly until someone realised they had broken the real database.

hindi: गैंट चार्ट — कार्यों की अवधि दिखाती पट्टियों वाला समय-चार्ट
definition: a bar chart mapping tasks against time, beloved by project managers
example: The Gantt chart is gorgeous; the project is another matter.

hindi: अंतर विश्लेषण — मौजूदा और वांछित स्थिति के बीच की दूरी मापना
definition: comparing current performance or capabilities with the desired future state to identify what must change to close the difference
example: The gap analysis found the biggest gap was between the analysis and anyone reading it.

hindi: अंतर-आधारित बिक्री — ग्राहक की वर्तमान और वांछित स्थिति के बीच की खाई बेचना
definition: a sales methodology that diagnoses the distance between a buyer's current state and desired future state and sells closing that distance
example: Gap selling taught us to sell the distance, not the product, which was convenient because the product was still in beta.

hindi: जैसा डालोगे वैसा पाओगे — ख़राब डेटा से कभी अच्छे नतीजे नहीं निकलते
definition: the principle that flawed or poor-quality input data will always produce flawed analysis, reports and decisions, however clever the model
example: We spent a million on the model and forgot garbage in, garbage out.

hindi: नोटिस अवधि में वेतन-सहित घर बैठाना — काम से दूर रखने को
definition: being paid through your notice period while barred from working
example: Garden leave: three months of salary to not touch the codebase.

hindi: फ़ॉर्म के पीछे बंद सामग्री — संपर्क देकर ही मिले
definition: content locked behind a form that collects your details first
example: The report is gated behind a form with eleven required fields.

hindi: द्वारपाल — निर्णयकर्ता तक पहुँच रोकने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the person who controls access to the decision maker
example: The gatekeeper is an executive assistant with excellent instincts and no mercy.

hindi: वैश्विक क्षमता केंद्र — विदेशी कंपनी का भारत में पूर्ण स्वामित्व वाला तकनीकी दफ़्तर
definition: global capability centre; an offshore office wholly owned by a foreign company, doing its engineering and operations work directly in India
example: Joining the GCC meant the same product, the same timezone and a noticeably fancier coffee machine.

hindi: यूरोपीय डेटा-संरक्षण क़ानून — निजी डेटा पर सख़्त नियम
definition: the EU's data protection law governing how personal data is handled
example: One GDPR deletion request just found our seven backup systems.

hindi: कार्यस्थल का दौरा — जहाँ असली काम होता है वहाँ जाकर देखना
definition: a manager visiting the shop floor where work actually happens, observing processes and asking questions rather than reading reports
example: The VP's first gemba walk ended when he asked why the forklifts were so loud.

hindi: सृजनात्मक एआई — पाठ, चित्र, ध्वनि या कोड रचने वाली प्रणालियाँ
definition: generative AI; systems that create text, images, audio, or code on demand
example: The deck says GenAI six times per slide; investors expect nothing less.

hindi: नरम याद-दिहानी — मीठी चेतावनी
definition: a reminder wearing kid gloves; the gentleness is the warning
example: Gentle reminder that timesheets were due yesterday.

hindi: जनरेटिव इंजन अनुकूलन — एआई जवाबों में ब्रांड का ज़िक्र करवाने की कला
definition: generative engine optimization; shaping content so chatbots and answer engines mention and cite your brand
example: The SEO team renamed itself the GEO team and kept the same slides.

hindi: भौगोलिक लाभ — ऊँचा वेतन कमाते हुए सस्ती जगह पर रहना या वहाँ से भर्ती करना
definition: earning a high-cost city salary while living somewhere cheaper, or hiring remotely from lower-cost regions
example: His geo-arbitrage plan lasted until pay localization caught up with his new postcode.

hindi: हरितगृह गैस लेखा मानक — उत्सर्जन मापने और रिपोर्ट करने का मानक ढाँचा
definition: greenhouse accounting standard that companies follow for measuring and reporting emissions across three scopes
example: According to the GHG Protocol, your commute counts; according to the canteen, so does your burger.

hindi: अचानक चुप हो जाना — बिना बताए जवाब बंद
definition: to stop replying entirely, without explanation or apology
example: The vendor ghosted us right after the proof of concept.

hindi: भूतिया आरक्षण — बुक किया कमरा जिसमें कोई आता ही नहीं
definition: a meeting room or desk reservation that nobody shows up to use, blocking space for others
example: The weekly sync was cancelled in March, but its ghost booking still haunts room 4B every Thursday.

hindi: खोखला बटन — केवल किनारे वाला पारदर्शी बटन
definition: a transparent button with only an outline and text, used for secondary actions beside a solid primary
example: The ghost button was so subtle that users treated 'Cancel' as a rumour.

hindi: खाका-प्रस्तुति — खाली पन्ने जिनमें केवल शीर्षक और अनुमानित चार्ट हों
definition: a skeleton presentation with headline titles and placeholder charts drafted before the analysis exists, showing what evidence each slide needs
example: The ghost deck looked so convincing that the client asked why we still needed the data.

hindi: दिखावटी नौकरी — जो विज्ञापित है पर वास्तव में भरी नहीं जाएगी
definition: a posted opening the company has no real intention of filling anytime soon
example: The listing has been up for eleven months, which makes it either a ghost job or a very picky team.

hindi: किसने लिखा पता करना — कोड की हर पंक्ति किसने और कब बदली, यह खोजना
definition: looking up which engineer last changed each line of code, usually while investigating why something broke
example: I ran git blame on the worst function in the codebase and found my own name.

hindi: गिटफ़्लो पद्धति — विकास, फ़ीचर, रिलीज़ और हॉटफ़िक्स की अलग-अलग शाखाओं वाली व्यवस्थित शाखा-पद्धति
definition: a branching model with separate develop, feature, release and hotfix branches, heavier than trunk-based development
example: We switched to gitflow and now need a diagram to explain where a bugfix goes.

hindi: समय लौटाना — मीटिंग तय समय से पहले खत्म करना
definition: ending a meeting early and returning the unused minutes to attendees' calendars
example: We covered everything, so I'll give you twenty minutes back, spend them wisely on email.

hindi: कुछ दो, कुछ लो — मोलभाव में हर छूट के बदले कुछ माँगना
definition: the negotiation rule that every concession offered to a buyer must be traded for something in return
example: The discount was a give-get: they received ten percent, we received a logo on our website.

hindi: सामान्य खाता कोड — खर्च को सही लेखा श्रेणी में डालने का नंबर
definition: general ledger code; the account number that classifies a transaction so it lands in the right expense category
example: The expense bounced back three times because nobody knows which GL code covers team pizza.

hindi: जोड़ने वाला कोड — दो सिस्टमों को चिपकाने भर का कोड
definition: unglamorous code whose only job is connecting systems together
example: The product is 10% features, 90% glue code.

hindi: टीम को जोड़े रखने वाला अदृश्य काम — पदोन्नति में अनदेखा
definition: essential unglamorous work that keeps teams functioning but rarely gets promoted
example: She did the glue work; the launch email thanked the architect.

hindi: सकल व्यापारिक मूल्य — प्लेटफ़ॉर्म से गुज़रे कुल लेन-देन की रकम
definition: gross merchandise value; total transactions flowing through a marketplace
example: GMV is huge; our slice of it is a garnish.

hindi: सबसे बारी-बारी पूछना — हर व्यक्ति को बोलने का मौका देना
definition: asking every attendee in turn to share an update or opinion during a meeting
example: Let's go around the room, said the host, and forty minutes vanished.

hindi: संपर्क टूट जाना — ग्राहक का अचानक चुप हो जाना
definition: when a previously engaged prospect stops responding entirely
example: After the pricing slide, the prospect went dark for three weeks.

hindi: लंबी पोज़ीशन लेना — भाव बढ़ने की उम्मीद में ख़रीदना या समर्थन करना
definition: buying or backing something expecting its price or value to rise over time
example: I'd go long on the platform team; I'd short anything with blockchain in the pitch.

hindi: सिर के ऊपर से जाना — अपने मैनेजर को छोड़ सीधे उसके बॉस के पास जाना
definition: to bypass your manager or the responsible person and take an issue directly to their superior
example: She went over his head to the director, and now both of them schedule meetings without her.

hindi: गो-लाइव — प्रणाली के वास्तविक उपयोग में आने का दिन
definition: the date a system starts serving real users
example: Go-live went fine; day two is when we met our users.

hindi: खोज अवधि — हस्ताक्षर के बाद बेहतर बोली खोजने की अनुमति वाली धारा
definition: a clause letting a seller actively solicit better offers for a set period after signing a deal
example: The go-shop lasted forty days and produced forty polite declines.

hindi: बाज़ार-प्रवेश रणनीति — उत्पाद बेचने की समग्र योजना
definition: the overall plan for how a product reaches customers — channels, pricing, sales motion
example: The go-to-market strategy is finalized, pending a new strategy next quarter.

hindi: जाओ/मत-जाओ निर्णय — लॉन्च करें या रोकें की अंतिम बैठक
definition: the final decision meeting on whether to launch or hold
example: The go/no-go meeting was a go, mostly because of sunk cost.

hindi: सरपरस्त आका — भारतीय दफ़्तरों में वह ताक़तवर वरिष्ठ जो किसी का करियर पीछे से आगे बढ़ाए
definition: in Indian English, a powerful senior patron who backs someone's career, protects them and influences their promotions
example: Everyone assumes the new VP has a godfather in the board; nobody can name him.

hindi: चालू व्यवसाय — कंपनी के अगले बारह महीने चलते रहने की ऑडिटर की धारणा
definition: the auditor's assessment of whether a company can keep operating for the next year; doubts about it signal serious distress
example: The auditors added a going concern note, and suddenly every vendor wanted payment upfront.

hindi: अनावश्यक चमक — माँगे बिना जोड़ी गई अतिरिक्त पॉलिश
definition: adding unrequested polish or features beyond what the requirements asked for
example: The button animates beautifully; nobody asked; classic gold-plating.

hindi: सुनहरी हथकड़ी — इतना अच्छा वेतन कि नौकरी छोड़ना मुश्किल
definition: pay or unvested equity so good that leaving a job feels impossible
example: He hates the role, but the golden handcuffs vest for two more years.

hindi: निकाले जाने पर अधिकारियों को मिलने वाला भारी मुआवज़ा
definition: a large payout executives receive if ousted, especially after an acquisition
example: The staff got severance calculators; the CEO got a golden parachute.

hindi: स्वर्णिम मार्ग — आधिकारिक, सुगम, अनुशंसित तरीका
definition: the officially supported, well-paved way to build and ship something
example: Stay on the golden path and the platform team stays friendly.

hindi: स्वर्ण रिकॉर्ड — किसी ग्राहक या उत्पाद की सबसे भरोसेमंद, एकीकृत प्रविष्टि
definition: the single trusted, merged version of a customer or product record built from duplicate entries across different company systems
example: The golden record says she lives in Pune, Delhi and, somehow, the test environment.

hindi: स्वर्ण सेट — जाँच के लिए प्रमाणित उत्तरों वाला भरोसेमंद नमूना-समूह
definition: a small, trusted set of examples with verified answers used to judge models
example: The golden set is fifty workouts the physio labeled personally; guard it.

hindi: स्वर्णिम संकेत — सेवा की सेहत के चार मुख्य माप: विलंब, ट्रैफ़िक, त्रुटियाँ और क्षमता-भार
definition: the four core measures of service health that monitoring should watch: latency, traffic, errors and saturation
example: The dashboard had three hundred graphs and not one of the golden signals.

hindi: शासन-व्यवस्था — निर्णय और नियंत्रण के तय ढाँचे
definition: the framework of rules and oversight for making decisions
example: Data governance means asking permission before the fun query.

hindi: शासी कानून — अनुबंध किस क्षेत्र के कानून से चलेगा
definition: the contract clause naming which jurisdiction's laws interpret the agreement and resolve disputes between the parties
example: Both sides wanted home-court governing law, so they settled on a state neither had visited.

hindi: सामान्य साझेदार — फ़ंड चलाने और निवेश तय करने वाला वरिष्ठ VC
definition: general partner; a senior VC who runs the fund and makes investment decisions
example: The associates loved us, but the GP asked the hard questions.

hindi: समूह प्रोडक्ट मैनेजर — कई प्रोडक्ट मैनेजरों का प्रबंधन करने वाला
definition: group product manager; senior product manager who leads several product managers and owns a broader product area
example: The GPM owns the whole area, which means owning every escalation in it.

hindi: जीपीयू — एआई को चलाने वाली चिप, आज की सबसे क़ीमती धातु
definition: graphics processing unit; the chip AI training and inference actually run on
example: The GPUs arrive Thursday; until then, the roadmap is aspirational.

hindi: जीपीयू-निर्धन — बड़े लैब जैसी चिप-संपदा से वंचित
definition: lacking the compute budget of big labs; making do with less
example: We're GPU-poor, so we distill, quantize, and pray.

hindi: समय लेना — किसी के कैलेंडर पर स्लॉट बुक करना
definition: to claim a slot on someone's calendar
example: Grab time with me Friday if the design still feels off.

hindi: सुगम अवनति — आंशिक विफलता में भी शालीनता से चलते रहना
definition: continuing to work in reduced form when parts of the system fail
example: Graceful degradation: the site is down but the error page is lovely.

hindi: पुरानी शर्तें जारी रखना — नए नियम से पुराने ग्राहकों को छूट देना
definition: to let existing customers keep old terms after rules or prices change
example: Early users were grandfathered into the price we now regret.

hindi: सेवा उपदान — लंबी सेवा के बाद नियोक्ता से मिलने वाली एकमुश्त राशि
definition: in Indian employment, a statutory one-time payment made by employers after five or more years of continuous service
example: He stayed four years and eleven months, and HR explained gratuity to him like a sad bedtime story.

hindi: अनुभवी दिग्गज — दशकों का अनुभव समेटे वयोवृद्ध इंजीनियर
definition: a veteran engineer who has seen every failure mode at least twice
example: The graybeard read the stack trace and said, again?

hindi: महा-इस्तीफ़ा लहर — 2021 के बाद भारी संख्या में लोगों का नौकरी छोड़ना
definition: the wave of employees quitting their jobs in large numbers after 2021, seeking better balance, wages and employers
example: Leadership blamed the Great Resignation, which was easier than reading the exit interviews.

hindi: हरित ऋणपत्र — केवल पर्यावरणीय परियोजनाओं के लिए उठाया गया ऋण
definition: debt issued specifically financing eligible environmental projects such as renewable energy, efficiency or clean transport
example: Treasury loves the green bond because it is the same loan with a nicer investor dinner.

hindi: हरा बिल्ड — सारे टेस्ट पास, डैशबोर्ड पर सब ठीक
definition: a build with all tests passing and nothing red on the dashboard
example: Green build on the first try, immediately suspicious.

hindi: सक्रियता संकेत — चैट ऐप में ऑनलाइन दिखने का निशान, जिसे काम का सबूत माना जाता है
definition: chat application's active status indicator, treated by remote teams and managers as proof someone is working
example: She stepped away for four minutes and came back to three messages asking where her green dot went.

hindi: कोरी ज़मीन — पुराने बोझ के बिना नई शुरुआत वाला
definition: built fresh with no legacy constraints
example: It's a greenfield project, so enjoy the six good months.

hindi: हरित-क्षेत्र बाज़ार — बिल्कुल नया बाज़ार, कोई पुराना खिलाड़ी नहीं
definition: a brand-new market with no incumbents or legacy systems to displace
example: It's a greenfield market, meaning we must explain the product from zero.

hindi: हरित चुप्पी — आलोचना के डर से अपनी पर्यावरण उपलब्धियाँ छिपाना
definition: deliberately staying quiet about genuine environmental targets and claims, fearing scrutiny, criticism or legal challenge
example: We hit every climate target this year, and legal's greenhushing means only the auditors will ever know.

hindi: हरी झंडी देना — परियोजना को औपचारिक मंज़ूरी देना
definition: to officially approve a project to proceed
example: Leadership greenlit the redesign right after the last redesign shipped.

hindi: मुक्ति-भुगतान — अधिग्रहण की धमकी देने वाले से ऊँचे दाम पर शेयर वापस ख़रीदना
definition: paying a hostile raider a premium to repurchase their shares so they abandon a takeover attempt
example: Shareholders called the buyback greenmail; the press release called it strategic capital allocation.

hindi: अतिरिक्त आवंटन विकल्प — मांग अधिक होने पर अंडरराइटर द्वारा अतिरिक्त शेयर बेचने का अधिकार
definition: an over-allotment option letting underwriters sell extra shares, usually fifteen percent, when offering demand runs strong
example: They exercised the greenshoe on day one and the syndicate desk ordered celebratory cake.

hindi: हरित दिखावा — पर्यावरण-हितैषी होने के बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर किए गए दावे
definition: overstating environmental credentials through marketing claims that company operations cannot actually support
example: The recycled-paper brochure announcing our green transformation was printed for a fleet of diesel trucks.

hindi: खोज मारना — कोड या लॉग में पैटर्न छानना
definition: to search code or logs for a pattern, named after the unix tool
example: Before asking the author, grep; the author also greps.

hindi: माल प्राप्ति नोट — सामान या सेवा मिलने की पुष्टि का दस्तावेज़
definition: goods receipt note; the record confirming delivered goods or services were received, required before the supplier invoice is paid
example: The vendor finished in June, but nobody raised the GRN, so finance thinks it's still July.

hindi: सकल मार्जिन — राजस्व में से सीधी लागत घटाकर बचा प्रतिशत
definition: revenue minus direct costs, as a percentage of revenue
example: Gross margin looks great if support tickets answer themselves.

hindi: सकल से शुद्ध — सूची-मूल्य से छूट, वापसी आदि घटाकर असली राजस्व तक पहुँचना
definition: reconciliation from gross sales at list price down to actual revenue after discounts, rebates, returns and allowances
example: The gross-to-net bridge showed that half of our list price exists purely for negotiation.

hindi: यथार्थ सत्य — प्रशिक्षण और जाँच के लिए प्रमाणित सही उत्तर
definition: the verified correct answer used to train models and score their outputs
example: We need ground truth for 'good form', so film the physiotherapist, not the intern.

hindi: तथ्याधार — मॉडल के जवाबों को असली, जाँचने-योग्य डेटा से जोड़ना
definition: tying a model's answers to real, verifiable data instead of its imagination
example: With grounding on your actual workouts, the coach stopped inventing personal records.

hindi: कोचिंग वार्ता ढाँचा — लक्ष्य, वास्तविकता, विकल्प और आगे की प्रतिबद्धता
definition: goal, reality, options, will; a coaching conversation structure managers use to help someone find their own next steps
example: He used the GROW model, and somehow every option led to working the weekend.

hindi: कमज़ोरी का सौम्य नाम — सुधार की ज़रूरत वाली बात
definition: review-speak for a weakness, phrased as an opportunity
example: Her growth area, per the review, is 'being less right in meetings'.

hindi: किसी भी क़ीमत पर विकास — घाटे की परवाह किए बिना तेज़ विस्तार की रणनीति
definition: a strategy prioritising rapid user and revenue growth regardless of losses, burn rate or unit economics
example: Growth at all costs worked beautifully right up until someone read the costs.

hindi: जुगाड़ू विकास तरकीबें — कम ख़र्च में तेज़ी से उपयोगकर्ता बढ़ाना
definition: scrappy, experiment-driven tactics to grow users fast on a small budget
example: Our growth hacking budget is one intern and unlimited enthusiasm.

hindi: विकास चक्र — उपयोग से ही नए उपयोगकर्ता पैदा करने वाला चक्र
definition: a self-reinforcing cycle where usage generates new users
example: The deck shows a growth loop; the data shows a line.

hindi: विकासशील सोच — यह मानना कि क्षमता मेहनत और सीख से बढ़ती है
definition: belief that abilities improve through effort, practice and learning, used at work to frame setbacks as development
example: Leadership asked us for a growth mindset about the budget, which is not growing.

hindi: विकास दौर — सिद्ध कारोबार को तेज़ी से बड़ा करने की पूँजी
definition: a late-stage raise to scale a proven business aggressively
example: After the growth round, we opened three offices and one crisis.

hindi: सकल रेटिंग अंक — पहुँच गुणा आवृत्ति से मापा गया विज्ञापन-भार
definition: gross rating point; reach multiplied by average frequency, the standard measure of advertising weight in television and broadcast media buying
example: We bought four hundred GRPs, so statistically everyone saw the advert twice and skipped it both times.

hindi: सकल राजस्व प्रतिधारण — विस्तार छोड़कर बचा हुआ पुराना राजस्व
definition: gross revenue retention; percentage of recurring revenue kept from existing customers after churn and downgrades, excluding any expansion revenue
example: NRR is the number for the board deck; GRR is the number for the 2 a.m. worry.

hindi: सुरक्षा-मापदंड — प्रयोग से नुकसान न हो, इसकी निगरानी करता आँकड़ा
definition: a metric watched during experiments to ensure a change causes no harm
example: The variant won, but the guardrail metric filed a complaint.

hindi: सुरक्षा-बाड़ — एआई के जवाबों को सुरक्षित और विषय पर रखने वाली सीमाएँ
definition: constraints keeping an AI system's outputs safe, legal, and on-topic
example: Guardrails keep the coach from prescribing supplements or discussing your divorce.

hindi: त्वरित अनौपचारिक परीक्षण — आसपास के लोगों से झटपट प्रतिक्रिया लेना
definition: quick, informal usability testing with whoever is nearby
example: Guerrilla testing in the cafe: five strangers, one prototype, free espresso opinions.

hindi: मार्गदर्शन अनुमान — कंपनी का निवेशकों को दिया आधिकारिक आय-अनुमान
definition: a public company's official forecast of future revenue or earnings, shared with investors and analysts
example: We beat guidance, mainly because guidance was set somewhere near the floor.

hindi: अनुमान घटाना — आगामी कमाई का पूर्वानुमान कम करना
definition: management lowering its official revenue or earnings forecast for coming periods, typically triggering a share price drop
example: They guided down on Tuesday and called it a reset on Wednesday.

hindi: अंतर्मन से जाँच — आँकड़ों से पहले सहज-बुद्धि की राय
definition: a quick instinct-level check that something feels right
example: Quick gut check: does anyone actually want this feature?

hindi: वर्ष का उत्तरार्ध — जुलाई से दिसंबर की योजना-अवधि
definition: the second half of the year, where first-half promises are relocated
example: It's been moved to H2, the roadmap's witness protection program.

hindi: जुगाड़ — तेज़, गंदा पर काम चलाऊ समाधान
definition: a quick, inelegant solution that works but wasn't built to last
example: It's a temporary hack, added to the codebase permanently.

hindi: हैकाथॉन — कुछ नया बना डालने की मैराथन कोडिंग स्पर्धा
definition: a short intense event where teams build prototypes, powered by pizza and optimism
example: The hackathon demo was glorious; the codebase quietly denies it exists.

hindi: जलते बालों वाली समस्या — ग्राहक की इतनी तत्काल समस्या कि वह तुरंत हल ख़रीदे
definition: a customer problem so urgent and painful that buyers will adopt any solution immediately, even imperfect
example: Compliance deadlines are a hair on fire problem; our dashboard's dark mode is not.

hindi: कटौती — गिरवी संपत्ति या कर्ज़ के मूल्य में जानबूझकर की गई कमी
definition: a percentage reduction applied to collateral value, or a loss creditors accept on debt owed to them
example: The bondholders took a forty percent haircut and called it a constructive outcome.

hindi: आधे दिन की छुट्टी — दिन का आधा समय अवकाश
definition: an Indian English term for taking leave for half of a working day, recorded against the leave balance
example: She took a half-day, which meant attending only the morning's four meetings.

hindi: मतिभ्रम — एआई का आत्मविश्वास से ग़लत जानकारी गढ़ना
definition: an AI system confidently producing information that is false or made up
example: It recommended a 45-minute plank and cited a fake study — textbook hallucination.

hindi: गलियारा परीक्षण — पास बैठे किसी से भी झटपट जाँच
definition: quick informal usability testing with whoever happens to be nearby, usually colleagues outside the project
example: Hallway testing with the finance team found the flaw in four minutes that three sprints had missed.

hindi: प्रभामंडल प्रभाव — एक खूबी से पूरे व्यक्ति को बेहतर आँकना
definition: rating bias where a single impressive trait inflates a reviewer's judgement of an employee's overall performance
example: One brilliant demo created a halo effect that covered six months of missed deadlines.

hindi: तीन-रेखा मेनू — छोटी स्क्रीन पर नेविगेशन छिपाने वाला आइकन
definition: the three-line icon hiding navigation on small screens
example: We solved discoverability by hiding everything in the hamburger menu.

hindi: हस्तांतरण — काम एक टीम से दूसरी को सौंपना
definition: the transfer of work between teams, where context goes to die
example: The design handoff included forty screens and zero edge cases.

hindi: मनचाहा सुनना — ग्राहक की हर बात को हाँ समझ लेना
definition: hearing what you want to hear in a prospect's polite noises
example: 'They said maybe next quarter' — that's happy ears translating 'no.'

hindi: सीधा-सरल रास्ता — वह प्रवाह जिसमें सब कुछ ठीक चलता है
definition: the execution flow where every input is valid and nothing goes wrong
example: The demo covered the happy path; the customers found the other ones.

hindi: पूर्ण समापन — सभी खातों को पूरी तरह मिलाकर पुस्तकें पक्की बंद करना
definition: a full, rigorous closing of the books with every account reconciled and locked, typically at quarter or year end
example: It's a hard close this quarter, so the team has cancelled weekends and ordered pizza in bulk.

hindi: कठोर अवतरण — तेज़ी के बाद अर्थव्यवस्था का मंदी में गिरना
definition: when an economic slowdown after rapid growth tips sharply into recession rather than cooling gently
example: Planning assumed a soft landing; the hiring freeze suggests someone upstairs expects a hard landing.

hindi: ठोस बचत — बजट में सचमुच दिखने वाली खर्च की कमी
definition: savings that measurably reduce actual spending on the books compared with the previous period
example: Finance only counts hard savings, which is why the productivity gains never made the slide.

hindi: ढाँचागत सेवाएँ — बिजली, एसी, लिफ़्ट जैसी इमारत की भौतिक देखरेख
definition: facilities management services that maintain building systems, such as heating, cooling, electrical, plumbing and lifts
example: Hard services fixed the air conditioning in a week, precisely as winter arrived.

hindi: पक्का शुरुआती समय — मीटिंग ठीक समय पर शुरू होनी ही है
definition: a meeting start time that cannot slip because attendees or executives have strict limits
example: It's a hard start with the CEO, so please stop joining at seven past.

hindi: सख़्त समय-सीमा — जिस वक़्त मीटिंग से निकलना ही होगा
definition: a fixed time when someone must leave a meeting
example: I have a hard stop at three, thankfully.

hindi: कोड में ठोक देना — मान सीधे कोड में जड़ना, बदलना कठिन
definition: to embed a value directly in code where configuration should be
example: The demo works as long as the customer is named Test User, hardcoded.

hindi: मज़बूतीकरण — रिलीज़ से पहले सुरक्षा और स्थिरता कसना
definition: strengthening a system against failure and attack before release
