example: One hardening week, because the other fifty-one were for features.

hindi: भराव-गोले — भरे-अधभरे गोलों से तुलना दिखाने का तरीका
definition: round ideograms filled by quarters, used in comparison tables to show how completely each option meets a criterion
example: Our product scored four full Harvey balls, on criteria we had chosen that morning.

hindi: कुल्हाड़ी वाला — बॉस के कड़वे काम जैसे छँटनी और कटौती करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: someone brought in or used by leadership to carry out unpopular tasks such as layoffs, cuts and firings
example: When the new COO arrived with no product background, everyone knew he was the hatchet man.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य सेवा पेशेवर — डॉक्टर, नर्स, फार्मासिस्ट जैसे लक्षित चिकित्सक
definition: healthcare professional; doctors, nurses and pharmacists considered as the audience for pharmaceutical communication and engagement
example: The omnichannel plan promised to meet HCPs where they are, which turned out to be nowhere near our emails.

hindi: स्वीकृत कर्मचारी संख्या — भर्ती की बजट-सीमा
definition: the number of employees a team is budgeted to have
example: We have the work for five engineers and the headcount for two.

hindi: पद-संख्या में कटौती — बजट की भाषा में छँटनी
definition: cutting employee numbers to meet budget targets, layoffs described through planning spreadsheet language
example: Finance called it a headcount reduction, as if the heads were optional.

hindi: मुख्य आँकड़ा — रिपोर्ट में सबसे ऊपर दिखाया जाने वाला अंक
definition: the single most quotable figure in a report or announcement
example: Growth is the headline number; the footnotes hold the truth.

hindi: गुंजाइश — बजट या क्षमता में बची हुई जगह
definition: the unspent room left within a budget, target or limit before it is exceeded
example: There's some headroom in the events budget, so naturally three teams want the same offsite.

hindi: पहले से सूचना — बाद में शिकायत न हो
definition: advance notice given so nobody can say they weren't told
example: Heads up, the CEO is walking the floor at noon.

hindi: प्रतिकूल हवाएँ — कारोबार को धीमा करने वाली बाहरी परिस्थितियाँ
definition: external business conditions slowing revenue growth or squeezing margins, cited on earnings calls to explain weaker results
example: The CFO listed seven headwinds, none of which was the product.

hindi: खाता स्वास्थ्य जाँच — ग्राहक की स्थिति परखने के लिए नियमित समीक्षा कॉल
definition: scheduled customer success review assessing product usage, satisfaction and renewal risks within an account, usually through a structured call
example: The health check went great until the customer asked who we were.

hindi: ग्राहक स्वास्थ्य अंक — खाते की स्थिति का संकेतक
definition: a composite metric estimating how happy and sticky a customer account is
example: The health score was green right up until the cancellation email.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता-अनुभव मापने का पंचसूत्री ढाँचा — ख़ुशी, जुड़ाव, अपनाना, टिकना और काम पूरा होना
definition: happiness, engagement, adoption, retention, task success; Google's user experience metrics framework for measuring product quality
example: We adopted the HEART framework and measured four letters out of five.

hindi: हीटमैप — कहाँ ज़्यादा क्लिक या ध्यान, रंगों से दिखाता नक्शा
definition: a color-coded view of where users click, scroll, or linger
example: The heatmap shows everyone clicking the logo, which goes nowhere.

hindi: भारी मशक़्क़त — काम का सबसे मेहनत वाला हिस्सा
definition: the hardest, most substantial part of the work
example: The library does the heavy lifting; we take the credit.

hindi: मूल एकाग्रता सूत्र — जुनून, श्रेष्ठता और कमाई के संगम पर टिकी एक स्पष्ट रणनीति
definition: the single strategic focus where company passion, world-class capability and the economic engine overlap, borrowed from Jim Collins
example: Our hedgehog concept fit on one slide, which is why nobody could explain the other forty.

hindi: हाइज़ेनबग — देखने की कोशिश करते ही ग़ायब होने वाला बग
definition: a bug that disappears whenever you try to observe it
example: Add a print statement and the heisenbug politely leaves.

hindi: मंडराता मैनेजर — हर काम पर लगातार नज़र रखने वाला अधिकारी
definition: a manager who hovers constantly over every task, checking progress and second-guessing routine decisions
example: My helicopter manager has pinged me four times about the email I am currently writing to him.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य अर्थशास्त्र और परिणाम शोध — दवा का आर्थिक मूल्य साबित करना
definition: health economics and outcomes research; studies proving a drug's clinical and economic value to payers deciding coverage
example: HEOR modelled the drug as saving hospitals millions, provided every patient lives exactly as the spreadsheet assumes.

hindi: नायक संस्कृति — संकट में अकेले बचाने वाले को पुरस्कृत करना, जिससे व्यवस्थित सुधार पीछे छूट जाते हैं
definition: a team habit of rewarding individuals who rescue outages single-handed, instead of fixing the systems that keep breaking
example: Hero culture: he fixed the outage at 3 a.m. and got an award for the outage he caused at 2.

hindi: मुख्य शीर्ष खंड — पेज के सबसे ऊपर का बड़ा प्रचार-क्षेत्र
definition: the big banner area at the top of a landing page
example: The hero section promises magic; the pricing page provides the disclaimers.

hindi: अनुभवजन्य नियम — त्वरित मूल्यांकन के लिए व्यावहारिक कसौटी
definition: a rule of thumb used to judge usability quickly
example: Visibility of system status is the heuristic; the frozen spinner is the violation.

hindi: अनुभवजन्य समीक्षा — मानक कसौटियों पर विशेषज्ञ की जाँच
definition: an expert review scoring an interface against established usability rules
example: The heuristic evaluation flagged everything the launch deadline had approved.

hindi: उच्च स्वायत्तता — बिना इजाज़त या निर्देश के ख़ुद पहल कर काम पूरा करने का गुण
definition: the trait of taking initiative and finding ways around obstacles without waiting for permission, instructions or resources
example: Hiring for high agency worked until three people independently rebuilt the same billing system.

hindi: लगातार उत्कृष्ट काम करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: an employee who consistently delivers beyond their level
example: The reward for a high performer is someone else's backlog.

hindi: उच्च संभावना वाला — भविष्य का नेता माना गया कर्मचारी
definition: an employee flagged by leadership as capable of future senior roles, often given special development programs
example: Being tagged high potential meant more training, more projects, and exactly the same salary.

hindi: गहन व्यक्तिगत सेवा वाला — हर ग्राहक पर समर्पित मानवीय ध्यान
definition: describing customer engagement with dedicated account managers, frequent meetings and personalised attention, reserved for high-value accounts
example: The account is high touch, meaning three people touch every email before it goes out.

hindi: उच्च-विस्तार — अंतिम रूप के करीब, पूरी बारीकियों समेत
definition: detailed and polished, close to the final product's look
example: We went high-fidelity too early and now everyone's debating button shadows.

hindi: मीटिंग पर कब्ज़ा — बैठक को अपने विषय की ओर मोड़ देना
definition: steering a meeting away from its agenda toward someone's own topic or complaint
example: He hijacked the meeting to debate the logo, and the launch went unplanned.

hindi: वेतन वृद्धि — सालाना तनख्वाह में बढ़ोतरी
definition: in Indian English, a salary increase, especially the annual percentage raise after appraisal
example: He was promised a double-digit hike and received a very sincere single-digit one.

hindi: अमेरिकी स्वास्थ्य सूचना कानून — मरीज़ों के डेटा की निजता व सुरक्षा के नियम
definition: health insurance portability and accountability act; the American law governing privacy and security of patient health information handled by providers and vendors
example: Engineering asked whether the screenshot counted under HIPAA, which is how compliance learned about the screenshot.

hindi: उच्च संभावना वाला कर्मचारी — जिसे भविष्य के नेतृत्व के लिए चुना गया हो
definition: high potential; an employee flagged by leadership for accelerated development and future senior roles
example: Being tagged a HiPo meant twice the stretch assignments and exactly the same salary.

hindi: सबसे ऊँचे वेतन वाले की राय — डेटा पर भारी पड़ती बॉस की मर्ज़ी
definition: highest paid person's opinion; product decisions made by the most senior voice in the room rather than by customer evidence or data
example: The experiment was clear, but the HiPPO preferred blue, so blue it is.

hindi: भर्ती धीरे, विदाई जल्दी — सोच-समझकर भर्ती और गलत भर्ती को तुरंत सुधारना
definition: hiring advice to evaluate candidates carefully but remove poorly fitting employees quickly once problems appear
example: The startup embraced hire slow, fire fast, though mostly it just hired fast and debated slowly.

hindi: भर्ती मानदंड — चुने जाने के लिए ज़रूरी न्यूनतम स्तर
definition: the minimum quality standard a candidate must clear to receive an offer
example: Everyone agrees we must never lower the hiring bar, until the quarter ends with open reqs.

hindi: भर्ती समिति — अंतिम भर्ती निर्णय लेने वाला समूह
definition: a group reviewing interview scorecards and packets to make the final hiring decision
example: The hiring committee has never met the candidate but has strong feelings about her.

hindi: नई भर्तियों पर अस्थायी रोक
definition: a pause on new hiring, usually the first sign of tighter times
example: The hiring freeze arrived one week after the 'aggressive growth' town hall.

hindi: जिस प्रबंधक की टीम के लिए भर्ती हो रही है
definition: the manager the new hire will work for, who owns the hiring decision
example: The recruiter screens, but the hiring manager decides.

hindi: आते ही रफ़्तार पकड़ना — बिना वॉर्म-अप के काम शुरू करना
definition: to be productive immediately, without a settling-in period
example: We expect the contractor to hit the ground running Monday.

hindi: हॉकी-स्टिक वक्र — लंबे ठहराव के बाद अचानक तीखी बढ़त
definition: a growth curve that stays flat, then shoots suddenly upward
example: The hockey stick starts next quarter, as it has every quarter.

hindi: विभाग प्रमुख — किसी विभाग का सर्वोच्च अधिकारी
definition: head of department; Indian English term for the senior manager in charge of a department or function
example: The request needs HOD approval, and the HOD needs a reminder about the request.

hindi: स्व-शासित संगठन — प्रबंधकों की जगह तय भूमिकाओं और घेरों से चलने वाली व्यवस्था
definition: self-management system replacing managers with self-organising circles and explicitly defined roles that hold decision authority
example: Under holacracy nobody is my boss, which is why I now have eleven circle leads.

hindi: संभावित आरक्षण — ज़रूरत पड़ने पर बैठक हेतु रोका समय
definition: time blocked on calendars in case a meeting is needed
example: There's a hold on Friday in case the deal closes.

hindi: कलम थामना — दस्तावेज़ का मसौदा लिखने की ज़िम्मेदारी लेना
definition: being the single person responsible for drafting and editing a shared document while others send comments
example: Everyone had opinions on the deck, but only the associate had to hold the pen, which meant holding the blame.

hindi: रोकी गई राशि — अधिग्रहण मूल्य का हिस्सा जो दावों हेतु रोका जाता है
definition: part of an acquisition price withheld in escrow for months to cover warranty claims or indemnities
example: Eighteen percent of the price sat in holdback, earning interest for the buyer's lawyers.

hindi: अलग रखा समूह — असली असर नापने के लिए बदलाव से बाहर रखे उपयोगकर्ता
definition: users deliberately kept from a change to measure its true impact
example: The holdout group is happier, which we are choosing not to discuss.

hindi: समग्र — हर पहलू को एक साथ देखने वाला
definition: considering the whole rather than the parts; sounds strategic in any sentence
example: We need a holistic view of the customer journey.

hindi: होम-ऑफ़िस भत्ता — घर पर डेस्क, कुर्सी और उपकरण लगाने के लिए कंपनी का पैसा
definition: one-time employer allowance for setting up a home workspace with desk, chair, monitor and other equipment
example: She spent the home office stipend on a ring light, which now illuminates her ceiling fan.

hindi: पकड़ दर — वीडियो विज्ञापन के पहले कुछ पल के बाद भी देखते रहने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: percentage of viewers who keep watching a video advertisement past the first three seconds after scrolling
example: The hook rate was excellent because the first second showed a dog, which is unrelated to accounting software.

hindi: फ़ौरन जुड़ना — झट से कॉल पर आना
definition: to join a call, usually on short notice
example: Can you hop on for five minutes to unblock deploys?

term: hope this email finds you well
hindi: आशा है आप कुशल होंगे — औपचारिक शुरुआत
definition: the ceremonial opener before asking for something
example: Hope this email finds you well; unfortunately, it finds you on-call.

hindi: सींग प्रभाव — एक कमी से पूरे व्यक्ति को कमतर आँकना
definition: rating bias where a single mistake or dislikable trait drags down a reviewer's judgement of overall performance
example: One outage in March produced a horns effect that lasted through December.

hindi: उत्तराधिकार की दौड़ — शीर्ष पद के लिए कई आंतरिक दावेदारों के बीच खुली प्रतिस्पर्धा
definition: a succession contest where several internal executives openly compete for the chief executive role until the board picks one winner
example: The CEO horse race ended on Friday with one winner and two resignation letters.

hindi: खुला माइक — अनजाने में सबको सुनाई गई बात
definition: a microphone accidentally left on, broadcasting words not meant for the room
example: A hot mic during the board call taught us new vocabulary.

hindi: अनारक्षित डेस्क — जो मेज़ ख़ाली मिले वही
definition: unassigned seating where you take whatever desk is free
example: Hot-desking means my monitor settings are never mine.

hindi: डेस्क-आरक्षण — दफ़्तर आने से पहले सीट बुक करना
definition: reserving a desk or room in advance for office days
example: Forgot hoteling again, so I'm working from the couch by reception.

hindi: तुरत मरम्मत — उत्पादन में सीधे लगाई गई आपात पैच
definition: an urgent patch pushed straight to production to stop the bleeding
example: Friday 5 pm hotfix — what could possibly go wrong?

hindi: ब्रांडों का घराना — अलग-अलग स्वतंत्र नामों से बिकते उत्पाद
definition: a brand architecture where a parent company sells products under separate, independent brand names that barely mention the parent
example: We are a house of brands, which is why the customers think we are twelve rival companies.

hindi: हम कैसे कर सकते हैं — समस्या को अवसर-प्रश्न में बदलना
definition: a framing that rewrites a user problem as an open question inviting solutions, used in design workshops
example: How might we reduce onboarding drop-off, asked the sticky note, beside another reading 'fewer screens?'.

hindi: मकान किराया भत्ता — किराए के लिए वेतन का कर-छूट वाला हिस्सा
definition: house rent allowance; in Indian salaries, the component covering rent, partly exempt from income taxation when receipts are submitted
example: March is when the whole team suddenly remembers to collect rent receipts for HRA.

hindi: एच.आर. बिज़नेस पार्टनर — किसी विभाग को समर्पित मानव-संसाधन साथी
definition: HR business partner; the HR person embedded with a specific org
example: The HRBP joined the meeting, which told everyone what kind of meeting it was.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य प्रौद्योगिकी मूल्यांकन — सरकारी संस्था द्वारा दवा की लागत-उपयोगिता जाँच
definition: health technology assessment; formal government review of whether a treatment's benefits justify its price before public reimbursement
example: The European launch sequence was planned around which HTA body would say no most slowly.

hindi: आशा है इससे मदद मिलेगी — उत्तर के अंत में विनम्र समापन
definition: hope this helps; polite closing line after answering a colleague's question or sharing a resource
example: He pasted a link to the manual and signed off HTH.

hindi: केंद्र और शाखाएँ — एक मुख्य दफ़्तर के साथ छोटे क्षेत्रीय दफ़्तरों वाला मॉडल
definition: workplace model pairing one central headquarters office with smaller regional satellite offices near where employees live
example: Under hub and spoke, the spoke office has great coffee and every decision still happens at the hub.

hindi: छोटा बैठक कक्ष — दो-चार लोगों की झटपट बातचीत का कमरा
definition: a small bookable meeting room for two to four people, built for quick informal team conversations
example: The huddle room seats four, fits three and hosts one person on a call all day.

hindi: मानव-समावेशी प्रक्रिया — एआई के फ़ैसलों पर इंसानी निगरानी
definition: a workflow where people review or correct an AI system's outputs
example: Injury-risk flags stay human-in-the-loop; a physio signs off before anyone gets scared.

hindi: अटका सौदा — बैंक द्वारा वादा किया कर्ज़ जो बाज़ार में बिक न सका
definition: a financing that banks committed to underwrite but cannot sell to investors at the agreed terms
example: The hung deal sat on the balance sheet all quarter, and nobody mentioned it at the holiday party.

hindi: शिकारी विक्रेता — नए ग्राहक लाने वाला सेल्सपर्सन
definition: salesperson focused on prospecting and winning fresh customer accounts rather than managing existing ones
example: She's a hunter: brilliant at landing new logos, allergic to returning their phone calls.

hindi: न्यूनतम प्रतिफल दर — निवेश मंज़ूरी के लिए ज़रूरी न्यूनतम रिटर्न
definition: the minimum expected return a project must promise before finance will approve the investment
example: The project cleared the hurdle rate after someone adjusted the adoption assumptions twice.

hindi: भागदौड़ संस्कृति — लगातार ज़्यादा काम को ही सफलता और पहचान मानने वाला माहौल
definition: a workplace culture that glorifies relentless overwork, long hours and constant busyness as proof of ambition and worth
example: Hustle culture is when the team celebrates your 2 a.m. commit and forgets to ask why you were awake.

hindi: कुछ दिन दफ़्तर, कुछ दिन घर — मिली-जुली कार्य-व्यवस्था
definition: splitting the week between office days and remote days
example: Hybrid means commuting in to take the same video calls.

hindi: मिश्रित बैठक — जिसमें कुछ लोग कमरे में और कुछ वीडियो कॉल पर जुड़े हों
definition: meeting where some participants share a physical room while others join remotely through a video call
example: In every hybrid meeting the room laughs at a joke the remote half never heard.

hindi: प्रचार चक्र — नई तकनीक पर उत्साह, निराशा और फिर स्थिरता का दौर
definition: the familiar pattern where emerging technology draws inflated excitement, then disappointment, then quieter practical adoption
example: Leadership asked where we sit on the hype cycle, which means someone read a Gartner report.

hindi: विशेष देखभाल अवधि — लॉन्च के तुरंत बाद बढ़ी हुई सहायता का दौर
definition: period of heightened support immediately after a customer goes live, with extra staff monitoring problems and responding faster than usual
example: Hypercare was scheduled for two weeks and ended when the engineers stopped answering Slack.

hindi: अति-विकास — साल-दर-साल दोगुनी रफ़्तार से बढ़ना
definition: an extreme growth phase, roughly doubling revenue or users year after year
example: Hypergrowth is thrilling until you meet the org chart it produces.

hindi: परिकल्पना-वृक्ष — संभावित उत्तर को जाँचने योग्य दावों में बाँटना
definition: a branching diagram that starts from a proposed answer and breaks it into testable claims, each needing evidence to confirm or reject
example: The hypothesis tree was elegant until the data rejected the trunk.

hindi: परिकल्पना-आधारित — पहले अनुमान, फिर उसे परखने वाला विश्लेषण
definition: describing analysis that starts from a proposed answer and gathers only the evidence needed to confirm or reject it
example: The project was hypothesis-driven, in that the hypothesis drove everything including which data got ignored.

hindi: कोड के रूप में ढाँचा — सर्वर और क्लाउड ढाँचे को हाथ से नहीं, कोड लिखकर बनाना और सँभालना
definition: infrastructure as code; managing servers, networks and cloud resources through versioned configuration files instead of manual setup
example: With IaC, deleting production now requires a pull request and an approval.

hindi: पहचान और पहुँच प्रबंधन — कौन क्या देख-बदल सकता है, इसका नियंत्रण
definition: identity and access management; the team and tools controlling employee accounts, logins and permissions
example: Ask IAM for access, and IAM will ask your manager, who will ask you what it is for.

hindi: इंडिविजुअल कंट्रिब्यूटर — बिना टीम मैनेज किए काम करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: individual contributor; an employee who does the work without managing anyone
example: She left management to go back to being an IC, and seems happier.

hindi: प्रयोग-प्राथमिकता अंक — असर, भरोसे और आसानी के आधार पर प्रयोगों की क्रम-सूची
definition: growth experiment prioritisation scoring impact, confidence and ease, each rated then combined into one ranking
example: Everyone's own idea somehow earned the highest ICE score in the backlog.

hindi: आइसबॉक्स — फ़िलहाल ठंडे बस्ते में डाले विचारों की सूची
definition: where backlog items go to be politely frozen instead of deleted
example: It's in the icebox, which has never once thawed.

hindi: बर्फ़ पिघलाने वाला सवाल — माहौल सहज करने की शुरुआत
definition: a light opening question or activity to warm up a meeting
example: The icebreaker took longer than the actual agenda item.

hindi: आदर्श ग्राहक प्रोफ़ाइल — सबसे उपयुक्त ख़रीदार का ख़ाका
definition: ideal customer profile — the type of company most likely to buy and succeed
example: Our ICP is mid-market fintech; our actual customers are whoever replied.

hindi: अगर छूट गया हो — दोबारा साझा की गई बात
definition: in case you missed it — a repost dressed as a favor
example: ICYMI, Friday's all-team email covers the new leave policy.

hindi: विचार-मंथन करना — 'सोचना' का महँगा कॉर्पोरेट रूप
definition: to generate ideas; an expensive way to say think
example: We booked the big room to ideate on the roadmap.

hindi: व्यक्तिगत विकास योजना — कर्मचारी के कौशल बढ़ाने की लिखित योजना
definition: individual development plan; a written plan of skills, training and goals agreed between employee and manager
example: His IDP listed three courses and 'become more strategic,' which nobody could schedule.

hindi: एकीकृत सुविधा प्रबंधन — इमारत की सारी सेवाएँ एक ही वेंडर को सौंपना
definition: integrated facilities management; a single vendor contracted to run all building services such as cleaning, maintenance and security
example: Since the IFM switch, one number fixes the lights, the lifts and nothing else.

hindi: अगर ठीक याद है — याद्दाश्त के भरोसे
definition: if I recall correctly — a memory offered without a warranty
example: IIRC we tried that in 2023 and it broke billing.

hindi: अगर मैं सही समझा — अपनी व्याख्या जाँचने का तरीका
definition: if I understand correctly; hedge restating someone's point to check your understanding before responding
example: IIUC you want it faster, cheaper and with more features — just confirming.

hindi: स्थापना, स्थानांतरण, जोड़ना, बदलाव — दफ़्तर में सीट या उपकरण हिलाने के अनुरोध
definition: install, move, add, change; facilities and service requests to relocate people, desks, phones or equipment within offices
example: My IMAC ticket to move one monitor two desks over is now in its third approval stage.

hindi: मेरी विनम्र राय में — विनम्रता की चादर में राय
definition: in my humble opinion — rarely humble, always an opinion
example: IMHO the logo was fine before the redesign.

hindi: मेरी राय में — निजी विचार
definition: in my opinion — the view is mine, feel free to differ
example: IMO we ship Friday and fix the copy next week.

hindi: प्रभाव-चित्रण — लक्ष्य, लोग, व्यवहार-बदलाव और फ़ीचरों को जोड़ने वाला नक्शा
definition: a planning technique connecting a business goal to the people involved, the behavior changes needed and the features that cause them
example: Impact mapping traced every feature back to a goal, except the one the CEO asked for.

hindi: प्रभाव का दिखावा — सामाजिक या पर्यावरणीय असर के खोखले दावे
definition: overstating the social or environmental impact claimed by an investment, product or programme beyond what evidence supports
example: The fund's impact washing counted every loan to a coffee shop as poverty alleviation.

hindi: प्रभाव-मेहनत खाका — किस काम में कम मेहनत से ज़्यादा फ़ायदा, यह छाँटना
definition: a prioritisation grid plotting initiatives by expected impact against required effort to find high-value work needing little effort first
example: Every idea on the impact-effort matrix migrated to high impact, low effort once its owner held the marker.

hindi: छँटनी की चपेट में आया — 'प्रभावित' कहकर निकाला गया
definition: HR's word for laid off, as in 'your role was impacted'
example: The email said impacted employees; the badge reader said it plainer.

hindi: काबिल होते हुए भी खुद को धोखेबाज़ महसूस करना
definition: feeling underqualified and about to be found out, despite real competence
example: Half the senior engineers have imposter syndrome; the other half should.

hindi: इंप्रेशन — सामग्री के किसी को दिखने की एक गिनती
definition: one instance of content being displayed to someone
example: A million impressions, forty clicks, one lesson.

hindi: दर्शन हिस्सेदारी — संभव सर्च विज्ञापन अवसरों में से आपके विज्ञापन कितनी बार दिखे
definition: percentage of eligible search advertisement impressions your campaigns actually received versus the total available
example: Our impression share is ninety percent on keywords nobody searches for.

hindi: प्रगति में — शुरू होकर अभी अधूरा
definition: already started and not yet landed, like most things here
example: We have six initiatives in flight and one runway.

hindi: सीमा के भीतर — इस चरण की डिलीवरी में शामिल
definition: included in what the team has agreed to deliver
example: Login is in scope; logging out gracefully, apparently, is not.

hindi: जानकारी में — ज़रूरी सूचनाओं से जुड़े रहना
definition: kept informed about developments
example: Keep me in the loop on the vendor negotiations.

hindi: कमरे में मौजूद — जहाँ असली फ़ैसला होता है वहाँ शामिल होना
definition: present when important decisions are actually made by senior leaders, rather than hearing about them afterward
example: Nobody from support was in the room, which explains the new refund policy.

hindi: उलझनों में धँसा — बारीकियों में इतना डूबना कि दिशा खो जाए
definition: lost in details, or overwhelmed by work
example: I was so in the weeds on the migration I missed lunch.

hindi: हाथ में आने वाला वेतन — कटौतियों के बाद असली मासिक रकम
definition: in Indian English, the monthly salary actually received after taxes, provident fund and deductions
example: The offer quoted CTC in bold and in-hand salary in a footnote.

hindi: स्वयं चलकर आए ग्राहक — जो ख़ुद संपर्क करें
definition: leads who come to you via content, search, or referrals
example: Inbound is up: mostly students, plus competitors requesting demos.

hindi: खाली इनबॉक्स की अवस्था — क्षणिक सुख
definition: the state of having no unhandled email, achieved briefly, discussed forever
example: He reached inbox zero at 5pm; it lasted eleven minutes.

hindi: प्रोत्साहित करना — इनाम देकर मनचाहा व्यवहार कराना
definition: to motivate behavior with rewards
example: The bonus incentivizes exactly the wrong metric.

hindi: गंभीर गड़बड़ी — उत्पादन की समस्या और उसका संगठित निपटान
definition: a production problem serious enough to trigger a coordinated response
example: It's not an outage, it's an incident, feel better?

hindi: घटना प्रमुख — किसी बड़ी गड़बड़ी के दौरान प्रतिक्रिया का नेतृत्व और समन्वय करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the person who coordinates response during a production incident, assigning tasks and making decisions rather than debugging personally
example: The incident commander's first order was to stop twelve people from restarting the same server.

hindi: समावेशी डिज़ाइन — हर क्षमता और परिस्थिति के लोगों के लिए रचना
definition: designing for the full range of human abilities and contexts
example: Inclusive design fixed it for screen readers and, surprise, for everyone.

hindi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार शर्तें — माल की ज़िम्मेदारी और जोखिम कब किसके पास
definition: standard international trade terms defining which party pays freight, insurance and duties, and where risk transfers
example: Nobody read the Incoterms until the container fell into the harbour.

hindi: वृद्धिशील बजट — पिछले साल के बजट में थोड़ा जोड़-घटाकर नया बजट
definition: setting next year's budget by adjusting last year's figures slightly rather than justifying each expense
example: Incremental budgeting is why a subscription nobody uses has survived four fiscal years.

hindi: वृद्धिशील असर — नतीजे का वह हिस्सा जो वैसे भी न आता
definition: the portion of results that would not have happened anyway
example: Ten thousand visits, says the campaign; incrementality asks how many were coming anyway.

hindi: उद्भवन केंद्र — शुरुआती आइडिया को जगह और सहारा देने वाला संस्थान
definition: an organization that nurtures very early ideas with space, support, and services
example: The incubator gave us desks, Wi-Fi, and weekly reminders to incorporate.

hindi: मौजूदा विक्रेता — जिसकी जगह लेनी है
definition: the vendor the customer already uses, and the one you must displace
example: The incumbent is terrible, beloved, and already in the budget.

hindi: क्षतिपूर्ति वचन — दूसरे पक्ष के नुक़सान की भरपाई का दायित्व
definition: a contractual promise to cover the other party's losses
example: The indemnification clause is where both lawyers earn their fees.

hindi: स्वतंत्र निदेशक — कंपनी या प्रबंधन से कोई संबंध न रखने वाला बोर्ड सदस्य
definition: a board member without any material relationship to the company or management, expected to provide objective oversight
example: The independent director was independent in every respect except that he had been the CEO's college roommate.

hindi: स्वतंत्र निर्माता — बिना निवेशकों के छोटे मुनाफ़ेदार उत्पाद बनाने वाला
definition: a builder who launches small, profitable products without investors
example: The indie hacker earns less than our intern and smiles more than our CEO.

hindi: अनुमान — प्रशिक्षित मॉडल से उत्तर निकालने की प्रक्रिया
definition: running a trained model to get outputs, as opposed to training it
example: Training took a week; inference has to happen before the user finishes their rep.

hindi: चलाने की लागत — हर जवाब पर मॉडल चलाने का ख़र्च
definition: the running expense of calling a model for every customer request, usually priced by tokens consumed
example: The chatbot was free for customers and extremely not free in inference cost.

hindi: मोड़-बिंदु — जहां से रुझान की दिशा या रफ्तार बदल जाए
definition: the moment a curve changes direction or accelerates
example: Every quarter is an inflection point if you squint.

hindi: बिना अधिकार का प्रभाव — जिन पर हुक्म नहीं चलता उन्हें भी राज़ी करने की कला
definition: getting colleagues you do not manage to support your goals through persuasion, relationships and credibility
example: Product managers run entirely on influence without authority and a surprising amount of snacks.

hindi: प्रभावशाली प्रचारक — जिसके अनुयायी उसकी सिफ़ारिश मानें
definition: someone with an audience who promotes products to it, occasionally with disclosure
example: We paid an influencer to love the product for exactly one post.

hindi: सूचना संरचना — सामग्री का वर्गीकरण और ढांचा ताकि चीज़ें मिलें
definition: how content is organized, grouped, and labeled so people can find it
example: Settings has four levels of nesting; our information architecture needs therapy.

hindi: सूचना अधिकार — निवेशकों को नियमित वित्तीय जानकारी पाने का हक
definition: investor entitlement to regular financial statements, budgets and company updates, usually granted above a minimum shareholding
example: Information rights meant the quarterly update went to forty people, and thirty-nine of them replied with advice.

hindi: शोध-निगरानी आरंभ करना — किसी कंपनी पर पहली बार विश्लेषक की रिपोर्ट और रेटिंग जारी करना
definition: when a brokerage analyst publishes their first research report and rating on a company, often after underwriting its listing
example: Two banks initiate coverage with buy ratings exactly twenty-five days after the offering, as tradition demands.

hindi: पहल — कई टीमों में फैला बड़ा रणनीतिक कार्य
definition: a large strategic effort that spans teams and usually several epics
example: Every quarter needs a flagship initiative and a name for it.

hindi: पाठ के बीच में — हर बिंदु के नीचे जवाब
definition: within the quoted text itself, where replies answer point by point
example: Replies inline in blue, as tradition demands.

hindi: लिंक्डइन संदेश — अनजान उम्मीदवार को भेजा गया भर्ती संदेश
definition: a paid LinkedIn message recruiters send to candidates outside their network
example: The InMail opened with his name spelled wrong and a role three levels below his own.

hindi: आंतरिक खुला स्रोत — कंपनी के भीतर खुले स्रोत की तरह टीमों का एक-दूसरे के कोड में योगदान
definition: applying open-source practices inside a company, letting any team read and contribute to another team's code
example: Under inner source, you may now submit fixes to the team that ignores your tickets.

hindi: इनपुट मापदंड — जिसे टीम सीधे बदल सके और जो नतीजों को चलाए
definition: a controllable driver metric that influences the outcomes you want
example: Ship more experiments is the input metric; revenue is the prayer.

hindi: अंदरूनी निवेश दौर — केवल मौजूदा निवेशकों से जुटाई गई फ़ंडिंग
definition: a financing funded entirely by existing investors, usually because outside investors declined to lead
example: The inside round kept the lights on and told the market everything the press release didn't.

hindi: दूरस्थ बिक्री — फ़ोन और वीडियो कॉल से दूर बैठकर बिक्री
definition: selling remotely through phone, email and video calls rather than visiting customers in person
example: Inside sales closed more this quarter than field sales, and without a single airport lounge receipt.

hindi: मापन-व्यवस्था — उत्पाद में व्यवहार दर्ज करने वाला कोड
definition: the code added to a product so behavior can be measured
example: We shipped first and added instrumentation later, so history began Tuesday.

hindi: प्रारंभिक भर्ती बैठक — भर्तीकर्ता और हायरिंग मैनेजर की पद-निर्धारण बैठक
definition: the kickoff where recruiter and hiring manager agree the role, level, profile and interview plan
example: In the intake meeting he asked for a senior engineer; by week three he wanted a principal at a junior salary.

hindi: अन्योन्यक्रिया डिज़ाइन — उपयोगकर्ता की क्रिया पर उत्पाद के व्यवहार की रचना
definition: designing how a product responds to what users do
example: Interaction design decides what happens on tap; ours chose 'nothing, silently'.

hindi: अंतर-कंपनी — एक ही समूह की कंपनियों के बीच के लेन-देन
definition: describing transactions between entities within the same corporate group, which must be reconciled and eliminated at consolidation
example: The India entity and the Singapore entity disagree on intercompany balances, like siblings splitting a bill.

hindi: आंतरिक कार्बन मूल्य — निवेश निर्णयों में उत्सर्जन की काल्पनिक लागत जोड़ना
definition: notional cost per tonne of emissions that companies apply when evaluating investments, budgets and projects
example: With an internal carbon price of fifty dollars, the new warehouse suddenly needed a better business case.

hindi: कंपनी के भीतर टीम या भूमिका बदलने की सुविधा
definition: moving between teams or roles inside the same company
example: Internal mobility is encouraged, once your manager stops blocking the transfer.

hindi: एक उम्मीदवार के लिए इंटरव्यू की पूरी शृंखला
definition: the full sequence of interviews a candidate goes through for one role
example: The interview loop was six rounds, which is five opinions too many.

hindi: सूचित करना — औपचारिक रूप से किसी को ख़बर देना
definition: an Indian English formal verb meaning to inform someone officially, often about leave, changes or decisions
example: Please intimate your manager before taking leave, not from the airport lounge.

hindi: संस्था के भीतर उद्यमी — कंपनी के अंदर रहकर नए उत्पाद या उद्यम खड़े करने वाला
definition: an employee who builds new products or ventures inside an established company with startup-style initiative
example: The intrapreneur pitched a new business unit, which legal is still reviewing eighteen months later.

hindi: भंडार आवर्तन — साल में कितनी बार पूरा माल बिककर बदला
definition: how many times inventory sells through and gets replaced within a year, showing how efficiently stock moves
example: Inventory turns improved dramatically once someone found the second warehouse.

hindi: निवेश सिद्धांत — किस क्षेत्र से बड़ा मुनाफ़ा आएगा, इसकी धारणा
definition: a fund's stated theory about where big returns will come from
example: Their investment thesis changed from crypto to AI in one weekend.

hindi: निवेशक दिवस — कंपनी का बड़े निवेशकों के सामने दीर्घकालिक योजना का प्रदर्शन
definition: scheduled event where company leadership presents long-term strategy, financial targets and roadmap to investors and analysts
example: Investor day unveiled a five-year plan so ambitious the CFO kept adding the word aspirational.

hindi: अनैच्छिक पृथक्करण — कंपनी द्वारा नौकरी समाप्त करना
definition: formal human resources wording for being fired or dismissed through layoffs by the employer
example: His paperwork listed involuntary separation, which sounded almost like a relationship status.

hindi: बौद्धिक संपदा — कोड, डिज़ाइन, ब्रांड जैसी अमूर्त संपत्ति
definition: intellectual property; creations like code, designs, and brands the company owns
example: HR reminded us the hackathon project is company IP now.

hindi: बौद्धिक संपदा हस्तांतरण — काम से बनी रचनाओं का स्वामित्व कंपनी को सौंपना
definition: the contract clause transferring ownership of inventions, code and creative work made during employment from the employee or contractor to the company
example: The startup's IP assignment was missing for the founder's first year, which due diligence found in about four minutes.

hindi: आरंभिक सार्वजनिक निर्गम — कंपनी का शेयर बाज़ार में सूचीबद्ध होना
definition: initial public offering; when a private company lists its shares on a stock exchange
example: The IPO date moved three times; the party budget survived every move.

hindi: पहले दिन की उछाल — सूचीबद्धता के दिन शेयर कीमत में तेज़ बढ़त
definition: a sharp first-day rise in a newly listed share price above its offering price
example: The IPO pop made headlines, and the founders quietly calculated how much money was left on the table.

hindi: निवेशक संबंध — कंपनी और शेयरधारकों के बीच संवाद संभालने वाला विभाग
definition: investor relations; the team managing communication between a listed company, its shareholders and research analysts
example: IR rehearsed the CEO for three hours so he could answer the margin question with no numbers at all.

hindi: वास्तविक मुलाक़ात — स्क्रीन के बाहर आमने-सामने मिलना
definition: in real life; meeting remote colleagues physically in person rather than through video calls or chat messages
example: We finally met IRL at the offsite, and he is much shorter than his video background suggested.

hindi: अविवेकी उत्साह — बाज़ार का बेलगाम आशावाद जो भाव बढ़ाता है
definition: unfounded market optimism that inflates asset prices well beyond their underlying value
example: Three companies pitched us the same app this week; irrational exuberance has entered the building.

hindi: प्रोत्साहन स्टॉक विकल्प — कर-लाभ वाले कर्मचारी शेयर विकल्प
definition: incentive stock option; an employee stock option with favourable American taxation if holding rules are followed
example: My ISOs are tax-advantaged, provided I understand the tax rules, which nobody does.

hindi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्थिरता मानक बोर्ड — निवेशकों के लिए वैश्विक ESG प्रकटीकरण मानक
definition: international sustainability standards board; body setting global investor-focused sustainability and climate disclosure standards
example: Investor relations asked whether ISSB alignment means we can finally stop filling in six questionnaires.

hindi: मुद्दा-वृक्ष — बड़े सवाल को छोटे उप-सवालों की शाखाओं में तोड़ना
definition: a branching diagram that breaks one large business question into smaller, narrower questions until each can be answered with analysis
example: The issue tree had forty branches and one leaf that anyone had actually researched.

hindi: हमेशा DNS ही निकलता है — रहस्यमय गड़बड़ी का चिर-परिचित अपराधी
definition: the ops proverb that mysterious outages trace back to DNS, again
example: Three hours of debugging later: it's always DNS.

term: it's not a bug, it's a feature
hindi: बग नहीं, फ़ीचर है — खामी को खूबी बताने की क्लासिक दलील
definition: the classic reframing of a defect as intentional behavior
example: Users can order negative quantities. It's not a bug, it's a feature.

hindi: दोहराकर सुधारना — बार-बार संस्करण बेहतर करते जाना
definition: to improve something through repeated versions
example: Ship it rough, iterate weekly, apologize never.

hindi: पुनरावृत्ति — विकास का एक निश्चित चक्र, स्प्रिंट का समानार्थी
definition: one repeating development cycle; the vendor-neutral word for a sprint
example: We'll polish it in a future iteration, says everyone, always.

hindi: आईटी सेवा प्रबंधन पद्धति — टिकट, बदलाव और घटनाओं की मानक प्रक्रिया
definition: information technology infrastructure library; framework standardising service desk tickets, changes, incidents and problem management
example: He quoted ITIL to explain why fixing the typo needed a change request, a problem record and a meeting.

hindi: जेलब्रेक — मॉडल से उसके सुरक्षा नियम तुड़वाने की चाल
definition: a prompt trick that makes a model ignore its safety rules
example: A user jailbroke the coach into writing their biology homework; impressive, but no.

hindi: झटकेदार चाल — एनिमेशन या स्क्रॉल का अटकना
definition: visible stutter or lag in scrolling, animation or transitions that makes an interface feel broken
example: The new transition added charm on the designer's laptop and jank on every phone we tested.

hindi: नौकरी विवरण — पद की ज़िम्मेदारियाँ और अपेक्षाएँ बताने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: job description; the written posting listing duties, requirements and qualifications for an open role
example: The JD asks for ten years of experience in a framework released four years ago.

hindi: मानवीय स्वचालन — दोष मिलते ही मशीन का ख़ुद रुक जाना
definition: automation with a human touch; machines stop themselves when detecting abnormalities so defects never travel downstream
example: The robot practises jidoka by halting whenever anyone from finance walks past.

hindi: ठीक समय पर आपूर्ति — माल तभी मँगाना जब उत्पादन में उसकी ज़रूरत हो
definition: just in time; ordering and producing materials only when needed, keeping inventory lean and exposing every supplier delay
example: We run JIT, which is lovely right up until one truck gets stuck at the border.

hindi: जल्दी-जल्दी नौकरियाँ बदलने की आदत — अक्सर वेतन बढ़ाने को
definition: changing employers every year or two, usually the fastest route to raises
example: Loyalty earned him 3 percent; job hopping earned his peers 30.

hindi: स्वीकृत भर्ती-पद — नौकरी खोलने की औपचारिक अनुमति
definition: an approved requisition to hire for a specific open role
example: The job req was open for six months, then quietly closed in the freeze.

hindi: काम-कथा — स्थिति, प्रेरणा और अपेक्षित परिणाम के रूप में ज़रूरत लिखना
definition: a requirement written as situation, motivation and expected outcome, an alternative to persona-based user stories in product backlogs
example: The job story said 'when I'm in a hurry', and the flow had nine steps.

hindi: कार्य-केंद्रित दृष्टि — ग्राहक उत्पाद को काम कराने के लिए 'किराए' पर लेता है
definition: a framework framing products as things users hire to get a job done
example: Jobs to be done says nobody wants a drill; they want the hole.

hindi: आगमन-स्थानांतरण-प्रस्थान प्रक्रिया — कर्मचारी के जुड़ने, बदलने और जाने पर पहुँच बदलना
definition: lifecycle process granting, adjusting and removing employee access when people join, change roles or leave
example: The joiner-mover-leaver process handled joiners well, movers sometimes, and leavers eventually.

hindi: जुगाड़ — सीमित साधनों से निकाला गया कामचलाऊ, चतुर समाधान
definition: an Indian English borrowing for a clever improvised workaround built with limited resources, often temporary but durable
example: The production server runs on a cron job, a spreadsheet and pure jugaad.

hindi: बस हाल पूछ रहा हूँ — असल में जवाब की माँग
definition: a soft follow-up implying the deadline is quietly on fire
example: Just checking in on the draft you promised Monday.

hindi: न्यायसंगत संक्रमण — कम-कार्बन बदलाव में कर्मचारियों और समुदायों को पीछे न छोड़ना
definition: principle that shifting toward cleaner operations should protect affected workers and communities through retraining, support and fair treatment
example: Our just transition slide shows smiling retrained workers; the budget line shows a question mark.

hindi: के-फैक्टर — हर उपयोगकर्ता औसतन कितने नए लाता है, उसका गुणांक
definition: how many new users each existing user brings in
example: A k-factor above one is the dream; ours is a rounding error.

hindi: निरंतर सुधार — रोज़ के छोटे-छोटे बदलावों से प्रक्रिया बेहतर करना
definition: continuous improvement through small, frequent changes suggested by the people doing the work, borrowed from Japanese lean practice
example: Our kaizen event produced forty sticky notes and one relocated stapler.

hindi: कानबान — कार्ड और कॉलम से प्रवाह दिखाती निरंतर कार्य-प्रणाली
definition: a method visualizing work as cards flowing across columns, limiting work in progress
example: We switched to kanban so the unfinished work could be seen.

hindi: कानो मॉडल — फ़ीचरों को ज़रूरी, प्रदर्शन और ख़ुशी देने वाले वर्गों में बाँटना
definition: a prioritization framework classifying features as basic expectations, performance features or delighters based on customer satisfaction
example: By the Kano model, a working login button is not a delighter, however proud the team is of it.

hindi: अत्यधिक काम से मृत्यु — जापानी शब्द, ज़्यादा काम के कारण मौत
definition: a Japanese term for death caused by overwork, used worldwide when discussing extreme working hours and burnout
example: The consultant mentioned karoshi in the burnout workshop, then stayed until ten finishing the slides.

hindi: काम चालू रखना — नयापन नहीं, बस ज़रूरी संचालन
definition: to do the minimum maintenance that keeps operations running
example: Half the budget just keeps the lights on.

hindi: मुख्य निष्कर्ष — मीटिंग या प्रस्तुति से याद रखने लायक बातें
definition: the few main points someone should remember from a meeting, presentation or document
example: Key takeaways: the budget is fine, the timeline is not, and lunch was late.

term: kick the can down the road
hindi: टालमटोल — कठिन फ़ैसला आगे के लिए सरकाना
definition: to defer a hard decision for someone future to handle
example: We kicked the pricing decision down the road again.

hindi: ऊपर धकेलना — किसी को बड़ा पद देकर असल ज़िम्मेदारी से हटाना
definition: moved into a senior-sounding role with little real power, a face-saving way to sideline an executive
example: He got kicked upstairs to Chief Vision Officer, a title with a view and no team.

hindi: शुभारंभ बैठक — परियोजना की पहली औपचारिक बैठक
definition: the opening meeting where a project's optimism peaks
example: Great kickoff; the project now begins its long descent into scope.

hindi: बंद कर देना — परियोजना या सुविधा को सीधे समाप्त करना
definition: to cancel a feature or project outright
example: Someone has to kill this feature; it's been on life support since v2.

hindi: आपात स्विच — बिगड़ैल फ़ीचर तुरंत बंद करने का बटन
definition: a control that instantly disables a feature when it misbehaves
example: New feature, new kill switch, old trust issues.

hindi: कृपया — विनम्र आदेश का शब्द
definition: please, in formal Indian office English; softens any command
example: Kindly share the updated tracker by noon.

hindi: सरल रखो — बेवजह की चतुराई से बचो (keep it simple, stupid)
definition: keep it simple, stupid; resist cleverness nobody can maintain
example: KISS, he said, deleting my beautiful abstraction.

hindi: ऊपर चापलूसी, नीचे दबंगई — बॉस के आगे झुकना और मातहतों को दबाना
definition: describes a manager who flatters senior leaders while treating their own team harshly and dismissively
example: Leadership calls him a great operator; his team calls it kiss up, kick down.

hindi: सब कुछ एक साथ — एक ही तिमाही में सारे बुरे ख़र्च और घाटे दिखा देना
definition: a quarter where a company books every loss and write-down at once to reset expectations
example: The new CEO's first report was a kitchen-sink quarter, conveniently blaming everything on the old CEO.

hindi: ध्यान में रखें — अभी नहीं, पर बाद के लिए याद रखें
definition: keep in view; tag for items to remember and revisit later without acting now, common in Asian offices
example: Your proposal has been marked KIV, which is where proposals go to retire.

hindi: भद्दा जुगाड़ — बेढंगा जोड़-तोड़ जो किसी तरह चलता है
definition: an ugly, awkward patchwork solution that somehow functions
example: The sync system is a kludge held together by cron jobs and hope.

hindi: प्रमुख प्रबंधकीय कर्मी — मुख्य कार्यकारी, वित्त प्रमुख और कंपनी सचिव जैसे कानूनन नामित अधिकारी
definition: key managerial personnel; in Indian English, the officers named under Indian companies legislation, such as chief executive, finance chief and company secretary
example: Becoming KMP came with a promotion, a disclosure form and a noticeably longer list of things that were now personally his fault.

hindi: छँटनी प्रश्न — आवेदन पर वह प्रश्न जो ग़लत उत्तर पर तुरंत बाहर कर दे
definition: a screening question on an application that automatically rejects anyone giving the wrong answer
example: The knockout question on relocation rejected the best applicant, who already lives in the city.

hindi: ज्ञान-भंडार — उत्पाद संबंधी सहायता लेखों का संग्रह
definition: searchable library of support articles, troubleshooting guides and answers used by customers and agents to solve product problems
example: The knowledge base article was accurate, three product versions ago.

hindi: ज्ञान सीमा-तिथि — इस तारीख़ के बाद की दुनिया से मॉडल अनजान
definition: the date after which a model's training data ends and it knows nothing
example: It recommends last year's fitness trends — blame the knowledge cutoff.

hindi: ज्ञान-संग्राही — जानकारी दबाकर खुद को अपरिहार्य बनाने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: an employee who deliberately keeps critical information undocumented so the team stays dependent on them
example: The knowledge hoarder's handover document was one line: 'call me'.

hindi: जानकारी की जमाख़ोरी — ख़ुद को अपरिहार्य बनाने के लिए जानकारी छिपाना
definition: deliberately withholding information, documentation or expertise from colleagues to stay indispensable and protect your position
example: His knowledge hoarding is so thorough that the deploy script only runs when he's in the building.

hindi: जाते हुए कर्मचारी से जानकारी हस्तांतरित करने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the rushed ritual of extracting what a departing employee knows
example: Two years of context, one week of knowledge transfer meetings.

hindi: ज्ञात समस्या — कंपनी द्वारा स्वीकार की गई पर अभी न सुलझी खराबी
definition: product defect the company has acknowledged and documented but still left unresolved, often shared with customers alongside a workaround
example: It has been a known issue for so long it now appears in the onboarding video.

hindi: प्रमुख राय-निर्माता — वह नामी चिकित्सक जिसकी बात पर बाक़ी डॉक्टर भरोसा करते हैं
definition: key opinion leader; a respected physician or researcher whose views shape how peers prescribe and whom companies court for advice and endorsement
example: The KOL agreed with our data in the advisory meeting and with our competitor's data at the congress.

hindi: मुख्य प्रदर्शन संकेतक — सफलता नापने का चुना हुआ आँकड़ा
definition: key performance indicator; a number chosen to represent success
example: Every team has five KPIs and full confidence in maybe one.

hindi: मुख्य परिणाम क्षेत्र — जिन कामों पर कर्मचारी को आँका जाएगा
definition: key result areas; in Indian English, the defined responsibilities and outcomes an employee is appraised against
example: Her KRAs were finalised in October, which made the April goals retroactively ambitious.

hindi: ज्ञान हस्तांतरण — जाने वाले व्यक्ति से काम की पूरी जानकारी नए व्यक्ति को सौंपना
definition: knowledge transfer; Indian English shorthand for sessions where a departing or rotating person hands project knowledge, systems and context to a successor
example: The KT was scheduled for his last afternoon, which explains why the handover document is one slide long.

hindi: परिचालन कार्य — सिस्टम चालू रखने का नियमित रखरखाव
definition: keep the lights on; the maintenance work that funds no promotions
example: Half our capacity is KTLO before any roadmap work starts.

hindi: अपने ग्राहक को जानें — खाता खोलने से पहले पहचान सत्यापन
definition: know your customer; mandatory identity verification of clients before onboarding, required for banks, fintechs and payment companies
example: The KYC flow asked for four documents, and the conversion rate asked for fewer.

hindi: न्यूनतम बोलीदाता — निविदा में सबसे कम भाव देने वाला विक्रेता
definition: lowest one; Indian English for the vendor quoting the lowest price in a tender, usually awarded the contract
example: We had to go with the L1, and now we are learning why their quote was lowest.

hindi: उपयोग-विस्तार — स्वीकृत दवा को नई बीमारियों के लिए मंज़ूरी दिलाना
definition: gaining regulatory approval for an existing drug in additional diseases, patient populations or treatment lines to grow revenue
example: The lifecycle plan is mostly label expansion with a patent attorney standing nearby.

hindi: निष्कर्ष की सीढ़ी — चुनिंदा तथ्यों से छलांग लगाकर धारणाएँ बना लेने का मॉडल
definition: a model showing how people climb from selected facts through assumptions to firm conclusions and actions, used to challenge hasty judgements
example: He saw one late reply and climbed the whole ladder of inference to disengagement by lunch.

hindi: पश्च संकेतक — घट चुके नतीजे की पुष्टि करने वाला आँकड़ा
definition: a metric that confirms what already happened
example: Revenue is a lagging indicator, and this quarter it lags with feeling.

hindi: छोटे से शुरू, फिर विस्तार — पहले घुसो, फिर बढ़ते जाओ
definition: start with a small deal, then grow revenue inside the account over time
example: Land and expand: sell to one team, then appear in every budget meeting.

hindi: ज़मीन हथियाना — ख़ाली ज़िम्मेदारी या नए प्रोजेक्ट पर झट से कब्ज़ा
definition: a quick move to claim ownership of an unclaimed project, product area or headcount before rival teams do
example: The AI strategy memo was barely sent when the land grab for owning it began.

hindi: पहुँच लागत — ख़रीद मूल्य के साथ ढुलाई, शुल्क और बीमा का कुल ख़र्च
definition: the total cost of getting a product to your door, including purchase price, freight, duties, insurance and handling
example: The cheap supplier won the bid, then the landed cost arrived with customs attached.

hindi: अभियान-पृष्ठ — एक ही कार्रवाई के लिए बना वेबपेज
definition: a single-purpose web page built to convert a campaign's visitors into leads
example: The landing page has one button and, somehow, three stakeholders.

hindi: छूटा हुआ दाता — जिसने पहले दिया पर अब देना बंद कर दिया
definition: a former supporter who gave in previous years but has stopped giving, targeted by reactivation appeals and campaigns
example: The reactivation mailer reached every lapsed donor, including the ones who lapsed because of the last mailer.

hindi: अंतिम मील — प्रोटोटाइप को असली इस्तेमाल लायक बनाने का कठिन हिस्सा
definition: the difficult final stretch of turning a working prototype into something reliable enough for everyday production
example: The model handles ninety percent of invoices; the last mile is the other ninety percent of the work.

hindi: अंतिम-क्लिक श्रेय — बिक्री का पूरा श्रेय खरीद से पहले वाले आख़िरी क्लिक को
definition: attribution model giving full conversion credit to the final click before purchase, ignoring every earlier touchpoint
example: Under last-click attribution, branded search is a genius and everything that made people search is worthless.

hindi: विलंब बजट — जवाब में अधिकतम स्वीकार्य देरी की सीमा
definition: the maximum response time a feature is allowed before users feel it
example: Rep feedback has a 200-millisecond latency budget; philosophy can take a second.

hindi: अनुभवी भर्ती — दूसरी कंपनी से समान स्तर पर लाया गया कर्मचारी
definition: an experienced professional hired from another company at a comparable level rather than from campus
example: As a lateral hire he got a higher salary and none of the tribal knowledge.

hindi: समान स्तर पर भूमिका-परिवर्तन — पदोन्नति नहीं
definition: changing roles at the same level, trading novelty for no raise
example: The lateral move gave her a new team and the same band.

hindi: लॉन्च अभियान — नए उत्पाद के प्रचार की समन्वित मुहिम
definition: the coordinated marketing push around a product release
example: The launch campaign is ready; the product is 'day-one patchable.'

hindi: रिलीज़ की श्रेणी — रिलीज़ कितनी बड़ी है, उसके हिसाब से मार्केटिंग का पैमाना
definition: a classification ranking product releases by significance, deciding how much marketing, sales enablement and announcement each launch receives
example: Engineering called it a tier-one launch; marketing quietly filed it as tier three.

hindi: आर्थिक कारणों से कर्मचारियों की छँटनी
definition: terminating employees for business reasons rather than performance
example: The layoff email began with 'our greatest asset has always been people'.

hindi: छँटनी से बचे लोगों का तनाव — छँटनी के बाद बचे कर्मचारियों की ग्लानि और डर
definition: guilt, anxiety and lowered morale among employees who keep their jobs after colleagues are laid off
example: Layoff survivor syndrome looks like everyone replying instantly and nobody taking lunch.

hindi: उधार-आधारित अधिग्रहण — भारी कर्ज़ लेकर कंपनी खरीदना
definition: leveraged buyout; acquiring a company mostly with borrowed money, repaid from the acquired company's own cash flows
example: After the LBO, the snack budget became a line item in someone's debt covenant.

hindi: ताज़ा अनुमान — मौजूदा जानकारी पर साल का सबसे नया वित्तीय अंदाज़ा
definition: latest estimate; the current best forecast of full-year results, updated with actuals as the year progresses
example: The LE dropped again, but the deck still calls it a timing difference.

hindi: संभावित ग्राहक — जिसने उत्पाद में रुचि दिखाई हो
definition: a person or company that has shown interest and might become a customer
example: Half the leads from the webinar were students and one was our own intern.

hindi: लीड सृजन — संभावित ग्राहकों की जानकारी जुटाना
definition: lead generation — activities that collect contact info from potential buyers
example: The ebook is lead gen: twelve pages of content, one page of form.

hindi: प्रमुख स्वतंत्र निदेशक — स्वतंत्र निदेशकों का अगुआ, जब अध्यक्ष ही मुख्य कार्यकारी हो
definition: the senior independent board member who leads sessions without management, especially when the chair also serves as chief executive
example: The lead independent director scheduled a quiet dinner, and everyone suddenly worried about the CEO's contract.

hindi: मुख्य निवेशक — जो दौर की शर्तें तय करता और बाक़ियों को जोड़ता है
definition: the investor who sets the round's terms and brings others along
example: Everyone's interested, but nobody wants to be the lead investor.

hindi: लीड-चुंबक — ईमेल पते के बदले मुफ़्त सामग्री
definition: a free resource offered in exchange for contact details
example: The lead magnet is a 'free guide' that costs exactly one email address.

hindi: लीड का अंक-निर्धारण — रुचि के आधार पर प्राथमिकता
definition: ranking leads by fit and behavior so sales calls the likeliest first
example: Lead scoring gave the intern 98 points for opening our email eleven times.

hindi: लीड समय — अनुरोध से आपूर्ति तक की कुल अवधि
definition: the clock from request to delivery, as customers experience it
example: Lead time on small requests is a quarter, somehow.

hindi: अग्रिम संकेतक — भविष्य के नतीजों की पहले झलक देने वाला आँकड़ा
definition: a metric that moves early and hints where results are heading
example: Signups are our leading indicator; dread is our lagging one.

hindi: रैंकिंग तालिका — सौदों या शुल्क के आधार पर बैंकों की क्रम-सूची
definition: a ranking of banks by deal volume or fees, cited endlessly in pitches and bonus discussions
example: We were number one in the league table, provided you filtered for mid-cap Nordic healthcare in March.

hindi: बुकिंग रिसाव — तय चैनल छोड़कर बाहर से की गई ख़रीद या बुकिंग
definition: business travel or spending booked outside the approved company booking channel, escaping negotiated rates and tracking
example: Procurement blames leakage on the sales team, who blame the booking tool, which blames nobody because it never loads.

hindi: दुबला स्टार्टअप तरीक़ा — बड़े प्लान की जगह छोटे तेज़ प्रयोग
definition: a method of building through rapid experiments and validated learning, not big upfront plans
example: Lean startup in practice: ship the test on Tuesday, apologize on Wednesday.

hindi: सीखने का चरण — नए अभियान में एल्गोरिद्म के स्थिर होने तक का अस्थिर समय
definition: period after launching or changing campaigns when the advertising algorithm is still calibrating delivery and results
example: Please stop editing the campaign; every tweak sends it back into the learning phase.

hindi: सीखें — अनुभव से निकले सबक़; 'lessons' का कॉर्पोरेट रूप
definition: lessons taken from an experience; grammatically suspect, universally used
example: The launch failed, but we documented the learnings.

hindi: न्यूनतम अधिकार — हर व्यक्ति को उतनी ही पहुँच जितनी काम के लिए ज़रूरी
definition: security principle granting each person only the access permissions their current role strictly needs
example: Least privilege applies to everyone, except the VP who needs admin on everything just in case.

hindi: अवकाश नकदीकरण — बची हुई छुट्टियों के बदले पैसा
definition: in Indian English, converting unused earned leave into cash, typically when leaving the company or at year end
example: She saved thirty days for leave encashment and then spent all of them resigning.

hindi: छुट्टी में भी काम — छुट्टी या बीमारी के दिनों में काम निपटाना
definition: using annual leave or sick days to catch up on work, or working while officially away
example: Her leaveism was so thorough that the out-of-office reply answered within minutes.

hindi: एल्गोरिद्म पहेली परीक्षा — रटे हुए कोडिंग प्रश्नों पर आधारित साक्षात्कार
definition: shorthand for algorithm-puzzle coding interviews, named after the practice site candidates grind before them
example: He did two hundred LeetCode problems to get a job fixing CSS.

hindi: विरासती कोड — पुराना चालू कोड जिसे छूने से सब डरते हैं
definition: old code that still runs the business and terrifies everyone who touches it
example: Legacy code is just code that makes money, unfortunately.

hindi: कानूनी रोक — मुकदमे के कारण संबंधित रिकॉर्ड हटाने पर पाबंदी
definition: an instruction suspending normal deletion so that emails, files and records relevant to expected litigation are preserved
example: He tried to clean out his inbox and learned, from an IT ticket, that he was under legal hold.

hindi: क़ानूनी समीक्षा — जोखिम के लिए वकीलों की जाँच
definition: having lawyers examine something for risk before it ships or is signed
example: The blog post is in legal review, so see you next month.

hindi: क़ानूनी भाषा — आम इंसान को समझ न आने वाली शब्दावली
definition: dense legal jargon ordinary humans cannot parse
example: The one-page agreement is forty pages of legalese now.

hindi: नौकरी से निकालना — 'जाने देना' कहकर
definition: fired or laid off, softened to sound like releasing a bird
example: They let him go, as if he'd been asking to leave.

hindi: साझा समझ बनाना — सबको एक ही जानकारी पर लाना
definition: to establish a shared understanding before discussing further
example: Before we debate, let's level set on what actually shipped.

hindi: कर्मचारी का स्तर तय करना — वेतन और अपेक्षाएँ उसी से जुड़ी
definition: assigning an employee a level that sets their pay and expectations
example: Two identical engineers, two different levelings, one awkward lunch.

hindi: इस्तेमाल करना — किसी मौजूदा चीज़ से ज़्यादा फ़ायदा उठाना
definition: to use something existing for advantage; corporate for 'use'
example: We should leverage the existing design system instead of rebuilding it.

hindi: सोपान ढाँचा — एक साझेदार के नीचे कई कनिष्ठ सलाहकारों का अनुपात
definition: consulting firm staffing structure where many junior consultants work beneath each partner to multiply billing
example: The leverage model explained why one partner and eleven analysts attended the kickoff.

hindi: उधार-आधारित अधिग्रहण — कंपनी को मुख्यतः कर्ज़ लेकर खरीदना
definition: acquiring a company using mostly borrowed money, with the target's own cash flows repaying that debt
example: After the leveraged buyout the company's first new hire was a treasurer and its first cut was the coffee.

hindi: मुझे ठीक लगता है — कोड समीक्षा की स्वीकृति (looks good to me)
definition: looks good to me; the reviewer's stamp of approval on a change
example: He typed LGTM forty seconds after I opened the pull request.

hindi: लाइसेंस लेखा-परीक्षा — विक्रेता द्वारा जाँच कि ग्राहक ख़रीदे गए से अधिक उपयोग तो नहीं कर रहा
definition: a vendor's formal review of a customer's software usage against purchased licences, often ending in back-billing
example: The license audit found we were using thirty more seats, which conveniently equalled their quarterly target.

hindi: जीवनचक्र विपणन — ग्राहक की हर अवस्था के अनुसार ईमेल, नोटिफ़िकेशन भेजना
definition: automated emails, notifications and messages timed to each customer stage, from signup through renewal and winback
example: Lifecycle marketing sent a 'welcome aboard' email to someone cancelling their account.

hindi: जीवनशैली व्यवसाय — मालिक के आराम के लिए, अनंत विस्तार के लिए नहीं
definition: a business built to fund its owner's life, not to scale endlessly
example: He calls it a lifestyle business; his VC friends call it a tragedy.

hindi: अंतिम आगत, प्रथम निर्गत — सबसे नए कर्मचारी पहले निकाले जाते हैं
definition: last in, first out; layoff selection method where the most recently hired employees lose their positions first
example: Under LIFO, the new hire's welcome lunch doubled as his farewell.

hindi: बढ़त — किसी बदलाव के खाते में गई आँकड़े की वृद्धि
definition: the increase in a metric credited to a specific change
example: The lift vanished the week after launch, as lifts do.

hindi: जस का तस स्थानांतरण — बिना बदले क्लाउड पर उठा धरना
definition: moving a system to new infrastructure unchanged, problems lovingly preserved
example: The lift and shift moved our tech debt to the cloud intact.

hindi: बिजली-सी वार्ता — पाँच मिनट की छोटी प्रस्तुति
definition: a very short presentation, often five minutes, given one after another at team events
example: His lightning talk ran twenty minutes, which is how weather works too.

hindi: दायित्व की सीमा — अनुबंध में अधिकतम हर्जाने की तय हद
definition: the contract clause capping the total money either party must pay the other when something goes wrong, usually excluding certain damages
example: The deal closed in a week; the limitation of liability took the other five.

hindi: धुंधली दृष्टि — आगे का अनुमान लगाना कठिन होना
definition: management's admission that future revenue is hard to forecast, usually offered alongside wider or withdrawn guidance
example: We have limited visibility into the second half, so here is a very confident slide about 2030.

hindi: पहले भुगतान का हक़ — बिक्री पर निवेशक को सबसे पहले पैसा
definition: the investor's right to get paid back first when the company sells
example: The exit made headlines; after liquidation preferences, the founders made lunch money.

hindi: परिसमापन ढेर — निवेशकों की कुल वरीयताएँ जो बिक्री में पहले चुकानी हैं
definition: the combined liquidation preferences of every funding round, which must be repaid before common shareholders receive anything
example: We sold for two hundred million; the liquidation stack was two hundred and ten.

hindi: तरलता घटना — काग़ज़ी हिस्सेदारी का असली पैसे में बदलना
definition: any transaction that converts paper equity into actual money
example: HR calls it a liquidity event; employees call it finally buying a car.

hindi: सूचीबद्ध मूल्य — छूट से पहले का आधिकारिक दाम
definition: the official published price nobody actually pays
example: List price exists mainly so the discount has something to be subtracted from.

hindi: विशाल भाषा मॉडल — आधुनिक एआई सहायकों का मूल इंजन
definition: large language model; the text-predicting engine behind modern AI assistants
example: We swapped LLMs over the weekend and nobody noticed, which is either great or terrifying.

hindi: एलएलएम-निर्णायक — एक मॉडल से दूसरे मॉडल के उत्तर जँचवाना
definition: using one language model to grade another model's outputs at scale
example: LLM-as-judge scores the coach's replies, and yes, we eval the judge too.

hindi: मुझे बता देना — जवाब मिले तो सूचित करें
definition: let me know — tell me once you have an answer
example: LMK if the numbers look off before I present them.

hindi: कम-बारीक — मोटे खाके वाला, जानबूझकर अधूरा डिज़ाइन
definition: rough, deliberately unpolished design work meant to test layout ideas before anyone invests in visual detail
example: It was lo-fi on purpose, which did not stop the VP from asking why the buttons were grey.

hindi: कोड की पंक्तियाँ — कोड के आकार या काम की मात्रा का मोटा (और भ्रामक) माप
definition: lines of code; a crude measure of codebase size or developer output, widely distrusted as a productivity metric
example: His best week was minus three thousand LOC, and it was genuinely his best week.

hindi: स्थानीयकरण — उत्पाद को हर बाज़ार की भाषा-संस्कृति के अनुरूप ढालना
definition: adapting a product's language, formats, and content for each market
example: Localization is more than translation, as our German buttons discovered.

hindi: स्थान-आधारित वेतन — शहर के ख़र्च के अनुसार वेतन तय करना
definition: adjusting salaries according to where employees live, usually tied to local living costs and market rates for remote workers
example: He moved to the hills and location-based pay moved his salary downhill with him.

hindi: लोगो-संयोजन — चिह्न और नाम की तय सापेक्ष व्यवस्था
definition: the fixed arrangement of a logo symbol, wordmark and sometimes tagline, with specified spacing and proportions that must not be altered
example: Someone stretched the lockup to fit the banner, and the brand team took it personally.

hindi: बिक्री-रोक की समाप्ति — सार्वजनिक निर्गम के बाद अंदरूनी लोगों को शेयर बेचने की छूट मिलना
definition: the date after an initial public offering when insiders and employees are finally allowed to sell shares
example: Attendance at the all-hands dropped sharply the week after lockup expiry.

hindi: बिक्री-निषेध अवधि — IPO के बाद अंदरूनी लोगों के शेयर बेचने पर रोक
definition: the months after a company's public listing during which insiders and early investors are contractually barred from selling shares
example: The whole office had the lockup period expiry date in their calendars, labelled 'dentist'.

hindi: प्रयास स्तर — काम में लगने वाली मेहनत का अनुमान
definition: level of effort; how much work something takes, in vague units
example: Give me a rough LOE before we promise it to the board.

hindi: तर्क मॉडल — संसाधन, गतिविधि, परिणाम और प्रभाव का एक-पृष्ठ ढाँचा
definition: a one-page programme diagram linking inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes and impact, usually required in grant applications
example: The grant portal rejected our logic model because impact was in the outcomes column.

hindi: ग्राहक कंपनी — नाम गिनाने लायक़ क्लाइंट
definition: a customer, counted as a brand name you can display on the website
example: The deal barely broke even, but it's a great logo for the homepage.

hindi: ग्राहक-संख्या छीजन — राजस्व नहीं, कितनी कंपनियां गईं इसकी गिनती
definition: customer accounts lost, counted by company rather than revenue
example: Revenue churn is fine; logo churn says the small customers are fleeing.

hindi: आशय पत्र — सौदे की प्रमुख शर्तें बताने वाला गैर-बाध्यकारी पत्र
definition: letter of intent; a mostly non-binding document setting headline price, structure and exclusivity before definitive agreements
example: The LOI took one afternoon; the purchase agreement took the rest of the year.

hindi: सबसे लंबा काम — पूरी समयसीमा तय करने वाला सबसे धीमा हिस्सा
definition: the slowest piece of work, the one that determines when everything ships
example: Compliance review is the long pole, as always.

hindi: लंबी चलने वाली शाखा — हफ़्तों तक मुख्य शाखा से अलग रहने वाली शाखा, जिसका विलय कठिन हो जाता है
definition: a feature branch kept separate from the main branch for weeks, drifting away and making the eventual merge painful
example: That long-lived branch has diverged so far it now qualifies as a separate product.

hindi: रंग-रूप और अनुभव — उत्पाद की समग्र छवि और एहसास
definition: the overall visual style and experiential character of a product
example: The client loves the look and feel, just wants both changed.

hindi: मिलते-जुलते दर्शक — मौजूदा ग्राहकों जैसे नए लोगों का समूह
definition: an advertising audience built by a platform to match the traits and behaviour of an existing customer list, used to find similar prospects
example: The lookalike audience found thousands of people exactly like our customers: also not buying.

hindi: शामिल करना — किसी को बातचीत की जानकारी में जोड़ना
definition: to bring someone into a conversation they will need
example: Loop in legal early; they bill by the surprise.

hindi: वेतन कटौती अवकाश — छुट्टियाँ ख़त्म होने पर बिना वेतन की छुट्टी
definition: loss of pay; Indian English term for leave days taken beyond balance, deducted from the monthly salary
example: One extra holiday day, marked LOP, cost more than the flight.

hindi: स्थानधारक पाठ — असली सामग्री की जगह भरा जाने वाला नकली लैटिन
definition: placeholder Latin text used before real copy exists
example: The lorem ipsum shipped to production, where it reads better than our copy.

hindi: कमरे की सबसे ऊँची आवाज़ — जो तर्क से नहीं, ज़ोर से फ़ैसले जीतता है
definition: the person whose forceful opinions decide meetings through volume and persistence rather than evidence or data
example: We call it consensus, but really the loudest voice in the room picked the vendor.

hindi: अपेक्षा से कम काम कर पाने वाला कर्मचारी — अक्सर PIP की ओर
definition: an employee rated as underdelivering, often the first step toward a PIP
example: The new metric reclassified half the org as low performers overnight.

hindi: कम व्यक्तिगत संपर्क वाला — सीमित मानवीय बातचीत वाली ग्राहक सेवा
definition: describing customer engagement with minimal personal attention, relying mostly on automated emails, documentation and occasional scheduled check-ins
example: Their account moved to low touch the day their renewal came in under budget.

hindi: अल्प-विस्तार — मोटे तौर पर विचार परखने भर का खाका
definition: rough and sketch-like, meant to test ideas cheaply
example: Keep it low-fidelity so stakeholders comment on the flow, not the font.

hindi: आसान निशाना — कम मेहनत में मिलने वाला फ़ायदा
definition: the easiest wins available, requiring minimal effort
example: Let's grab the low-hanging fruit before redesigning the whole flow.

hindi: जानबूझकर बहुत कम पेशकश करना
definition: to offer noticeably below market, hoping the candidate doesn't know better
example: They lowballed her, then acted surprised when she had competing offers.

hindi: सबसे सस्ता समझदार किराया — नियमानुसार वाजिब सबसे कम हवाई किराया
definition: the cheapest reasonable airfare a travel policy expects employees to book, allowing for sensible times and connections
example: The lowest logical fare left at 5 a.m. with two connections, and finance called that logical.

hindi: सीमित साझेदार — वे संस्थाएँ जिनका पैसा VC फ़ंड लगाते हैं
definition: limited partner; the institutions and individuals whose money VC funds invest
example: When markets dip, even VCs have to call their LPs gently.

hindi: लाख प्रति वर्ष — भारतीय मुद्रा में वार्षिक सैलरी का माप
definition: lakhs per annum; Indian English unit for quoting annual salary packages in lakhs of rupees
example: Twelve LPA, the offer said, before listing the variable components.

hindi: दीर्घकालिक प्रोत्साहन — कई वर्षों में मिलने वाला इनाम
definition: long-term incentive; compensation such as equity grants or deferred bonuses paid across several years to reward sustained performance and retention
example: Leadership talks about the LTI the way farmers talk about monsoon: soon, probably, maybe.

hindi: आंशिक ट्रक-भार — कई ग्राहकों का माल एक ट्रक में साझा ढुलाई
definition: less than truckload; freight shipments too small to fill a trailer, consolidated with other shippers' goods
example: Shipping LTL saved money and added three surprise stops in cities nobody mentioned.

hindi: पिछले बारह महीने — हालिया एक वर्ष के आँकड़ों का लगातार योग
definition: last twelve months; financial figures summed over the most recent twelve months rather than the fiscal year, used for trailing comparisons
example: On an LTM basis we're growing, provided you start counting from our worst month.

hindi: ग्राहक जीवनकाल मूल्य — एक ग्राहक से कुल अपेक्षित कमाई
definition: lifetime value; total revenue expected from one customer
example: LTV exceeds CAC in the model, which is where it lives.

hindi: भोजन-संग-शिक्षण — लंच पर ज्ञान सत्र
definition: a talk over lunch where someone teaches the team something
example: Friday's lunch and learn covers our new billing system.

hindi: अंतिम कार्य दिवस — कंपनी में आख़िरी दिन
definition: last working day; Indian English shorthand for the final date an employee serves before exiting
example: Her LWD was Friday, and by Thursday she was already muting every channel.

hindi: पिछले साल दिया, इस साल नहीं — दोबारा जोड़े जाने योग्य पुराने दाता
definition: last year but unfortunately not this; donors who gave during the previous year but have not yet given during the current year
example: December is when the whole development team starts treating the LYBUNT report like a hostage list.

hindi: विलय और अधिग्रहण — कंपनियों की ख़रीद-फ़रोख़्त
definition: mergers and acquisitions; the business of buying and combining companies
example: The M&A team showed up, and everyone updated their resumes quietly.

hindi: निगरानी और मूल्यांकन — कार्यक्रम की प्रगति और प्रभाव को मापने का तंत्र
definition: monitoring and evaluation; the ongoing tracking of programme indicators plus periodic assessment of whether the intended outcomes and impact happened
example: M&E asked for baseline data from a project that launched three years before anyone thought of a baseline.

hindi: मशीन लर्निंग — नियम लिखने के बजाय डेटा से पैटर्न सीखना
definition: systems that learn patterns from data instead of following hand-written rules
example: It's machine learning when it works and 'the algorithm' when it doesn't.

hindi: व्यापक आर्थिक माहौल — ब्याज, महँगाई और माँग की समग्र स्थिति
definition: broad economic conditions like interest rates, inflation and consumer demand, invoked to explain results outside management's control
example: The macro environment was blamed for the miss and ignored for last year's beat.

hindi: जादुई संख्या — कोड में बिना व्याख्या पड़ा नंगा स्थिरांक
definition: an unexplained constant hardcoded where a named value should be
example: Why 86400? The magic number knows; the author doesn't.

hindi: आला-अफ़सरों का गलियारा — शीर्ष नेतृत्व के दफ़्तर, आम कर्मचारियों से दूर
definition: the executive floor or senior leadership collectively, seen as distant from everyday employees
example: The return-to-office memo came from mahogany row, which has its own parking.
