hindi: रखरखाव समय — पहले से घोषित समय जब सेवा में बदलाव या बंदी की अनुमति हो
definition: a scheduled period, announced in advance, when risky changes or planned downtime are allowed, usually at night or weekends
example: The maintenance window was two to four on Sunday morning, which explains the team's mood on Monday.

hindi: बड़ा दान — किसी एक दाता से मिलने वाला असाधारण रूप से बड़ा योगदान
definition: an unusually large donation from one individual, cultivated personally over months by senior fundraisers and leadership
example: The major gift arrived with a naming request for the building, the wing and possibly the director.

hindi: इसे उभारो — अस्पष्ट माँग कि डिज़ाइन ज़्यादा आकर्षक दिखे
definition: vague stakeholder feedback asking that a design look bolder or more exciting, without saying how
example: The client asked us to make it pop, so we made it orange, and now they want it to pop less.

hindi: ऐसी चीज़ बनाओ जो लोग चाहें — असली माँग वाले उत्पाद पर ध्यान
definition: the Y Combinator motto that building a product customers genuinely need matters more than anything else
example: The retro concluded we should make something people want, which was harder to put on a roadmap than it sounds.

hindi: लक्ष्य पूरा करना — तिमाही का वित्तीय आँकड़ा किसी भी तरह हासिल करना
definition: to reach the committed revenue or profit target for the period, often through last-minute effort
example: We made the number by pulling three deals forward, so next quarter starts in a hole.

hindi: निर्माता-समय — रचना हेतु लंबे अखंड घंटे
definition: long unbroken work blocks creators need, unlike managers' hour-sliced calendars
example: One 3 p.m. meeting can wreck an afternoon of maker time.

hindi: मानव-दिवस — एक व्यक्ति के एक दिन के काम की इकाई
definition: an effort estimation unit counting work as days of one person, used heavily in services proposals, staffing plans and billing
example: Forty man-days, the estimate said, assuming nobody takes a comp off.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे बाहर किया गया — दबाव डालकर नौकरी छुड़वाना
definition: pushed toward leaving through poor reviews, shrinking duties or pressure, instead of being fired outright
example: He wasn't fired; he was managed out over three increasingly awkward quarters.

hindi: प्रबंधन आरक्षित निधि — अनपेक्षित ज़रूरतों के लिए रोका गया बजट
definition: budget held back by leadership for unexpected needs rather than assigned to any team
example: The management reserve exists so the VP can say yes to exactly one surprise per quarter.

hindi: प्रबंधक की समय-सारणी — घंटे-घंटे की मीटिंगों में बँटा दिन
definition: a workday chopped into hourly meeting slots, contrasted with the long uninterrupted blocks makers need
example: She moved to management and her calendar switched to a manager's schedule overnight.

hindi: बिना निकाले इस्तीफे की ओर धकेलना
definition: engineering someone's exit through pressure and paperwork instead of firing them
example: No one fired him; managing out just made staying unbearable.

hindi: ऊपर की ओर प्रबंधन — अपने बॉस की ज़रूरतें, प्राथमिकताएँ और अपेक्षाएँ सँभालना
definition: deliberately shaping your relationship with your boss by anticipating their needs, priorities and expectations and communicating accordingly
example: Managing up mostly means telling her the bad news before her boss does.

hindi: अनिवार्य मनोरंजन — जबरन टीम-बिल्डिंग गतिविधि
definition: compulsory team-building activities, enjoyment attendance required
example: Thursday's mandatory fun is trivia; attendance is tracked.

hindi: मुनाफ़े का अंतर — बिक्री मूल्य में से लागत घटाकर बचा हिस्सा
definition: the share of revenue left after costs
example: Every discount comes straight out of the margin, sales.

hindi: अतिरिक्त ज़मानत की माँग — उधार पर किए निवेश में घाटा होने पर ब्रोकर का और पैसा माँगना
definition: a broker's demand for more cash when borrowed positions lose value, forcing sales otherwise
example: The margin call came Friday afternoon, right after the fund manager posted about conviction.

hindi: मुनाफ़े की दर सिकुड़ना — हर बिक्री पर मुनाफ़े का हिस्सा घटना
definition: profit margins narrowing because costs rise faster than revenue or pricing weakens, a worry on earnings calls
example: Margin compression was blamed on freight, labour, currency and, briefly, the weather.

hindi: मुनाफ़े की दर बढ़ना — हर बिक्री पर मुनाफ़े का हिस्सा बढ़ना
definition: profit margins widening because revenue grows faster than costs or costs fall, celebrated by investors
example: Margin expansion came mostly from cancelling the snacks and the roadmap.

hindi: प्रति में जोड़ना — ईमेल की कॉपी किसी को भेजना ताकि वह जानकारी में रहे
definition: an Indian English phrase for adding someone to the copied recipients line of an email so they stay informed
example: Mark my manager in cc, so the reply arrives with both urgency and politeness.

hindi: बाज़ार भाव पर आँकना — संपत्ति को आज की क़ीमत पर दर्ज करना
definition: valuing assets or holdings at their current market price rather than original purchase cost
example: Once we mark to market, the equity everyone joined for looks more like a souvenir.

hindi: बाज़ार पहुँच — बीमा और सरकारी सूची में दवा को शामिल कराना
definition: the function that secures reimbursement, pricing and coverage from payers and governments so patients can actually obtain a drug
example: Approval took eight years; market access said the harder part starts now.

hindi: बाज़ार समायोजन — बाज़ार दर तक लाने हेतु वेतन सुधार
definition: a salary increase made because pay has fallen below market rates for the role, independent of performance ratings
example: He only got a market adjustment after three teammates left for the market.

hindi: बाज़ार लचीलापन — बिक्री हेतु ऋण की शर्तें बदलने का बैंक का अधिकार
definition: the right of arranging banks to change loan pricing or terms to sell debt to investors
example: The borrower learned about market flex when the interest margin moved fifty basis points overnight.

hindi: बाज़ार आकलन — किसी बाज़ार का कुल आकार अनुमान लगाना
definition: estimating the total revenue or customer volume of a market, often from assumptions multiplied together top-down or bottom-up
example: The market sizing assumed every household buys two units, which explains the optimistic total.

hindi: मंच बाज़ार — ख़रीदार-विक्रेता को जोड़कर हर सौदे से कमीशन
definition: a platform connecting buyers and sellers and taking a cut of each transaction
example: The marketplace takes fifteen percent and, in exchange, both sides blame us.

hindi: थोक भर्तीकर्ता — हर साल हज़ारों नए स्नातक लेने वाली कंपनी
definition: in Indian English, a large services firm hiring thousands of freshers yearly across campuses, usually offering modest starting salaries
example: The mass recruiter visited on day one, and half the batch was employed by lunchtime.

hindi: मिलान दान — कर्मचारी के दान के बराबर कंपनी का अतिरिक्त योगदान
definition: an employer donation that matches an employee's personal charitable giving, often dollar for dollar up to an annual limit
example: The matching gift form took longer to complete than the donation it was matching.

hindi: महत्वपूर्ण उल्लंघन — अनुबंध की मूल शर्त का गंभीर उल्लंघन
definition: a failure serious enough to defeat the contract's core purpose, giving the other party rights to terminate or claim damages
example: Being late with one report is annoying; being late with all of them starts sounding like material breach.

hindi: गंभीर कमज़ोरी — आंतरिक नियंत्रण की ऐसी ख़ामी जिससे वित्तीय विवरण ग़लत हो सकें
definition: a serious internal-control deficiency that makes a significant misstatement in financial reports reasonably possible, requiring public disclosure
example: Disclosing a material weakness took one paragraph; explaining it to analysts took the rest of the quarter.

hindi: महत्ता आकलन — कौन-से ESG मुद्दे सबसे ज़रूरी हैं, यह तय करने की प्रक्रिया
definition: structured exercise ranking which sustainability issues matter most to stakeholders and business, deciding what gets reported
example: The materiality assessment put water scarcity eleventh, just below the office coffee survey.

hindi: दोहरी रिपोर्टिंग वाला संगठन — काम और विभाग के अलग-अलग बॉस
definition: a structure where people answer to both a functional manager and a project lead
example: In our matrix organization, I need two approvals to take Friday off.

hindi: मासिक सक्रिय उपयोगकर्ता — महीने में कम से कम एक बार आने वाले
definition: monthly active users; unique people active at least once a month
example: MAU looks great if you never ask what active means.

hindi: नियम-बाहर ख़र्च — स्वीकृत प्रक्रिया या अनुबंधों को दरकिनार कर की गई ख़रीद
definition: purchasing done outside approved contracts, suppliers or procurement processes, often on corporate cards
example: Half our software stack started as maverick spend on someone's expense report.

hindi: मासिक व्यावसायिक समीक्षा — हर महीने प्रदर्शन की समीक्षा बैठक
definition: monthly business review; a recurring leadership meeting examining monthly metrics, targets and business performance
example: Every chart in the MBR goes up and to the right, some just need creative axes.

hindi: घूमकर प्रबंधन — दफ़्तर में घूमकर टीम से सीधे मिलना और हालात जानना
definition: management by walking around; leaders informally visiting teams and workspaces to listen and spot problems firsthand
example: His MBWA consists of walking around, stopping at the coffee machine and walking back.

hindi: सात-तत्व संगठन ढाँचा — संगठन के सात जुड़े पहलुओं का तालमेल परखना
definition: a framework assessing organisational alignment across strategy, structure, systems, shared values, style, staff and skills
example: The McKinsey 7S review found all seven elements misaligned, which at least made them consistent.

hindi: बहु-चैनल नेटवर्क — कई क्रिएटरों को सौदे और सहायता देने वाली कंपनी
definition: multi-channel network; company managing many creators' channels, selling brand sponsorships and support for a revenue share
example: The MCN promised growth, took thirty percent, and sent a monthly newsletter.

hindi: मॉडल संदर्भ प्रोटोकॉल — एआई को टूल और डेटा से जोड़ने का मानक
definition: model context protocol; an open standard letting assistants connect to company tools, files and data sources through shared connectors
example: Sales asked whether the CRM has an MCP server, which is a sentence nobody said a year ago.

hindi: न्यूनतम पकड़ने योग्य असर — प्रयोग जो सबसे छोटा बदलाव भांप सके
definition: minimum detectable effect; the smallest change an experiment can reliably measure
example: Our MDE is five percent; our hoped-for lift is one.

hindi: मास्टर डेटा प्रबंधन — ग्राहक, उत्पाद जैसे मूल रिकॉर्डों की एक ही सही प्रति बनाए रखना
definition: master data management; the discipline and tooling that keeps one consistent, authoritative record for core business entities such as customers and products
example: The MDM project aims to merge our six customer lists into one, currently a seventh.

hindi: नकल जैसी दवा — पहले से मौजूद दवा जैसी ही नई दवा
definition: a drug that works through the same mechanism as an existing approved medicine, differing only slightly in chemistry or dosing
example: Marketing banned the phrase me-too drug and replaced it with 'differentiated option', which cost forty slides.

hindi: परस्पर अलग, सामूहिक रूप से संपूर्ण — हर हिस्सा अलग, पर मिलकर कुछ भी न छूटे
definition: mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive; splitting a problem into buckets that never overlap and together leave nothing out
example: The partner sent the issue tree back twice because 'other' is not a MECE category.

hindi: सौदा-योग्यता ढाँचा — मापदंड, आर्थिक खरीदार, निर्णय मानदंड व प्रक्रिया, पीड़ा और समर्थक की जाँच
definition: metrics, economic buyer, decision criteria, decision process, identify pain, champion; enterprise deal qualification framework
example: By MEDDIC standards the deal had one letter covered, and it was the champion's enthusiasm.

hindi: विस्तृत सौदा-योग्यता ढाँचा — मेडिक में कागज़ी प्रक्रिया और प्रतिस्पर्धा जोड़कर बना
definition: metrics, economic buyer, decision criteria, decision process, paper process, identify pain, champion, competition; extended deal qualification framework
example: MEDDPICC added paper process and competition, so now there are two more boxes to fill with 'TBD'.

hindi: प्रचार परिचय-पत्र — दर्शक संख्या और प्रचार दरों वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: document creators and publishers send brands showing audience size, demographics, engagement statistics and sponsorship pricing
example: The media kit rounded eleven thousand followers up to a confident fifteen.

hindi: माध्यम-मिश्रण — बजट का विभिन्न चैनलों में बँटवारा
definition: the combination of advertising channels, such as television, search, social, outdoor and print, chosen for a campaign and the budget split between them
example: The media mix is sixty percent social, because the director's nephew said television is dead.

hindi: मीटिंग के बाद की मीटिंग — जहाँ असली बातें और फ़ैसले होते हैं
definition: the informal conversation after a meeting ends, where people voice real opinions and decisions happen
example: Everyone nodded in the meeting; the real objections surfaced in the meeting after the meeting.

hindi: मीटिंग से पहले की मीटिंग — असली फ़ैसला पहले निजी बातचीत में हो जाता है
definition: a private conversation among influential decision makers held before a formal meeting where the outcome is really settled
example: The meeting before the meeting decided everything, so the meeting mostly admired the slides.

hindi: बैठक-फैलाव — मीटिंगों का धीरे-धीरे बढ़ना
definition: the gradual growth of meetings in number, length, or attendees
example: Meeting creep turned thirty minutes into an hour with twelve guests.

hindi: बैठक-स्वच्छता — एजेंडा, समयपालन और स्पष्ट नतीजे
definition: good habits like agendas, punctuality, and clear outcomes
example: Basic meeting hygiene: an agenda, an owner, an end time.

hindi: अपेक्षाओं के अनुरूप — ठीक-ठाक रेटिंग जो तारीफ नहीं लगती
definition: the middle rating; officially fine, emotionally deflating
example: A year of weekends distilled into 'meets expectations'.

hindi: मानसिक थकान उतारने की छुट्टी
definition: a day off to recover from stress rather than physical illness
example: After the launch, the whole team quietly took mental health days in shifts.

hindi: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य प्राथमिक सहायक — सहकर्मियों को संकट में शुरुआती मदद देने के लिए प्रशिक्षित कर्मचारी
definition: an employee trained to spot distress in colleagues and guide them toward professional mental health support
example: The mental health first aider had the busiest week of the year, coincidentally also review week.

hindi: मानसिक प्रतिरूप — चीज़ कैसे काम करती है इसकी उपयोगकर्ता की धारणा
definition: the user's internal idea of how something works
example: Users' mental model says trash is recoverable; our delete button thinks otherwise.

hindi: विपणन दक्षता अनुपात — कुल आय को कुल विपणन खर्च से भाग देने वाला माप
definition: marketing efficiency ratio; total business revenue divided by total marketing spend, ignoring channel attribution
example: We switched to MER the quarter every channel claimed credit for the same customer.

hindi: भाड़े का सैनिक — जो मुख्यतः पैसे और अगले बेहतर ऑफ़र के लिए काम करता है
definition: an employee or founder driven mainly by compensation and personal gain rather than belief in the mission
example: The mercenary stayed exactly until the cliff, then left for a higher offer the following morning.

hindi: मर्ज टकराव — दो लोगों के बदलाव आपस में भिड़ना
definition: when two people's changes collide and someone must reconcile them by hand
example: Nothing bonds a team like a three-way merge conflict at 6 pm.

hindi: विलय का नरक — लंबे समय से अलग पड़ी शाखाओं को जोड़ते समय टकरावों का अंबार
definition: the painful stretch of resolving endless merge conflicts when long-lived branches finally come together
example: Three teams, one release branch, two weeks of merge hell and a group chat nobody wants to open.

hindi: विलय कतार — स्वीकृत बदलावों को बारी-बारी जाँचकर मुख्य शाखा में मिलाने वाली स्वचालित कतार
definition: an automated queue that tests approved pull requests in order and merges them into the main branch one at a time
example: The merge queue is forty deep, so your one-line typo fix ships Thursday.

hindi: योग्यता वृद्धि — प्रदर्शन के आधार पर वेतन बढ़ोतरी
definition: a salary raise awarded according to performance rating rather than seniority or inflation
example: This year's merit increase was carefully calibrated to be slightly below inflation.

hindi: संदेश वापसी — भेजी ईमेल को वापस लेने की कोशिश
definition: email feature attempting to withdraw a sent message, which mostly alerts everyone to read it
example: The message recall notice made sure all two hundred people read the original.

hindi: संदेश-निर्धारण — ग्राहकों से क्या और कैसे कहना है
definition: the agreed set of words a company uses to describe itself and its value
example: Marketing spent two weeks on messaging; sales still says 'it's like email, but better.'

hindi: संदेश-भवन — मुख्य संदेश, स्तंभ और प्रमाणों का ढाँचा
definition: a one-page framework placing the core brand message at the summit, supported by message pillars and proof points underneath, so every team says the same thing
example: Three workshops later, the messaging house has a roof, four pillars and no agreement on the foundation.

hindi: सीमित मुफ़्त पहुँच — कुछ लेख मुफ़्त, फिर सदस्यता ज़रूरी
definition: paywall allowing readers a fixed number of free articles each month before requiring a subscription
example: The metered paywall allows five free articles, which our readers treat as a monthly challenge.

hindi: मध्यवर्ती वित्त — वरिष्ठ कर्ज़ और इक्विटी के बीच का महंगा पूंजी स्तर
definition: hybrid capital ranking between senior debt and equity, pricier than loans and often carrying warrants
example: Mezzanine financing closed the funding gap at a rate the CFO described only as 'character-building'.

hindi: बहु-स्तरीय पहचान जाँच — पासवर्ड के साथ फ़ोन या कोड से दूसरी पुष्टि
definition: multi-factor authentication; login requiring password plus second proof like phone approval or code
example: MFA means the laptop is secure and also useless when your phone is in the other room.

hindi: पुष्टि-अनुरोधों से थकान — बार-बार के लॉगिन संकेतों को बिना सोचे मंज़ूर कर देना
definition: employees approving endless login push prompts without thinking, which attackers exploit by spamming approval requests
example: Thirty prompts before lunch; by the thirty-first, MFA fatigue had him tapping approve on a stranger in another country.

hindi: सर्वाधिक अनुकूल शर्त — बाद में किसी को बेहतर शर्तें मिलें तो पहले निवेशक को भी
definition: most favored nation; an early investor's right to receive any better terms the company later grants other investors in similar instruments
example: Every sweetener in the new SAFE flowed straight back to the first investor through the MFN.

hindi: सूक्ष्म प्रभावक — छोटे पर सक्रिय दर्शक वर्ग वाला क्रिएटर
definition: creator with a small but highly engaged niche following, typically between ten thousand and one hundred thousand followers
example: We swapped one celebrity for forty micro-influencers and forty times the invoices.

hindi: सूक्ष्म पाठ — बटनों, फ़ॉर्मों और त्रुटियों के छोटे-छोटे शब्द
definition: the tiny words on buttons, forms, and error messages
example: Good microcopy is why users forgive you; ours says 'Error 402'.

hindi: सूक्ष्म अन्योन्यक्रिया — छोटी क्रिया पर छोटी, संतोषजनक प्रतिक्रिया
definition: a small moment of feedback, like a toggle animating on tap
example: The like-button microinteraction got two sprints; search got a shrug.

hindi: हर छोटे काम पर नियंत्रण — भरोसे की जगह निगरानी
definition: supervising every small detail instead of trusting people with outcomes
example: The micromanagement was so thorough it needed its own status meeting.

hindi: सूक्ष्म-सेवाएँ — छोटी स्वतंत्र सेवाओं में बँटा वास्तुशिल्प
definition: an architecture of many small independent services, trading one problem for a distributed one
example: We split the monolith into forty microservices and one shared outage.

hindi: मध्यम बाज़ार — छोटे और विशाल ग्राहकों के बीच का वर्ग
definition: the segment between SMB and enterprise, big enough to pay, small enough to decide
example: Mid-market: enterprise expectations, SMB budgets.

hindi: मध्य-वर्ष समीक्षा — साल के बीच प्रदर्शन की जाँच
definition: a performance check-in halfway through the review year, meant to prevent surprises at year-end
example: The mid-year review was cancelled for scheduling reasons, so the surprises were saved for December.

hindi: मील का पत्थर — परियोजना की महत्वपूर्ण पड़ाव-तिथि
definition: a significant checkpoint marking real progress in a project
example: We hit the milestone by moving the milestone.

hindi: नियमित फेरा — एक ही ट्रक का कई सप्लायरों से तय मार्ग पर माल उठाना
definition: a scheduled delivery route where one truck collects from or delivers to several suppliers on fixed loops
example: The milk run is so predictable the suppliers set their lunch breaks by it.

hindi: न्यूनतम प्रिय उत्पाद — छोटा मगर दिल जीतने लायक संस्करण
definition: the smallest version users would actually love, not merely tolerate
example: We aimed for minimum lovable product and shipped minimum, mostly.

hindi: अति आवश्यक — जिसके बिना कामकाज ठप हो जाए
definition: essential to operations; failure is not survivable
example: The spreadsheet nobody understands is, of course, mission-critical.

hindi: उद्देश्य-प्रेरित — किसी बड़े मक़सद को कंपनी की मुख्य पहचान बताने वाला
definition: describing a company that presents a larger social purpose as its core identity, sometimes invoked to justify below-market salaries
example: It's a mission-driven company, so the mission gets a slide and the salary gets a footnote.

hindi: भाड़े के सैनिक बनाम मिशनरी — पैसे के लिए या उद्देश्य के लिए काम करने वाले
definition: the contrast between employees committed to the company purpose and those motivated mainly by money, popularised by investor John Doerr
example: The CEO wanted missionaries, not mercenaries, then wondered why the missionaries kept asking about the ESOP refresh.

hindi: ध्येय-समर्पित कर्मी — जो पैसे से ज़्यादा कंपनी के उद्देश्य में विश्वास के कारण काम करता है
definition: an employee or founder driven by genuine belief in the company's mission rather than money
example: Hire missionaries, the VC said, while offering the missionaries below-market salaries.

hindi: उपशमन — जोखिम का असर घटाने की योजना
definition: the plan for softening a risk you can't eliminate
example: Our mitigation for the deadline risk is hope, documented.

hindi: एमएलऑप्स — उत्पादन में मॉडल चलाने और सँभालने की इंजीनियरिंग
definition: the engineering practice of deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning in production
example: MLOps is DevOps plus the model quietly getting worse for no visible reason.

hindi: चिकित्सा, विधि और नियामक समीक्षा — प्रचार सामग्री की अनिवार्य जाँच
definition: medical, legal and regulatory review; mandatory approval of every promotional material for accuracy and compliance before release
example: The social post was eleven words long and spent five weeks in MLR.

hindi: विपणन-मिश्रण मॉडल — किस चैनल से कितनी बिक्री आई, इसका सांख्यिकीय अनुमान
definition: marketing mix modelling; statistical analysis of historical sales and spending data that estimates how much each advertising channel contributed to revenue results
example: The MMM credited billboards with the sales spike that actually came from a festival.

hindi: गोपनीय मूल्य-प्रभावी जानकारी — ऐसी अप्रकाशित सूचना जो शेयर भाव बदल सकती है
definition: material non-public information; unreleased facts about a company that could move its share price and restrict trading
example: The deal team is over the wall and holding MNPI, so lunch conversation is now strictly about cricket.

hindi: सुरक्षा खाई — प्रतिस्पर्धियों से कारोबार बचाने वाली स्थायी बढ़त
definition: a durable advantage that protects a business from competitors
example: Our moat, according to the deck, is 'passion'; according to finance, nothing.

hindi: समूह प्रोग्रामिंग — पूरी टीम मिलकर एक ही कोड पर
definition: the whole team collaborating on one piece of code at one screen
example: Mob programming today, so bring opinions and snacks.

hindi: मोबाइल-प्रथम — छोटी स्क्रीन से डिज़ाइन शुरू करने की रीति
definition: designing for small screens first, then scaling up
example: We're mobile-first, which is why the desktop app feels like a stretched phone.

hindi: सक्रिय समर्थक — ग्राहक के भीतर वह व्यक्ति जो सौदे के लिए सहमति जुटाता है
definition: a stakeholder inside the buying account who actively builds internal consensus and drives the purchase decision forward
example: He liked our demo; a mobilizer would have booked the meeting with finance.

hindi: प्रतिरूप — स्क्रीन कैसी दिखेगी उसका स्थिर, विस्तृत चित्र
definition: a static, detailed picture of what a screen will look like
example: The mockup looks great; now someone has to actually build it.

hindi: अवरोधक संवाद-बॉक्स — बाकी स्क्रीन रोककर ध्यान माँगने वाला पॉपअप
definition: a popup that blocks the page until the user deals with it
example: A modal opened over the modal; the designer has been notified.

hindi: मॉडल — डेटा से सीखा हुआ तंत्र जो इनपुट से अनुमान या उत्तर बनाता है
definition: a trained system that turns input data into predictions or generated output
example: The new model nails squats but still thinks a lunge is a yoga pose.

hindi: मॉडल कार्ड — मॉडल का उद्देश्य, डेटा और सीमाएँ बताने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: a short document describing a model's purpose, training data, limits, and risks
example: The model card admits it struggles with pilates; respect the honesty.

hindi: बैठक का विवरण — बैठक में लिए गए निर्णयों और कार्यों का लिखित सार
definition: minutes of meeting; Indian English name for the written summary of decisions, owners and action items circulated after a meeting
example: Whoever speaks least in the meeting is somehow always the one who sends the MOM.

hindi: बंदर-पैच — चलते सिस्टम का व्यवहार बाहर से बदल देना
definition: a runtime modification of existing code from outside, powerful and regrettable
example: The monkey patch fixed the library and broke two others.

hindi: एकाश्म सिस्टम — सब कुछ एक ही बड़े ऐप में
definition: a single large application containing everything, unfashionable yet frequently victorious
example: The monolith outlived three plans to kill it.

hindi: एकल भंडार — सारा कोड एक ही रिपॉज़िटरी में
definition: one repository holding all the company's code
example: The monorepo clone takes forty minutes, great coffee culture though.

hindi: माह-अंत समापन — महीने के खाते मिलाकर बंद करने की प्रक्रिया
definition: finance's recurring process of reconciling accounts, posting entries and finalising the books after each month
example: Nobody books meetings with accounting during month-end close unless they enjoy silence.

hindi: माह-दर-माह — पिछले महीने से तुलना करके
definition: compared with the previous month
example: Month-over-month looks bad, so this review is quarterly now.

hindi: भाव-फलक — शैली की दिशा तय करने वाला चित्र-संग्रह
definition: a collage of images setting a design's visual direction
example: The moodboard is beaches and serenity; the product is expense reports.

hindi: मुख्य नौकरी के साथ-साथ दूसरा काम करना
definition: working a second job alongside your main one, often quietly
example: His side app made money, so legal called it moonlighting.

hindi: चाँद-निशाना — कम संभावना, विशाल इनाम वाला महत्वाकांक्षी दाँव
definition: a wildly ambitious project with low odds and enormous payoff
example: The moonshot got a lab, a name, and no deadline anyone believes.

hindi: न्यूनतम ऑर्डर मात्रा — विक्रेता जितनी कम से कम मात्रा बेचने को तैयार है
definition: minimum order quantity; the smallest amount a supplier will accept in a single order
example: We needed fifty mugs; the MOQ was five thousand, so the office now has a mug strategy.

hindi: मॉस्को विधि — must, should, could, won't में प्राथमिकता बाँटना
definition: prioritizing requirements into must, should, could, and won't have
example: After MoSCoW, everything landed in must, defeating the entire method.

hindi: माउस हिलाने वाला जुगाड़ — ऑनलाइन दिखने की तरकीब
definition: a device or app keeping your status active while you are away
example: The mouse jiggler keeps him green during school pickup.

hindi: तेज़ चलो, टूटे तो टूटे — रफ़्तार को स्थिरता से ऊपर रखना
definition: the ethos of prioritizing speed over stability, consequences later
example: We moved fast and broke things, mostly the login page.

hindi: असर डालना — नतीजों में दिखने लायक़ बदलाव लाना
definition: to produce a measurable, noticeable improvement
example: A new logo won't move the needle on revenue.

hindi: दाता-क़दम प्रबंधन — संभावित बड़े दाता को योजनाबद्ध संपर्कों से दान तक ले जाना
definition: planned sequence of personal contacts and touchpoints that moves a prospective donor from first introduction toward making a major gift
example: According to moves management, lunch number three is where we finally mention money.

hindi: कई हिस्सों वाला — जितने हिस्से, उतनी टूटने की जगहें
definition: the many interdependent pieces that make something fragile
example: This launch has too many moving parts and one intern.

hindi: गुप्त प्रतिलिपि में खिसकाना — परिचय कराने के बाद बातचीत से चुपचाप हटना
definition: polite email move shifting an introducer to blind copy once the introduced people start talking
example: Thanks for the intro, moving you to bcc — the kindest way to leave a thread.

hindi: मार्केटिंग द्वारा परखा संभावित ग्राहक — रुचि के संकेतों के आधार पर
definition: marketing-qualified lead — someone whose engagement suggests they may be worth sales attention
example: Downloading one ebook made me an MQL; now I get three emails a day.

hindi: बाज़ार आवश्यकता दस्तावेज़ — बाज़ार, ग्राहक और अवसर का लिखित विवरण
definition: market requirements document; a document describing target customers, market opportunity and competitive needs before product requirements are written
example: The MRD said enterprise, the PRD said consumer, and the launch said neither.

hindi: सामग्री आवश्यकता योजना — उत्पादन के लिए कब क्या कितना चाहिए, इसकी गणना
definition: material requirements planning; software calculating which components, quantities and timings production needs from demand forecasts
example: The MRP run said we needed zero screws, so we now have two thousand unfinished chairs.

hindi: मासिक आवर्ती राजस्व — हर महीने दोहराई जाने वाली कमाई
definition: monthly recurring revenue from subscriptions
example: MRR dipped, so the all-hands is now a listening tour.

hindi: मुख्य सेवा समझौता — भविष्य के सब कामों की छतरी-शर्तें
definition: master service agreement; umbrella terms covering all future work with a vendor
example: The MSA took four months; the actual project took three.

hindi: चिकित्सा विज्ञान संपर्क अधिकारी — डॉक्टरों से वैज्ञानिक चर्चा करने वाला विशेषज्ञ
definition: medical science liaison; a scientifically trained field specialist who discusses clinical data with physicians without promoting sales
example: The MSL is not allowed to sell, which is why sales keeps inviting the MSL to lunch.

hindi: विफलताओं के बीच औसत समय — कोई प्रणाली कितनी देर ठीक चलकर फिर खराब होती है
definition: mean time between failures; the average running time a system or component lasts before breaking again, used to judge reliability
example: The MTBF looked impressive until someone noticed the calculation quietly excluded weekends.

hindi: पता लगाने का औसत समय — गड़बड़ी शुरू होने से उसे पकड़ने तक का औसत समय
definition: mean time to detect; the average time between a production failure beginning and monitoring or people actually noticing it
example: Our MTTD is currently measured in customer tweets.

hindi: सुधार का औसत समय — किसी गड़बड़ी से सेवा को फिर से ठीक होने में लगने वाला औसत समय
definition: mean time to recovery; the average time between a service failure starting and the service being restored for users
example: Our MTTR improved dramatically once we started counting from when someone noticed.

hindi: व्यर्थ काम — ऐसी गतिविधि जो ग्राहक के लिए कोई मूल्य न जोड़े
definition: waste in lean thinking; any activity, motion, waiting or inventory that consumes resources without adding customer value
example: Three approval signatures for a box of pens is textbook muda.

hindi: बहु-एजेंट — मिलकर या एक-दूसरे को जाँचते हुए काम करते कई एआई
definition: several AI agents cooperating or checking each other to finish a task
example: Our multi-agent setup: one plans workouts, one checks safety, one apologizes for the others.

hindi: कई संपर्क साधना — ग्राहक कंपनी में अनेक रिश्ते बनाना
definition: building relationships with several stakeholders in an account so one departure can't kill the deal
example: Multi-threading saved the deal when our champion left for a competitor.

hindi: बहु-संपर्क श्रेय — बिक्री का श्रेय कई विज्ञापन संपर्कों में बाँटना
definition: attribution model splitting conversion credit across several touchpoints along the customer journey instead of one
example: Multi-touch attribution gave every channel partial credit, so every channel lead claimed the whole thing anyway.

hindi: बहु-माध्यम — पाठ, चित्र और ध्वनि सब एक साथ समझने वाला
definition: handling multiple input or output types — text, images, audio, video — in one model
example: The multimodal model reads your form video and roasts your lunge in writing.

hindi: गुणक संकुचन — कमाई वही रहते हुए भी मूल्यांकन गुणक का घटना
definition: when investors accept lower valuation multiples for each unit of earnings, shrinking company value even while profits hold
example: Revenue grew thirty percent and the stock fell anyway; finance blamed multiple compression and the moon.

hindi: बहु-चर परीक्षण — कई बदलावों के मेल एक साथ आज़माने वाला प्रयोग
definition: an experiment testing several element combinations at once
example: The multivariate test needs traffic we will have by 2031.

hindi: कुकुरमुत्ता प्रबंधन — कर्मचारियों को अँधेरे में रखना और जानकारी न देना
definition: a management style that keeps employees uninformed about decisions and context while expecting them to keep producing
example: We learned about the acquisition from the press release, which is peak mushroom management.

hindi: साझा कार्य योजना — खरीदार और विक्रेता की मिलकर बनी समय-सारिणी
definition: shared document where buyer and seller agree dated steps leading to signature and launch
example: The mutual action plan was very mutual: we wrote every step, and they ignored every date.

hindi: आपसी सहमति से अलगाव — दोनों ओर से मानी गई विदाई
definition: departure described as jointly agreed between employee and employer, often a negotiated dismissal
example: It was a mutual separation: the company decided, and he mutually agreed.

hindi: न्यूनतम व्यवहार्य उत्पाद — सबसे सादा संस्करण जिससे माँग परखी जाए
definition: minimum viable product; the simplest version that lets you test real demand
example: The MVP is a spreadsheet and a phone number, and it works.

hindi: एक का नमूना — सिर्फ एक उदाहरण से निकाला गया निष्कर्ष
definition: a conclusion drawn from a single example
example: The CEO's neighbor hated the onboarding; n=1 became the roadmap.

hindi: अस्वीकृति — प्रस्ताव या बदलाव से असहमति
definition: negative acknowledgement; terse reply formally rejecting a proposal, patch or request, the opposite of an approval
example: One NACK from the architect and the whole thread went quiet.

hindi: चिह्नित बड़ा ग्राहक — विशेष रणनीति वाला खाता
definition: a high-value target company assigned to a specific rep with a specific plan
example: It's a named account, which means two VPs also claim credit for it.

hindi: मूल-स्वरूप विज्ञापन — जो आसपास की सामग्री जैसा दिखे
definition: paid advertising designed to match the look and format of the surrounding editorial content on a platform
example: The native advertising blended in so well that even our own editors thought they had written it.

hindi: स्वाभाविक पलायन — खाली पद न भरकर संख्या घटाना
definition: shrinking headcount by leaving vacant positions unfilled when employees resign or retire
example: We're reducing costs through natural attrition, which means nobody gets replaced and everybody gets busier.

hindi: मार्गदर्शन ढांचा — उत्पाद में इधर-उधर जाने के रास्ते
definition: the menus and links that let users move around a product
example: If users need a tutorial for the navigation, the navigation failed.

hindi: गोपनीयता समझौता — कंपनी की जानकारी बाहर न बताने का क़रार
definition: non-disclosure agreement; a contract to keep shared information secret
example: Sign the NDA before we show you the roadmap we'll abandon.

hindi: पड़ोसी देश से काम — मिलते-जुलते समय-क्षेत्र वाले देश को काम देना
definition: outsourcing to a nearby country with overlapping working hours
example: We tried nearshoring so standup could stay in daylight.

hindi: सुधार आवश्यक — समीक्षा की निचली रेटिंग
definition: the performance rating below meets expectations, often the formal first step toward a performance improvement plan
example: 'Needs improvement' was printed in the same cheerful font as everything else in the review.

hindi: नकारात्मक छीजन — मौजूदा ग्राहकों की बढ़त का छोड़ने वालों से भारी पड़ना
definition: when expansion revenue from existing customers exceeds losses from departures
example: Negative churn is the goal; ours is aggressively positive.

hindi: वर्जित खोज-शब्द — वे शब्द जिनकी खोज पर विज्ञापन कभी नहीं दिखाना है
definition: search term deliberately excluded from campaigns so advertisements never appear for irrelevant or costly searches
example: Adding 'free' as a negative keyword saved more money than the whole optimisation roadmap.

hindi: टीम-मोहल्ला बैठक — हर टीम के लिए तय साझा मेज़ों का इलाक़ा
definition: assigning each team its own zone of shared desks so colleagues sit near each other without fixed seats
example: Neighbourhood seating means marketing now owns the corner by the snack cupboard, and guards it.

hindi: दिलचस्प जाल में फँसाना — ऐसी पहेली फेंकना कि इंजीनियर सब छोड़ बैठे
definition: to derail an engineer by presenting a problem too interesting to ignore
example: One casual puzzle nerd-sniped three engineers for an afternoon.

hindi: बिल्कुल नया — मौजूदा ग्राहकों से नहीं, नए स्रोत से आया
definition: describes revenue or customers coming from accounts never previously sold to, rather than existing customer expansion
example: The board wants net new logos, not the same five customers buying more seats.

hindi: तीस दिन में भुगतान — बिल की तारीख़ से 30 दिन की मोहलत
definition: payment terms giving the buyer thirty days after the invoice date
example: Net-30 means day 29 for them and rent day for us.

hindi: नेटवर्क प्रभाव — हर नया उपयोगकर्ता सबके लिए मूल्य बढ़ाता है
definition: when each new user makes the product more valuable for everyone else
example: Network effects are great once you have a network; therein lies the job.

hindi: तंत्रिका जाल — परतों में जुड़ी इकाइयों से बना सीखने वाला ढाँचा
definition: a model built from layers of simple units that learn patterns together
example: The neural network learned squat form from ten thousand wobbly videos.

hindi: तटस्थ संदर्भ — केवल पद और तारीख़ें पुष्टि करना, कोई राय नहीं
definition: employer reference confirming only role title and employment dates, avoiding opinions and legal exposure
example: The neutral reference confirmed she existed there between two dates, glowingly.

hindi: हाल में डिग्री पूरी कर पहली नौकरी में आया कर्मचारी
definition: an entry-level hire fresh out of university
example: The new grad fixed the flaky test everyone else had learned to ignore.

hindi: नया सदस्य — जिसने हाल ही में कंपनी जॉइन की हो
definition: an employee who has recently joined the company, regardless of experience level; standard Indian English usage
example: Please add the new joinees to the team channel before they discover the old one.

hindi: नियुक्ति अनुदान — जॉइन करते समय मिलने वाला शुरुआती इक्विटी पैकेज
definition: the initial equity package granted when someone joins, usually the largest single grant, vesting across several years
example: The recruiter spent twenty minutes on the new-hire grant and ten seconds on the actual job.

hindi: ख़बर-सवारी — ताज़ा ख़बर से जोड़कर ब्रांड का प्रचार
definition: inserting a brand into a trending news story or cultural moment with quick, topical content to gain attention and coverage
example: The newsjacking post landed perfectly, until someone read what the news story was actually about.

hindi: अच्छा-हो-तो — ज़रूरी नहीं, पर वांछनीय सुविधा
definition: a feature everyone wants and nobody will fund
example: It got labeled a nice-to-have, which is how features are euthanized.

hindi: यहाँ-का-नहीं रोग — बाहरी समाधान ठुकराकर खुद बनाना (not invented here)
definition: rejecting outside solutions to build your own, because it wasn't invented here
example: Classic NIH syndrome: we rebuilt the database, badly.

hindi: नौ-खाना ग्रिड — प्रदर्शन और संभावना से कर्मचारियों का वर्गीकरण
definition: a talent matrix plotting employees by current performance against future potential, used in succession planning
example: He learned from the nine-box grid that leadership considered him high performance, moderate potential and slightly mysterious.

hindi: निंजा डेवलपर — चुपचाप कमाल दिखाने वाले का चलताऊ (अब व्यंग्य) खिताब
definition: ironic job-ad title for a developer with quietly magical skills
example: We hired a code ninja; he vanished, like a real ninja.

hindi: छोटी-सी आपत्ति — समीक्षा में मामूली, न रोकने वाली टिप्पणी
definition: a trivial review comment the author may fix or ignore without blocking approval
example: Nit: extra blank line on 42. Otherwise LGTM.

hindi: प्राकृतिक भाषा संसाधन — मशीन से इंसानी भाषा समझवाने का क्षेत्र
definition: natural language processing; the field of making software understand human language
example: Before LLMs, our NLP was a regex file everyone was afraid to open.

hindi: इससे देर नहीं — अंतिम समय-सीमा, इसके बाद नहीं
definition: no later than; phrasing that marks a firm deadline, with delivery expected before that point
example: Send comments NLT Thursday noon, which everyone read as Thursday 11:59.

hindi: उत्तर की आवश्यकता नहीं — सिर्फ़ जानकारी के लिए भेजा गया संदेश
definition: no need to reply; email tag telling recipients the message is informational and needs no response
example: She marked it NNTR, then asked in standup why nobody had responded.

hindi: कुछ करना नहीं — केवल सूचना
definition: reassurance that this message is purely informational, breathe easy
example: Weekly status attached, no action needed unless something looks wrong.

hindi: एजेंडा नहीं तो मीटिंग नहीं — बिना विषय के बैठक अस्वीकार
definition: a team rule that meeting invitations lacking written agendas may be declined without guilt
example: We adopted no agenda, no meeting, and now agendas just say 'discuss'.

hindi: अनिर्णय — ग्राहक ने कुछ भी न खरीदने का फ़ैसला किया
definition: deal outcome where the buyer chooses nothing, keeping their existing arrangement instead of any vendor
example: We didn't lose to a competitor; we lost to no decision, which has an excellent sales team.

hindi: अदेयता प्रमाण पत्र — हर विभाग से कोई बकाया न होने की पुष्टि
definition: in Indian English, exit clearance confirming a leaving employee owes nothing to finance, admin or information technology
example: Getting the no dues certificate took longer than serving the entire notice period.

hindi: सिर्फ़ 'नमस्ते' नहीं — अभिवादन के साथ ही सवाल लिखना
definition: chat etiquette asking people to include their question with the greeting instead of sending a bare 'hi'
example: He linked the no hello page in reply to 'hi', which took longer than answering.

hindi: कोई बात नहीं — सहमति या अनुमति देने का सहज तरीका
definition: an Indian English reply signalling agreement, permission or acceptance that something is fine and needs nothing further
example: No issues, he said, which is also what he said about the outage.

hindi: बिना क्रय आदेश भुगतान नहीं — बिना स्वीकृत आदेश के आए बिल का भुगतान रोकने की नीति
definition: procurement policy that invoices arriving without a matching approved purchase order will not be paid
example: The vendor learned about no PO, no pay the day their invoice bounced for the third time.

hindi: बिना सोचे हाँ — इतना साफ़ फ़ैसला कि सोचना न पड़े
definition: a decision so obvious it needs no thought
example: Fixing the checkout bug first is a no-brainer.

hindi: बैठक-मुक्त दिवस — पूरे दिन कोई मीटिंग नहीं
definition: a weekday the team keeps free of all meetings
example: Wednesday is no-meeting day, except for the exceptions.

hindi: अन्य खरीदार निषेध — विक्रेता को दूसरी बोलियाँ मांगने से रोकने वाली धारा
definition: a clause barring a seller from soliciting competing offers once a merger agreement is signed
example: Under the no-shop the CEO had to stop answering calls from anyone with 'Capital' in their name.

hindi: कहीं और न जाने की शर्त — टर्म शीट के बाद दूसरे निवेशकों से बात पर रोक
definition: a term sheet provision barring founders from soliciting other investors or offers during an exclusivity period while diligence runs
example: The no-shop clause arrived thirty minutes before a better offer did.

hindi: ग़ैरहाज़िर — स्वीकार करके भी न आने वाला
definition: someone who accepts a meeting and never appears
example: The organizer was the no-show, which is a bold move.

hindi: नेटवर्क संचालन केंद्र — चौबीसों घंटे सिस्टम और नेटवर्क पर नज़र रखने वाली टीम
definition: network operations centre; a team or room that monitors systems and networks around the clock and raises alerts
example: The NOC called to ask whether the red screens were intentional.

hindi: नामांकन समिति — नए निदेशक चुनने और बोर्ड संचालन देखने वाली समिति
definition: the board committee that identifies director candidates, oversees succession and reviews governance practices, often called nomgov
example: The nominating committee's search for fresh perspectives ended, somehow, at the same golf club.

hindi: अशुल्क — ऐसा काम जिसका पैसा किसी ग्राहक से नहीं वसूला जाता
definition: describes consultant hours spent on internal work, proposals or training that cannot be charged to clients
example: Recruiting, mentoring and the offsite were all non-billable, and all mandatory.

hindi: न रोकने वाला — ऐसी समीक्षा टिप्पणी जो सुझाव है, विलय की शर्त नहीं
definition: describing a review comment offered as a suggestion that does not need resolving before the pull request merges
example: Non-blocking, but have you considered rewriting the whole thing in a different language?

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धा-निषेध — प्रतिद्वंद्वी के यहाँ काम करने पर रोक की शर्त
definition: a clause restricting you from joining or starting a competitor
example: His non-compete covers an industry he's eager to leave anyway.

hindi: गैर-मुख्य संपत्तियाँ — बेचने लायक़ मानी गई इकाइयाँ
definition: businesses or holdings management considers outside its main strategy, typically candidates for sale or closure
example: Last year's bold acquisition is this year's non-core assets.

hindi: बिना सौदे का निवेशक दौरा — बिना शेयर बेचे निवेशकों से मिलने की यात्रा
definition: management tour meeting institutional investors across cities without raising capital, purely to build relationships and support valuation
example: Six cities in four days on a non-deal roadshow, selling nothing except the same story.

hindi: अनियत — एक ही सवाल पर हर बार अलग जवाब देने वाला
definition: giving different outputs for the same input, as language models often do
example: The bug isn't reproducible because the model is non-deterministic — QA loves that.

hindi: निंदा न करने की शर्त — पूर्व नियोक्ता की सार्वजनिक बुराई न करने का वचन
definition: a clause, common in severance and settlement agreements, forbidding someone from publicly criticizing the company or its leadership
example: Thanks to the non-disparagement clause, his farewell post described the company as a truly unique learning experience.

hindi: गैर-कार्यकारी निदेशक — बोर्ड में बैठने वाला पर रोज़मर्रा प्रबंधन से दूर सदस्य
definition: a board member who oversees and advises management without holding a day-to-day operating role, common in British and Indian English
example: The non-executive director asked the one question nobody in management had rehearsed an answer for.

hindi: गैर-मानक आँकड़े — प्रबंधन द्वारा समायोजित वित्तीय माप
definition: describing financial figures adjusted by management outside standard accounting rules, typically excluding stock compensation and non-recurring charges
example: The non-GAAP profit was lovely, largely because it excluded everything that cost money.

hindi: साधारण वरीयता शेयर — या तो पैसा वापस या आम शेयर में बदलना, दोनों नहीं
definition: preferred stock whose holders choose either their liquidation preference or conversion into common shares, but never both payouts
example: Their lawyer called non-participating preferred the boring, fair version, which in term sheets counts as high praise.

hindi: अखेदजनक पलायन — ऐसे लोगों का जाना जिनके जाने से कंपनी को फ़र्क नहीं पड़ता
definition: departures of employees the company was content to lose, often weaker performers or roles planned away
example: HR counted his exit as non-regrettable attrition, which he found in the leaked slide.

hindi: न लुभाने की शर्त — एक-दूसरे के कर्मचारी या ग्राहक न तोड़ने का वचन
definition: a clause barring a party or departing employee from recruiting the other side's staff or poaching its customers for a period
example: The non-solicit lasted twelve months, so the recruiter's LinkedIn message arrived on day three hundred sixty-six.

hindi: असामान्य शर्तें — मानक अनुबंध से हटकर माँगी गई शर्तें
definition: contract clauses requested by a buyer that differ from the company template and need legal or finance approval
example: The customer's non-standard terms included unlimited liability and a pony.

hindi: सिरे से ख़ारिज — ऐसा प्रस्ताव जो शुरू ही नहीं हो सकता
definition: an idea with no chance of acceptance
example: Doubling the budget is a non-starter this quarter.

hindi: रेटिंग समायोजन — टीमों की रेटिंग को तय वितरण में बिठाना
definition: in Indian English, the appraisal step where managers adjust ratings across teams to match the mandated bell curve
example: His rating went in as a four and came out of normalization as a three with no explanation attached.

hindi: ध्रुव तारा — दिशा दिखाने वाला सबसे बड़ा लक्ष्य
definition: the single guiding goal everything else should serve
example: Weekly active users is our north star, until the next offsite.

hindi: ध्रुवतारा सुविधा — उत्पाद की पहचान बनाने वाली केंद्रीय खूबी
definition: the defining capability a product is known and chosen for
example: Search is our north-star feature, which is awkward given its results.

hindi: ध्रुवतारा मापदंड — कंपनी की असली प्रगति दिखाने वाला एक प्रमुख आँकड़ा
definition: the single metric a company treats as its truest measure of value delivered
example: We changed our north-star metric twice this year, which says something.

hindi: यहाँ नहीं बना — बाहर बनी चीज़ को ठुकराकर सब कुछ ख़ुद बनाने की ज़िद
definition: the reflex of rejecting outside tools or libraries and rebuilding them in-house because someone else wrote them
example: Pure not invented here: we now maintain our own date library, and it thinks February has thirty days.

hindi: नोट कर लिया — सुना, मानना अलग बात
definition: message received and filed; agreement not included
example: Noted. I'll raise it again when the budget reopens.

hindi: नोटिस अवधि की भरपाई — नई कंपनी द्वारा बची नोटिस अवधि का भुगतान
definition: in Indian English, compensating the previous employer for the remaining notice period so a newly hired employee joins sooner
example: The new employer offered a notice buyout, and suddenly his handover took four days.

hindi: इस्तीफे और आख़िरी दिन के बीच की अवधि
definition: the time between resigning and your actual last day
example: Her notice period was two weeks of handover and goodbye lunches.

hindi: नोटिस अवधि ख़रीद — जल्दी छोड़ने के लिए बची अवधि का भुगतान
definition: in Indian English, paying the employer to waive the remaining notice period, often funded by the next employer, so the employee joins sooner
example: The recruiter offered a notice period buyout, clearly more eager than his current manager to see him go.

hindi: नवीनता प्रभाव — सिर्फ नएपन की वजह से आया अस्थायी उछाल
definition: a temporary lift caused by newness rather than lasting value
example: Week one loved it; the novelty effect resigned by week three.

hindi: अभी-अगला-बाद कार्य-योजना — तारीख़ों की जगह प्राथमिकता वाले तीन खाने
definition: a roadmap format grouping product work into current, upcoming and future columns instead of committing to specific dates
example: The now-next-later roadmap worked beautifully until sales asked when 'later' was.

hindi: कोई बात नहीं — सहर्ष स्वीकृति
definition: no problem — an easy yes, or a gracious you're-welcome
example: NP, I'll swap my slot with yours.

hindi: नेट प्रमोटर स्कोर — ग्राहक सिफारिश करने को कितने तैयार, इसका पैमाना
definition: net promoter score; how likely customers are to recommend you
example: NPS rose two points, so the survey link moved above the fold.

hindi: उत्तर अपेक्षित नहीं — जवाब देने की ज़रूरत नहीं, केवल सूचना
definition: no reply necessary; email subject tag telling recipients the message is purely informational and expects no response
example: Subject: Office closed Friday (NRN) — which is why nobody replied, and why forty people replied anyway.

hindi: शुद्ध राजस्व प्रतिधारण — मौजूदा ग्राहकों से बचा और बढ़ा राजस्व
definition: net revenue retention; revenue kept and grown from existing customers
example: NRR above one hundred means expansion is outrunning churn, briefly.

hindi: गैर-योग्य स्टॉक विकल्प — सामान्य कर वाले शेयर विकल्प
definition: non-qualified stock option; a stock option taxed as ordinary income on exercise, often granted to advisors and contractors
example: Advisors get NSOs and a standing invitation to the offsite they never attend.

hindi: इससे अधिक नहीं — ख़र्च की ऊपरी सीमा जिसे विक्रेता पार नहीं कर सकता
definition: not to exceed; the maximum amount a purchase order or contract allows a supplier to bill
example: The estimate was eighty thousand with an NTE of a hundred, so the invoice came in at ninety-nine.

hindi: जानने की ज़रूरत — केवल ज़रूरी लोगों तक सीमित जानकारी
definition: need to know; restriction limiting sensitive information only to people whose work requires it
example: The reorg was strictly NTK, so naturally the whole floor knew by lunch.

hindi: हल्के से याद दिलाना — बिना डाँटे टोकना
definition: to gently remind someone about something they have not done yet
example: Nudge me on Thursday if I haven't replied by then.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे रुचि पकाना — लीड को ख़रीदने लायक़ तैयार करना
definition: to keep unready leads warm with helpful content until they can buy
example: We're nurturing that lead, which is marketing for 'emailing them monthly forever.'

hindi: आपत्तियों का जवाब — ग्राहक की शंकाएँ दूर करना
definition: responding to a prospect's concerns about price, timing, or competitors without flinching
example: Objection handling 101: 'too expensive' usually means 'convince me it's worth it.'

hindi: अवलोकन क्षमता — लॉग, मेट्रिक्स और ट्रेस से सिस्टम के अंदर की हालत समझ पाना
definition: how well engineers can understand what a running system is doing from its logs, metrics and traces
example: We invested heavily in observability and can now watch the outage in stunning detail.

hindi: अपतटीय विकास केंद्र — एक ही ग्राहक के लिए अलग सुरक्षित कार्य-क्षेत्र
definition: offshore development centre; a secured dedicated floor or team inside a services company working exclusively for a single client
example: Phones stay outside the ODC, so all the gossip happens by the lift.

hindi: समग्र उपकरण प्रभावशीलता — मशीन की उपलब्धता, गति और गुणवत्ता का संयुक्त माप
definition: overall equipment effectiveness; availability times performance times quality, measuring how productively a machine actually runs
example: The plant boasts great OEE because nobody logs the downtime during lunch.

hindi: ब्रांड से बेमेल — पहचान या लहजे के विपरीत
definition: inconsistent with a brand's guidelines, voice, visual identity or values, so it feels wrong for the company to publish
example: Comic Sans on the investor deck was declared off-brand, and possibly a resignation letter.

hindi: एक-का-हेरफेर — गिनती में ठीक एक से चूकने की क्लासिक भूल
definition: the classic error of counting one too many or too few
example: The two hard problems: naming, cache invalidation, and off-by-one errors.

hindi: खुला भर्ती अभियान — किसी भी कॉलेज के स्नातकों के लिए कॉलेज से बाहर आयोजित
definition: in Indian English, a recruitment event open to graduates from any college, held outside the campus placement process
example: Two thousand candidates turned up to the off-campus drive for forty seats and one working projector.

hindi: चक्र से बाहर पदोन्नति — सामान्य समीक्षा समय के बाहर तरक्की
definition: a promotion granted outside the scheduled review period, usually to retain someone holding a competing offer
example: Nothing produces an off-cycle promotion faster than a competitor's offer letter.

hindi: बेमौसम वेतन वृद्धि — सालाना चक्र के बाहर दी गई बढ़ोतरी
definition: a salary increase granted outside the regular annual review, typically to retain someone or correct underpayment
example: You can get an off-cycle raise in two ways: excellent work or a competing offer, and only one works.

hindi: अनधिकृत उपयोग वाला — स्वीकृति से बाहर की बीमारी में दवा का प्रयोग
definition: describing prescribing a drug for conditions, doses or patients outside its approved labeling, which companies must never promote
example: Sales asked whether they could mention the off-label data if the doctor asked first, and compliance aged a decade.

hindi: विदा हो रहे कर्मचारी से एक्सेस और सामान वापस लेने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the process of removing a departing employee's access, badge, and responsibilities
example: Offboarding took ten minutes; getting laptop access had taken three weeks.

hindi: प्रस्ताव स्वीकृति दर — दिए गए प्रस्तावों में स्वीकार हुए प्रतिशत
definition: a recruiting metric showing what percentage of extended offers candidates actually accept
example: The offer acceptance rate dropped the week the office announced five days onsite.

hindi: प्रस्ताव मोलभाव — कई ऑफ़र जुटाकर बेहतर पैकेज निकलवाना
definition: in Indian English, collecting multiple offers to negotiate a higher package elsewhere
example: She was offer shopping, and our letter was simply leverage for her current employer.

hindi: खुला परामर्श समय — कोई भी सवाल लेकर आ सकता है
definition: a standing open slot where anyone can drop in with questions
example: Bring your API questions to the platform team's office hours.

hindi: दफ़्तरी घरेलू काम — नोट्स लेना, पार्टी आयोजन जैसे अदृश्य, बिना श्रेय वाले काम
definition: necessary but unrewarded tasks like note-taking, party planning and scheduling that fall disproportionately on some employees
example: Taking minutes for the fifth meeting running, she logged it as office housework in her self-review.

hindi: दफ़्तर की माँ — जो सबके जन्मदिन, स्नैक्स और भावनात्मक देखभाल सँभालती है
definition: a colleague, usually a woman, who informally handles birthdays, snacks and everyone's emotional care, unpaid and unpromoted
example: The office mom remembered everyone's birthday; the promotion committee did not remember hers.

hindi: दफ़्तर की गुटबाज़ी और प्रभाव का खेल
definition: the informal maneuvering for influence that no org chart shows
example: He said he stays out of office politics, which is itself a strategy.

hindi: दफ़्तर-प्रथम — जहाँ दफ़्तर में काम डिफ़ॉल्ट है और घर से काम अपवाद
definition: describing a company where working from the office is the default and remote work needs special approval
example: We are office-first, explained the manager, dialling in from his holiday home.

hindi: विदेश में काम कराना — लागत घटाने को काम दूसरे देश ले जाना
definition: moving work to another country, usually to cut costs
example: Offshoring saved money until the timezone math arrived.

hindi: बाहरी बैठक — दफ़्तर से दूर रणनीति और टीम-जुड़ाव
definition: a work retreat away from the office for strategy or bonding
example: The strategy emerged at the offsite; it stayed there too.

hindi: लक्ष्य और मुख्य परिणाम — प्रगति नापने का ढांचा
definition: objectives and key results; a goal paired with measurable outcomes
example: The OKR promised a retention lift; the dashboard disagrees.

hindi: एकमात्र अहम मीट्रिक — इस दौर में ध्यान देने लायक एक ही आँकड़ा
definition: one metric that matters; single metric a product team focuses on during a given stage to avoid chasing competing numbers
example: The OMTM changed three times this quarter, which is two more than one.

hindi: काम पर लग गया — ज़िम्मा ले लिया
definition: confirmation that you've taken the task and started
example: On it — fix going out within the hour.

hindi: नज़र में है — ध्यान में है, भले अभी कार्रवाई न हो
definition: known and being tracked, though not yet acted on
example: The bug is on my radar, right behind forty other things.

hindi: हमारा दस्तावेज़ — सौदा अपने ही अनुबंध टेम्पलेट पर करवाना
definition: negotiation shorthand for using your own company's contract template rather than the counterparty's, which controls the starting terms
example: We'll only agree to the pilot if it's on our paper, said the lawyer who wrote our paper.

hindi: बिना परियोजना — किसी ग्राहक काम पर न लगा सलाहकार
definition: a consultant currently between client projects, paid but not assigned, waiting to be staffed
example: Three weeks on the beach and he'd reformatted every template the firm owns.

hindi: एक राय पर — सबकी समझ एक जैसी होना
definition: sharing the same understanding
example: Quick call to make sure we're on the same page?

hindi: पटरी पर — योजना के अनुसार चल रहा
definition: proceeding according to plan, or at least reported that way
example: We're on track, assuming the track moves with us.

hindi: ब्रांड के अनुरूप — पहचान, लहजे और दिशानिर्देशों से मेल खाता
definition: consistent with a brand's guidelines, voice, visual identity and values, and therefore acceptable to publish without correction
example: The slide is on-brand in every respect except the content.

hindi: आपात ड्यूटी — तय अवधि में अलर्ट सँभालने की ज़िम्मेदारी
definition: the rotation duty of answering production alerts, day or night
example: I'm on-call this week, so my phone sleeps closer than my spouse.

hindi: डिवाइस-स्थित — बिना सर्वर भेजे फ़ोन या घड़ी पर ही प्रोसेसिंग
definition: running entirely on the user's phone or watch, no server round trip
example: Pose analysis is on-device now: faster, private, and immune to airplane mode.

hindi: नए कर्मचारी को काम और संस्कृति से परिचित कराने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the process of settling a new hire into their role, tools, and team
example: Her onboarding was a laptop, forty Slack channels, and a wiki last updated in 2021.

hindi: प्रारंभिक परिचय क्रम — नए उपयोगकर्ता को उत्पाद से जोड़ने वाले पहले कदम
definition: the guided first-use steps that turn a signup into an active user
example: Our onboarding flow asks twelve questions before showing any value.

hindi: एक दूर, सब दूर — यदि एक भी व्यक्ति रिमोट है तो सभी अपने लैपटॉप से जुड़ें
definition: rule that if even one participant joins remotely, everyone joins the meeting from their own laptop
example: We follow one remote, all remote, so six people sit in one room wearing headphones and talking to their screens.

hindi: एक ही जवाबदेह — किसी काम की पूरी ज़िम्मेदारी एक व्यक्ति या वेंडर पर
definition: a single person or vendor held fully accountable for a project, so blame has one clear destination
example: Procurement loved the single-vendor deal mostly for the one throat to choke.

hindi: आमने-सामने बैठक — प्रबंधक और सदस्य की निजी मीटिंग
definition: a recurring private meeting between two people, usually manager and report
example: Bring the promotion question to our one-on-one on Thursday.

hindi: आपके प्रबंधक का प्रबंधक — एक स्तर ऊपर का बॉस
definition: your manager's manager, the next level up the chain
example: The promo needs sign-off from your one-over-one, so be visible.

hindi: एक-पन्ना सार — पूरे प्रस्ताव का एक पृष्ठ का ख़ाका
definition: a single-page summary of a proposal, usually four pages long
example: Send a one-pager the VP can read in the elevator.

hindi: एक ही बार में कर देना — बिना सुधार के पहले प्रयास में सफल
definition: for a model to complete a task correctly in a single attempt, without follow-up prompts or corrections
example: The assistant one-shotted the landing page, then took eleven tries to centre the button.

hindi: एकमुश्त शुल्क — असामान्य खर्च जिसे दोहराया न जाने वाला बताया जाता है
definition: an expense presented as unusual and non-recurring, such as restructuring or litigation, often excluded from adjusted earnings
example: This is our fourth one-time charge in two years, which makes it a fairly regular one-time.

hindi: एक-से-अनेक — एक साथ कई ग्राहकों तक पहुँचने वाली सेवा
definition: describing customer success programs that serve many accounts together through webinars, newsletters and group training instead of individual attention
example: The one-to-many webinar had two hundred registrants and nine attendees, including us.

hindi: एकतरफ़ा दरवाज़ा — ऐसा फ़ैसला जिसे पलटना लगभग असंभव हो
definition: decision that is costly or impossible to reverse, deserving slow, careful deliberation before anyone commits
example: Renaming the company is a one-way door; renaming the Slack channel was apparently one too.

hindi: अंतिम चरण की लंबी इंटरव्यू-शृंखला, अब अक्सर वीडियो पर
definition: the final multi-hour interview round, historically in-office, now often virtual
example: The onsite ran five hours; lunch was the only round she passed comfortably.

hindi: ग्राहक-स्थल समन्वयक — ग्राहक के पास बैठकर भारतीय टीम से जोड़ने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: in Indian English, the team member stationed at the client location, relaying requirements and escalations between client and offshore team
example: The onsite coordinator translates 'this is completely broken' into 'minor observations from client'.

hindi: विदेश तैनाती का अवसर — ग्राहक के देश में जाकर काम करने का मौका
definition: in Indian English, a chance to work at the client location abroad, prized for salary, allowances and visa experience
example: He was promised an onsite opportunity at every appraisal for five years running.

hindi: स्थानीय-विदेशी ढाँचा — कुछ लोग ग्राहक के पास, बाक़ी काम कम लागत वाले देश में
definition: delivery setup, common in Indian English IT services, placing a small team at the client and most work offshore
example: In the onsite-offshore model, his day ended when the client's began.

hindi: देखो-समझो-तय करो-करो चक्र — तेज़ी से बदलती स्थिति में फ़ैसले का चक्र
definition: observe, orient, decide, act; a rapid decision cycle for acting faster than competitors in changing conditions
example: Our OODA loop is fine; it's just stuck on orient since March.

hindi: दफ़्तर से बाहर — छुट्टी पर, पहुँच से दूर
definition: out of office — away from work and, in theory, not reading this
example: I'm OOO next week, so please panic responsibly.

hindi: खुला नामांकन — साल में एक बार लाभ योजनाएँ चुनने की अवधि
definition: the yearly window when employees choose or change health insurance, retirement and other benefit plans
example: Open enrollment is when everyone becomes an insurance actuary for exactly two weeks.

hindi: खुला कार्यालय — दीवार-रहित, सहयोग और शोर दोनों
definition: an office layout without walls, built for collaboration and noise
example: The open floor plan is great, say the people with offices.

hindi: खुला भर्ती पद — स्वीकृत पर अभी तक न भरा गया पद
definition: an approved headcount requisition that recruiters are actively working but has not yet been filled
example: We have six open reqs, which the team interprets as six reasons to wait.

hindi: मंच खोलना — सबको बोलने का न्योता
definition: to invite anyone present to speak or ask questions
example: I'll open the floor after the demo; be gentle.

hindi: खुला मॉडल — डाउनलोड होकर अपने सर्वर पर चल सकने वाला मॉडल
definition: a model whose trained parameters are published for download so companies can host and modify it themselves
example: Security wanted everything on premises, so we switched to open weights and bought a small heater.

hindi: अगले स्तर पर काम करना — तरक्की से पहले ऊँचे पद जैसा काम
definition: already performing the responsibilities of the level above, the usual requirement before promotion is granted
example: She was operating at the next level for two years, which management found very cost-effective.

hindi: परिचालन नकद प्रवाह — मूल कारोबार से वास्तव में आई नकदी
definition: cash actually generated by core business operations during a period, after working capital movements and before investment spending
example: Profits were up, operating cash flow was down, and the CFO calmly asked who had been booking revenue early.

hindi: परिचालन उत्तोलन — स्थिर लागत के कारण बिक्री बढ़ने पर मुनाफ़ा तेज़ी से बढ़ना
definition: how much profit grows faster than revenue because fixed costs stay flat while sales increase
example: The investor deck promised operating leverage; the hiring plan promised the opposite.

hindi: परिचालन उत्कृष्टता — कामकाज को लगातार कुशल और भरोसेमंद बनाना
definition: running business processes efficiently and reliably at scale, often the label on cost-cutting and process standardisation programmes
example: The operational excellence team's first deliverable was a twelve-step approval flow.

hindi: अमल में लाना — विचार को रोज़मर्रा की प्रक्रिया बनाना
definition: to turn an idea into repeatable day-to-day process
example: Great vision — now who will operationalize it?

hindi: संचालक — कंपनी को सचमुच चलाने-बढ़ाने का अनुभव रखने वाला
definition: someone who has actually run and scaled companies, not just invested or advised
example: We wanted an operator on the board, not another spreadsheet enthusiast.

hindi: परिचालन ख़र्च — कारोबार रोज़ चलाने की लागत
definition: operating expenses; the ongoing costs of running the business
example: Cloud bills are opex, which is why finance reads our dashboards.

hindi: आग्रही डिज़ाइन — एक सही तरीका चुनकर बाकी विकल्प हटा देना
definition: deliberately supporting one right way instead of endless options
example: The tool is opinionated, and its opinion of your workflow is low.

hindi: संभावित सौदा — बिक्री-क्रम में दर्ज सक्रिय प्रस्ताव
definition: a potential deal formally tracked in the pipeline with a stage and a value
example: It became an opportunity the moment the prospect said 'interesting.'

hindi: सुधार का क्षेत्र — कमज़ोरी का विनम्र नाम
definition: review euphemism for a weakness or skill the employee is failing at and must improve
example: His opportunity area was listed as 'communication,' which his manager communicated by email a week late.

hindi: अवसर-आकलन — किसी समस्या को हल करने से कितना मूल्य मिलेगा, उसका अनुमान
definition: estimating how much revenue, usage or customer value solving a particular problem could unlock before committing to build
example: Opportunity sizing put the market at a billion dollars, using a spreadsheet with generous assumptions.

hindi: अवसर-समाधान वृक्ष — लक्ष्य से ग्राहक-अवसरों और फिर समाधानों तक की शाखाएँ
definition: a visual discovery framework linking a desired outcome to customer opportunities, then candidate solutions and experiments for each
example: Our opportunity solution tree had one opportunity and nine solutions, all of them the founder's.

hindi: सहमति-आधारित डेटा — उपयोगकर्ता की स्पष्ट हाँ के बाद ही लिया गया डेटा
definition: data collected only after users explicitly agree to share it
example: The health model trains on opt-in data only, which legal mentions in every meeting.

hindi: छवि — बात सही हो या न हो, दिखती कैसी है
definition: how a decision looks to others, regardless of its merits
example: Cutting free coffee saved little, but the optics were terrible.

hindi: कर्मचारी शेयर कोष — भावी कर्मचारियों के लिए अलग रखे शेयर
definition: shares set aside to grant future employees, usually carved out before a round
example: The investors asked us to enlarge the option pool from our side.

hindi: विकल्प कोष की चाल — नया कर्मचारी कोष निवेश-पूर्व मूल्यांकन में जोड़कर संस्थापकों का हिस्सा घटाना
definition: the practice of sizing a fresh employee option pool into the valuation before investment, quietly diluting founders instead of incoming investors
example: The headline valuation looked generous until the option pool shuffle took twelve percent off the founders' side of the table.

hindi: मौखिक प्रस्तुति — बोली के अंतिम चरण में ग्राहक के सामने प्रस्तुतीकरण
definition: final-stage presentation where shortlisted firms pitch their proposal in person to the client
example: The orals went perfectly until the client asked who would actually do the work.

hindi: क्रय आदेश पत्र — मुख्य अनुबंध के तहत कीमत व मात्रा तय करने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: the short signed document under a master agreement listing products, quantities, pricing and term for a specific purchase
example: The MSA took three months; each order form after it takes a single DocuSign.

hindi: माँग दर्ज करने वाला विक्रेता — जो बेचता नहीं, बस ग्राहक की माँग लिख लेता है
definition: a salesperson who passively processes customer requests rather than actively selling, shaping or expanding deals
example: He calls himself a strategic seller, but he is an order taker with a nice lanyard.

hindi: संगठन का ढांचा-चित्र — कौन किसे रिपोर्ट करता है
definition: the diagram of who reports to whom across a company
example: The product shipped late, so everyone studied the org chart for clues.

hindi: बिना विज्ञापन मिला — स्वाभाविक रूप से आया ट्रैफ़िक
definition: reached without paid promotion, via search, sharing, or word of mouth
example: Organic traffic doubled after we accidentally ranked for someone else's brand.

hindi: स्वाभाविक वृद्धि — अधिग्रहण के बिना अपने कारोबार से बढ़त
definition: revenue growth from existing business operations, excluding acquisitions and currency effects, investors' preferred measure of health
example: Total growth was twenty percent; organic growth was a rounding error.

hindi: कारोबार-श्रेय — नया ग्राहक या सौदा लाने का आधिकारिक श्रेय
definition: credit a partner receives for bringing new client business into the firm, tied to compensation
example: Two partners claimed origination on the deal, and neither had attended the pitch.

hindi: दुर्लभ रोग दर्जा — दुर्लभ बीमारी की दवा को मिलने वाली विशेष छूटें
definition: regulatory status for drugs treating rare diseases, granting market exclusivity, reduced fees and incentives to developers
example: Somehow the portfolio held six orphan designations and one very large common disease sliced into subtypes.

hindi: लक्ष्य पूरा होने पर कुल कमाई — बिक्री भूमिकाओं का वेतन-गणित
definition: on-target earnings; base plus commission if you hit full quota
example: OTE assumed a quota only two reps had ever hit.

hindi: समय पर और पूरा — सही समय पर पूरी मात्रा पहुँचाने का माप
definition: on time in full; the delivery metric counting orders that arrived both by the promised date and complete
example: The retailer fines us for every OTIF miss, including the ones that arrive early.

hindi: दूसरी ओर — विपरीत पक्ष या विकल्प रखना
definition: on the other hand; shorthand introducing a counterpoint or alternative view within the same message
example: It's cheaper; OTOH it's also on fire.

hindi: संपर्क से बाहर — कुछ समय के लिए अनुपलब्ध होना
definition: unreachable or unavailable for a period; also paying personally
example: I'm out of pocket Friday afternoon for a flight.

hindi: दायरे से बाहर — जो इस काम में शामिल नहीं
definition: explicitly not included in the current work, however much anyone wishes
example: Great idea; it's out of scope, which is where great ideas live.

hindi: अनुपस्थिति का स्वतः जवाब — छुट्टी की स्वचालित सूचना
definition: the automatic email saying you're away and naming your unlucky backup
example: His out-of-office reply names a backup who left last month.

hindi: नियम-बाहर — यात्रा नियमावली से बाहर की बुकिंग या ख़र्च
definition: describing a travel booking or expense that breaks company travel policy limits and needs extra justification or approval
example: My hotel was flagged out-of-policy because the approved one was forty minutes away and on fire.

hindi: अपनी पहल से संपर्क — कंपनी की ओर से पहला क़दम
definition: sales activity where you contact prospects first — cold calls, cold emails, sequences
example: Outbound works; the first two hundred emails are just warming up.

hindi: परिणाम-आधारित मूल्य — काम पूरा होने पर ही शुल्क
definition: software pricing charged only for completed results, such as resolved tickets, instead of licenses or consumption
example: The vendor offered outcome-based pricing, then spent a week arguing about what counts as resolved.

hindi: उत्पादन नहीं परिणाम — कितना बनाया नहीं, क्या बदला उससे आँकना
definition: the product principle of judging work by changed customer behavior and business results rather than by features delivered
example: The slide said outcomes over outputs; the bonus plan said features shipped.

hindi: विचलित बिंदु — बाकी डेटा से बहुत अलग पड़ता माप
definition: a data point far outside the pattern of the rest
example: One enterprise deal is an outlier, not a strategy.

hindi: बहिर्नियोजन सहायता — निकाले गए कर्मचारियों को नई नौकरी खोजने में मदद
definition: employer-funded help for dismissed employees finding fresh positions, including resume coaching and career counselling
example: Outplacement offered a resume workshop run by someone laid off last spring.

hindi: आउटपुट मापदंड — मेहनत का अंतिम नतीजा दिखाने वाला आँकड़ा
definition: a result metric you care about but cannot move directly
example: You cannot assign someone an output metric, though we keep trying.

hindi: संपर्क अभियान — संभावित ग्राहकों तक पहुँचने की कोशिश
definition: the activity of contacting potential customers through calls, emails, and messages
example: Our outreach strategy is three emails, one call, and quiet resignation.

hindi: बाहर से भीतर — ग्राहक और बाज़ार के नज़रिए से कंपनी को परखना
definition: describing analysis built from external data, customer views and competitor evidence rather than the company's internal assumptions
example: The outside-in view showed customers had never heard of the flagship product the board loved.

hindi: अति-निदेशकता — एक व्यक्ति का बहुत सारे बोर्डों में एक साथ बैठना
definition: holding seats on excessive numbers of company boards simultaneously, leaving a director without enough time for proper oversight
example: Proxy advisors flagged overboarding after noticing the director's seven boards met more often than she did.

hindi: क्षमता से अधिक लेना — जितना हो सके उससे ज़्यादा काम उठाना
definition: to accept more sprint work than the team can actually finish
example: We overcommit every sprint to keep our disappointment consistent.

hindi: ज़रूरत से अधिक बताना — दूरस्थ काम में जानबूझकर हर प्रगति और निर्णय साझा करना
definition: deliberately share progress, decisions and context more often than feels necessary, because remote colleagues cannot overhear
example: We overcommunicate here, said the lead, in a message that was eleven paragraphs long.

hindi: चुपचाप एक साथ कई पूर्णकालिक नौकरियाँ करने वाला
definition: secretly holding multiple full-time remote jobs at once
example: Two laptops, three standups, one suspiciously quiet calendar: overemployed.

hindi: अति-अनुकूलन — रटे हुए डेटा पर उम्दा, नए डेटा पर नाकाम
definition: a model memorizing its training data and failing on anything new
example: Perfect on our test gym, lost in every other gym — that's overfitting.

hindi: माँग से भरा दौर — जितनी जगह थी उससे ज़्यादा निवेशक तैयार
definition: having more investor demand than the round has room for
example: The round is oversubscribed, a sentence founders practice saying casually.

hindi: स्वामित्व लेना — काम की पूरी ज़िम्मेदारी उठाना
definition: to be fully responsible for something, credit and blame included
example: You own onboarding now — congratulations and condolences.

hindi: कहानी पर क़ब्ज़ा — किसी घटना को नेतृत्व के सामने अपने ढंग से पेश करना
