definition: to control how leadership perceives an event, outcome or project by telling your version of it first
example: After the outage, he owned the narrative so fast the post-mortem read like a success story.

hindi: अपने माध्यम — कंपनी के स्वयं के नियंत्रण वाले चैनल
definition: marketing channels the company controls outright, such as its website, blog, newsletter, mobile application and social accounts, with no media spend required
example: The newsletter is owned media, which is why nobody can explain why it costs so much.

hindi: लाभ-हानि विवरण — आय बनाम ख़र्च का हिसाब
definition: profit and loss statement; a summary of income versus expenses
example: The new VP asked who owns the P&L before asking our names.

hindi: ख़रीद कार्ड — छोटी कंपनी ख़रीद के लिए दिया गया कॉरपोरेट कार्ड
definition: procurement card; a company payment card for small business purchases that skips the purchase order process
example: The P-card limit is five hundred dollars, which explains the three separate four-hundred-dollar chair orders.

hindi: पी-हैकिंग — मनचाहा नतीजा दिखने तक विश्लेषण से छेड़छाड़
definition: torturing analysis until an insignificant result looks significant
example: Slicing by left-handed Tuesday users is not insight, it is p-hacking.

hindi: पी-वैल्यू — नतीजा महज़ संयोग होने की संभावना का माप
definition: the probability the observed result happened by chance
example: The p-value is 0.06, so we are calling it directionally significant.

hindi: सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता — सब छोड़कर तुरंत करने योग्य काम
definition: the highest priority; drop everything, this is on fire
example: It's a P0, so cancel your evening and possibly your weekend.

hindi: उच्च प्राथमिकता — अत्यावश्यक, पर सब कुछ रोकने योग्य नहीं
definition: urgent work that matters immensely yet somehow isn't a P0
example: They filed it as P1, the diplomatic way of saying today.

hindi: ख़रीद से भुगतान तक — माँग, आदेश, प्राप्ति, बिल और भुगतान की पूरी प्रक्रिया
definition: procure-to-pay; the complete purchasing workflow from requisition and purchase order through receipt, invoice and supplier payment
example: Our P2P cycle is forty days, thirty-eight of which are waiting for approvals.

hindi: 99वाँ प्रतिशतक — सबसे धीमे एक प्रतिशत अनुरोधों का प्रतिक्रिया समय
definition: the 99th percentile response time, meaning the slowest one percent of requests, used to judge latency for real users
example: The average looks great; the p99 is where our customers actually live.

hindi: अनुमान में गुंजाइश जोड़ना — सुरक्षा के लिए समय या रक़म बढ़ाना
definition: to quietly add buffer to an estimate
example: Pad the estimate; the calendar has opinions we haven't met.

hindi: आपात बुलावा भेजना — रात-दिन कभी भी ड्यूटी वाले इंजीनियर को तुरंत चेतावनी भेजकर बुलाना
definition: to trigger an urgent alert that wakes or interrupts the on-call engineer and demands an immediate response
example: The disk filled up at four, so naturally it paged the one person on holiday.

hindi: पन्ना-दर-पन्ना समीक्षा — वरिष्ठ द्वारा प्रस्तुति की बारीक जांच
definition: a senior banker's page-by-page review of a deck, producing markup on fonts, footnotes and logos
example: The page flip ran two hours and ended with a debate about whether the logo was blue enough.

hindi: पन्ना-पलट समीक्षा — डेक को स्लाइड-दर-स्लाइड साथ बैठकर जाँचना
definition: a review session walking through a draft deck slide by slide to check flow, logic and messaging before the client sees it
example: The page turn started at nine and reached slide four by lunch.

hindi: तुरंत जगाने योग्य — इतना गंभीर कि ड्यूटी वाले इंजीनियर को उसी समय बुलाना उचित हो
definition: describing an alert serious and actionable enough that it should interrupt the on-call engineer immediately, rather than wait until morning
example: Is a slow internal report pageable? Only if you want the on-call to quit.

hindi: अलर्ट घंटी — ऑन-कॉल इंजीनियर को जगाने वाला संदेश-तंत्र
definition: whatever device or app wakes the on-call engineer when production breaks
example: The pager went off at 3 am, as is tradition.

hindi: सशुल्क प्रचार — विज्ञापन ख़रीदकर पाई गई पहुँच
definition: advertising you buy — search ads, social ads, sponsorships
example: Paid media works instantly and stops working the instant you stop paying.

hindi: समस्या की खुदाई — क्रमिक प्रश्नों से ग्राहक की असली पीड़ा और उसकी कीमत तक पहुँचना
definition: a sequence of progressively deeper discovery questions that moves a prospect from surface complaints to the personal and financial cost of the problem
example: Three questions into the pain funnel, the prospect was describing his reorg and we were taking notes like therapists.

hindi: दुखती रग — ग्राहक या टीम की सबसे बड़ी परेशानी
definition: a specific recurring frustration for customers or teams
example: Manual invoicing is our customers' biggest pain point.

hindi: दर्दनिवारक बनाम विटामिन — ज़रूरी समाधान बनाम केवल अच्छा-होने-वाला उत्पाद
definition: the distinction between products solving urgent pain customers must fix and optional improvements they can skip
example: The investor asked painkiller vs vitamin, and our honest answer was 'gummy'.

hindi: जोड़ी प्रोग्रामिंग — दो डेवलपर, एक कीबोर्ड
definition: two developers writing code together at one keyboard
example: Pair programming: one types, one prevents crimes.

hindi: पैनल साक्षात्कार — कई साक्षात्कारकर्ता एक साथ
definition: an interview where several interviewers question the candidate together in the same session
example: The panel interview had five interviewers and six opinions.

hindi: छोटी चुभन — अकेले मामूली, मिलकर कष्टदायी बनने वाली खामी
definition: a small annoyance that's trivial alone and painful in bulk
example: We fixed a hundred paper cuts and reviews called the app 'suddenly nice'.

hindi: काग़ज़ी करोड़पति — जिसकी दौलत अभी केवल शेयरों के हिसाब में है
definition: someone, usually a startup employee, whose equity is worth millions on paper but cannot yet be sold or spent
example: He is a paper millionaire and still splits the cab fare to the nearest rupee.

hindi: कागज़ी प्रक्रिया — अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर तक की कानूनी और खरीद प्रक्रिया
definition: customer's legal, security and procurement steps required before a contract can actually be signed
example: Everyone said yes in May; the paper process said September.

hindi: दस्तावेज़ी सबूत — फ़ैसलों का लिखित सिलसिला
definition: the documented evidence of decisions and actions
example: Put it in email; verbal approvals leave no paper trail.

hindi: आमूल बदलाव — सोचने के ढंग में बुनियादी परिवर्तन
definition: a fundamental change in approach; frequently claimed, rarely occurring
example: The memo called the new filing system a paradigm shift.

hindi: समान दर्जे पर — बराबर वरीयता से भुगतान पाने वाले दावे
definition: ranking equally, with creditors or securities sharing repayment rights without any seniority between them
example: The new notes rank pari passu with the old ones, which the old holders took personally.

hindi: समता — प्रतिद्वंद्वी या दूसरे प्लेटफ़ॉर्म के बराबर होना
definition: matching what a competitor or another platform already offers
example: We spent the year chasing parity and calling it strategy.

hindi: टाल-सूची — अभी टाले गए मुद्दों की सूची
definition: a list where off-topic questions are parked, often permanently
example: Put it in the parking lot, next to last month's questions.

hindi: काम-फैलाव नियम — काम उतना फैल जाता है जितना समय उसे दिया जाए
definition: observation that work expands to fill whatever time is available for its completion
example: Given a month for a one-pager, Parkinson's law delivered it at 11:58 pm on day thirty.

hindi: दोहरा लाभ वाला वरीयता शेयर — पहले पैसा वापस, फिर बाकी में भी हिस्सा
definition: preferred stock whose holders receive their liquidation preference first and then also share the remaining proceeds alongside common shareholders
example: With participating preferred on the table, the founders did the math and found they were selling the company mostly for the investors.

hindi: साझेदार मार्ग — फ़र्म में साझेदार बनने की ओर जाने वाला करियर रास्ता
definition: career path at a professional services firm leading toward partnership, with rising sales expectations
example: Being on partner track means your weekends are now also on partner track.

hindi: भीड़ वाला निवेश दौर — बिना मुख्य निवेशक के कई छोटे निवेशकों से फ़ंडिंग
definition: a financing assembled from many small checks without a lead investor, leaving nobody clearly responsible for helping
example: The party round brought thirty investors, thirty opinions and not one person who'd take the late-night call.

hindi: उत्तीर्ण होना — कॉलेज की पढ़ाई पूरी कर डिग्री लेना
definition: an Indian English phrasal verb meaning to graduate from college, used on resumes and in hiring conversations
example: He passed out in 2019, the resume said, alarming the recruiter in another country.

hindi: निष्क्रिय उम्मीदवार — जो नौकरी नहीं ढूँढ रहा पर प्रस्ताव सुन सकता है
definition: an employed person not actively searching for work whom recruiters approach anyway with openings
example: Every hiring manager wants passive candidates, right up until they have to match their current salary.

hindi: सुधार संस्करण — बिना नई सुविधाओं के सिर्फ़ त्रुटियाँ ठीक करने वाला छोटा संस्करण
definition: a small version containing only fixes for defects, shipped without new features after a main release
example: The patch release fixed the crash and introduced a charming new one.

hindi: सुधार-मंगलवार — हर महीने सुरक्षा अपडेट और ज़बरन रीस्टार्ट का दिन
definition: monthly Microsoft security update release, bringing company-wide forced laptop restarts and installation reminders
example: Patch Tuesday restarted his laptop mid-presentation, which at least ended the questions.

hindi: एकाधिकार की ढलान — संरक्षण ख़त्म होते ही दवा की बिक्री का अचानक गिरना
definition: the steep revenue drop when patents protecting a bestselling drug expire and cheaper generic copies flood the market
example: The strategy offsite was called 'Beyond 2029', which everyone understood to mean the patent cliff.

hindi: मुनाफ़े की राह — घाटे से लाभ तक पहुँचने की विश्वसनीय योजना
definition: a credible plan showing how a loss-making startup will become profitable, demanded by investors in downturns
example: The new deck had a path to profitability, drawn in a colour that suggested it was optional.

hindi: ढर्रा-तोड़ शुरुआत — कोल्ड कॉल में अप्रत्याशित पंक्ति से सामने वाले का ध्यान खींचना
definition: an unexpected opening line in a cold call or email designed to break the prospect's automatic brush-off response
example: His pattern interrupt was admitting it was a cold call, which the prospect found refreshing for eleven seconds.

hindi: बने रास्ते पक्के करो — जो उपयोगकर्ता पहले से करते हैं उसे आधिकारिक बनाओ
definition: designing features around workarounds users already rely on instead of forcing new behaviour
example: Everyone exported to spreadsheets anyway, so we paved the cowpaths and shipped an export button.

hindi: पक्की सड़क — प्लेटफ़ॉर्म टीम का समर्थित, आसान और मानक तरीका जिसे अपनाने को कहा जाता है
definition: the supported, standardised set of tools and workflows a platform team maintains and encourages developers to follow
example: Stay on the paved road and deploys are easy; leave it and you own the potholes.

hindi: वेतन संपीड़न — नए और पुराने कर्मचारियों के वेतन का अंतर मिट जाना
definition: when salaries for experienced staff barely exceed those of recent hires because market rates rose faster than raises
example: Pay compression became obvious when the intern's offer letter leaked onto the team channel.

hindi: वेतन समता — समान काम के लिए समान वेतन सुनिश्चित करना
definition: ensuring employees doing comparable work receive comparable salaries regardless of gender, race or other protected characteristics
example: The pay equity audit took six months, mainly because nobody wanted to open the spreadsheet.

hindi: नोटिस के बदले वेतन — नोटिस अवधि काम कराए बिना वेतन देना
definition: salary paid for the notice period so the employee leaves immediately instead of working it
example: They offered pay in lieu of notice, which is corporate for please return your laptop today.

hindi: वेतन अनुपात — निश्चित वेतन और कमीशन का बँटवारा
definition: split between fixed base salary and variable commission within a sales role's target earnings
example: A 50/50 pay mix is exciting in January and considerably less exciting in March.

hindi: वेतन पारदर्शिता — वेतन सीमा को खुले में बताना
definition: openly publishing salary ranges in hiring posts and internally, often legally mandated, so employees can compare compensation
example: Pay transparency arrived, and the hiring range turned out to be wide enough to park a truck in.

hindi: निवेश करो या अधिकार खोओ — अगले राउंड में पैसा न लगाने पर प्रेफ़रेंस खोना
definition: a financing provision forcing existing investors to fund their share of a round or lose preferred rights, often converting into common stock
example: The pay-to-play clause turned a dozen passive investors into very attentive ones overnight.

hindi: लागत वसूली अवधि — ग्राहक-लागत वापस कमाने में लगने वाला समय
definition: months needed for a customer's revenue to cover their acquisition cost
example: An eighteen-month payback period, optimistically labeled patience.

hindi: वेतन से दान — हर महीने तनख़्वाह से सीधे कटने वाला दान
definition: employee charitable donations deducted directly from salary each payday, often before income tax, and sent to chosen charities
example: Payroll giving signups spike every March, which finance insists is purely about charity.

hindi: फार्मेसी लाभ प्रबंधक — बीमा की ओर से दवा सूची और छूट तय करने वाला बिचौलिया
definition: pharmacy benefit manager; intermediary negotiating drug rebates and controlling formulary coverage on behalf of insurers and employers
example: Our price went down, the PBM's rebate went up, and the patient's copay somehow stayed exactly the same.

hindi: योजना-करो-जाँचो-सुधारो चक्र — सुधार का बार-बार चलने वाला क्रम
definition: plan, do, check, act; the repeating improvement cycle of testing a change, measuring results and standardising what works
example: We completed plan and do beautifully; check and act are scheduled for next fiscal year.

hindi: नियामक निर्णय तिथि — जिस दिन अमेरिकी नियामक दवा पर फ़ैसला देगा
definition: prescription Drug User Fee Act date; the deadline by which American regulators must decide whether to approve a submitted drug application
example: The launch team counts down to the PDUFA date the way children count down to birthdays, with more caffeine.

hindi: समस्या कुर्सी और कीबोर्ड के बीच — यानी उपयोगकर्ता ही गड़बड़ (problem exists between keyboard and chair)
definition: problem exists between keyboard and chair; the user is the bug
example: Diagnosis after four hours: PEBKAC, closed with unusual satisfaction.

hindi: बीच में झांकना — प्रयोग पूरा होने से पहले नतीजे देख लेना
definition: checking experiment results early, which quietly corrupts them
example: No peeking until the test ends, we agreed, refreshing hourly.

hindi: परत-दर-परत खोलना — समस्या की तहें एक-एक कर समझना
definition: to examine a problem one layer at a time
example: Every time we peel the onion on billing, someone cries.

hindi: सहकर्मियों द्वारा लिखी समीक्षा-टिप्पणी
definition: review comments written about you by colleagues at your level
example: Peer feedback season is when everyone suddenly replies to your messages.

hindi: सुरक्षा भेदन परीक्षण — बाहरी विशेषज्ञों से सिस्टम पर नियंत्रित हमला
definition: penetration test; hired security experts attacking company systems to find weaknesses before real attackers
example: The pen test report came back with forty findings, thirty-nine of which were 'accepted risk' by Friday.

hindi: लोगों का प्रबंधक — जिसके अधीन कर्मचारी रिपोर्ट करते हैं
definition: a manager with direct reports, responsible for their reviews, growth and hiring, unlike an individual contributor
example: Becoming a people manager meant trading code reviews for performance reviews.

hindi: मानव संसाधन विभाग का आधुनिक नाम
definition: the modern rebrand of the HR department, same forms, warmer font
example: People ops sent a survey about the survey fatigue survey.

hindi: दैनिक भत्ता — यात्रा के दौरान रोज़ का तय ख़र्च
definition: a fixed daily allowance for meals and expenses while traveling
example: The per diem covers dinner if dinner is a sandwich.

hindi: मेरी पिछली ईमेल के अनुसार — विनम्र भाषा में 'पढ़ा क्यों नहीं'
definition: polite corporate code for 'I already answered this; please read'
example: Per my last email, the deadline has not moved.

hindi: प्रति-सीट मूल्य — हर उपयोगकर्ता के हिसाब से शुल्क
definition: software pricing charged for each named user license, regardless of how much each person actually uses
example: Per-seat pricing made sense until the agents started doing the seats' work.

hindi: काम का आवधिक मूल्यांकन — रेटिंग और वेतन इसी से तय
definition: the periodic evaluation of your work that feeds ratings and raises
example: The performance review compressed a year of work into three adjectives.

hindi: प्रदर्शन-प्रबंधित — औपचारिक सुधार प्रक्रिया में डाला गया, प्रायः निकासी से पहले
definition: placed under formal performance scrutiny, usually documentation building toward a dismissal
example: Once you're performance-managed, every calendar invite starts to feel like evidence.

hindi: प्रतिनिधि उपयोगकर्ता चरित्र — शोध से गढ़ा काल्पनिक ग्राहक
definition: a fictional character representing a key user type, built from research
example: Our persona 'Busy Priya' would have abandoned this signup form by step two.

hindi: वैयक्तिकरण — हर उपयोगकर्ता के हिसाब से अनुभव ढालना
definition: tailoring content, plans, or difficulty to each individual user automatically
example: Personalization means your warm-up knows about your desk job and your left knee.

hindi: राजनीतिक, आर्थिक, सामाजिक, तकनीकी, कानूनी, पर्यावरणीय — बाहरी माहौल का आकलन
definition: political, economic, social, technological, legal, environmental; a checklist for scanning the external forces affecting a business strategy
example: The PESTLE analysis flagged regulation as a risk, three weeks after the regulator fined them.

hindi: निजी दुलारी सुविधा — किसी प्रभावशाली की पसंद के दम पर टिकी सुविधा
definition: a feature that survives because someone powerful loves it
example: Nobody uses it, but it's the founder's pet feature, so it stays.

hindi: पीटर सिद्धांत — लोग अपनी अक्षमता के स्तर तक तरक्की पाते हैं
definition: the observation that employees keep getting promoted until they reach a role they cannot perform
example: The best engineer became the worst director, a textbook Peter principle promotion.

hindi: पालतू बनाम मवेशी — सर्वर सहेजो मत, बदल डालो का सिद्धांत
definition: treat servers as replaceable herd members, not beloved pets nursed back to health
example: Pets vs cattle, yet here we are, hand-feeding server number seven.

hindi: भविष्य निधि — वेतन से कटकर जमा होने वाली सेवानिवृत्ति बचत
definition: provident fund; in Indian English the mandatory retirement savings where employee and employer each contribute a share of basic salary
example: Nobody checks their PF balance until they switch jobs and discover three separate accounts.

hindi: कृपया संलग्न देखें — फ़ाइल साथ में है
definition: please find attached — the file is on this email, promise
example: PFA the revised invoice; kindly ignore the previous three.

hindi: कृपया नीचे देखें — विवरण ईमेल में आगे दिया गया है
definition: please find below; Indian English email phrase pointing readers to details written further down
example: PFB the details, followed by nothing, because he forgot to paste them.

hindi: छाया शेयर — बिना वास्तविक शेयर दिए शेयर-मूल्य से जुड़ा नकद लाभ
definition: a cash bonus tracking share value without issuing real shares, giving employees upside but no ownership
example: Phantom stock gave us all the excitement of equity with none of the voting rights, much like actual stock.

hindi: दवा सुरक्षा निगरानी — बाज़ार में आई दवा के दुष्प्रभावों पर नज़र
definition: the monitoring, collection and reporting of adverse drug reactions after approval, required of every company selling medicines
example: Someone mentioned a headache at the offsite and pharmacovigilance asked for a case report form.

hindi: चरण द्वार — अगले चरण से पहले अनिवार्य समीक्षा-पड़ाव
definition: a formal checkpoint a project must pass before the next phase begins
example: We're stuck at the phase gate awaiting one signature and one miracle.

hindi: चरणबद्ध वापसी — लंबी छुट्टी या बीमारी के बाद धीरे-धीरे पूरा काम शुरू करना
definition: a gradual return to full hours and duties after long illness, parental leave or burnout
example: Her phased return promised half days, which the calendar invites interpreted as half nights.

hindi: चरणबद्ध बँटवारा — सालाना बजट को महीनों या तिमाहियों में बाँटना
definition: how an annual budget or target is spread across months or quarters, which decides when a variance appears
example: The phasing put all the revenue in Q4, which made Q1 through Q3 look remarkably relaxed.

hindi: नकली फ़िशिंग परीक्षण — कर्मचारियों की सतर्कता जाँचने को भेजा गया जाल-ईमेल
definition: fake scam email sent by the security team to test whether employees click suspicious links
example: The phishing simulation promised a free pizza voucher, and half of finance is now booked into remedial training.

hindi: फ़ोन-कक्ष — खुले दफ़्तर में छोटा ध्वनिरोधी केबिन
definition: a tiny soundproof pod for calls in an open office
example: All four phone booths are taken; the stairwell it is.

hindi: पहली छँटनी-कॉल — आगे की इंटरव्यू से पहले की जांच
definition: an initial call that filters candidates before the full interview loop
example: The phone screen went well, which earned her five more interviews.

hindi: पीआई नियोजन — कई टीमों की साझा तिमाही योजना-बैठक
definition: the big-room event where many teams plan a shared program increment
example: PI planning: two days, forty people, one wall of sticky notes.

hindi: चुनना और पैक करना — ऑर्डर के सामान निकालकर डिब्बाबंद करना
definition: the warehouse process of pulling ordered items from shelves and packaging them for shipment to customers
example: Pick and pack is fully automated, except the picking and the packing.

hindi: राय लेना — किसी के अनुभव से मुफ़्त सलाह लेना
definition: to ask someone for informal advice, usually unpaid
example: Can I pick your brain over coffee about pricing?

hindi: व्यक्तिगत पहचान सूचना — जिस डेटा से व्यक्ति पहचाना जा सके
definition: personally identifiable information; any data that can be traced to a specific person
example: Scrub the PII before the logs go anywhere near a training run.

hindi: गोपनीय जानकारी व आविष्कार हस्तांतरण अनुबंध — नौकरी के पहले दिन साइन होने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: proprietary information and inventions assignment agreement; the day-one employee contract covering confidentiality and handing work inventions to the company
example: Buried in the onboarding packet, the PIIA claimed my weekend side project, my sourdough recipe and possibly my cat.

hindi: वस्तु रूप में भुगतान — नकद ब्याज की जगह और कर्ज़ जोड़ना
definition: payment in kind; interest paid by adding more debt to the principal instead of paying cash
example: PIK interest meant the loan grew quietly every quarter, like the analyst's workload.

hindi: मुख्य स्तंभ पृष्ठ — किसी विषय का विस्तृत केंद्रीय लेख जिससे बाकी लेख जुड़ें
definition: long, comprehensive website page covering a broad topic, linking out to narrower supporting articles for search ranking
example: The pillar page is nine thousand words, and the bounce rate suggests nobody has read past three hundred.

hindi: प्रायोगिक शुरुआत — छोटे स्तर पर सीमित आज़माइश
definition: a small, time-boxed deployment before a full rollout
example: The pilot went so well it's been extended indefinitely, unpaid.

hindi: पायलट में अटकना — प्रयोग का कभी असली इस्तेमाल तक न पहुँचना
definition: the state where promising pilots and proofs of concept continue forever without ever reaching real production
example: Our document assistant has been in pilot purgatory for so long it qualifies for a long-service award.

hindi: संदेश भेजकर ध्यान खींचना — किसी को छोटा सा संदेश करना
definition: to send someone a quick message to get their attention
example: Ping me when the build is green and I'll deploy.

hindi: प्रदर्शन-सुधार योजना — अक्सर निकालने की औपचारिक भूमिका
definition: performance improvement plan; officially a rescue, frequently a documented exit
example: The PIP had goals no one had met while employed there.

hindi: क़तार — आते हुए सौदों, कामों या उम्मीदवारों की धारा
definition: the stream of deals, work, or candidates on the way in
example: The pipeline looks healthy until you call the leads.

hindi: सौदा-भंडार अनुपात — बचे लक्ष्य के मुकाबले खुले सौदों का कुल मूल्य
definition: ratio of open pipeline value against remaining quota, usually expected near three times the target
example: Pipeline coverage is 3x, which sounds healthy until you notice half of it is one deal from 2023.

hindi: पाइपलाइन निर्माण — नए योग्य सौदे पैदा करने का काम
definition: creating fresh qualified sales opportunities that feed future quarters, often tracked as a separate target
example: Marketing owns pipeline generation until the quarter is missed, at which point it was always sales.

hindi: पाइपलाइन समीक्षा — प्रबंधक द्वारा खुले सौदों की नियमित जाँच
definition: recurring manager meeting inspecting open deals, their stages, next steps and close dates
example: Every deal in the pipeline review was 'progressing nicely', which is sales for 'no reply since June'.

hindi: पाइपलाइन सफ़ाई — मृत या फूले हुए सौदे हटाने की कवायद
definition: cleaning pipeline records by closing dead deals and correcting inflated amounts or unrealistic dates
example: After the pipeline scrub, coverage dropped from four times to a number nobody said aloud.

hindi: समुद्री डाकू मीट्रिक्स — AARRR फ़नल के पाँच चरणों का बोलचाल नाम
definition: informal name for the AARRR funnel of acquisition, activation, retention, referral and revenue metrics used to track product growth
example: He explained pirate metrics for twenty minutes and never once said 'arrr', which felt like a waste.

hindi: प्रस्ताव प्रस्तुति — उत्पाद या विचार बेचने की बात
definition: a persuasive presentation of a product, company, or idea
example: She refined the pitch until even engineering admitted it sounded plausible.

hindi: प्रस्तुति स्लाइडें — उत्पाद या कंपनी बेचने के लिए
definition: the slide deck used to sell a product, company, or vision
example: Version 47 of the pitch deck finally has fewer than sixty slides.

hindi: प्रस्ताव पुस्तिका — ग्राहक को सौदा जीतने के लिए बनाई गई स्लाइडें
definition: the bound slide deck bankers prepare to win a mandate, full of valuation charts and credentials
example: The analyst rebuilt the pitchbook overnight so the client could skim three pages over breakfast.

hindi: दिशा बदलना — पुराना आइडिया छोड़कर नया व्यवसाय मॉडल अपनाना
definition: to change a company's core product or strategy after the original one fails to take off
example: We pivoted from meal plans to AI coaching — the third pivot this year.

hindi: सारांश तालिका — स्प्रेडशीट में पंक्तियों को समूहों में जोड़कर सारांश बनाने का औज़ार
definition: a spreadsheet feature that summarises rows of data by grouping, totalling and cross-tabulating them into a compact table
example: Our entire forecasting process is one heroic pivot table that only Priya dares to refresh.

hindi: बदलो या मरो — रणनीति बदलना ही बचने का आख़िरी रास्ता
definition: the moment when changing strategy is the only alternative to shutting down
example: The offsite agenda had one item: pivot-or-die, lunch included.

hindi: पिक्सेल खिसकाना — छोटी दृश्य बारीकियों पर अटके रहना
definition: endless small visual adjustments to spacing and alignment, often while bigger product questions stay unanswered
example: Two days of pixel pushing on the settings screen, and nobody has asked whether users ever open it.

hindi: बिंदु-सटीक — डिज़ाइन से हूबहू, पिक्सेल तक मेल खाता
definition: matching the design mockup exactly, down to the pixel
example: The engineer made it pixel-perfect; the designer moved the pixels.

hindi: पिज़्ज़ा पार्टी — वेतन या स्टाफ़ के बजाय दिया जाने वाला सस्ता इनाम
definition: a cheap team treat offered as recognition instead of raises, staffing or reduced workload
example: After a record quarter and three resignations, leadership announced a pizza party, vegetarian option pending.

hindi: स्थान-रक्षक — विवरण तय होने से पहले रोका गया समय
definition: a tentative calendar block reserving time before details are final
example: I sent a placeholder for Tuesday; agenda to follow, allegedly.

hindi: प्लानिंग पोकर — सब एक साथ अंक दिखाकर आकलन करना
definition: an estimation game where everyone reveals a size at once to avoid anchoring
example: Planning poker ended in a tie between three and thirteen.

hindi: ठहराव — बढ़त रुककर आँकड़े का सपाट हो जाना
definition: a stretch where a growing metric stops growing
example: We renamed the plateau a period of consolidation.

hindi: आंतरिक ढाँचा निर्माण — डेवलपरों के लिए साझा औज़ार और तैनाती व्यवस्था बनाने का काम
definition: building shared internal tooling, deployment pipelines and infrastructure that product engineering teams use instead of maintaining their own
example: Platform engineering promised one way to deploy, and delivered a fourth.

hindi: मंच रणनीति — वह आधार बनना जिस पर दूसरे कारोबार टिकें
definition: a strategy to become the base layer other businesses build on
example: It started as an invoicing tool; the deck now calls it a platform play.

hindi: कार्यपुस्तिका — आज़माए तरीक़ों का दोहराने लायक़ संग्रह
definition: a documented set of repeatable tactics for a situation
example: The sales playbook is thorough; nobody has opened it.

hindi: खुद काम भी करे और टीम भी संभाले — दो नौकरियाँ, एक वेतन
definition: a manager still expected to do hands-on work alongside managing
example: The player-coach role means two jobs, each done at half strength.

hindi: कृपया मार्गदर्शन करें — निर्णय या उत्तर माँगना
definition: email closer requesting a decision or guidance, often a polite way of saying 'your move'
example: The printer is on fire, please advise.

hindi: संतुलन आँकड़ा — मॉडल को मिलाने के लिए डाली गई संख्या
definition: a balancing figure forced into a financial model or forecast so the totals reach the required target
example: The gap to plan was closed with a plug labelled new initiatives, with no initiatives attached.

hindi: विलय के बाद एकीकरण — दो कंपनियों को मिलाकर एक चलाने का काम
definition: post-merger integration; combining the people, systems, processes and cultures of two companies after an acquisition closes
example: The PMI team merged two payroll systems and, briefly, three payrolls.

hindi: प्रोडक्ट मार्केटिंग मैनेजर — उत्पाद की स्थिति, संदेश और लॉन्च सँभालने वाला
definition: product marketing manager; role owning a product's positioning, messaging, launches and sales enablement
example: The PMM renamed our feature three times before anyone outside could pronounce it.

hindi: परियोजना प्रबंधन कार्यालय — प्रक्रिया और टेम्पलेट का केंद्र
definition: project management office; the team that owns process, templates, and status decks
example: The PMO needs the status in their template by Thursday.

hindi: क्रय आदेश — विक्रेता से खरीद की औपचारिक स्वीकृत माँग
definition: purchase order; the formal approved document committing budget to a vendor before any invoice is paid
example: No PO, no payment, said accounts payable to the vendor who had already delivered.

hindi: दूसरी कंपनी का कर्मचारी फुसलाकर ले जाना
definition: to lure an employee away from another company
example: The rival poached their whole platform team over one quarter.

hindi: अवधारणा का प्रमाण — ख़रीद से पहले सीमित तकनीकी परीक्षण
definition: proof of concept — a limited trial proving the product works before a real purchase
example: The POC succeeded, so they've requested a second, larger POC.

hindi: जेब में वीटो — जवाब न देकर चुपचाप किसी प्रस्ताव को मार देना
definition: killing a proposal or decision by quietly never responding to it rather than openly rejecting it
example: The budget request wasn't rejected; it received a pocket veto and a very busy calendar.

hindi: आकलन करना — कहानी को स्टोरी पॉइंट देना
definition: to assign story points to a backlog item during estimation
example: We still need to point the stories before planning tomorrow.

hindi: नुकीले-बालों वाला बॉस — दिलबर्ट कार्टून से, तकनीक न समझने वाला आत्मविश्वासी मैनेजर
definition: a clueless, confident manager who misunderstands the technical work, named after the Dilbert comic strip character
example: The pointy-haired boss asked whether the cloud could be moved closer to the office.

hindi: विष-गोली रक्षा — शत्रुतापूर्ण अधिग्रहण रोकने हेतु शेयर-तनुकरण योजना
definition: a shareholder rights plan letting existing holders buy discounted shares, diluting any hostile bidder who crosses an ownership threshold
example: The board adopted a poison pill on Friday and described it on Monday as 'shareholder-friendly'.

hindi: भूल-रोधक उपाय — ऐसी बनावट जिससे ग़लती करना ही असंभव हो जाए
definition: mistake-proofing; designing a process or fixture so the wrong action becomes physically impossible or immediately obvious
example: The new connector only fits one way, which is poka-yoke for people who never read instructions.

hindi: परिष्कार — उत्पाद को पूर्ण एहसास देने वाली अंतिम सफ़ाई
definition: the final refinement that makes a product feel finished
example: It works; it just needs two weeks of polish and a miracle.

hindi: राजनीतिक पूँजी — दफ़्तर में कमाई गई साख और एहसान जिन्हें ख़र्च किया जा सके
definition: the goodwill, trust and favours someone has accumulated at work, which they can spend to push decisions through
example: I'm not spending political capital on the font change; save it for the headcount fight.

hindi: कमी-पूरक कोड — पुराने ब्राउज़र में नई सुविधा की नक़ल
definition: code that recreates a modern feature in environments too old to have it
example: Half our bundle is polyfills for browsers nobody admits using.

hindi: अनेक भंडार — हर सेवा या परियोजना का कोड अलग-अलग भंडार में रखने की पद्धति
definition: the practice of keeping each service or project in its own separate code repository, the opposite of a monorepo
example: In our polyrepo setup, one shared change means seven pull requests and seven reviewers.

hindi: उद्योग प्रतिस्पर्धा की पाँच शक्तियाँ — उद्योग के मुनाफ़े को आँकने का ढाँचा
definition: strategy framework assessing industry profitability through rivalry, supplier power, buyer power, substitutes and threat of entrants
example: The consultant ran Porter's five forces and concluded, for a fee, that competition exists.

hindi: पोर्टफ़ोलियो कंपनी — जिसमें फ़ंड ने निवेश किया है
definition: a startup that a fund has invested in
example: As a portfolio company, we get advice, intros, and quarterly panic emails.

hindi: मुद्रा आकलन — वीडियो से शरीर के जोड़ों की स्थिति पहचानना
definition: detecting body joint positions from video to analyze movement and form
example: Pose estimation says your elbows flare on push-ups; the camera has receipts.

hindi: यौन उत्पीड़न निवारण — भारत में कार्यस्थल उत्पीड़न रोकने का कानून व समिति
definition: prevention of sexual harassment; the Indian workplace law requiring an internal committee and mandatory training, referred to as POSH in Indian English
example: The annual POSH training was mandatory, and for once the completion dashboard deserved its attention.

hindi: बाज़ार में स्थान-निर्धारण — प्रतिस्पर्धा के बीच अलग पहचान
definition: how a product is framed in buyers' minds relative to alternatives
example: Our positioning changed three times this year; the product did not.

hindi: निवेश-पश्चात SAFE — निवेशक का हिस्सा पैसा आने के बाद के मूल्यांकन पर तय
definition: the standard modern SAFE, fixing investor ownership against the valuation after all SAFE money converts, so founders absorb the dilution
example: The founders stacked four post-money SAFEs and discovered each one diluted them, not each other.

hindi: नया निवेश जुड़ने के तुरंत बाद की कंपनी की क़ीमत
definition: a company's value immediately after the new investment is added
example: Post-money valuation is pre-money plus the check nobody rounds down.

hindi: घटना-समीक्षा — विफलता के बाद कारणों की जाँच बैठक
definition: a review after a failure to document what happened and prevent a repeat
example: The post-mortem doc is longer than the outage was.

hindi: उत्तर-प्रशिक्षण — मूल प्रशिक्षण के बाद मॉडल को उपयोगी बनाने का काम
definition: everything done after pretraining — fine-tuning, feedback, safety work — to make a model useful
example: The base model was raw talent; post-training taught it manners.

hindi: मूल्य प्रमाण — ग्राहक के वातावरण में उत्पाद का लाभ सिद्ध करना
definition: proof of value; trial proving measurable business benefit inside the customer's environment before purchase
example: The POV succeeded technically, and the customer now wants it free for another quarter.

hindi: पावर लॉ — गिनती के निवेश ही पूरे फ़ंड की कमाई कर देते हैं
definition: the pattern where one or two investments return more than the rest combined
example: The power law means the fund needs one of us to be enormous.

hindi: प्रभाव का नक्शा — ग्राहक कंपनी में कौन किसे प्रभावित करता है, इसका चार्ट
definition: a chart of the stakeholders inside a buying company showing who holds influence, budget and veto over the deal
example: The power map had eleven boxes, and the one that mattered was the CFO's assistant.

hindi: पावर यूज़र — उत्पाद को औसत से कहीं ज़्यादा और गहराई से चलाने वाला
definition: a heavy user who exercises the product far beyond the average
example: Our power users found features we forgot we shipped.

hindi: विद्युत क्रय समझौता — किसी उत्पादक से सीधे लंबी अवधि के लिए हरित बिजली ख़रीदने का सौदा
definition: power purchase agreement; long-term contract buying electricity directly from renewable generator at agreed price
example: The fifteen-year PPA locked in cheap wind power and three years of procurement negotiation.

hindi: प्रति-क्लिक भुगतान विज्ञापन — जहाँ केवल क्लिक होने पर पैसा कटता है
definition: pay per click; advertising model where the advertiser pays only when someone clicks, usually search campaigns
example: The PPC account had four hundred campaigns and one person who still remembered why.

hindi: प्रस्तुति फ़ाइल — बैठक में दिखाई जाने वाली स्लाइडें
definition: powerPoint; Indian English name for any slide deck prepared for meetings, reviews or client presentations
example: The strategy is ready; only the PPT, and therefore the strategy, remains.

hindi: उत्पाद-उपयोग से परखा ग्राहक — इस्तेमाल ने ख़रीद-रुचि दिखाई
definition: product-qualified lead — a user whose product usage signals they're ready to pay
example: A PQL hit the seat limit twice this week; sales is already circling.

hindi: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति और प्रश्नोत्तर — उत्पाद बनाने से पहले लिखा जाने वाला काल्पनिक घोषणा दस्तावेज़
definition: press release, frequently asked questions; a document imagining a product's launch announcement and hard questions before approval to build
example: The PR/FAQ answered every question except the one the CFO asked.

hindi: विशेषज्ञता क्षेत्र — फ़र्म के भीतर उद्योग या सेवा आधारित विभाग
definition: industry or service specialism within a professional services firm, with its own partners and clients
example: She switched practice area from banking to healthcare, and her slides stayed exactly the same.

hindi: उत्पाद आवश्यकता दस्तावेज़ — क्या और क्यों बनाना है उसका लेख
definition: product requirements document; what to build and why, in writing
example: The PRD is six pages of context and one line of requirements.

hindi: पहले ही घोषित करना — तय तारीख़ से पहले तिमाही नतीजों की झलक देना
definition: release preliminary quarterly figures before the scheduled earnings date, usually because results differ sharply from expectations
example: We only pre-announce bad news, so the market now reads any early press release as a confession.

hindi: पूर्व-पुष्टि करना — प्रस्ताव से पहले उम्मीदवार की स्वीकृति टटोलना
definition: to confirm a candidate would accept specific terms before the formal offer is made
example: Always pre-close on salary, or you will learn about the competing offer from the rejection.

hindi: पूर्व-बैठक — असली मीटिंग से पहले तैयारी के लिए छोटी मीटिंग
definition: a smaller meeting held before the main meeting to align positions and rehearse decisions
example: We need a pre-meeting to prepare for Thursday's pre-meeting.

hindi: नए निवेश से पहले की कंपनी की क़ीमत
definition: a company's value before the new investment money is added
example: They argued about pre-money valuation for three weeks and one dinner.

hindi: पूर्व-समीक्षा — शुरू से पहले संभावित विफलता के कारणों की कल्पना
definition: imagining a project has already failed, then listing why, before it starts
example: The pre-mortem predicted everything except how right it was.

hindi: पूर्व-पठन — बैठक से पहले भेजा गया दस्तावेज़
definition: a document sent before a meeting so discussion starts informed
example: Nobody opened the pre-read, so we read it together, silently.

hindi: आय-पूर्व — अभी कमाई शुरू नहीं, उम्मीदें भरपूर
definition: not yet earning money, a stage described optimistically in every deck
example: We're pre-revenue, which sounds better than 'nobody pays us yet.'

hindi: सबसे शुरुआती निवेश दौर — जब सिर्फ़ आइडिया और टीम हो
definition: the earliest funding stage, often just an idea, a deck, and a founder
example: Our pre-seed came from two angels and a very trusting uncle.

hindi: यात्रा-पूर्व स्वीकृति — टिकट बुक करने से पहले मैनेजर की अनुमति
definition: manager sign-off required before booking business travel, confirming the trip purpose and estimated costs
example: Pre-trip approval arrived the day after I landed, which I am choosing to call alignment.

hindi: पहले से मनाना — मीटिंग से पहले हितधारकों को अलग-अलग राज़ी करना
definition: briefing key stakeholders individually before a meeting so decisions face no surprises in the room
example: I pre-wired the VP, so the decision meeting is really a formality with slides.

hindi: पूर्व सौदे — पिछले अधिग्रहणों के मूल्य से वर्तमान कंपनी का मूल्यांकन
definition: valuing a company using multiples paid in previous acquisitions of similar businesses
example: The precedent transactions dated back to 2007, a vintage the client found very flattering.

hindi: पूर्वानुमान विश्लेषण — पुराने डेटा से आगे क्या होगा, इसका अनुमान
definition: analysis that uses historical business data and statistical models to forecast what will likely happen next, such as customer churn
example: Predictive analytics flagged the churn risk perfectly, two weeks after the customer left.

hindi: पहले ही निवेश कर देना — कंपनी के फ़ंडिंग शुरू करने से पहले राउंड का प्रस्ताव
definition: to offer a term sheet before a company formally starts fundraising, securing the round ahead of competing investors
example: The fund tried to preempt the Series A, which the founders took as flattery and their advisors took as a sign to raise more.

hindi: वरीयता भुगतानों का ढेर — संस्थापकों से पहले चुकाई जाने वाली कुल निवेशक राशि
definition: the total liquidation preferences across every preferred round, which must be repaid before common shareholders receive anything
example: After five rounds the preference stack was taller than any realistic acquisition offer.

hindi: वरीयता शेयर — निवेशकों के विशेष अधिकार वाले शेयर
definition: investor shares carrying liquidation preference, anti-dilution protection and voting rights that founders' common shares lack
example: The employees own common, the investors own preferred stock, and the difference shows up only on the worst day.

hindi: पसंदीदा विक्रेता — पहले से मंज़ूर, तयशुदा शर्तों वाला आपूर्तिकर्ता
definition: a supplier already approved by procurement, with negotiated terms, that teams are expected to purchase from first
example: The preferred vendor was preferred mainly by the person who signed the master agreement.

hindi: असमय अनुकूलन — नापने से पहले तेज़ करने की ज़िद
definition: tuning performance before measuring whether it matters
example: He micro-optimized a loop that runs once, at startup, yearly.

hindi: समय से पहले विस्तार — उत्पाद-बाज़ार मेल से पहले भर्ती और ख़र्च बढ़ाना
definition: expanding hiring, spending and infrastructure before reaching product-market fit, a leading cause of startup failure
example: Premature scaling is a sales team of forty selling a product with four customers.

hindi: समय से पहले खिसकाना — पोस्टपोन का उल्टा
definition: to move something earlier — the opposite of postpone, Indian English's gift
example: Can we prepone the review to Wednesday and enjoy Friday?

hindi: बिक्री-पूर्व तकनीकी दल — सौदे से पहले डेमो और समाधान देने वाली टीम
definition: technical team supporting sellers before signature with demos, solution design and customer technical questions
example: Presales built a custom demo overnight for a feature engineering has never heard of.

hindi: दिखावटी उपस्थिति — मौजूद पर अनुत्पादक
definition: being visibly present or online without being productive
example: Late-night green dots are presenteeism, not progress.

hindi: शीर्ष विक्रेता सम्मान — सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन पर पुरस्कार यात्रा
definition: the annual award trip for top-performing salespeople
example: He mentions President's Club the way other people mention their kids.

hindi: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति — मीडिया के लिए आधिकारिक घोषणा
definition: an official announcement sent to journalists, written like news and read like marketing
example: The press release says 'industry-leading'; the industry was not consulted.

hindi: दबाव-परीक्षण करना — योजना की कमज़ोरियाँ जाँचना
definition: to challenge a plan hard to find its weak points
example: Pressure-test the pricing before the customers do it for free.

hindi: मूल्य सूची पुस्तिका — हर उत्पाद और योजना की आधिकारिक कीमतें
definition: the official internal catalogue of products, plans and approved prices that sales quotes are built from
example: The price book said two hundred per seat; the rep's heart said whatever closes by Friday.

hindi: लक्ष्य मूल्य — विश्लेषक का अनुमानित भावी शेयर भाव
definition: analyst's forecast of where a share price should trade within twelve months, published alongside their rating
example: Three brokers raised their price target the morning after the stock had already doubled.

hindi: भाव में शामिल — खबर का असर पहले से कीमत में आ चुका होना
definition: already reflected in the current price because investors expected the news beforehand
example: The layoff announcement was priced in; the stock had dropped the week the offsite got cancelled.

hindi: मूल्य-निर्धारित निवेश दौर — तय मूल्यांकन पर शेयर जारी करने वाली फ़ंडिंग
definition: an equity financing with an agreed valuation and share price, issuing preferred stock rather than notes or SAFEs
example: After three years of SAFEs, the first priced round came with more lawyers than employees.

hindi: मूल्य कदम — दाम बढ़ाने का विनम्र नाम
definition: earnings-call euphemism for raising customer prices, framed as strategic moves rather than increases
example: Pricing actions offset inflation, the CFO explained, while customers called them price hikes.

hindi: मूल्य पृष्ठ — वेबसाइट पर प्लान और उनके दाम
definition: the website page listing plans and prices, plus one column that says contact us
example: The pricing page has three tiers; everyone asks about a secret fourth.

hindi: मूल्य शक्ति — ग्राहक खोए बिना दाम बढ़ाने की क्षमता
definition: company's ability to raise customer prices without losing meaningful sales volume, a prized competitive advantage
example: We have real pricing power, said the CEO, the week churn doubled.

hindi: प्राथमिक मापदंड — प्रयोग की जीत-हार पहले से तय करने वाला आँकड़ा
definition: the one metric named in advance to judge an experiment
example: The primary metric lost, so the recap leads with a secondary one.

hindi: छाप-छाप कर डिबगिंग — जगह-जगह प्रिंट डालकर बग खोजना
definition: hunting bugs by sprinkling print statements everywhere, debugger be damned
example: Advanced tooling installed, printf debugging chosen anyway.

hindi: पूर्व अनुमति — दवा देने से पहले बीमा की मंज़ूरी लेना
definition: insurer requirement that a prescriber obtain approval before a specific drug is covered, often slowing uptake of expensive therapies
example: The launch dashboard tracks prescriptions written and prescriptions still stuck in prior authorization, which are different columns for a reason.

hindi: गोपनीयता नीति — उपयोक्ता डेटा के इस्तेमाल का घोषित नियम
definition: a public statement of how user data is collected and used
example: Update the privacy policy before marketing updates the tracking.

hindi: निजता-रक्षक — निजी डेटा उजागर किए बिना काम करने वाला
definition: designed to deliver AI features without exposing individuals' personal data
example: The insights are privacy-preserving: we learn trends, not that you skipped Tuesday.

hindi: अर्जित अवकाश — काम के आधार पर जमा होने वाली लंबी छुट्टी
definition: an Indian English category of earned paid leave that accumulates with service and can often be carried forward or encashed
example: Twenty days of privilege leave saved up, and the sprint calendar has no gaps.

hindi: विशेष पहुँच — सिस्टम बदलने वाले उच्च अधिकार जिन पर कड़ी निगरानी
definition: powerful administrator permissions over critical systems, granted sparingly, logged and closely watched by security
example: Privileged access now requires three approvals, a ticket and a reason longer than the fix.

hindi: विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त और गोपनीय — वकील से बातचीत का सुरक्षित ठप्पा
definition: a label marking communications with lawyers to claim protection from disclosure in litigation, though labeling alone never guarantees privilege
example: He wrote 'privileged and confidential' on the lunch order, just to be safe.

hindi: आनुपातिक अधिकार — अगले दौर में हिस्सा बनाए रखने का हक़
definition: an investor's right to keep their ownership percentage by joining future rounds
example: The angel exercised her pro rata; she likes owning exactly one percent.

hindi: समस्या क्षेत्र — समाधान सोचने से पहले समस्या की पूरी समझ
definition: the territory of user needs, understood before proposing solutions
example: Stay in the problem space; nobody said the answer is an app.

hindi: ख़रीद प्रक्रिया — कंपनी के लिए सामान-सेवाएँ ख़रीदने की औपचारिक व्यवस्था
definition: the formal process of buying goods and services for a company
example: Procurement needs three quotes before we can buy one license.

hindi: उत्पादन वातावरण — असली उपयोगकर्ताओं वाला लाइव सिस्टम
definition: the live production environment where real users and real consequences live
example: Wait, is this terminal pointed at prod?

hindi: उत्पाद संचालन — प्रोडक्ट टीमों के औज़ार, डेटा और प्रक्रियाएँ सँभालने वाला काम
definition: the function supporting product teams with tooling, data, processes and customer insights so product managers can focus on decisions
example: Product ops built a template for writing templates.

hindi: प्रोडक्ट ओनर — बैकलॉग की प्राथमिकता तय करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the person who owns the backlog and decides what's worth building
example: Ask the product owner; the backlog is her kingdom.

hindi: मुफ़्त उत्पाद बँटाई — इस उम्मीद में क्रिएटरों को सामान भेजना कि वे ज़िक्र करें
definition: sending free products to creators without payment, hoping they will mention or review them voluntarily
example: The product seeding campaign shipped two hundred boxes and produced one unboxing, filmed by the intern's cousin.

hindi: उत्पाद-सूझ — क्या बनाना सार्थक होगा इसकी अंतर्दृष्टि
definition: the intuition for what users need and what's worth building
example: Product sense is knowing which of ten reasonable ideas actually matters.

hindi: उत्पाद तिकड़ी — प्रोडक्ट मैनेजर, डिज़ाइनर और टेक लीड की साझा खोज टीम
definition: the product manager, designer and tech lead who conduct customer discovery together and jointly decide what to build
example: The product trio interviewed customers together, then argued separately about what they heard.

hindi: उत्पाद आधारित कंपनी — अपना सॉफ्टवेयर बनाकर बेचने वाली कंपनी
definition: in Indian English, a company building and selling its own software, generally seen as better paying than client services work
example: Every service engineer's LinkedIn headline quietly reads 'aspiring product-based company'.

hindi: उत्पाद-प्रेरित वृद्धि — बिक्री टीम से पहले उत्पाद ख़ुद बिके
definition: a strategy where self-serve product usage drives acquisition and expansion
example: Product-led growth: the free tier does the cold calling.

hindi: उत्पाद-आधारित बिक्री — मुफ़्त उपयोगकर्ताओं के संकेतों पर सेल्स का संपर्क
definition: a hybrid motion where sales teams target accounts already using a free or self-serve product, prioritized by usage signals
example: Product-led sales means the rep calls you right after your third login.

hindi: उत्पाद-बाज़ार मेल — जब ग्राहक उत्पाद को सचमुच चाहने लगें
definition: the stage where a product satisfies strong market demand and customers keep coming back
example: We can't scale marketing until we find product-market fit.

hindi: उत्पादन तैयारी समीक्षा — लॉन्च से पहले सेवा की निगरानी और संचालन की जाँच
definition: a checklist review before launch confirming a service has monitoring, alerts, runbooks, capacity and an on-call owner
example: The production readiness review asked who owned the pager, and the room discovered a new hobby of staring at laptops.

hindi: उत्पादकता का नाटक — दिखावे की व्यस्तता
definition: visible busyness performed to look productive rather than be productive
example: Instant replies at midnight are productivity theater, not throughput.

hindi: लाभ केंद्र — सीधे कमाई करने वाला विभाग
definition: a part of the business that directly generates revenue
example: Sales calls itself a profit center at every all-hands.

hindi: मुनाफ़ा चेतावनी — नतीजों से पहले ही कम कमाई की सार्वजनिक सूचना
definition: public announcement ahead of scheduled results that earnings will fall short of guidance or market expectations
example: The profit warning went out at seven, the share price went out at seven-oh-one.

hindi: स्वचालित विज्ञापन-ख़रीद वाला — सॉफ़्टवेयर नीलामी से पल भर में ख़रीदे गए विज्ञापन
definition: describing advertising bought automatically through software auctions in real time, rather than negotiated directly with publishers
example: The programmatic campaign placed our banking advertisement beside a quiz about which cheese you are.

hindi: क्रमिक प्रकटीकरण — ज़रूरत पड़ने पर ही ब्योरा दिखाना
definition: revealing details gradually so users aren't overwhelmed at once
example: It's progressive disclosure, not burying the export button five menus deep.

hindi: प्रोजेक्ट पर नियुक्ति — किसी कर्मचारी को औपचारिक रूप से प्रोजेक्ट पर लगाना
definition: in Indian English, formally assigning an employee to a project in the resourcing system, which ends bench time
example: His project allocation came through on Friday evening, for a Monday start in another city.

hindi: पदोन्नति समिति — तरक्की के मामलों पर फ़ैसला करने वाला समूह
definition: the group of senior leaders who read promotion cases and decide which candidates advance a level
example: The promo committee spent four minutes on his case and forty on whether the rubric needed a font change.

hindi: पदोन्नति का निर्धारित मौसम — साल के तय दौर
definition: the fixed windows each year when promotions are considered
example: Miss the promo cycle by a week, wait six months.

hindi: पदोन्नति-प्रेरित विकास — तरक्की के लिए नई चीज़ें बनाना, पुरानी सँभालना नहीं
definition: building shiny launches that look good in promotion cases while maintenance work nobody gets credit for decays
example: Three internal chat apps exist because of promo-driven development, and none of them has an owner.

hindi: प्रशंसक ग्राहक — उत्पाद की सिफ़ारिश करने को तत्पर
definition: a customer enthusiastic enough to recommend you, per the survey anyway
example: He's a promoter on the survey and a detractor in the hallway.

hindi: प्रवर्तक समूह — कंपनी पर नियंत्रण रखने वाले संस्थापक, परिवार और उनकी कंपनियाँ
definition: in Indian English, the founders, their family members and affiliated entities who control a listed company and disclose holdings
example: The promoter group trimmed its stake by two percent, and the stock fell as though they had fled the country.

hindi: पदोन्नति के लिए तैयार प्रमाण-दस्तावेज़
definition: the evidence document assembled to argue someone deserves promotion
example: The promotion packet took longer to write than the project it described.

hindi: प्रॉम्प्ट — एआई को दिया गया निर्देश या सवाल
definition: the text you give an AI model to tell it what to do
example: Half the job is writing code; the other half is begging via prompt.

hindi: प्रॉम्प्ट अभियांत्रिकी — मनचाहा उत्तर पाने के लिए निर्देश गढ़ने की कला
definition: crafting and refining prompts so a model reliably does what you want
example: Three days of prompt engineering later, it stopped signing every reply 'Namaste, gym fam'.

hindi: प्रॉम्प्ट इंजेक्शन — पढ़वाई गई सामग्री में छिपे निर्देशों से मॉडल का अपहरण
definition: hiding malicious instructions in content a model reads, hijacking its behavior
example: A workout note said 'ignore previous instructions' — nice prompt injection attempt, Kevin.

hindi: निर्देश संग्रह — टीम के आज़माए हुए निर्देशों का साझा भंडार
definition: a shared, curated collection of tested prompts a team reuses instead of rewriting instructions every time
example: The prompt library has three hundred entries, and everyone still uses the one Priya wrote.

hindi: प्रमाण-बिंदु — दावे को सही ठहराने वाले तथ्य
definition: specific facts, statistics, customer results or features that substantiate a marketing claim and support each pillar of the messaging
example: We claim to be the fastest; the proof points team is still looking for evidence.

hindi: संभावित ग्राहक — जिससे सौदे की उम्मीद हो
definition: a potential customer a salesperson is actively pursuing
example: The prospect loved the demo, which means nothing until legal sees the contract.

hindi: ग्राहक-खोज — नए संभावित ख़रीदार तलाशने का काम
definition: the work of finding and contacting potential new customers
example: Prospecting hour: coffee, a list of fifty names, and unearned optimism.

hindi: वीटो अधिकार — कुछ बड़े फ़ैसलों पर निवेशकों की सहमति ज़रूरी
definition: investor veto rights over major company actions such as selling, raising money, issuing senior shares or changing the charter
example: The founder learned about the protective provisions the day he tried to raise a bridge without asking.

hindi: अनुमानित पर्सोना — शोध से पहले टीम की धारणाओं पर बना उपयोगकर्ता
definition: a persona built from team assumptions before research exists, meant to be validated or replaced later
example: The proto-persona was supposed to be temporary; three years on, 'Busy Priya' still has a desk.

hindi: कार्यशील नमूना — असली उत्पाद जैसा व्यवहार करता क्लिक-योग्य मॉडल
definition: a clickable model that simulates the product before it's built
example: The prototype demos beautifully as long as you click only the one working button.

hindi: पहुँच व्यवस्था — नए कर्मचारी के खाते, टूल और अनुमतियाँ तैयार करना
definition: preparing accounts, tools, laptop and system access for a newly hired employee or changed role
example: Provisioning took two weeks, so the new hire spent orientation reading the wiki on a borrowed login.

hindi: पास दिखने वालों को अनजाने में तरजीह — दूरस्थ कर्मचारियों की कीमत पर
definition: favoring people physically visible in the office over remote colleagues
example: Proximity bias meant the promotion went to whoever sat near the VP.

hindi: मतदान सलाहकार — संस्थागत निवेशकों को वोट देने की सिफ़ारिश करने वाली फ़र्म
definition: a firm that recommends to institutional investors how to vote on director elections, executive compensation and shareholder resolutions
example: One lukewarm report from the proxy advisor and the pay committee discovered a sudden fondness for performance conditions.

hindi: मत-संग्राम — शेयरधारकों के वोट जीतकर निदेशक मंडल पर कब्ज़े की लड़ाई
definition: a contest where dissident shareholders solicit other shareholders' votes to replace board directors or force strategic changes
example: The proxy fight produced more glossy letters to shareholders than the company had sent in a decade.

hindi: स्थानापन्न मापदंड — असली लक्ष्य की जगह नापा जाने वाला आसान आँकड़ा
definition: an easier-to-measure stand-in for the outcome you actually care about
example: Time in app is a proxy metric for value, or for confusion.

hindi: वार्षिक मतदान मौसम — आम बैठकों और शेयरधारक मतदान की भीड़ वाला समय
definition: the months each year when most public companies hold annual meetings and shareholders vote on directors and proposals
example: It's proxy season, so investor relations has stopped taking lunch breaks and started taking antacids.

hindi: मतदान सूचना-पत्र — वार्षिक बैठक से पहले शेयरधारकों को भेजा गया अनिवार्य दस्तावेज़
definition: the mandatory filing sent to shareholders before the annual meeting, detailing director nominees, executive compensation and voting items
example: Every spring the proxy statement reveals what the CEO earned, and every spring the office pretends not to read it.

hindi: सार्वजनिक सूचना — पूरी टीम के लिए ज़रूरी चेतावनी
definition: public service announcement; chat heading for a general warning or tip meant for the whole team
example: PSA: the coffee machine is broken again, the most-reacted message of the week.

hindi: कृपया नीचे देखें — नीचे के संदेश या विवरण पर ध्यान दें
definition: please see below; email phrase directing readers to details or earlier messages further down
example: PSB, he wrote, forwarding a thread forty replies deep.

hindi: प्रदर्शन-आधारित शेयर इकाइयाँ — लक्ष्य पूरे होने पर ही मिलने वाले शेयर
definition: performance stock units; equity awards that vest only when company targets such as revenue or share price are achieved
example: His PSUs depend on a share price target that the market seems to have heard about and ignored.

hindi: बिना डर के गलती या असहमति कह पाने का माहौल
definition: a climate where people can admit mistakes or disagree without punishment
example: Psychological safety is measured by who speaks after the VP does.

hindi: कृपया देख लें — समीक्षक से बदलावों पर नज़र डालने का विनम्र अनुरोध
definition: please take a look; a polite request asking a reviewer to read your code changes or document
example: PTAL, it's a two-line change, ignore the other four hundred lines.

hindi: सवेतन अवकाश — छुट्टी के भुगतान-सहित दिन
definition: paid time off; vacation days the company pays you not to work
example: He scheduled PTO, then attended two meetings from the beach.

hindi: आगे खींचना — अगली तिमाही का सौदा इसी तिमाही में बंद करवाना
definition: persuading a customer to sign earlier, moving a deal into the current quarter
example: To pull in the deal, we offered a discount so generous the customer asked if we were okay.

hindi: मर्ज का अनुरोध — बदलाव को समीक्षा हेतु पेश करना
definition: a proposed change submitted for review before merging
example: My pull request is small, only 87 files.

hindi: फ़ैसला दाग़ना — आख़िरकार क़दम उठा ही देना
definition: to finally commit and act
example: After three quarters of debate, we pulled the trigger.

hindi: माँग का पहले खिंचना — भविष्य की बिक्री का पहले हो जाना
definition: sales shifted into an earlier period by promotions or panic buying, leaving later periods weaker
example: Record quarter, pure pull-forward, and next quarter already has an apology drafted.

hindi: त्वरित सर्वेक्षण — कर्मचारियों की मनोदशा जानने का छोटा, बार-बार होने वाला सर्वे
definition: a short, frequent employee survey measuring morale, engagement and wellbeing between the annual surveys
example: The pulse survey asked how stressed everyone felt, with a mandatory completion deadline of today.

hindi: चढ़ाओ और बेचो — प्रचार से भाव बढ़ाकर ऊँचे पर बेच निकलना
definition: hyping an asset to inflate its price, then selling holdings before the price collapses
example: That influencer's token was a pump and dump with an unusually good logo.

hindi: पंचआउट कैटलॉग — खरीद प्रणाली के भीतर से सीधे विक्रेता की वेबसाइट पर ख़रीदारी
definition: a supplier's online catalogue opened from inside the company purchasing system, so selected items return as a requisition
example: The punchout catalog made buying pens easy and buying anything useful impossible.

hindi: आगे सरकाना — निर्णय या काम अगले चक्र पर टालना
definition: to defer a task or decision to a later sprint or quarter
example: Let's punt this to next quarter, where problems go to rest.

hindi: आज़माइश से लगाव — मुफ़्त इस्तेमाल करवाकर ग्राहक को उत्पाद का आदी बनाना
definition: a closing technique that lets a buyer keep the product freely for a while, betting they become too attached to return it
example: The free trial was a puppy dog close, and by week two the whole finance team refused to give it back.

hindi: क्रय माँग-पत्र — खरीद से पहले आंतरिक स्वीकृति के लिए भरा जाने वाला अनुरोध
definition: the internal request an employee raises asking approval to purchase something, which becomes a purchase order once approved
example: I raised a purchase requisition for a monitor and received three approval emails and no monitor.

hindi: बैंगनी गिलहरी — ऐसा उम्मीदवार जिसकी हर योग्यता असंभव रूप से सटीक हो
definition: a candidate matching every requirement of an unrealistically specific role, and therefore nearly impossible to find
example: Fluent Mandarin, Kubernetes, and ten years in dental billing: we are hunting a purple squirrel.

hindi: उद्देश्य का दिखावा — सामाजिक मिशन का प्रचार बिना ठोस काम के
definition: marketing a company's social purpose or mission loudly while its actual practices, spending and decisions do little to support it
example: The purpose-washing campaign cost more than the purpose.

hindi: दूसरे अवसरों की तलाश — जबरन विदाई को सम्मानजनक दिखाने वाली भाषा
definition: corporate euphemism announcing someone was forced out or fired, framed as a voluntary departure
example: He left to pursue other opportunities, effective immediately, badge already deactivated.

hindi: अन्य अवसरों की तलाश — जाने की असली वजह छिपाने वाला वाक्य
definition: standard departure announcement wording that hides whether someone resigned, was pushed, or was fired
example: The VP is pursuing other opportunities, effective about ten minutes ago.

hindi: सौदा प्रयास — किसी बड़े ग्राहक सौदे को जीतने की संगठित कोशिश
definition: organized effort by a professional services firm to secure a specific large client contract
example: The pursuit team spent two months and one proposal budget chasing a client who went in-house.

hindi: आगे टालना — तिथि या कार्य को बाद में खिसकाना
definition: to move a date or task later on purpose
example: Let's push the release to Tuesday, famously a lucky day.

hindi: प्रतिरोध करना — असहमति जताकर माँग का जवाब देना
definition: to respectfully resist a request or decision
example: The team pushed back on the deadline; the deadline blinked.

hindi: सीमाएँ लाँघना — मुमकिन की हद से आगे जाना
definition: to go beyond accepted limits
example: The design team pushed the envelope; legal pushed it back.

hindi: उत्पादन में भेजना — बदलाव को असली ग्राहकों वाले लाइव सिस्टम पर जारी करना
definition: releasing code changes straight onto the live production system that real customers depend upon
example: He pushed to prod before lunch and spent the afternoon explaining why.

hindi: फ़िलहाल रोकना — बात को बाद के लिए टाँक देना
definition: to pause a topic with the intention of returning, rarely honored
example: Let's put a pin in it until after launch.

hindi: बढ़त और घटत — किसी आँकड़े को ऊपर-नीचे करने वाले छोटे-छोटे कारण
definition: the assorted positive and negative items that together explain movement in a financial figure
example: There were puts and takes this quarter, which is finance for 'please don't ask about individual lines'.

hindi: पिरामिड सिद्धांत — पहले निष्कर्ष, फिर उसके समर्थन में तर्क
definition: structuring a document or deck with the main conclusion first, then grouping the supporting arguments and evidence beneath it
example: By the pyramid principle, the answer goes on slide one, so naturally she put it on slide forty.

hindi: प्रश्नोत्तर — श्रोताओं के सवालों का सत्र
definition: a segment where the audience asks questions
example: Keep five minutes for Q&A or people will ambush you after.

hindi: त्रैमासिक समीक्षा — तिमाही नतीजों और योजना की बैठक
definition: quarterly business review; a formal look at the quarter's numbers and plans
example: The QBR deck is ninety slides; the decision is one.

hindi: तिमाही-दर-तिमाही — पिछली तिमाही से तुलना
definition: quarter over quarter; comparing results against the immediately preceding quarter, also called sequential growth
example: Year-over-year looked ugly, so the deck switched to QoQ without comment.

hindi: योग्य लघु व्यवसाय शेयर — अमेरिकी कर-छूट वाले स्टार्टअप शेयर
definition: qualified small business stock; American startup shares whose holders may exclude capital gains after holding them five years
example: Half of founder dinner conversations are about QSBS, and the other half pretend they aren't.

hindi: गुणात्मक शोध — क्यों और कैसे समझाने वाली बातचीत और अवलोकन
definition: qualitative research; the interviews and observations explaining why
example: The qual explains what the dashboard numbers are mumbling about.

hindi: योग्य फ़ंडिंग — वह राउंड जिसमें नोट या SAFE शेयर में बदल जाए
definition: a priced equity round above a minimum size that automatically triggers conversion of outstanding notes and SAFEs
example: Two million counted as a qualified financing, so naturally the round closed at one point nine.

hindi: परखा हुआ संभावित ग्राहक — बजट और ज़रूरत की पुष्टि के बाद
definition: a lead vetted for budget, need, and authority before sales spends time on it
example: It's only a qualified lead if someone besides the intern answered the email.

hindi: परखना — लीड में दम है या नहीं, जाँचना
definition: to assess whether a lead is worth pursuing, and walk away if not
example: Qualify hard: the fastest deal you'll ever work is the one you qualify out.

hindi: कमाई की गुणवत्ता — मुनाफ़ा कितना टिकाऊ और नकदी-समर्थित है
definition: assessment of how sustainable and cash-backed reported profits are, stripping out one-time items and accounting choices
example: The quality of earnings review found most of the growth lived in a single reserve release.

hindi: भर्ती की गुणवत्ता — नए कर्मचारी का बाद में वास्तविक प्रदर्शन
definition: a recruiting metric judging hires by later performance, retention and manager ratings
example: Quality of hire is the metric everyone praises and nobody has managed to measure.

hindi: गुणवत्ता अंक — सर्च विज्ञापन की प्रासंगिकता का मंच-प्रदत्त अंक, जो कीमत तय करता है
definition: search platform's rating of advertisement relevance and landing page experience, which lowers costs when higher
example: Our quality score was three, which the agency described as room for improvement.

hindi: मात्रात्मक शोध — कितना और कितने बताने वाले आँकड़े
definition: quantitative data; the numbers saying how much and how many
example: The quant says users leave at step three; the qual says why.

hindi: परिमाणीकरण — मॉडल के अंकों की परिशुद्धता घटाकर उसे हल्का-तेज़ बनाना
definition: shrinking a model's numbers to lower precision so it runs faster and smaller
example: After quantization the model fits on the watch and only got slightly dumber.

hindi: अलग करना — बार-बार अस्थिर होने वाले परीक्षण को मुख्य जाँच से अस्थायी रूप से हटाना
definition: to temporarily remove a flaky test from the required build checks so it stops blocking merges
example: We quarantined the test in January and it has been living in quarantine happily ever since.

hindi: तिमाही नियोजन — हर तिमाही का प्राथमिकता-निर्धारण अनुष्ठान
definition: the ritual of choosing next quarter's priorities while finishing last quarter's
example: Quarterly planning ate three weeks of the quarter it planned.

hindi: जुगाड़ू — जल्दी का कामचलाऊ हल
definition: done fast and imperfectly to serve an immediate need
example: A quick and dirty script became our billing system.

hindi: छोटा सा सवाल — जो अक्सर छोटा नहीं होता
definition: an opener that promises brevity and rarely delivers it
example: His 'quick question' at 4:58 had three sub-questions.

hindi: झटपट जीत — कम मेहनत में जल्दी दिखने वाला नतीजा
definition: a fast, low-effort improvement used to show momentum
example: Fixing the pricing-page typo was today's quick win.

hindi: उपेक्षा से इस्तीफा दिलवाना — काम और मौके छीनकर
definition: starving someone of work, raises, and attention until they resign
example: Quiet firing looks like a calendar that slowly empties.

hindi: मौन अवधि — IPO के आसपास कंपनी के प्रचार पर नियामक रोक
definition: the regulated window around an offering when a company must avoid promotional statements about itself
example: During the quiet period the founder's podcast went mysteriously on hiatus.

hindi: बिना इस्तीफे बस उतना ही काम जितने के पैसे मिलते हैं
definition: doing exactly your job description and nothing more, without resigning
example: HR called it quiet quitting; he called it working the hours he's paid.

hindi: गणपूर्ति — निर्णय हेतु न्यूनतम उपस्थिति
definition: the minimum attendance needed for a meeting to decide anything
example: Three declines later, we lost quorum and rescheduled again.

hindi: बिक्री लक्ष्य — तय अवधि में अनिवार्य आँकड़ा
definition: the revenue number a salesperson must hit per quarter or year
example: He hit quota in November and spent December 'strategically planning.'

hindi: लक्ष्य प्राप्ति — विक्रेता ने अपने कोटे का कितना प्रतिशत पूरा किया
definition: percentage of assigned sales quota a seller or team actually closed within the period
example: Quota attainment was 'solid across the board', which means two people carried everyone.

hindi: लक्ष्य राहत — किसी कारणवश विक्रेता के कोटे में कटौती
definition: reduction of a seller's quota to account for leave, territory changes or lost accounts
example: She asked for quota relief after her biggest account was reassigned, and received a motivational speech instead.

hindi: कोटा-धारी — जिस पर सीधा बिक्री लक्ष्य हो
definition: describes a sales role personally assigned a revenue target, with commission depending on hitting it
example: We have forty quota-carrying reps and sixty people who schedule meetings about them.

hindi: कोटेशन — काम या सामान की प्रस्तावित क़ीमत
definition: a vendor's stated price for specified work or goods
example: Get a second quote; the first one funded someone's yacht.

hindi: भूलभुलैया — ऐसा विषय जिसमें उतरते ही समय खो जाए
definition: a topic that consumes far more time the deeper you go
example: The logging bug was a three-day rabbit hole.

hindi: भूमिका मैट्रिक्स — कौन उत्तरदायी, जवाबदेह, परामर्शित, सूचित
definition: a matrix naming who's responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed
example: We built a RACI, then argued over who owns the RACI.

hindi: खरी पर परवाह भरी बात — सीधी आलोचना जो सम्मान के साथ कही जाए
definition: feedback style that pairs caring personally with challenging directly, saying hard truths kindly and plainly
example: He invoked radical candor, then spent twenty minutes being candid and zero minutes caring.

hindi: पुनर्प्राप्ति-सम्वर्धित सृजन — पहले दस्तावेज़ खोजो, फिर मॉडल से उत्तर बनवाओ
definition: retrieval-augmented generation; fetching relevant documents and letting the model answer from them
example: RAG means the bot quotes our help docs instead of its dreams.

hindi: लाल-पीला-हरा स्थिति — रंगों से परियोजना की सेहत
definition: red, amber, green; project health compressed into a traffic light
example: The RAG status turned amber, the color of managed panic.

hindi: गुस्से में आवेदन — दफ़्तर से नाराज़ होकर थोक में दूसरी नौकरियों के लिए अर्ज़ी भेजना
definition: angrily sending dozens of quick applications to other employers after a frustrating workday, quitting the current job in spirit
example: After the third reorg email, Priya spent her lunch break rage applying to eleven companies and one bakery.

hindi: गुस्से के क्लिक — खीझ में एक ही जगह बार-बार क्लिक
definition: rapid repeated clicking on the same element by a frustrated user, tracked as a signal of broken design
example: Session replays showed rage clicks on the 'Save' button, which saves, but silently.

hindi: इंद्रधनुषी दिखावा — प्राइड समर्थन का प्रचार बिना वास्तविक समावेशी नीतियों के
definition: marketing public support for LGBTQ+ causes, often during Pride month, without matching inclusive policies, funding or action internally
example: The logo went rainbow on June first and back on July first; employees called it rainbow-washing.

hindi: कारोबार लाने वाला — जो फ़र्म के लिए बड़े ग्राहक और सौदे लाता है
definition: senior person who reliably brings large clients and new business into a professional services firm
example: The rainmaker never touched a slide, but every slide existed because of her.

hindi: गुज़ारे लायक़ मुनाफ़ा — बस संस्थापकों का ख़र्च निकलना
definition: earning just enough to cover the founders' bare living costs
example: We're ramen profitable, which the team celebrated with actual ramen.

hindi: नए विक्रेता का गति पकड़ना — पूर्ण लक्ष्य तक पहुँचना
definition: to get a new rep up to full productivity and full quota
example: Reps ramp in three months, according to a plan written by someone who never has.

hindi: गति बढ़ाना — क्षमता या प्रयास क्रमशः बढ़ाना
definition: to increase capacity, effort, or speed gradually
example: We're ramping up hiring right after the budget freeze thaws.

hindi: टीम घटाव — प्रोजेक्ट में लोगों की संख्या क्रमशः कम करना
definition: planned reduction in headcount on a client project, releasing engineers as budgets shrink or work winds down
example: The ramp-down email said "transition", but the bench knew exactly what it meant.

hindi: रैंक करो और निकालो — सबसे निचले कर्मचारियों को हर साल हटाना
definition: forced ranking of employees against each other, with the lowest-ranked slice fired every review cycle
example: Under rank and yank, the team's best strategy was quietly hiring someone to be the bottom ten percent.

hindi: सिफ़ारिश, सहमति, निष्पादन, राय, निर्णय — बड़े फ़ैसलों में भूमिकाएँ बाँटने का ढाँचा
definition: recommend, agree, perform, input, decide; a decision-rights framework clarifying who proposes, who signs off and who owns the final decision
example: Per the RAPID, I have input, which means I get to watch.

hindi: दर सूची — हर पद के प्रति घंटे या प्रति दिन शुल्क की तालिका
definition: table of hourly or daily billing prices for each consultant level, negotiated with the client
example: According to the rate card, the analyst's spreadsheet cost more than his car.

hindi: दर सीमा — तय समय में अनुरोधों की अधिकतम संख्या
definition: the provider's ceiling on how many model requests an account may send each minute before further calls are refused
example: The launch went perfectly until we hit the rate limit in front of the customer.

hindi: अंधी गली में घुसना — बेनतीजा बहस में समय गँवाना
definition: to sink meeting time into an unproductive tangent
example: We ratholed on naming for twenty of our thirty minutes.

hindi: मूल्यांकन-अंक — जिससे बोनस और पदोन्नति तय होती है
definition: the score a review assigns you, driving bonus and promotion odds
example: The rating scale has five points and two that are ever used.

hindi: भूमिका-आधारित पहुँच नियंत्रण — पद के हिसाब से अनुमतियाँ तय होना
definition: role-based access control; system permissions granted through assigned roles rather than individual people
example: Under RBAC, the intern and the CFO share a role called 'misc' that can see everything.

hindi: रिलीज़ उम्मीदवार — अंतिम जाँच हेतु तैयार संस्करण, जो ठीक निकला तो वही जारी होगा
definition: release candidate; a build believed ready to ship, released for final testing before becoming the official version
example: We are on RC7, which is a polite way of saying the first six were not candidates.

hindi: मूल कारण विश्लेषण — समस्या की असली वजह की जाँच
definition: root cause analysis; the formal hunt for why something actually broke
example: The RCA is due Friday; the root cause is due whenever.
