hindi: पुनर्मूल्यांकन — बाज़ार का किसी कंपनी को नया, ऊँचा या नीचा गुणक देना
definition: when markets change the valuation multiple they assign a company, upward or downward
example: Leadership hoped the AI announcement would trigger a re-rating; it triggered follow-up questions.

hindi: दायरा फिर तय करना — बदले हालात में काम की सीमा दोबारा खींचना
definition: to redefine the boundaries of work after reality intervenes
example: Week three: we re-scoped the project into a different project.

hindi: के विषय में — जवाब का शीर्षक-चिह्न
definition: regarding — the prefix email adds to every reply in a chain
example: The subject is now 'Re: Re: Re: Final final v3'.

hindi: पहुंच — सामग्री देखने वाले अलग-अलग लोगों की कुल संख्या
definition: the number of distinct people who saw something
example: Our reach is huge if you count the intern's test accounts.

hindi: संपर्क करना — किसी से बात शुरू करना
definition: to contact someone; corporate for call, message, or email
example: Someone from sales will reach out shortly, and often.

hindi: पढ़े जाने की रसीद — संदेश खुलने का सबूत
definition: proof a message was opened, ending all plausible deniability
example: Read receipts are on, so 'just saw this' won't fly.

hindi: परिणाम-प्रस्तुति — नतीजों का सार साझा करना
definition: a summary presentation of results or decisions to a wider group
example: The research readout is Tuesday; leadership gets the short version.

hindi: अनुमान दोहराना — पिछला पूर्वानुमान बरक़रार रखना
definition: management confirming its previously issued revenue and earnings forecast remains unchanged, signalling nothing has broken
example: We reaffirm guidance, said the CFO, with the enthusiasm of a hostage video.

hindi: वास्तविक दुनिया का प्रमाण — क्लिनिकल ट्रायल के बाहर मरीज़ों से मिला डेटा
definition: clinical evidence drawn from routine patient records, claims and registries rather than controlled trials, used for regulators and payers
example: When the trial missed, the team discovered a deep passion for real-world evidence.

hindi: पुनर्संरेखण — टीमें बदलना, कभी-कभी छँटनी का पर्दा
definition: reshuffling teams, reporting lines and priorities, frequently announced alongside quiet layoffs
example: After the realignment, the org chart had fewer boxes and more dotted lines.

hindi: वसूली दर — दर्ज घंटों के मूल्य में से वास्तव में वसूला गया हिस्सा
definition: percentage of recorded billable hours value that the client actually ends up paying for
example: The work was brilliant; the realization rate suggested the client disagreed.

hindi: तर्कशील मॉडल — जवाब से पहले चरण-दर-चरण सोचने वाला मॉडल
definition: a model that works through problems step by step before answering, trading speed for accuracy
example: The reasoning model took eleven seconds to conclude you should drink water.

hindi: आधार बदलना — अपने बदलाव नई मुख्य शाखा पर फिर चढ़ाना
definition: to replay your commits on top of the latest main branch, rewriting history
example: Rebase before merging, and may the conflicts be gentle.

hindi: छूट की दीवार — बड़ी छूट के दम पर पुरानी दवा का नई को सूची से बाहर रखना
definition: an incumbent drug's large volume rebates that make payers reluctant to cover a cheaper or better competitor
example: Our drug is cheaper and better, which the rebate wall considers two irrelevant facts.

hindi: नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा प्रमाणपत्र — हरित बिजली उत्पादन के दावे का ख़रीदा जा सकने वाला अधिकार
definition: renewable energy certificate; tradable proof that megawatt hour of renewable electricity was generated, bought to claim cleaner power
example: We bought enough RECs to call the data centre green without changing a single cable.

hindi: भेजा ईमेल वापस खींचना — अक्सर नाकाम कोशिश
definition: to try to unsend an email; everyone gets notified you tried
example: He recalled the salary email, so everyone opened it immediately.

hindi: हालिया पक्षपात — सिर्फ़ ताज़ा घटनाओं के आधार पर मूल्यांकन
definition: review bias where the last few weeks of work outweigh the whole year's performance
example: Recency bias explains why the whole team suddenly volunteers for everything in November.

hindi: सिफ़ारिश इंजन — हर उपयोगकर्ता की अगली पसंद भाँपने वाला तंत्र
definition: a system predicting what each user wants next, from workouts to videos
example: The recommendation engine suggests rest days now, and retention went up.

hindi: मिलान करना — दो हिसाबों का फ़र्क़ सुलझाना
definition: to match two sets of records and resolve the differences
example: Someone must reconcile card statements with expense reports. Someone.

hindi: वसूली योग्य अग्रिम — भविष्य के कमीशन से काटी जाने वाली अग्रिम राशि
definition: advance paid against future commissions that sellers must repay from later earnings if they underperform
example: The recoverable draw felt like a bonus until the statement showed it walking back out the door.

hindi: लाल सागर — भीड़ भरा बाज़ार जहाँ प्रतिस्पर्धी कीमत पर लड़ते हैं
definition: a crowded existing market where competitors fight over the same customers, mostly through price cuts and shrinking margins
example: Our blue ocean strategy lasted until three competitors turned it into a red ocean by Tuesday.

hindi: लालफ़ीताशाही — काम रोकने वाली नौकरशाही प्रक्रियाएँ
definition: bureaucratic procedures that slow everything down
example: Two-day fix, six weeks of red tape.

hindi: रेड टीमिंग — कमज़ोरियाँ खोजने के लिए अपने ही सिस्टम पर हमला
definition: deliberately attacking your own AI system to find failures before users do
example: Red teaming day: everyone tries to make the coach say something lawsuit-worthy.

hindi: शेयर वापसी का अधिकार — तय समय बाद कंपनी से पैसा वापस मांगना
definition: an investor right to force the company to repurchase their preferred shares after a fixed period, typically years later
example: Nobody expects redemption rights to matter, which is exactly why the investor's counsel kept them in.

hindi: संशोधन चिह्नित करना — अनुबंध में बदलाव सुझाना
definition: to mark up a contract with proposed edits
example: Legal redlined the contract until it was mostly red.

hindi: पद समाप्त होने से नौकरी जाना — ब्रिटिश प्रयोग
definition: the British term for a layoff, where the role, not the person, is 'redundant'
example: The London office announced redundancies; the Slack emoji were universal.

hindi: कोड की पुनर्रचना — व्यवहार बदले बिना ढाँचा सुधारना
definition: to restructure code for clarity without changing its behavior
example: I'll just quickly refactor this, he said, three days ago.

hindi: उम्मीदवार के पुराने सहकर्मियों से पूछताछ
definition: calls to a candidate's former colleagues to verify how they actually work
example: The reference check was glowing, as references chosen by the candidate tend to be.

hindi: संदर्भ ग्राहक — संतुष्ट ग्राहक जो संभावित ग्राहकों से बात करने को तैयार हो
definition: satisfied customer who agrees to speak with prospective buyers, appear in case studies or vouch publicly for the product
example: Our one reference customer has now taken more sales calls than our sales team.

hindi: कर्मचारी द्वारा सुझाया गया उम्मीदवार — अक्सर बोनस के साथ
definition: a candidate recommended by a current employee, often for a bonus
example: He submitted the referral, collected the bonus, and apologized privately.

hindi: रेफ़रल योजना — ग्राहक द्वारा नया ग्राहक लाने पर इनाम
definition: a scheme rewarding customers for bringing in new customers
example: The referral program pays fifty dollars per friend; friendships priced accordingly.

hindi: परिशोधन — बैकलॉग कार्यों को स्पष्ट और आकलन-योग्य बनाना
definition: the politer modern name for grooming: clarifying and sizing upcoming backlog items
example: We renamed grooming to refinement; the tickets are equally vague.

hindi: पुनः पूर्वानुमान — साल के बीच में अनुमानित आँकड़े फिर से तय करना
definition: to revise the annual financial forecast midway through the year using actual year-to-date results
example: We reforecast in July, which is how the target quietly became achievable.

hindi: पुराने अनुदान के ऊपर नया इक्विटी अनुदान
definition: an additional equity grant layered on as earlier grants finish vesting
example: No refresh this cycle means the recruiter messages suddenly look interesting.

hindi: नवीनीकरण अनुदान — प्रारंभिक हिस्सेदारी निहित होने पर मिला नया अनुदान
definition: a fresh equity award given to existing employees, usually as initial grants finish vesting, to keep them staying
example: The refresh grant arrived the week after her recruiter call, which HR insisted was coincidence.

hindi: नवीकरण अनुदान — मौजूदा कर्मचारी को दिया गया अतिरिक्त इक्विटी अनुदान
definition: an additional equity grant given to existing employees, usually yearly with performance reviews, so total compensation holds after the initial grant vests
example: His refresher grant was so small that the vesting email felt like an apology.

hindi: इनकार — सुरक्षा नियमों के चलते मॉडल का अनुरोध ठुकराना
definition: a model declining a request its safety training judges inappropriate
example: The model's refusal rate spiked; now it won't even discuss protein shakes.

hindi: निष्पक्ष प्रकटीकरण नियम — अहम जानकारी सभी निवेशकों को एक साथ देने का नियम
definition: regulation fair disclosure; American rule requiring companies to share material information with all investors simultaneously, never selectively
example: The CEO started to answer the analyst's hallway question, then remembered Reg FD and admired the carpet instead.

hindi: पुरानी खराबी की वापसी — नया बदलाव पुराना फ़ीचर तोड़ दे
definition: a bug where something that used to work breaks after a change
example: The fix shipped, along with a regression in login.

hindi: औसत की ओर वापसी — असामान्य नतीजों का खुद सामान्य पर आ जाना
definition: extreme results drifting back toward normal on their own
example: The record week regressed to the mean, taking the forecast with it.

hindi: जिनका जाना कंपनी को अखरता है — अच्छे लोगों का पलायन
definition: departures the company actually minds; the people they wanted to keep
example: The dashboard splits leavers into regretted attrition and everyone management annoyed.

hindi: पंजीकरण दीवार — सामग्री से पहले मुफ़्त खाता बनवाने की शर्त
definition: registration wall requiring readers to create a free account before accessing articles, collecting their details
example: The regwall collected ten thousand emails, most of them ending in example.com.

hindi: पहिया दोबारा बनाना — बनी-बनाई चीज़ फिर से बनाना
definition: to rebuild something that already exists and works
example: We reinvented the wheel, but ours has our logo.

hindi: संबंधित-पक्ष लेन-देन — कंपनी और उसके अंदरूनी लोगों से जुड़े पक्ष के बीच सौदा
definition: a deal between the company and an insider, director, promoter or their relatives, requiring disclosure and approval
example: The office lease was a related-party transaction, which explained why the landlord shared the chairman's surname.

hindi: रिलीज़ शाखा — किसी संस्करण को स्थिर करने और जारी करने के लिए अलग की गई शाखा
definition: a branch split from the main branch to stabilise and ship a specific version while development continues elsewhere
example: Only critical fixes go into the release branch, and everything is critical this week.

hindi: रिलीज़ कप्तान — किसी एक रिलीज़ को समय पर और सुरक्षित जारी कराने का बारी-बारी ज़िम्मेदार इंजीनियर
definition: the engineer on a rotating duty responsible for coordinating, verifying and shipping one release safely
example: As release captain this week, her main job is saying 'not in this release' politely.

hindi: विमोचन टिप्पणियाँ — नए संस्करण के बदलावों का उपयोगकर्ता-सार
definition: the user-facing summary of what's new in a release
example: The release notes are cheerful; the incident channel tells the fuller story.

hindi: रिलीज़ ट्रेन — तय समय पर छूटती नियमित रिलीज़
definition: a fixed release schedule that departs on time with whatever's ready
example: Miss the release train and you wait six weeks on the platform.

hindi: राहत की तेज़ी — बुरी ख़बर के बाद अस्थायी रिकवरी
definition: a temporary price recovery after heavy selling, when feared news turns out less severe
example: Shares got a relief rally when the layoffs were only ten percent instead of the rumored twenty.

hindi: कार्यमुक्ति पत्र — नौकरी छोड़ने की आधिकारिक पुष्टि
definition: in Indian English, the formal letter from an employer confirming an employee has been released from duties
example: His next employer wanted the relieving letter, and his last employer wanted three more weeks to write it.

hindi: स्थानांतरण पैकेज — नई जगह जाने का ख़र्च कंपनी द्वारा
definition: short for relocation package; company-paid moving costs, temporary housing and travel when a role requires changing cities
example: The relo covered movers, a month of housing and one very optimistic city guide.

hindi: पुनः-विपणन — पुराने आगंतुकों या ग्राहकों तक विज्ञापन या ईमेल से दोबारा पहुँचना
definition: reaching previous website visitors or customers again with advertisements or emails, bringing them back to complete purchases
example: The remarketing budget exists mainly to remind people what they already decided against.

hindi: मूलतः दूरस्थ कार्य-संस्कृति — दफ़्तर अपवाद है, नियम नहीं
definition: designed so remote is the default and the office is optional
example: We're remote-first, except for decisions, which happen at headquarters.

hindi: रिमोट-अनुकूल — दूरस्थ काम की अनुमति, पर संस्कृति दफ़्तर-केंद्रित
definition: describing a company that permits remote work while its culture, decisions and promotions still centre on the office
example: The job ad said remote-friendly, which turned out to mean remote-tolerated.

hindi: मुकरना — स्वीकार किया प्रस्ताव बाद में ठुकरा देना
definition: to withdraw from an accepted offer before joining, done by either candidate or company
example: He reneged the Friday before his start date, which explained the silence on the onboarding emails.

hindi: नवीनीकरण — अनुबंध या सदस्यता की अवधि आगे बढ़ाना
definition: extending a contract or subscription for another term
example: The renewal auto-triggered before anyone remembered we hate the tool.

hindi: पुनः खुलने की दर — बंद टिकटों का वह हिस्सा जो फिर से खुल गया
definition: percentage of closed support tickets reopened because the customer's problem remained unresolved after the agent closed them
example: Our reopen rate dropped to zero once reopening tickets required a support ticket.

hindi: पुनः ऑर्डर स्तर — भंडार जिस स्तर पर पहुँचे तो नया माल मँगाना
definition: the inventory level that triggers a replenishment order, calculated from supplier lead time demand plus safety stock
example: The system flagged the reorder point perfectly; nobody reads the system.

hindi: टीमों और रिपोर्टिंग का फेरबदल
definition: a reshuffle of teams and reporting lines, arriving roughly twice a year
example: The third reorg this year gave him a fourth manager.

hindi: दोहराव गणना — कैमरे या सेंसर से कसरत के रेप गिनना
definition: automatically counting exercise repetitions from camera or sensor data
example: Rep counting works great until someone does half-reps and disputes the machine.

hindi: सबको एक साथ जवाब — पूरी सूची को उत्तर
definition: to answer everyone on the email, whether they wanted it or not
example: Someone hit reply-all to say congrats, and forty people agreed.

hindi: सबको-जवाब तूफ़ान — बड़ी सूची पर जवाबों की बाढ़
definition: flood of replies when many recipients on a large distribution list answer everyone at once
example: The reply-all storm peaked with forty people replying 'please remove me'.

hindi: अधीनस्थ कर्मचारी — जो किसी प्रबंधक को रिपोर्ट करता है
definition: an Indian English term for an employee who reports to a particular manager, meaning a direct report
example: He has twelve reportees and still books his own conference rooms.

hindi: सीधा प्रबंधक — जिसे कर्मचारी सीधे रिपोर्ट करता है
definition: an Indian English term for the manager an employee formally reports to, who approves leave and appraisal ratings
example: Your reporting manager approves leave; your actual manager is whoever pings loudest.

hindi: दोहराने के क़दम — गड़बड़ी को फिर से पैदा करने का तरीक़ा या उदाहरण
definition: a reliable set of steps or minimal example that reproduces a reported defect so engineers can investigate
example: No repro, no fix: 'it broke yesterday' is not a test case.

hindi: दोहराने के चरण — समस्या को फिर से उत्पन्न करने की क्रमवार विधि
definition: exact sequence of actions that reliably recreates a reported product problem, which engineering demands before investigating customer tickets
example: Engineering bounced the ticket for missing repro steps; the customer's steps were 'open the product'.

hindi: भर्ती स्वीकृति — किसी खाली पद को भरने की औपचारिक अनुमति
definition: short for requisition, the approved headcount request that authorises recruiters to open and fill a specific position
example: The req was approved in January, frozen in February and posted in March for a role that no longer exists.

hindi: भर्ती बोझ — एक रिक्रूटर पर एक साथ चल रहे पदों की संख्या
definition: the number of open requisitions assigned to one recruiter at the same time, used to measure recruiting capacity
example: With a req load of forty, the recruiter's candidate experience was mostly autoresponders.

hindi: बदलाव माँगना — समीक्षा में विलय रोककर सुधार की माँग करना
definition: the code review verdict that blocks a pull request from merging until the author addresses the reviewer's comments
example: She clicked request changes over a missing comma and left for a two-week holiday.

hindi: ज़रूरतें इकट्ठा करना — हितधारकों से पूछकर उत्पाद की माँगें लिखना
definition: collecting and documenting stakeholder and customer needs for a product or feature before design and engineering begin
example: Requirements gathering ended when the stakeholders stopped replying, not when they stopped changing their minds.

hindi: दिया हुआ नौकरी-प्रस्ताव वापस लेना
definition: to withdraw a job offer after extending it
example: The startup rescinded the offer two weeks before his start date.

hindi: शोध संचालन — प्रतिभागी भर्ती, सहमति और शोध-भंडार का प्रबंधन
definition: the operations behind user research: participant recruitment, consent, incentives, tools and shared insight storage
example: Research ops found us six participants by Friday, which is five more than the plan had.

hindi: आरक्षित विषय — वे फ़ैसले जो केवल बोर्ड या निवेशक की मंज़ूरी से हो सकते हैं
definition: decisions that management cannot make alone and require board or investor approval, such as acquisitions or large borrowing
example: Opening an office in Lisbon turned out to be one of the reserved matters, so the team's relocation plans waited a quarter.

hindi: वापसी उत्पादन — विदेश गया उत्पादन अपने देश वापस लाना
definition: bringing manufacturing or sourcing back to the home country after previously moving it overseas
example: The reshoring announcement came with a flag, a ribbon cutting and a forty percent price increase.

hindi: बर्ख़ास्तगी के बदले इस्तीफ़ा — निकाले जाने से पहले ख़ुद इस्तीफ़ा देने का विकल्प
definition: offer letting an employee resign instead of being fired, keeping their record cleaner
example: He chose to resign in lieu of termination, which is choosing the door you're pushed through.

hindi: स्वेच्छा से नौकरी छोड़ने की औपचारिक घोषणा
definition: formally quitting your job, ideally before it quits you
example: The resignation letter was three polite lines hiding two years of reasons.

hindi: पुनर्कौशल — कर्मचारी को बिल्कुल नई भूमिका के लिए प्रशिक्षित करना
definition: training employees for entirely different roles because automation is shrinking or replacing their current work
example: HR announced reskilling and layoffs in one email, so people read both paragraphs very carefully.

hindi: ऊपरी रूप बदलना — ढाँचा वही, सिर्फ़ रंग-रूप नया
definition: to change a product's visual styling such as colours, fonts and icons without altering its structure or flows
example: We reskinned the app for the rebrand, and every confusing flow now confuses people in teal.

hindi: संसाधन — प्रोजेक्ट पर लगाया गया कर्मचारी, इंसान को क्षमता की इकाई मानकर
definition: a person assigned to project work, treated as interchangeable capacity; especially common in Indian English at services firms
example: We need two more Java resources by Monday, said the manager, as if ordering chairs.

hindi: उत्तरदायी एआई — निष्पक्षता, सुरक्षा और जवाबदेही के साथ एआई बनाना
definition: building and shipping AI with fairness, safety, privacy, and accountability designed in
example: Responsible AI review comes before launch, not after the press cycle.

hindi: अनुकूली — हर स्क्रीन आकार पर ठीक दिखने वाला
definition: adapting layout to look right on any screen size
example: It's responsive: it looks equally cramped on every device.

hindi: आराम से निहितीकरण — केवल शेयर निहित होने तक बिना मेहनत टिके रहना
definition: staying in a role with minimal effort mainly to keep collecting unvested equity, often after an acquisition
example: After the acquisition he entered rest-and-vest mode, attending meetings strictly in a decorative capacity.

hindi: पुनर्कथन — पहले प्रकाशित वित्तीय नतीजों को ग़लती मिलने पर दोबारा जारी करना
definition: the reissuing of previously published financial statements after errors are discovered, often triggering investigations
example: After the restatement, last year's record growth became last year's respectable growth.

hindi: प्रतिबंधित निधि — केवल दाता द्वारा तय कार्य पर खर्च होने वाला पैसा
definition: donated money that must only be spent on the specific purpose, project or period the donor designated
example: We have restricted funds for a new van and unrestricted desperation about petrol.

hindi: पुनर्गठन — ढांचा बदलने की आड़ में अक्सर पद-कटौती
definition: reorganizing the business in ways that usually include eliminating roles
example: Restructuring was announced; everyone refreshed the org chart and their resumes.

hindi: आवेदन-पत्र छँटाई — साक्षात्कार से पहले आवेदनों की पहली जाँच
definition: the first review stage where recruiters read applications to decide who gets interviewed
example: The resume screen takes about six seconds per application and considerably less on Fridays.

hindi: बायोडाटा-प्रेरित विकास — करियर चमकाने के लिए तकनीक चुनना
definition: choosing fashionable technologies because they will look impressive on your resume, not because the project needs them
example: The to-do app now runs on Kubernetes, a textbook case of resume-driven development.

hindi: इसे फिर ऊपर ला रहा हूँ — अनदेखे संदेश की याद दिलाना
definition: polite chat nudge bringing an ignored message back to the attention of busy readers
example: Resurfacing this, he wrote, for the fourth consecutive Monday.

hindi: पुनः-लक्ष्यीकरण — पहले आए लोगों को दोबारा विज्ञापन दिखाना
definition: showing advertisements to people who previously visited a website, opened a mobile application or viewed a product, encouraging them to return and convert
example: Retargeting kept chasing me with the sofa I had already bought.

hindi: प्रतिधारण — लौटते रहने वाले उपयोगकर्ताओं का अनुपात
definition: the share of users who keep coming back over time
example: Retention is flat, which marketing insists is the new up.

hindi: रुके रहने के लिए दिया जाने वाला बोनस
definition: money paid specifically to keep you from leaving during a rocky period
example: The retention bonus said 'stay'; the reorg said 'why'.

hindi: टिकाव वक्र — समय के साथ कितने ग्राहक बने रहे, यह दिखाने वाला ग्राफ़
definition: a chart showing what share of customers from a signup group remain active over the following weeks or months
example: Investors wanted the retention curve to flatten; ours was still heading for the floor.

hindi: रोककर रखने वाला अनुदान — किसी को जाने से रोकने हेतु दिया गया अतिरिक्त इक्विटी
definition: an extra equity grant offered to keep a valued employee from leaving, typically vesting over a fresh multi-year schedule
example: Nothing makes a manager discover your value like a competing offer and a retention grant form.

hindi: पद पर रहते हुए सेवानिवृत्त — नौकरी पर है पर मन और मेहनत से अलग
definition: describes an employee who still holds the job and salary but has stopped making meaningful effort
example: He has been retired in place since the last reorg, attending every meeting and contributing to none.

hindi: पुनःप्रशिक्षित करना — ताज़ा डेटा पर मॉडल को दोबारा सिखाना
definition: to train a model again on fresh data after performance slips
example: Winter data is in; retrain before the model forgets outdoor runs exist.

hindi: टीम-प्रवास — योजना और मेलजोल की बहु-दिवसीय यात्रा
definition: a multi-day team trip mixing planning with bonding
example: The retreat agenda says vision; the photos say karaoke.

hindi: पुनरावलोकन — स्प्रिंट के बाद क्या सुधारें, इसकी टीम बैठक
definition: the end-of-sprint meeting where the team inspects how it works and picks improvements
example: The retrospective's top action: actually do last retro's actions.

hindi: इंटर्नशिप के बाद पक्की नौकरी का प्रस्ताव
definition: a full-time offer extended to an intern after their internship
example: The whole internship was quietly an audition for the return offer.

hindi: राजस्व मान्यता — किस अवधि में आय बही में दर्ज हो, इसके नियम
definition: rules deciding which accounting period revenue is recorded in, based on when the promised service is actually delivered
example: Sales closed the deal in March; revenue recognition says most of it lands next year.

hindi: उल्टी नीलामी — विक्रेता एक-दूसरे से कम भाव लगाकर ठेका पाने की होड़ करते हैं
definition: an online bidding event where competing suppliers repeatedly lower their prices to secure the buyer's contract
example: The reverse auction saved twelve percent and cost us every vendor relationship we had.

hindi: स्वदेश वापसी पुनर्गठन — विदेशी मूल कंपनी को वापस भारत लाना, प्रायः सूचीकरण से पहले
definition: in Indian English, moving a startup's parent company domicile back to India, usually before listing on Indian exchanges
example: The reverse flip came with a tax bill large enough to be its own funding round.

hindi: उल्टी आपूर्ति श्रृंखला — लौटाए गए माल को वापस लाना और निपटाना
definition: managing products flowing backward from customers, including returns, repairs, refurbishment, recycling and disposal
example: Our reverse logistics team processes more boxes than sales does after every holiday.

hindi: उल्टी वेस्टिंग — संस्थापक के शेयर पहले मिलते हैं, छोड़ने पर कंपनी वापस खरीद सकती है
definition: an arrangement where founders own shares upfront but the company can repurchase unvested shares if a founder leaves early
example: Reverse vesting is how a cofounder who quits in month three doesn't walk away owning a third of the company.

hindi: बदलाव पलटना — कमिट का उल्टा लगाकर पुरानी स्थिति बहाल करना
definition: to undo a change by applying its exact opposite
example: When in doubt, revert first, debate later.

hindi: जवाब देना — भारतीय अंग्रेज़ी में उत्तर भेजने के अर्थ में
definition: reply or respond to an email, in Indian English usage, as in 'kindly revert back with your inputs'
example: Kindly revert back by Friday — and she did, promptly, with more questions.

hindi: दोबारा वेस्टिंग — निवेश के समय संस्थापकों के शेयर फिर से वेस्टिंग में डालना
definition: the investor requirement that founders subject already-owned shares to a fresh vesting schedule as a condition of funding
example: The founders celebrated the term sheet, then read the revesting clause and celebrated slightly less.

hindi: राजस्व संचालन — बिक्री, विपणन और ग्राहक-सफलता की प्रणालियाँ सँभालने वाली टीम
definition: revenue operations; team running the systems, data, territories and processes behind sales, marketing and success
example: RevOps rebuilt the territories overnight, and three reps woke up owning accounts in countries they couldn't find.

hindi: पुनर्लेखन — पुराना सिस्टम फेंक नए सिरे से बनाना
definition: scrapping an existing system to build it again from scratch
example: The rewrite is on schedule: year two of the six-month plan.

hindi: टिप्पणियों हेतु अनुरोध — बड़े तकनीकी बदलाव से पहले राय माँगने वाला लिखित प्रस्ताव
definition: request for comments; a written design proposal circulated to engineers for feedback before a significant change is built
example: The RFC collected forty comments, thirty of them about the diagram's font.

hindi: सूचना हेतु अनुरोध — विक्रेताओं से उनकी क्षमता की शुरुआती जानकारी माँगना
definition: request for information; an early procurement document asking vendors to describe their capabilities before any pricing or formal proposal
example: The RFI asked forty questions; three vendors answered with the same brochure.

hindi: प्रस्ताव आमंत्रण — विक्रेताओं से औपचारिक बोली माँगना
definition: request for proposal; a formal invitation for vendors to bid
example: Six vendors answered the RFP; one answered the actual question.

hindi: मूल्य उद्धरण हेतु अनुरोध — तय ज़रूरत पर विक्रेताओं से भाव माँगना
definition: request for quotation; a procurement document asking vendors for firm pricing against a clearly specified requirement
example: We sent the RFQ on Monday and spent Tuesday explaining what 'clearly specified' meant.

hindi: अनुरोधों का पूरा परिवार — RFI, RFP, RFQ जैसे सभी खरीद-अनुरोधों का सामूहिक नाम
definition: request for anything; umbrella label covering every formal procurement request such as information, proposal and quotation documents
example: Procurement calls it the RFx process, which is how you know it has at least three stages.

hindi: बायोडाटा बनवाने वाली घटना — ऐसी भूल जिसके बाद नई नौकरी ढूँढनी पड़े
definition: resume generating event; a mistake serious enough to get someone fired and sent looking for employment elsewhere
example: Dropping the production database on a Friday is a classic RGE.

hindi: चार-कसौटी प्राथमिकता अंक — पहुँच, प्रभाव, भरोसे और मेहनत से फ़ीचरों का क्रम तय करना
definition: reach, impact, confidence, effort; prioritization scoring that multiplies reach, impact and confidence, then divides by effort to rank features
example: After RICE scoring, the CEO's pet feature came last, so we re-estimated its confidence until it didn't.

hindi: अमीर या राजा — पैसा बढ़ाने या नियंत्रण रखने में से एक चुनने की संस्थापक दुविधा
definition: the founder's tradeoff between raising outside capital to build wealth and keeping personal control of the company
example: He said he had weighed rich versus king, then signed the term sheet and spent every board meeting mourning the crown.

hindi: दूसरे के दम पर चढ़ना — किसी सफल वरिष्ठ के साथ जुड़कर ख़ुद आगे बढ़ना
definition: to advance your career by attaching yourself to a successful senior colleague rather than earning promotion through your own results
example: He rode her coattails through two promotions and now calls it mentorship.

hindi: कार्यबल में कटौती — छँटनी का औपचारिक-कानूनी नाम
definition: reduction in force; the formal, legal-flavored term for layoffs
example: Legal says RIF, the deck says restructuring, the team says Tuesday's layoffs.

hindi: सही लोगों को बस में बिठाना — रणनीति से पहले सही टीम चुनना
definition: principle that leaders should first hire the right people and remove the wrong ones before deciding strategy or direction
example: We got the right people on the bus, then the reorg changed the route and the driver.

hindi: लेखा परीक्षा अधिकार — ग्राहक द्वारा वेंडर के रिकॉर्ड व नियंत्रण जाँचने की अनुमति
definition: a contract clause letting a customer inspect a vendor's records, security controls or billing to verify compliance
example: Their right to audit meant three consultants, two weeks and one very tidy server room.

hindi: संपर्क-विच्छेद का अधिकार — काम के घंटों के बाद ईमेल और कॉल अनदेखा करने का अधिकार
definition: employee's legal or policy right to ignore work emails, messages and calls outside working hours
example: Our policy guarantees the right to disconnect, announced in a message sent at eleven at night.

hindi: जीतने का हक़ — बाज़ार में सफल होने की ठोस वजह
definition: the specific capabilities or advantages that justify believing a company can beat competitors in a chosen market
example: The deck asserted our right to win in six markets, citing enthusiasm as the capability.

hindi: छँटनी का सौम्य नाम — कर्मचारियों की संख्या घटाना
definition: reducing staff numbers, phrased to sound like optimization rather than layoffs
example: The all-hands announced rightsizing; twelve desks were empty by Friday.

hindi: उखाड़कर बदलना — ग्राहक की मौजूदा प्रणाली हटाकर अपनी लगाना
definition: selling a customer on removing an incumbent vendor's system entirely and installing yours instead
example: A rip and replace sounds bold in the pitch and very expensive in the customer's steering committee.

hindi: जोखिम की भूख — कितना जोखिम उठाने को निवेशक या कंपनी तैयार है
definition: how much risk investors or a company are willing to take for higher potential returns
example: The board's risk appetite shrank noticeably the moment the valuation did.

hindi: जोखिम पंजिका — संभावित खतरों और उपायों की सूची
definition: the official list of what could go wrong and who's watching it
example: The risk register's top risk: nobody reads the risk register.

hindi: जोखिम-विमुख — जब निवेशक सुरक्षित संपत्तियों की ओर भागते हैं
definition: describing markets where investors shun risky assets and move money toward safer holdings
example: It's a risk-off quarter, so the pitch for a moonshot budget can wait until someone is feeling brave.

hindi: जोखिम-प्रिय — जब निवेशक जोखिम भरी संपत्तियाँ खरीदने को तैयार हों
definition: describing markets where investors embrace risky assets, chasing growth over safer holdings
example: Markets are risk-on again, and suddenly every startup in the portfolio is an AI company.

hindi: सबसे जोखिम भरी धारणा — वह मान्यता जो ग़लत हुई तो पूरा विचार ढह जाए
definition: the belief behind a product idea that would sink everything if false, tested first before building anything else
example: Our riskiest assumption was that anyone wanted this, so naturally we tested the button color first.

hindi: मानवीय प्रतिक्रिया से पुनर्बलन — लोगों की पसंद से मॉडल को सुधारना
definition: reinforcement learning from human feedback; training a model on people's preference ratings
example: RLHF is why the coach says 'great effort' instead of the truth.

hindi: आसान प्रवेश, कठिन निकास — जुड़ना सरल, छोड़ना मुश्किल
definition: a dark pattern where signing up is effortless but cancelling a subscription or account is deliberately hard
example: Our cancellation flow was called a roach motel in a review, which is how we learned it had seven steps.

hindi: सतत यात्री — काम के लिए हर हफ़्ते सफ़र करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: employee, typically a consultant, who travels to client locations every week and lives out of hotels
example: The road warrior knew every airport lounge password and none of his neighbours.

hindi: रोडमैप — आगामी कार्य की समयबद्ध योजना-झलक
definition: a high-level plan of what will ship and roughly when, subject to reality
example: The roadmap is speculative fiction, updated quarterly.

hindi: निवेशक दौरा — IPO से पहले शेयर बेचने के लिए प्रस्तुतियों की यात्रा
definition: the series of investor presentations management gives across cities before pricing a share listing or bond offering
example: By the fourth roadshow city the CEO could deliver the growth story in his sleep, and occasionally did.

hindi: विज्ञापन-खर्च पर प्रतिफल — खर्चे प्रति रुपये से आई आय
definition: return on advertising spend; revenue generated for every unit of money spent on advertising, used to judge campaign efficiency
example: ROAS looks spectacular once you count customers who were already buying anyway.

hindi: रॉकस्टार डेवलपर — भर्ती-विज्ञापनों की अतिशयोक्ति भरी उपाधि
definition: recruiter-speak for a brilliant developer, often signaling unrealistic expectations
example: The posting wants a rockstar; the salary wants a cover band.

hindi: पहले खरीदने का अधिकार — शेयर बाहर बिकने से पहले मौजूदा निवेशकों को मौका
definition: right of first refusal; existing investors or the company may match any outside offer before shares are sold to someone else
example: The buyer agreed on price in a week, then waited thirty days for the ROFR to expire.

hindi: निवेश पर प्रतिफल — लगाए पैसे के बदले मिला फायदा
definition: return on investment; what you got back relative to what you spent
example: The ROI of the rebrand remains a matter of faith.

hindi: पद समाप्ति — व्यक्ति नहीं, पद हटाने का दावा
definition: layoff framed as removing the position itself rather than dismissing the person holding it
example: It's a role elimination, not personal, said the manager eliminating her role.

hindi: आगे बढ़ाया मिलान — आरंभिक शेष से अंतिम शेष तक हर बदलाव का विवरण
definition: schedule reconciling an account's opening balance to its closing balance by listing every addition and reduction
example: The fixed-asset roll forward didn't foot, so the missing laptop became a finance-wide mystery.

hindi: प्रोजेक्ट से मुक्त होना — काम पूरा होने या कटौती पर टीम छोड़ना
definition: to be formally released from a client project, returning to the bench or moving to the next allocation
example: Three of us roll off next month, and the client thinks the work will somehow continue.

hindi: समेकन रणनीति — कई छोटी कंपनियाँ ख़रीदकर एक बनाना
definition: a strategy of buying many small companies and merging them into one
example: Their roll-up bought every dental clinic in three states.

hindi: पिछले संस्करण पर वापसी — खराब रिलीज़ को उलटना
definition: reverting production to the previous version after a bad release
example: The rollback took two minutes; the postmortem took two weeks.

hindi: चलता अनुमान — हर अवधि आगे खिसकने वाला पूर्वानुमान
definition: a forecast refreshed every month or quarter that always looks the same number of periods ahead
example: The rolling forecast rolls forward every month, and so, somehow, does the recovery.

hindi: क्रमिक विस्तार — फ़ीचर को चरणों में जारी करना
definition: releasing something gradually to users, in stages you can retreat from
example: The rollout is at five percent, where it's been resting comfortably.

hindi: हस्तांतरित हिस्सेदारी — बेचने वालों के शेयर जो खरीदार की कंपनी में बदले जाते हैं
definition: sellers' shares converted into equity in the acquiring company instead of cash, keeping them invested after the deal
example: Half my payout was rollover equity, so the exit felt suspiciously like a new job.

hindi: मूल कारण — लक्षण नहीं, असली वजह
definition: the underlying reason a failure happened, as opposed to its symptoms
example: The root cause was a config change; the symptom was everything.

hindi: बारी-बारी क्रम — सबकी बारी से बात
definition: a format where everyone speaks in turn
example: Quick round-robin: one update each, thirty seconds, no slides.

hindi: केवल-परिणाम कार्य-व्यवस्था — जहाँ घंटे या जगह नहीं, केवल काम का नतीजा मायने रखता है
definition: results-only work environment; employees judged purely on outcomes delivered, with hours and location left entirely to them
example: We are a ROWE now, the director said, before asking why nobody was online at eight.

hindi: प्रति हज़ार व्यूज़ कमाई — क्रिएटर को हर हज़ार दृश्यों पर मिलने वाली वास्तविक आय
definition: revenue per mille; the actual earnings a creator or publisher receives for every thousand views or pageviews
example: The views doubled, the RPM halved, and finance asked why we were celebrating.

hindi: पुनर्प्राप्ति बिंदु उद्देश्य — आपदा में अधिकतम कितना डेटा खोना स्वीकार्य है
definition: recovery point objective; the maximum amount of recent data, measured in time, a business accepts losing after a disaster
example: Our RPO is fifteen minutes, and our last working backup is from March.

hindi: समय पर शेयर में बदलने वाली स्टॉक-इकाई
definition: restricted stock unit; equity that becomes real shares as it vests
example: The RSUs vest quarterly, and so does his motivation.

hindi: विश्वास का कारण — ग्राहक दावे पर भरोसा क्यों करे, इसका आधार
definition: reason to believe; the evidence, ingredient, feature or credential that makes a brand's benefit claim credible to customers
example: The RTB for 'clinically proven' turned out to be one intern and a spreadsheet.

hindi: पहले दस्तावेज़ पढ़ो — जवाब मैनुअल में ही है (read the fine manual)
definition: read the fine manual; the answer was in the documentation all along
example: He asked in three channels before the gentle RTFM arrived.

hindi: दफ़्तर वापसी का आदेश — रिमोट काम समेटने की नीति
definition: return to office; a mandate ending or shrinking remote work
example: The RTO memo cited collaboration; the parking garage cited capacity.

hindi: बत्तख से बातचीत — समस्या ज़ोर से समझाते ही हल सूझ जाना
definition: explaining your problem aloud, often to an inanimate object, until the solution reveals itself
example: Ten minutes of rubber-ducking and the bug confessed on its own.

hindi: बिना सोचे मुहर लगाना — असल जाँच के बग़ैर मंज़ूरी देना
definition: to approve something without real scrutiny
example: The board rubber-stamped the plan between coffee and lunch.

hindi: घातक नरमी — अच्छा बनने के चक्कर में ज़रूरी आलोचना न करना
definition: feedback failure where a manager cares personally but never challenges directly, withholding hard truths to stay liked
example: Three years of ruinous empathy, and his first honest feedback arrived inside the PIP.

hindi: चालीस का नियम — वृद्धि दर और मुनाफा मिलाकर चालीस पार हो
definition: growth rate plus profit margin should total at least forty percent
example: We pass the rule of 40 whenever we redefine one of the terms.

hindi: बीच में ढाल बनना — टीम तक पहुँचने से पहले दख़ल और दबाव ख़ुद झेलना
definition: to protect your team from distractions, interruptions and senior pressure by absorbing them yourself
example: Her manager runs interference so well that the team thinks the CEO is a rumour.

hindi: राय जाँचना — प्रस्ताव दिखाकर प्रतिक्रिया देखना
definition: to float an idea and see how people react
example: Run it up the flagpole at Monday's leads meeting.

hindi: कार्यक्रम-क्रम — मिनट-दर-मिनट योजना
definition: the minute-by-minute plan for a big meeting or event
example: The all-hands run of show gives the CEO twelve minutes.

hindi: समय से आगे खिंचना — तय अंत के बाद भी चलना
definition: to continue past a meeting's scheduled end time
example: We ran over again, straight into my lunch.

hindi: रन रेट — मौजूदा रफ्तार को सालभर तक खींचा गया अनुमान
definition: current performance extrapolated over a full year
example: Our run rate assumes December behaves like our best week ever.

hindi: आपात निर्देश-पुस्तिका — संकट में क्या करें, कदम-दर-कदम
definition: step-by-step instructions for handling a known operational situation
example: The runbook's step three: page someone who knows what to do.

hindi: बची हुई पूँजी की अवधि — कंपनी कितने महीने और चल सकती है
definition: the number of months a startup can operate before its money runs out
example: After the funding round, we have eighteen months of runway.

hindi: बिक्री और संचालन योजना — माँग और आपूर्ति योजनाओं का मासिक तालमेल
definition: sales and operations planning; the monthly process aligning sales forecasts with production, inventory and supply capacity
example: S&OP is where sales promises a record quarter and operations quietly updates its resume.

hindi: सूचीकरण पंजीकरण दस्तावेज़ — अमेरिकी शेयर बाज़ार में उतरने से पहले दाखिल विस्तृत विवरण
definition: the American registration filing a company publishes before listing, disclosing financials, risks and ownership
example: Everyone read the S-1 for the risk factors and the exact compensation of the founders.

hindi: सेवा रूपी सॉफ़्टवेयर — सदस्यता पर किराए जैसा सॉफ़्टवेयर
definition: software as a service; software rented by subscription instead of sold outright
example: Everything is SaaS now, including, somehow, our office plants.

hindi: भविष्य की हिस्सेदारी का सरल क़रार — अभी पैसा, शेयर अगले दौर में
definition: simple agreement for future equity; money now for shares at the next round
example: We signed the SAFE in a week; the lawyers were almost disappointed.

hindi: सुरक्षा भंडार — माँग या आपूर्ति में अचानक गड़बड़ी के लिए रखा अतिरिक्त माल
definition: extra inventory held above expected demand as a buffer against supplier delays or sudden spikes in orders
example: Finance calls it excess inventory until the port closes, then it becomes safety stock.

hindi: बिक्री-स्वीकृत लीड — मार्केटिंग से आई वह लीड जिसे सेल्स टीम ने आगे बढ़ाने लायक माना
definition: sales accepted lead; a marketing lead the sales team has reviewed and formally agreed to pursue with follow-up
example: Marketing counted two hundred MQLs; sales counted nine SALs and one grudge.

hindi: वेतनभोगी साझेदार — साझेदार की उपाधि पर मुनाफ़े में हिस्सेदारी नहीं
definition: partner title at a professional services firm paid a fixed salary without profit ownership
example: As a salaried partner she got the title, the business cards and none of the profits.

hindi: वेतन विभाजन — CTC के अलग-अलग घटकों की सूची
definition: in Indian English, the itemised split of a CTC into basic salary, allowances, provident fund, gratuity and variable components
example: The salary breakup had eleven lines, and the gratuity was doing a lot of heavy lifting.

hindi: बिक्री चक्र — पहले संपर्क से सौदे तक की अवधि
definition: the time from first contact to signed deal
example: Our sales cycle is 90 days, or 300 if procurement notices.

hindi: बिक्री सक्षमता — विक्रेताओं को सामग्री और प्रशिक्षण देना
definition: equipping reps with the training, content, and tools to sell effectively
example: Sales enablement built a beautiful portal; reps still ask for 'that one deck.'

hindi: बिक्री अभियंता — तकनीकी सवालों के जवाब देने वाला विशेषज्ञ
definition: the technical expert who joins sales calls to answer the hard questions
example: The sales engineer's job: make the demo survive contact with a real question.

hindi: बिक्री गति — पाइपलाइन से राजस्व बनने की रफ़्तार
definition: rate revenue moves through pipeline, combining opportunity count, deal size, conversion rate and cycle length
example: To boost sales velocity, leadership shortened the sales cycle by redefining when it starts.

hindi: बिक्री-आधारित विकास — सेल्स टीम के ज़रिए ग्राहक जोड़ने वाली रणनीति
definition: growth strategy where sales representatives drive customer acquisition through demos, negotiations and contracts rather than self-serve product usage
example: We're sales-led growth with a free trial nobody is allowed to find.

hindi: सेवा योग्य बाज़ार — TAM का वह हिस्सा जिसे आप वाक़ई सेवा दे सकते हैं
definition: serviceable addressable market; the slice of TAM your product can realistically serve
example: The SAM slide is where the trillion quietly becomes a billion.

hindi: नमूना आकार — प्रयोग में शामिल उपयोगकर्ताओं की संख्या
definition: how many users a test includes, which decides how much to trust it
example: Bold conclusion for a sample size of eleven.

hindi: प्रतिबंध जाँच — ग्राहक या भुगतान को प्रतिबंधित सूचियों से मिलाना
definition: checking customers, partners and transactions against government sanctions lists before doing business with them
example: Sanctions screening flagged a customer called Crimea Pizza, and the deal desk had a long afternoon.

hindi: जान-बूझकर कम बताना — बाद की वाहवाही के लिए सौदे छिपाना
definition: understating your forecast or hiding deals to beat expectations later
example: He 'found' three deals on the last day of the quarter; sandbagging season again.

hindi: प्रयोग-स्थल — जहाँ तोड़फोड़ से कोई असली नुकसान नहीं
definition: an isolated environment where you can experiment without breaking anything real
example: Try it in the sandbox first; prod has feelings.

hindi: सैंडलर बिक्री पद्धति — प्रश्नों और स्पष्ट सहमतियों से ग्राहक को स्वयं निर्णय तक पहुँचाने वाली विधि
definition: a consultative sales methodology built on upfront contracts, deep pain questioning and letting prospects disqualify themselves early
example: After the Sandler selling course, every rep started ending calls with permission to say no.

hindi: तर्क-जाँच — कोई बड़ी चूक तो नहीं, इसकी त्वरित पड़ताल
definition: a quick check that something is not obviously wrong
example: Sanity check: does this discount actually leave us a margin?

hindi: शेयर मूल्य वृद्धि अधिकार — शेयर के बढ़े दाम का लाभ पाने का हक़
definition: stock appreciation rights; awards paying the increase in company share price over a grant value, in cash or shares
example: The SARs looked generous until the share price discovered gravity.

hindi: ग्राहक-रोक विभाग — रद्द करने वाले ग्राहकों को मनाकर रोकने वाली टीम
definition: retention team that receives cancellation requests and tries persuading departing customers to stay, often with discounts or plan changes
example: The save desk offered three months free to everyone except the customers who never tried to cancel.

hindi: वेतन पर मत — अधिकारियों के वेतन पैकेज पर शेयरधारकों का सलाहकारी वोट
definition: a shareholder advisory vote on executive compensation packages, held at annual meetings and closely watched by boards
example: After losing the say on pay vote, the board promised to listen, then renamed the bonus a retention award.

hindi: शेयर-आधारित वेतन — कर्मचारियों को नकदी के बजाय शेयर या विकल्प में भुगतान
definition: stock-based compensation; employee equity awards expensed in accounts, often excluded from adjusted earnings figures
example: Adjusted profit looks lovely until someone adds back the SBC, which the analyst on line three always does.

hindi: स्थिति-व्यवहार-प्रभाव ढाँचा — घटना, आचरण और उसके असर के सहारे प्रतिक्रिया देना
definition: situation, behavior, impact; a feedback structure that names the moment, the observed action and its effect on others
example: Using the SBI model, she named the meeting, the monologue and the impact, which was that the meeting ran long.

hindi: विज्ञान-आधारित लक्ष्य पहल — जलवायु विज्ञान के अनुरूप उत्सर्जन लक्ष्यों की पुष्टि
definition: science based targets initiative; body validating whether corporate emission reduction targets match climate science pathways
example: SBTi rejected our target, which the press release has tactfully renamed a validation journey.

hindi: ढाँचा-कोड — शुरुआत के लिए खड़ा किया गया अस्थायी ढाँचा
definition: generated or temporary structure that gets a project standing before real work begins
example: The scaffolding from the tutorial is still in production.

hindi: बड़े पैमाने पर बढ़ाना — लागत बढ़ाए बिना कारोबार बढ़ाना
definition: to grow revenue and operations fast without costs growing just as fast
example: It works for ten customers; now we find out if it scales.

hindi: विस्तार-चरण कंपनी — PMF के बाद तेज़ फैलाव में जुटी
definition: a startup past product-market fit, now focused on rapid expansion
example: We're officially a scale-up now, so the chaos has middle managers.

hindi: मानक संविदात्मक खंड — यूरोप से बाहर डेटा भेजने की स्वीकृत शर्तें
definition: standard contractual clauses; European Commission template terms that legally permit transferring personal data outside Europe
example: Legal attached the SCCs, all forty pages, to a contract for a meeting-notes tool.

hindi: परिदृश्य योजना — कई संभावित भविष्यों के लिए रणनीति तैयार करना
definition: preparing strategy against several plausible futures, such as best, base and worst cases, instead of one forecast
example: Scenario planning covered four futures, none of which included the one that actually happened.

hindi: देर से भेजना — संदेश अभी लिखकर प्राप्तकर्ता के कामकाजी समय में पहुँचाना
definition: writing a message now but delaying delivery until the recipient's working hours begin
example: She drafts at midnight and uses schedule send, so the team believes she keeps normal hours.

hindi: अनुसूची सात — भारत में CSR खर्च के मान्य क्षेत्रों की सूची
definition: the list in India's Companies Act specifying which activities, such as education, health and environment, count toward mandatory corporate social responsibility spending
example: Finance spent a week proving the office garden party qualified under Schedule VII.

hindi: दायरा तय करना — काम कितना बड़ा है, यह परिभाषित करना
definition: to define how big a piece of work is before committing to it
example: Let's scope it first and panic afterward, in order.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष उत्सर्जन — कंपनी के अपने स्रोतों से सीधा निकला प्रदूषण
definition: direct greenhouse emissions from sources the company owns or controls, such as boilers, furnaces and fleet vehicles
example: Scope 1 emissions fell sharply, mostly because we sold the factory to someone else.

hindi: ख़रीदी ऊर्जा का उत्सर्जन — बिजली, भाप या हीटिंग ख़रीदने से हुआ अप्रत्यक्ष उत्सर्जन
definition: indirect greenhouse emissions from generating the electricity, steam, heating or cooling that the company purchases
example: Scope 2 emissions vanished on paper the day procurement discovered renewable certificates.

hindi: मूल्य-श्रृंखला उत्सर्जन — आपूर्तिकर्ताओं और ग्राहकों तक फैला अप्रत्यक्ष उत्सर्जन
definition: indirect greenhouse emissions across the value chain, from suppliers, business travel, product usage and disposal
example: Scope 3 emissions are ninety percent of our footprint and one hundred percent of nobody's objectives.

hindi: दायरा-विस्तार — योजना के बाद चुपचाप बढ़ती माँगें
definition: the quiet expansion of a project's requirements after everyone agreed on them
example: One small tweak plus one small tweak equals scope creep.

hindi: कार्य-सीमा कटौती — समय पर पहुँचने के लिए सुविधाएँ घटाना
definition: removing planned work to hit a deadline
example: One more scope cut and we're shipping a login page.

hindi: मूल्यांकन पत्रक — साक्षात्कार के बाद भरा जाने वाला अंक-पत्र
definition: the written interview feedback form rating a candidate against defined competencies with a recommendation
example: Please submit your scorecard before the debrief, not during it.

hindi: स्थिति, जटिलता, प्रश्न, उत्तर — कहानी कहने का परामर्श ढाँचा
definition: situation, complication, question, answer; consulting storytelling structure for opening a presentation or memo
example: Even his resignation email followed SCQA, which made the answer hard to argue with.

hindi: स्थिति, उलझन, समाधान — कहानी की तरह बात रखने का ढाँचा
definition: situation, complication, resolution; a storytelling structure that frames the context, names the problem, then presents the recommendation
example: The SCR opened with the situation, identified the complication as the previous consultants, and resolved to hire new ones.

hindi: जुगाड़ू — कम पैसे और साधनों में तेज़ी से काम निकाल लेने वाला
definition: resourceful and fast-moving with very little money, staff or tooling, typical of early startup teams
example: We were scrappy enough to build the demo on a free tier and nervous enough to never click the billing tab.

hindi: स्क्रीन वाचक — दृष्टिबाधितों के लिए स्क्रीन पढ़कर सुनाने वाला सॉफ़्टवेयर
definition: software that reads interfaces aloud for blind and low-vision users
example: The screen reader announces our buttons as 'button', 'button', and 'button'.

hindi: चयन प्रश्नावली — शोध के लिए सही प्रतिभागी छाँटना
definition: a short questionnaire used to filter and select suitable participants for a user research study
example: The screener was so strict that the only qualified participant turned out to be our own intern.

hindi: लेखक — बैठक के नोट्स दर्ज करने वाला
definition: the person taking notes and capturing decisions in a meeting
example: Rotate the scribe role so notes aren't always Priya's job.

hindi: स्क्रम — स्प्रिंट और निश्चित भूमिकाओं वाला एजाइल ढांचा
definition: the most common agile framework, organizing work into sprints with fixed roles and ceremonies
example: Half the team read the scrum guide; the other half just attends the meetings.

hindi: स्क्रम मास्टर — प्रक्रिया चलाने और बाधा हटाने वाला सूत्रधार
definition: the facilitator who runs scrum's ceremonies and clears the team's blockers
example: Our scrum master's whole job is defending the team's calendar.

hindi: स्क्रमों का स्क्रम — कई टीमों के प्रतिनिधियों की समन्वय बैठक
definition: a coordination standup where representatives of several scrum teams sync
example: The scrum of scrums exists so standup can have a standup.

hindi: स्क्रम-किंतु — 'हम स्क्रम करते हैं, बस...' वाला आधा-अधूरा स्क्रम
definition: doing scrum except for the parts you skip, explained with 'but'
example: We do scrum, but no retros; textbook ScrumBut.

hindi: बिक्री विकास प्रतिनिधि — बैठकों के लिए नए ग्राहक खोजने वाला
definition: sales development representative — the rep who prospects and books meetings for AEs
example: The SDR sent eighty emails today; two bounced, one replied 'unsubscribe.'

hindi: झपट्टा-प्रबंधन — अचानक आकर हंगामा करना, सब पर बरसना और उड़ जाना
definition: a management style of swooping in occasionally, criticising everything without context, then leaving the team to clean up
example: Seagull management: one visit a quarter, forty comments, zero follow-up.

hindi: उड़ता-आता मैनेजर — अचानक आकर शोर मचाए, गड़बड़ करे और गायब हो जाए
definition: a manager who appears only when problems surface, makes noisy criticism and sweeping changes, then disappears
example: Our seagull manager flew in, rewrote the roadmap, and was back on leave by lunch.

hindi: मौसमी असर — कैलेंडर से बंधे आँकड़ों के अनुमानित उतार-चढ़ाव
definition: predictable ups and downs tied to the calendar
example: Growth is down, but so is everyone in December; blame seasonality.

hindi: सीट — प्रति-उपयोक्ता सॉफ़्टवेयर शुल्क की इकाई
definition: one paid user license in per-user software pricing
example: We pay for forty seats and eleven people log in.

hindi: मेज़ पर जगह — जहाँ बड़े फ़ैसले होते हैं वहाँ शामिल होने का हक़
definition: a recognised place among the senior leaders where important decisions are made, rather than merely being informed
example: Design finally got a seat at the table, right next to the projector cable.

hindi: मौजूदा शेयरों की बिक्री — एक्ज़िट से पहले पुराने हिस्सेदारों की कमाई
definition: a sale of existing shares, letting early holders cash out before an exit
example: The founders took a small secondary and suddenly believed in work-life balance.

hindi: ख़ास नुस्ख़ा — कामयाबी का गुप्त कारण
definition: the special ingredient behind a company's success
example: Our support team is the secret sauce; guard them.

hindi: क्षेत्र परिवर्तन — निवेशकों का पैसा एक उद्योग से दूसरे उद्योग में ले जाना
definition: investors moving money from one industry sector to another as economic expectations shift
example: Sector rotation out of tech meant our recruiting pitch lost its best slide overnight.

hindi: सुरक्षा जागरूकता प्रशिक्षण — ठगी और डेटा-चोरी पहचानने का अनिवार्य कोर्स
definition: mandatory yearly course teaching employees to spot phishing scams, suspicious links and data theft
example: Everyone finished the security awareness training at double speed with the video muted.

hindi: सुरक्षा छूट — किसी नियम से अस्थायी, दर्ज की गई छूट
definition: formally approved, time-limited permission to bypass a security rule, recorded and signed by designated risk owners
example: The security exception expired in 2021, which the legacy server has chosen not to notice.

hindi: सुरक्षा प्रश्नावली — विक्रेता से उसकी डेटा-सुरक्षा व्यवस्था पर लंबी प्रश्न-सूची भरवाना
definition: a lengthy standard form buyers send vendors about data protection, access controls and security practices before purchasing
example: The security questionnaire had four hundred rows, and every answer was 'see attached SOC 2 report'.

hindi: सुरक्षा समीक्षा — जोखिमों के लिए सिस्टम या विक्रेता की जाँच
definition: an assessment of a system or vendor for security risks
example: The security review flagged the plugin we already deployed.

hindi: बीज दौर — उत्पाद बनाने और बाज़ार परखने के लिए पहला औपचारिक निवेश
definition: the first formal funding round, used to build the product and find fit
example: The seed round closed in March; the celebration pizza was expensed in April.

hindi: खंड — साझा गुण के आधार पर बना उपयोगकर्ताओं का उपसमूह
definition: a subset of users grouped by a shared trait
example: Every segment is growing except the one that pays.

hindi: कर्तव्यों का विभाजन — एक ही व्यक्ति शुरू और मंज़ूर दोनों न करे
definition: control ensuring no single person can both request and approve the same payment, change or access
example: Segregation of duties means he raises the purchase order and his desk neighbour approves it without reading.

hindi: चयन पूर्वाग्रह — गैर-प्रतिनिधि नमूना चुनने से झुका नतीजा
definition: skew from studying a group that was never representative
example: We surveyed our happiest users and confirmed users are happy.

hindi: चुनिंदा प्रकटीकरण — अहम जानकारी केवल कुछ निवेशकों को देना
definition: sharing material company information with certain investors or analysts before releasing it publicly to everyone, which regulators prohibit
example: Compliance treats any dinner with a fund manager as a selective disclosure risk with appetizers.

hindi: अपने काम का खुद लिखा मूल्यांकन
definition: the review-season essay where you rate your own year's work
example: The self-assessment is where humility goes to hurt your rating.

hindi: स्वयं-व्याख्यायी कोड — इतना साफ़ कि टिप्पणी न लगे (अक्सर बहाना)
definition: code claimed to be so clear it needs no comments, a claim rarely audited
example: It's self-documenting, he said, of the function named process2.

hindi: अपने दम पर सुधार — बाज़ार के बिना भी मुनाफ़ा बढ़ाने के उपाय
definition: profit improvements management can deliver independently of market conditions, such as cost cuts, pricing and restructuring
example: With no demand in sight, the entire plan is self-help and a hopeful chart.

hindi: स्वयं-सेवा ख़रीद — बिना विक्रेता से बात किए
definition: bought and set up by the customer alone, no salesperson involved
example: Self-serve revenue is the best kind: nobody had to attend a meeting.

hindi: स्वयं-सेवा रिपोर्टिंग — बिना विश्लेषक के ख़ुद डेटा खोजने और रिपोर्ट बनाने के औज़ार
definition: reporting tools that let business users explore company data and build their own dashboards without waiting for an analyst
example: Self-service BI launched Monday; by Tuesday the analysts were servicing everyone's self-service.

hindi: मनाने वाली कॉल — उम्मीदवार को प्रस्ताव स्वीकारने के लिए राज़ी करने की बातचीत
definition: a call where leaders pitch the company to persuade a candidate to accept an offer
example: The CEO's sell call mentioned the mission eleven times and the equity once.

hindi: विक्रेता पक्ष — बेचने वाले की ओर से काम करने वाले बैंक या विश्लेषक
definition: describing banks and analysts working for sellers of companies or securities, rather than purchasing investors
example: On a sell-side mandate every buyer is 'highly strategic' until the bids come in.

hindi: खोज-विज्ञापन विपणन — खोज नतीजों में पैसे देकर अपना विज्ञापन दिखाना
definition: search engine marketing; buying paid advertisements on search results pages, mostly through keyword bidding
example: SEM is the only team whose results appear instantly and disappear the moment the card declines.

hindi: अर्थ-आधारित खोज — शब्द नहीं, मतलब मिलाकर ढूँढने वाली खोज
definition: search that matches meaning rather than exact keywords
example: Semantic search knows 'sore everywhere' means they want the recovery page.

hindi: अर्थपूर्ण संस्करण — major.minor.patch नंबरिंग की परिपाटी
definition: semantic versioning; numbering releases as major.minor.patch with promises attached
example: They call it semver, yet every minor release breaks us.

hindi: संवेदनशीलता विश्लेषण — एक अनुमान बदलने पर नतीजा कितना बदलता है
definition: testing how much a model's outcome changes when individual assumptions such as price, volume or cost are varied
example: The sensitivity analysis showed the whole business case depended on one assumption labelled 'TBC'.

hindi: सेंसर संलयन — कई सेंसरों के संकेत मिलाकर साफ़ तस्वीर बनाना
definition: combining signals from multiple sensors into one clearer picture of what's happening
example: Sensor fusion blends heart rate, motion, and GPS into one coherent 'you're jogging'.

hindi: मेरे फ़ोन से भेजा गया — छोटे या टाइपो भरे जवाब का बहाना
definition: phone email signature that doubles as an excuse for brief replies and typing errors
example: The reply said 'k' followed by sent from my iPhone, which explained everything.

hindi: काला पानी भेजना — किसी को महत्वहीन और दूर-दराज़ के काम में धकेल देना
definition: sidelined into an unimportant, low-visibility role or location as punishment after falling out with leadership
example: After contradicting the CEO, she was sent to Siberia to lead the intranet refresh.

hindi: खोज-इंजन अनुकूलन — खोज परिणामों में ऊपर दिखने की तकनीक
definition: search engine optimization — shaping content so search engines rank it higher
example: The SEO team wants 'best CRM 2026' in the title of everything, including birthday cards.

hindi: पृथक्करण अनुबंध — विदाई की शर्तों वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: document setting exit terms, usually severance money in exchange for waiving legal claims
example: The separation agreement ran twelve pages, eleven of them about what he could never say.

hindi: स्वचालित संपर्क शृंखला — ईमेल और कॉल की तय कड़ी
definition: an automated series of emails and call tasks aimed at a prospect
example: Step six of the sequence is the breakup email; it gets the most replies.

hindi: क्रमिक उद्यमी — एक के बाद एक कंपनियाँ शुरू करने वाला
definition: a founder who starts company after company, exit or no exit
example: She's a serial entrepreneur; this is startup number four and counting.

hindi: पहला बड़ा वेंचर दौर — शुरुआती सफलता दिखने के बाद का निवेश
definition: the first major venture round, raised once a startup shows real traction
example: Every slide in our Series A deck says 'growth' at least twice.

hindi: सीरीज़ A संकट — सीड फ़ंडिंग के बाद अगला दौर न जुटा पाने वाले स्टार्टअप
definition: the squeeze where many seed-funded startups fail to raise their next Series A funding round
example: Thanks to the Series A crunch, our 'eighteen months of runway' became a countdown timer.

hindi: सीरीज़ A के बाद का दौर — चलते मॉडल को बड़ा करने की पूँजी
definition: the round after Series A, meant for scaling a model that already works
example: Post Series B, we suddenly have a legal team and a travel policy.

hindi: खोज परिणाम पृष्ठ — खोजने पर दिखने वाला नतीजों का पन्ना
definition: search engine results page; the page of results shown after searching, where rankings and advertisements compete
example: We rank first on the SERP, just below four advertisements, a map and an answer box.

hindi: टीम की बाधाएँ हटाने को प्राथमिकता देने वाली प्रबंधन-शैली
definition: a management style framed around removing the team's obstacles rather than commanding
example: He practices servant leadership, which mostly means apologizing for the roadmap.

hindi: सर्वर से मापन — ब्राउज़र की जगह कंपनी के अपने सर्वर से बिक्री का आँकड़ा भेजना
definition: sending conversion events from your own servers rather than browsers, avoiding blockers and cookie restrictions
example: Server-side tracking recovered thirty percent of our conversions, and one hundred percent of engineering's patience.

hindi: सेवा खाका — ग्राहक अनुभव और पर्दे-पीछे की प्रक्रिया का जुड़ा नक्शा
definition: a map linking the customer journey to the behind-the-scenes operations
example: The service blueprint revealed the 'instant' refund involves three humans and a fax.

hindi: सेवा अनुबंध बंधन — तय अवधि से पहले नौकरी छोड़ने पर जुर्माने की शर्त
definition: in Indian English, an agreement, common for freshers, requiring service for fixed years or paying a penalty on early exit
example: The service bond cost more than his degree, which turned the rival offer into arithmetic.

hindi: सेवा क्रेडिट — अनुबंधित स्तर पूरा न होने पर ग्राहक को दी जाने वाली छूट
definition: account credit given to customers when a provider misses contracted uptime or support commitments, instead of refunding money
example: The service credit for the six-hour outage came to roughly the price of a sandwich.

hindi: सेवा शुल्क छूट — वादा की गई सेवा चूकने पर ग्राहक के बिल में कटौती
definition: account credits a vendor owes customers when uptime or support commitments are missed, usually their sole remedy under the contract
example: Four hours of downtime earned them service credits worth eleven dollars and a strongly worded email.

hindi: सेवा आधारित कंपनी — ग्राहकों के लिए सॉफ्टवेयर बनाकर घंटों का बिल भेजने वाली कंपनी
definition: in Indian English, an outsourcing firm billing clients for engineers' time, building and maintaining software for other companies
example: At a service-based company the product is you, billed hourly.

hindi: नोटिस अवधि पूरी करना — इस्तीफ़े के बाद तय दिन काम करना
definition: in Indian English, working through the contractual notice period after resigning, before the final exit date
example: He is serving notice, which mostly means attending farewell lunches and documenting everything.

hindi: सत्र — उपयोगकर्ता की एक बार की लगातार गतिविधि
definition: one continuous stretch of user activity in the product
example: Average session length is ninety seconds, our most honest metric.

hindi: सत्र रीप्ले — असली उपयोगकर्ता की स्क्रीन-गतिविधि की रिकॉर्डिंग
definition: recordings of real user sessions, watched to see where people struggle
example: One session replay of a confused user beats forty dashboard debates.

hindi: सर्वोच्च आपात स्तर — सबसे गंभीर श्रेणी की गड़बड़ी
definition: the highest-severity incident, all hands, everything else can wait
example: Declare a sev1 and cancel my dentist appointment.

hindi: नौकरी से निकालने पर दिया गया मुआवज़ा-पैकेज
definition: the payout given when you're terminated, usually tied to tenure
example: The severance was two weeks per year, and a fast NDA.

hindi: बिक्री, सामान्य व प्रशासनिक खर्च — उत्पादन से अलग ऊपरी परिचालन खर्च
definition: selling, general and administrative expenses; overhead costs of running the company, excluding production and research spending
example: Every cost-cutting memo starts with SG&A and ends with the free coffee.

hindi: मुझे ठीक लगता है — किसी प्रस्ताव पर हल्की-फुल्की सहमति
definition: sounds good to me; quick written agreement with a proposal, plan or change without formal approval
example: He replied SGTM to the migration plan, which turned out to mean he had read the subject line.

hindi: शेयरधारक समझौता — निवेशकों और संस्थापकों के अधिकार तय करने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: shareholders' agreement; in Indian English startup usage, the binding document setting investor rights, board composition, transfer restrictions and exits
example: The term sheet took a week; the SHA took three months and two lawyers' vacations.

hindi: छाया एआई — बिना अनुमति कर्मचारियों द्वारा इस्तेमाल होते एआई टूल
definition: employees using unapproved artificial intelligence tools for work, outside company security, privacy and procurement review
example: Legal banned chatbots, and shadow AI adoption promptly hit a hundred percent.

hindi: छाया आईटी — बिना मंज़ूरी इस्तेमाल हो रहे टूल और सिस्टम
definition: software teams use without IT's approval or knowledge
example: The official tool has 12 users; shadow IT has 300.

hindi: साथ रहकर ड्यूटी सीखना — अनुभवी साथी के साथ आपात ड्यूटी की चेतावनियाँ देखकर प्रशिक्षण
definition: a training shift where a newer engineer receives production alerts alongside the primary on-call engineer, watching before taking responsibility
example: Her shadow on-call week was quiet, which taught her nothing and lulled her beautifully.

hindi: छाया संगठन-चार्ट — असली प्रभाव और रिश्तों का अनलिखा नक़्शा
definition: the unofficial network showing who actually holds influence and decides things, regardless of formal titles and reporting lines
example: On paper she's a senior analyst; on the shadow org chart she runs the division.

hindi: छाया कर्मचारी — बिना बिलिंग के साथ सीखता अतिरिक्त कर्मचारी
definition: an Indian English and IT services term for an unbilled team member who shadows a billed person to learn the project as backup
example: The shadow resource knows the codebase best, which is why nobody bills for it.

hindi: खोज में हिस्सेदारी — श्रेणी की कुल खोजों में अपने ब्रांड का अंश
definition: the percentage of all branded searches in a category that name your brand, used as a leading indicator of market share
example: Share of search spiked on Tuesday, right after the outage made us trend.

hindi: आवाज़ में हिस्सेदारी — बाज़ार की कुल चर्चा या विज्ञापन में अपना अंश
definition: the percentage of total advertising, media coverage or social conversation in a market that belongs to your brand versus competitors
example: Our share of voice doubled this quarter, mostly because a rival stopped advertising.

hindi: बटुए में हिस्सेदारी — ग्राहक के कुल खर्च में अपना अंश
definition: the portion of a customer's total spending in a category that goes to your company rather than to competitors
example: We have the account, but our share of wallet is roughly the coffee budget.

hindi: साझा माध्यम — सोशल मंचों पर फैलने वाली सामग्री
definition: content that spreads through social platforms when audiences share, repost or comment, sitting between owned media and earned media in channel planning
example: The plan calls for shared media, which means hoping someone's aunt forwards the video.

hindi: साझा मूल्य — ऐसी रणनीति जिससे कंपनी और समाज दोनों को लाभ हो
definition: business strategy that creates economic value for the company by solving social or environmental problems within its core operations
example: Every CSR pitch this year is labelled shared value, which mostly means the brand team gets a share.

hindi: शेयरधारक मूल्य — मालिकों के लिए शेयर की कीमत और लाभांश
definition: returns created for company owners through share price gains and dividends, invoked to justify strategic decisions and layoffs
example: The layoffs were announced as unlocking shareholder value, which the shareholders agreed with by lunch.

hindi: तीखी कोहनियाँ — आगे बढ़ने के लिए दूसरों को धकेलने वाला आक्रामक रवैया
definition: an aggressive, competitive working style that pushes colleagues aside to capture credit, resources or promotion
example: She has sharp elbows, but at least you always know which meeting she'll win.

hindi: शेल्फ़ पर पड़ा सॉफ़्टवेयर — ख़रीदा गया लेकिन कभी इस्तेमाल न हुआ लाइसेंस
definition: software licences an organisation purchased and keeps paying for, but which nobody actually uses
example: We bought five hundred seats; forty log in, and the rest is shelfware with a renewal date.

hindi: देखभाल से पार लगाना — काम को हर पड़ाव से सुरक्षित निकालना
definition: to guide something patiently through a long process
example: She shepherded the proposal through five reviews and two reorgs.

hindi: पाली भत्ता — रात या विदेशी समय-क्षेत्र में काम करने का अतिरिक्त पैसा
definition: extra payment for working night shifts or client timezone hours, common in support and offshore delivery teams
example: The shift allowance covers exactly one strong coffee per night of the US shift.

hindi: पहले की ओर खिसकाना — परीक्षण और सुरक्षा जाँच को विकास में पहले ही शुरू करना
definition: moving testing, security and quality checks earlier in the development process instead of leaving them until release
example: Management wants to shift left, which apparently means testing now starts in the kickoff meeting.

hindi: पच्चर कोड — असंगत हिस्सों के बीच फ़िट बैठाने वाली पतली परत
definition: a thin compatibility layer wedged between mismatched components
example: A small shim, they said; it now has its own on-call.

hindi: चमकती चीज़ का रोग — हर नए विचार के पीछे भागकर पुराना काम अधूरा छोड़ना
definition: the habit of chasing every exciting product idea or trend, abandoning current work before it delivers results
example: Shiny object syndrome struck again: the chatbot replaced the checkout fix nobody finished.

hindi: जारी कर दो — काफ़ी अच्छा है, अभी रिलीज़ करो
definition: declaration that the work is good enough to release right now
example: It passes the tests and it's 6 pm — ship it.

hindi: जारी करने योग्य — असली उपयोगकर्ताओं तक भेजने लायक तैयार
definition: finished enough to release to real users
example: It's ship-ready except for the crash, which we're calling rare.

hindi: मंदी के दाँव का अनुपात — कितने शेयर भाव गिरने की उम्मीद में उधार लेकर बेचे गए हैं
definition: percentage of shares currently sold short, showing how many investors are betting the price will fall
example: Short interest hit twenty percent, so the board wants the next investor deck to be very, very confident.

hindi: मंदड़ियों का आरोप-पत्र — गिरावट पर दाँव लगाने वालों का कंपनी में गड़बड़ी बताने वाला सार्वजनिक शोध
definition: public research published by short sellers alleging fraud, accounting problems or overvaluation at a company whose shares they are wagering against
example: A forty-page short report dropped at dawn, and IR spent the morning rebutting footnote nine.

hindi: मंदड़ियों की मजबूरन ख़रीद — गिरावट पर दांव लगाने वालों का घाटे से बचने के लिए महँगे में ख़रीदना
definition: a sudden price spike that forces short sellers to repurchase shares, pushing prices higher still
example: The short squeeze lasted three days; the post-mortem on why we shorted a meme lasted three weeks.

hindi: अंतिम सूची में रखना — विकल्प छाँटकर चुनिंदा रखना
definition: to narrow candidates down to a final few
example: We shortlisted three vendors and the one sales already promised.

hindi: अपेक्षित-लागत मॉडल — सामग्री, श्रम और मार्जिन जोड़कर अनुमान कि चीज़ की सही क़ीमत क्या होनी चाहिए
definition: a bottom-up estimate of what a product should cost from materials, labour, overhead and reasonable margin, used in negotiation
example: Our should-cost model says forty dollars; their quote says ninety, and their sales rep says 'innovation'.

hindi: खर्च दिखावा — विभाग को उसकी लागत दिखाना पर शुल्क न लेना
definition: reporting the internal costs a department consumes without actually billing its budget, unlike a chargeback
example: Showback changed nothing until finance hinted it would become a chargeback next year.

hindi: शो रोक देने वाला दोष — रिलीज़ असंभव कर देने वाली खामी
definition: a defect severe enough to halt a release entirely
example: Minor visual glitch, they said; the showstopper deleted accounts.

hindi: माल की कमी — चोरी, क्षति या ग़लती से गायब हुआ भंडार
definition: inventory lost between receipt and sale through theft, damage, spoilage or recording errors, never matching the books
example: Shrinkage spiked every December, around the same time as the staff party.

hindi: अलग पत्र — किसी एक निवेशक को दिए गए अतिरिक्त अधिकार
definition: a separate agreement granting one investor extra rights or terms outside the main financing documents
example: The cap table looked clean until someone found the side letter promising a board seat to three different people.

hindi: अलग बातचीत — मुख्य चर्चा से हटकर छोटी बात
definition: a quick side conversation outside the main discussion
example: Quick sidebar after this call about the demo?

hindi: नौकरी शुरू करने पर एकमुश्त राशि — अक्सर वापसी-शर्त सहित
definition: a lump sum paid for joining, often repayable if you leave early
example: The sign-on bonus was generous, with a twelve-month leash attached.

hindi: संकेत बनाम शोर — मतलब की जानकारी और बेमतलब उतार-चढ़ाव का फर्क
definition: separating meaningful movement in data from random fluctuation
example: Two days of data is noise; three days is a board slide.

hindi: संकेत जोखिम — बड़े निवेशक के अगले राउंड में न आने से बनी नकारात्मक छवि
definition: the danger that a well-known existing investor declining to invest again makes outside investors assume something is wrong
example: The seed fund's policy of never following on created perfect signaling risk for every company it touched.

hindi: हस्ताक्षर खंड — ईमेल के अंत में नाम-पद
definition: the block of name, title, and quotes ending every email
example: Her signature is longer than most of her emails.

hindi: मौन बैठक — शुरू में सब चुपचाप दस्तावेज़ पढ़ते हैं
definition: a meeting that opens with attendees silently reading and commenting on a document before discussing
example: The silent meeting was the first time anyone read the document before disagreeing with it.

hindi: अलग-थलग ढाँचा — दूसरों से कटकर काम करता विभाग
definition: a team that hoards information and works in isolation
example: The data lives in three silos and two grudges.

hindi: रामबाण — हर समस्या का एकमुश्त इलाज
