definition: a single fix that solves everything; does not exist
example: The new tool is great, but it's no silver bullet.

hindi: रजत पदक उम्मीदवार — अंतिम दौर तक पहुँचा पर न चुना गया उम्मीदवार
definition: a strong finalist who lost the offer narrowly and is worth contacting for later openings
example: Before posting the new req, check the silver medalists from last quarter's loop.

hindi: एक ही स्क्रीन पर सब — सारे आँकड़े एक जगह देखने का वादा
definition: one unified view of everything, promised by every tool
example: The new tool is a single pane of glass, our seventh.

hindi: एक ही स्रोत चुनना — विकल्प होते हुए भी जानबूझकर एक विक्रेता से ख़रीद
definition: deliberately buying from one chosen supplier without competitive bidding even though other suppliers could provide it
example: We single source it because switching would mean learning a new invoice format.

hindi: एकमात्र प्रामाणिक स्रोत — सबके लिए एक ही सही जगह
definition: the one authoritative place where correct data lives, in theory
example: We have three single sources of truth.

hindi: एक-सूत्री — जिस सौदे में ग्राहक से केवल एक संपर्क हो
definition: describes a deal depending on a single customer contact, leaving it fragile should that person leave
example: We were single-threaded through Priya, who has just posted her farewell on LinkedIn.

hindi: एकल-समर्पित स्वामी — एक ही पहल पर पूरा ध्यान देने वाला ज़िम्मेदार नेता
definition: a leader dedicated full-time to one initiative without competing responsibilities, accountable for its entire outcome
example: He's the single-threaded owner of search, plus billing, plus the offsite.

hindi: एकल-ट्रिगर त्वरण — कंपनी बिकते ही बाकी शेयर तुरंत वेस्ट
definition: immediate vesting of unvested shares triggered by an acquisition alone, whether or not the holder keeps a role
example: Acquirers hate single-trigger acceleration because it pays everyone to leave on day one.

hindi: साइट-नक्शा — उत्पाद के सभी पन्नों और उनके जुड़ाव का चित्र
definition: a diagram of all pages and how they connect
example: The sitemap has forty pages; analytics says users visit five.

hindi: परिस्थिति-अनुसार नेतृत्व — टीम सदस्य की क्षमता और प्रतिबद्धता देखकर शैली बदलना
definition: a leadership style model where the manager shifts between directing, coaching, supporting and delegating based on each person's skill and commitment
example: She practised situational leadership: directing the interns, delegating to seniors, and coaching whoever sat nearest the coffee machine.

hindi: दोष-न्यूनीकरण पद्धति — आँकड़ों के सहारे प्रक्रिया को लगभग त्रुटिहीन बनाना
definition: a statistical quality method that reduces process variation and defects toward roughly three errors per million opportunities
example: He brought six sigma rigour to the office coffee order and still got it wrong.

hindi: छह-पन्नों का ज्ञापन — मीटिंग से पहले पढ़ा जाने वाला लिखित प्रस्ताव
definition: a narrative memo of at most six pages that attendees read silently at the start of a meeting instead of watching slides
example: He wrote a six-pager, then asked if he could also present the deck.

hindi: इनाम का आकार — किसी अवसर से संभावित कुल लाभ
definition: the estimated total financial value an opportunity or initiative could deliver, used to justify investing effort in it
example: The size of the prize was two billion, a figure that grew each time the partner repeated it.

hindi: ढांचा स्क्रीन — सामग्री लोड होते समय दिखने वाला धूसर खाका
definition: a placeholder layout shown while real content loads
example: Users now recognize our skeleton screen better than our content.

hindi: वास्तविक वस्तु-नकल — डिजिटल डिज़ाइन में असली चीज़ों की बनावट
definition: interface design that imitates physical objects and textures, like leather calendars or paper notepads
example: The notes app returned to skeuomorphism, and the product manager returned to calling it 'warm'.

hindi: कौशल-आधारित स्वयंसेवा — अपने पेशेवर हुनर से संस्था की मदद
definition: employees donating their professional expertise, such as legal, finance, design or technology work, to nonprofits rather than general manual labour
example: Skills-based volunteering meant the charity got a brand strategy when it really needed a working printer.

hindi: दांव पर हिस्सेदारी — नतीजे से अपना नफ़ा-नुक़सान जुड़ा होना
definition: personal stake in an outcome, so failure costs you too
example: Advisors advise; founders have skin in the game.

hindi: अपने बॉस के बॉस से सीधी मुलाकात
definition: a meeting with your manager's manager, skipping the layer between
example: In the skip-level she finally learned why the roadmap kept changing.

hindi: बिक्री वार्षिक आरंभ सम्मेलन — नए वर्ष की योजना और प्रेरणा वाली बैठक
definition: sales kickoff; annual company event launching the year's quotas, territories, messaging and strategy for sellers
example: The SKO keynote promised a transformational year, then unveiled quotas thirty percent higher.

hindi: स्टॉक पहचान इकाई — हर उत्पाद-रूप का अलग कोड
definition: stock keeping unit; the unique code tracking each distinct product variant, size or colour through inventory and sales
example: Marketing wants twelve new colours, which operations hears as twelve new SKUs.

hindi: सेवा-स्तर अनुबंध — जवाब और अपटाइम की संविदागत गारंटी
definition: service level agreement — the contractual promise of response times and uptime
example: The SLA guarantees a response in four hours; a solution is sold separately.

hindi: सेवा-स्तर घड़ी — टिकट पर अनुबंधित समय-सीमा की उलटी गिनती
definition: running timer tracking how much time remains before a support ticket breaches its contracted response or resolution commitment
example: Setting the ticket to 'waiting on customer' pauses the SLA clock, which explains its popularity.

hindi: सेवा स्तर संकेतक — सेवा की विश्वसनीयता को मापने वाला वास्तविक आँकड़ा
definition: service level indicator; the actual measured metric, such as request success rate or latency, that a reliability target is checked against
example: Nobody agreed on the SLI, so every team's dashboard said the service was healthy.

hindi: काट-छांट कर देखना — डेटा को कई कोणों से बांटकर परखना
definition: to break data apart along different dimensions until something interesting appears
example: We sliced and diced until the quarter looked survivable.

hindi: कागज़ी रणनीति — जो केवल प्रस्तुति में मौजूद है, हकीकत में नहीं
definition: a strategy, product or capability that exists convincingly in presentation slides but has not been built or implemented
example: The integrated platform was pure slideware, though the slides had excellent gradients.

hindi: खिसकना — तय तिथि से आगे टल जाना
definition: to move past a planned date, quietly and usually more than once
example: The launch slipped a week, in the way weeks become months.

hindi: फिसलन — सौदों की समापन तिथि आगे खिसकना
definition: deals moving their expected close dates into later quarters, weakening the current forecast
example: Slippage this quarter was so consistent that next quarter is now fully booked with this quarter's deals.

hindi: सेवा स्तर उद्देश्य — किसी सेवा की विश्वसनीयता का आंतरिक रूप से तय किया गया लक्ष्य
definition: service level objective; an internal reliability target for a service, such as availability or latency, measured over a rolling window
example: Our SLO is 99.9 percent, which leaves roughly forty minutes a month for the database to be creative.

hindi: धीमा चलाना — किसी काम को जानबूझकर टालते रहना ताकि वह ख़ुद मर जाए
definition: to deliberately delay work or a decision you oppose while outwardly appearing to cooperate, hoping it quietly stalls
example: Legal isn't blocking the partnership; they're just slow-walking it until the quarter ends.

hindi: लघु भाषा मॉडल — फ़ोन पर चलने लायक़ छोटा, किफ़ायती मॉडल
definition: a compact model cheap enough to run on phones or laptops
example: A small language model on the watch handles rep talk; the cloud handles philosophy.

hindi: स्मार्ट लक्ष्य — स्पष्ट, मापने योग्य, समयबद्ध लक्ष्य
definition: a goal written to be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound, the standard formula in performance planning
example: 'Be awesome' was rejected by the manager for failing the SMART goal test on all five letters.

hindi: सुस्पष्ट मापनीय लक्ष्य — विशिष्ट, मापने योग्य, प्राप्य, प्रासंगिक और समयबद्ध लक्ष्य
definition: specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, time-bound; a checklist for writing goals that can be tracked and assessed
example: My SMART goals were measurable, which is how everyone noticed I missed them.

hindi: समझदार पूँजी — पैसे के साथ अनुभव और संपर्क भी लाने वाला निवेश
definition: investment that brings expertise and connections along with the cash
example: We picked the smart money over the bigger check; the intros paid off.

hindi: कमरे का सबसे होशियार — जो हर बहस जीतना चाहता है, टीम से ऊपर खुद को रखता है
definition: a colleague who must always prove they are the most knowledgeable person present, at the team's expense
example: He was the smartest person in the room, which is why nobody else in the room spoke.

hindi: लघु और मध्यम व्यवसाय — छोटे ग्राहकों का वर्ग
definition: small and medium-sized business — customers with quick decisions and modest budgets
example: SMB customers decide in a week and leave just as fast.

hindi: विषय विशेषज्ञ — किसी खास क्षेत्र का गहरा जानकार जिससे सब पूछते हैं
definition: subject matter expert; the go-to person with deep knowledge of one specific system, process or domain
example: Loop in the SME before we decide, or we will decide twice.

hindi: मुस्कुराओ और फ़ोन घुमाओ — लगातार ढेरों कोल्ड कॉल करना
definition: making a high volume of cold calls to prospects while staying relentlessly cheerful through every single call
example: The new SDRs spent their first week learning the product and their second learning to smile and dial.

hindi: धुआँ परीक्षण — बुनियादी जाँच कि कुछ सुलग तो नहीं रहा
definition: a quick basic check that the system starts and nothing is obviously on fire
example: The smoke test passed, so we're at least 10% confident.

hindi: अनोखा सर्वर — हाथ से सँवारा, दोबारा न बन पाने वाला
definition: a hand-configured server so unique nobody can rebuild it
example: Don't reboot the snowflake server; nobody remembers how it works.

hindi: तो क्या — आँकड़े से निकलने वाला असली मतलब क्या है
definition: the insight or implication a chart or finding carries for the decision at hand, demanded when analysis stops at facts
example: He presented forty charts of data, and the partner's only question was 'so what?'

hindi: सुरक्षा अनुपालन प्रमाणन — डेटा-सुरक्षा नियंत्रणों की ऑडिट रिपोर्ट
definition: a security compliance audit that big customers demand from SaaS vendors
example: The deal is waiting on SOC 2, so everyone suddenly loves process.

hindi: सामाजिक-मंच निगरानी — ऑनलाइन चर्चाओं में ब्रांड-उल्लेखों पर नज़र
definition: monitoring social platforms, forums and reviews for mentions of a brand, competitors or topics, then analysing sentiment and trends
example: Social listening picked up the complaint thread two days after the chief executive did.

hindi: सामाजिक प्रमाण — दूसरों का भरोसा दिखाकर विश्वास जगाना
definition: evidence that other people already use and trust a product
example: Three customer logos on the landing page — instant social proof.

hindi: सामाजिक दिखावा — कर्मचारियों या समाज के प्रति ज़िम्मेदारी के खोखले दावे
definition: overstating social credentials such as diversity, labour standards or community commitments that company practices cannot support
example: The social washing campaign celebrated inclusion on the same day the contractors lost their canteen.

hindi: सबको बताना — फ़ैसले से पहले विचार लोगों तक पहुँचाना
definition: to float an idea around so nobody is surprised later
example: Socialize the proposal with the leads before the review.

hindi: हल्का समापन — अनुमानों के सहारे जल्दी खाते बंद करना
definition: a faster, lighter closing of the books using estimates, skipping detailed reconciliations, typically for interim months
example: It was a soft close, so the numbers are right in the way weather forecasts are right.

hindi: सम्मानजनक समापन — डूबती कंपनी का बिककर बच जाना
definition: a face-saving acquisition that rescues a struggling startup from shutting down
example: It wasn't the exit we dreamed of, but a soft landing beats a shutdown.

hindi: धीमी शुरुआत — बड़े लॉन्च से पहले सीमित रिलीज़
definition: a quiet, limited release used to test before the real launch
example: The soft launch went so quietly that even our moms missed it.

hindi: नरम इनकार — सीधे मना न करके ऐसा जवाब जिसका मतलब इनकार हो
definition: a polite, noncommittal response that avoids openly refusing but signals the request will not happen
example: 'Let's revisit next quarter' is the most reliable soft no in the building.

hindi: सुस्ती का दौर — बिक्री या माँग में अस्थायी कमज़ोरी
definition: temporary weakness in sales or customer demand, framed by management as brief and already improving
example: It's a soft patch, the CEO said, now entering its fourth quarter.

hindi: अनौपचारिक सुधार योजना — बिना काग़ज़ के दी गई चेतावनी
definition: informal performance warning with expectations and deadlines, delivered before any formal improvement plan exists
example: The weekly 'alignment check-ins' with his manager were a soft PIP wearing a friendly hat.

hindi: अप्रत्यक्ष बचत — समय या क्षमता की बचत जो बजट में नहीं दिखती
definition: claimed savings such as reclaimed hours or productivity that never reduce actual spending
example: The tool paid for itself in soft savings, according to the team that wanted the tool.

hindi: सहायक सेवाएँ — सफ़ाई, कैंटीन, सुरक्षा जैसी लोगों से जुड़ी सुविधाएँ
definition: facilities management services that support people in a building, such as cleaning, catering, security and reception
example: Soft services got cut first, which is why the pantry now runs on a single sad kettle.

hindi: एकमात्र स्रोत — जब केवल एक ही विक्रेता वह चीज़ दे सकता है, इसलिए बिना प्रतिस्पर्धा ख़रीद
definition: buying from one supplier without competitive bidding because that supplier is the only one able to provide it
example: It's a sole source purchase, meaning we couldn't find anyone else in the twenty minutes we looked.

hindi: एकल संस्थापक — बिना सह-संस्थापक के अकेले कंपनी शुरू करने वाला
definition: a founder starting and running a company without any co-founder, often viewed warily by investors
example: As a solo founder, his standup had perfect attendance and zero disagreement.

hindi: एकल उद्यमी — अकेले ही पूरा कारोबार चलाने वाला
definition: an entrepreneur who builds and runs the business entirely alone
example: As a solopreneur, every all-hands meeting is just him and his coffee.

hindi: समस्या खोजता समाधान — असली ज़रूरत के बिना बनाई गई तकनीक या उत्पाद
definition: a product or technology built before identifying any genuine customer need it could address
example: The blockchain feature was a solution looking for a problem, and the problem was our roadmap.

hindi: समाधान बिक्री — उत्पाद नहीं, ग्राहक की समस्या का हल बेचना
definition: selling approach centred on diagnosing customer problems first and positioning the product as their remedy
example: It's solution selling, so we diagnose their problem, which happily always turns out to be our product.

hindi: समाधान क्षेत्र — तय समस्या के संभावित हलों की दुनिया
definition: the range of possible ways to solve a defined problem
example: We jumped to the solution space before agreeing what the problem was.

hindi: समाधान-निर्माण — समस्या समझे बिना सीधे हल पर कूद पड़ना
definition: jumping to design a specific solution before understanding the customer problem; also common Indian English for designing a technical solution
example: Ten minutes into the problem statement, sales was already solutioning a dashboard.

hindi: प्राप्य बाज़ार — निकट भविष्य में वाक़ई जीतने लायक़ हिस्सा
definition: serviceable obtainable market; the share you can actually win near term
example: Nobody claps at the SOM slide, but it's the only honest one.

hindi: भावी यूनिकॉर्न — जल्द एक अरब डॉलर मूल्यांकन छूने की उम्मीद वाला स्टार्टअप
definition: a startup expected to reach a billion-dollar valuation soon, a label especially common in Indian English startup press
example: Three funding announcements called us a soonicorn, and none of them mentioned our burn.

hindi: देर से जवाब के लिए क्षमा — विलंब की माफ़ी
definition: the apology that opens replies sent days, or eras, later
example: Sorry for the late reply; this was under 400 unread emails.

hindi: पहुँच, जान-पहचान — भारतीय अंग्रेज़ी में नौकरी या काम निकलवाने का निजी संपर्क
definition: in Indian English, a personal connection with influence, used to secure a hire, approval or favour
example: He didn't clear the interview loop; he came in through source.

hindi: उम्मीदवार खोजक — संभावित उम्मीदवार ढूँढने वाला भर्ती विशेषज्ञ
definition: a recruiting specialist who finds and first contacts potential candidates before recruiters take over
example: The sourcer found forty profiles, twelve replies and one candidate who actually read the message.

hindi: स्रोत और उपयोग — सौदे का पैसा कहाँ से आएगा और कहाँ जाएगा, इसकी तालिका
definition: a table showing where deal money comes from and where it goes, which must balance exactly
example: The sources and uses balanced perfectly once someone added a line called 'other'.

hindi: उम्मीदवारों की सक्रिय खोज — आवेदन का इंतज़ार नहीं
definition: proactively finding candidates rather than waiting for applications
example: Half of sourcing is cold messages beginning with an apology for the cold message.

hindi: कार्य विवरण — अनुबंध में तय काम, समयसीमा और डिलिवरेबल
definition: statement of work; the contract section defining exactly what will be delivered
example: If it's not in the SOW, it's a change request.

hindi: सार्बेन्स-ऑक्सली अधिनियम — सूचीबद्ध कंपनियों के वित्तीय नियंत्रण का कानून
definition: the Sarbanes-Oxley Act; United States legislation requiring listed companies to document and test internal financial controls
example: You can't change that spreadsheet formula without a SOX control review, so please enjoy the old formula.

hindi: खाली सूचीबद्ध कंपनी — विलय से स्टार्टअप को शेयर बाज़ार में लाती है
definition: a shell company that lists publicly, then merges with a startup to take it public
example: They went public via SPAC and learned what quarterly earnings feel like.

hindi: जगह का उपयोग — दफ़्तर की जगह कितनी और कैसे काम आ रही है
definition: measuring how much office desk and room space is actually used over time, usually to justify shrinking it
example: Space utilisation data showed the boardroom is used twice a month, both times for crying.

hindi: उलझा हुआ कोड — नूडल्स-सा गुत्थमगुत्था, समझ से परे प्रवाह
definition: tangled code whose control flow twists like noodles, defying comprehension
example: I traced the spaghetti code for an hour and ended where I started.

hindi: एक प्रबंधक के अधीन कर्मचारियों की संख्या
definition: the number of direct reports a single manager oversees
example: After the reorg, her span of control doubled but her hours stayed at all of them.

hindi: वक्ता कार्यक्रम — कंपनी द्वारा डॉक्टर को भुगतान देकर साथियों को दवा पर बोलवाना
definition: a company-sponsored event where paid physicians present approved drug information to fellow prescribers, heavily scrutinized by compliance
example: Compliance reviewed the speaker program menu longer than the slides.

hindi: अगुवाई करना — नई मुहिम का नेतृत्व करना
definition: to lead a new effort from the front
example: He spearheaded the migration and got the arrows to prove it.

hindi: विशेष परियोजनाएँ — किसी को हटाने से पहले दिया जाने वाला अस्पष्ट पद
definition: a euphemism for a vague role given to a sidelined executive, often shortly before they leave
example: He's moving to special projects, which is HR for 'update your LinkedIn'.

hindi: वाक्-से-पाठ — बोली गई बात को लिखित शब्दों में बदलना
definition: converting spoken audio into written words automatically
example: Speech-to-text handles workout logging, though 'eight reps' still sometimes lands as 'ate crepes'.

hindi: लीड पर तत्परता — नई पूछताछ का कितनी जल्दी जवाब दिया
definition: time between an inbound enquiry arriving and a salesperson first contacting that prospect
example: Our speed to lead is four days, by which time the prospect has bought from someone who answered.

hindi: परिवार के साथ समय बिताना — वरिष्ठ अधिकारी की अचानक विदाई का सभ्य बहाना
definition: classic announcement phrasing for a senior executive departure, frequently covering a forced resignation
example: The CFO left to spend more time with family, who were reportedly also surprised.

hindi: प्रबंधित ख़र्च — कुल ख़र्च का वह हिस्सा जो खरीद विभाग की निगरानी और अनुबंधों से होता है
definition: the share of company spending that flows through procurement-negotiated contracts and approved purchasing processes
example: Procurement's favourite slide is spend under management, going up and to the right.

hindi: तात्कालिक बिक्री बोनस — ख़ास उत्पाद बेचने पर इनाम
definition: a short-term bonus for selling a specific product or hitting a sprint goal
example: A $500 spiff on the new module and suddenly every demo features it.

hindi: स्पाइक — अनिश्चितता जाँचने हेतु समयबद्ध खोजी कार्य
definition: a timeboxed investigation to answer a technical question before committing to build
example: Let's do a spike before we promise anything to sales.

hindi: अतिप्रवाह — स्प्रिंट में न समाकर आगे बहा काम
definition: planned work that didn't fit the sprint and flows into the next one
example: We planned for zero spillover, which was itself optimistic planning.

hindi: अलग इकाई बनाना — हिस्से को स्वतंत्र कंपनी या टीम बनाना
definition: to split part of a company or project into its own entity
example: The side project got spun off before it got good.

hindi: प्रश्न-आधारित बिक्री — स्थिति, समस्या, प्रभाव और ज़रूरत वाले प्रश्नों से बेचना
definition: consultative questioning method moving through situation, problem, implication and need-payoff questions before pitching
example: His SPIN selling was flawless, except he asked all four questions before the customer had finished sitting down.

hindi: जल्दी खड़ा करना — नई टीम या सिस्टम फ़ौरन शुरू करना
definition: to quickly get a new team, project, or system running
example: We spun up a task force to study our task forces.

hindi: एकल संपर्क सूत्र — किसी विषय के लिए तय अकेला ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति
definition: single point of contact; widely used in Indian English for the one named person handling a vendor, client or issue
example: The vendor's SPOC is on leave, and the SPOC's SPOC hasn't been assigned.

hindi: विफलता का अकेला बिंदु — ऐसा हिस्सा जिसके रुकते ही पूरी प्रणाली रुक जाए
definition: single point of failure; one component, system or person whose failure alone brings down an entire service
example: The architecture review found no SPOF, apart from Priya, who holds the only password.

hindi: बंद कमरों में आपकी पैरवी करने वाला वरिष्ठ
definition: a senior person who advocates for your promotion in rooms you're not in
example: A mentor gives advice; a sponsor says your name in calibration.

hindi: तुरंत दिया गया छोटा पुरस्कार-बोनस
definition: a small, immediate bonus for a specific piece of good work
example: The outage he fixed at 3 a.m. earned a spot bonus and insomnia.

hindi: दस्ता-क़बीला संरचना — इंजीनियरों को छोटे स्वायत्त दलों और बड़े समूहों में बाँटने का ढाँचा
definition: agile scaling structure organising engineers into squads, tribes, chapters and guilds, named after the company that described it
example: We adopted the Spotify model, which so far means our teams are called squads.

hindi: अंधाधुंध भेजो और उम्मीद करो — बिना छँटाई के ढेर सारे संदेश भेजना
definition: sending generic outreach messages to huge untargeted prospect lists and hoping a handful of recipients respond
example: The spray and pray campaign reached forty thousand inboxes and one reply, asking to unsubscribe.

hindi: ऊपर से एआई छिड़क दो — बिना सोचे उत्पाद में एआई जोड़ने का आदेश
definition: an instruction to bolt artificial intelligence features onto an existing product mainly so it sounds modern and fundable
example: The roadmap review ended, as always, with someone asking us to sprinkle some AI on it.

hindi: स्प्रिंट — विकास कार्य का छोटा निश्चित चक्र, प्रायः दो सप्ताह
definition: a short fixed period, usually two weeks, in which a team commits to specific work
example: We'll pick that up next sprint, which is agile for eventually.

hindi: स्प्रिंट लक्ष्य — स्प्रिंट का एक साझा उद्देश्य
definition: the single objective a sprint's work is supposed to serve
example: Our sprint goal is finishing last sprint's goal.

hindi: स्प्रिंट नियोजन — स्प्रिंट का काम चुनने की बैठक
definition: the meeting where a team picks and commits to the sprint's work
example: Sprint planning took four hours, which was not in the plan.

hindi: स्प्रिंट समीक्षा — हितधारकों को पूर्ण कार्य दिखाना
definition: the end-of-sprint session showing finished work to stakeholders
example: The sprint review demo worked, so the sprint gets remembered fondly.

hindi: विशेष प्रयोजन वाहन — कई निवेशकों को एक सौदे में एक साथ लाने वाली इकाई
definition: special purpose vehicle; a single-deal entity pooling many small investors so they appear as one line on the capital table
example: The angel syndicate came in through an SPV, which kept the cap table tidy and the email thread enormous.

hindi: बिक्री टीम द्वारा परखा संभावित ग्राहक — असली सौदे की संभावना
definition: sales-qualified lead — vetted by sales as a genuine opportunity, not the database language
example: Marketing sent fifty MQLs; sales accepted four as SQLs and complained anyway.

hindi: बिक्री-योग्य अवसर — बिक्री टीम द्वारा स्वीकृत असली सौदा
definition: sales qualified opportunity; prospect confirmed by sales as having genuine need, budget and buying intent
example: Marketing celebrated two hundred leads; sales accepted four as SQOs and one of those was a competitor.

hindi: कमिट समेटना — कई कमिट मिलाकर एक करना
definition: to combine many messy commits into one tidy commit before merging
example: Squash it; nobody needs nine commits named 'fix typo'.

hindi: साइट विश्वसनीयता इंजीनियरिंग — सॉफ़्टवेयर इंजीनियरिंग से सेवाओं को स्थिर और चालू रखने का काम
definition: site reliability engineering; the discipline and team that keeps production services running reliably, using software engineering instead of manual operations
example: The SRE asked who owned the service, and the silence answered for everyone.

hindi: सामाजिक निवेश प्रतिफल — खर्च के हर रुपये से बने सामाजिक मूल्य का आकलन
definition: social return on investment; estimating the social, environmental and economic value created for every unit of money a programme spends
example: The SROI came out at seven to one, which is roughly where every SROI comes out.

hindi: एकल प्रवेश — एक ही लॉगिन से कंपनी के सारे टूल खुल जाना
definition: single sign-on; shared company login opening every workplace tool without separate passwords
example: The new vendor is approved as soon as it supports SSO, which it will next quarter, every quarter.

hindi: मंज़िल योजना — इमारत की किस मंज़िल पर कौन-सी टीम बैठेगी, इसका ख़ाका
definition: a floor-by-floor plan of which teams occupy which building floors, used for office moves and space planning
example: The new stack plan puts legal on the top floor, as far as architecturally possible from sales.

hindi: क्रमबद्ध करना — हर काम को ऊपर से नीचे तक एक क्रम देना
definition: to force-order every item so there are no convenient ties
example: Stack rank the features; 'all of them' is not a ranking.

hindi: कर्मचारियों को आपस में क्रम देना — किसी को नीचे आना ही है
definition: force-ranking employees against each other so someone must land at the bottom
example: Stack ranking turned a great team into five careful rivals.

hindi: परत-दर-परत बदलाव — बड़े काम को एक-दूसरे पर टिके छोटे समीक्षा-योग्य टुकड़ों में बाँटना
definition: a workflow of splitting a large change into small dependent pull requests, each reviewed separately and stacked on the previous
example: With stacked diffs, the reviewer can reject your work in seven small, digestible pieces.

hindi: कर्मी पूर्ति — ग्राहक की टीम में बाहरी कर्मचारियों को अस्थायी रूप से जोड़ना
definition: supplying external workers who join a client's team temporarily, billed by time instead of outcomes
example: It was sold as transformation and delivered as staff augmentation with nicer lanyards.

hindi: वरिष्ठ से ऊपर के इंजीनियरिंग स्तर — स्टाफ, प्रिंसिपल आदि
definition: engineering levels above senior — staff, principal, and beyond
example: At staff+, the job is mostly documents and diplomacy.

hindi: क्रमिक बोर्ड — हर साल केवल कुछ निदेशकों का चुनाव, ताकि बोर्ड एक झटके में न बदले
definition: a board where directors serve overlapping multi-year terms, so only a fraction face election each year, slowing takeovers
example: Thanks to the staggered board, the activist needed three annual meetings and considerable patience to win control.

hindi: पूर्व-उत्पादन वातावरण — रिलीज़ से पहले की रिहर्सल जगह
definition: a production-like environment where changes rehearse before the real show
example: It worked on staging, which resembles production the way a photo resembles a person.

hindi: हितधारक — परियोजना के परिणाम में रुचि रखने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: anyone with an interest in a project's outcome and opinions about it
example: The demo went well until a stakeholder discovered opinions.

hindi: हितधारक पूँजीवाद — शेयरधारकों के साथ कर्मचारियों, ग्राहकों और समाज के हित भी साधने का विचार
definition: the view that companies should serve employees, customers, communities and society alongside shareholders, not shareholders alone
example: The annual report celebrated stakeholder capitalism on page three and the plant closure on page forty.

hindi: हितधारक नक़्शा — कौन कितना प्रभावशाली है और किस पक्ष में है, इसका चार्ट
definition: a chart plotting stakeholders by their influence and attitude toward a project, used to plan persuasion and approvals
example: According to the stakeholder map, the real decision maker is the finance lead nobody invited.

hindi: बासी शाखा — महीनों से अछूती पड़ी शाखा, जो मुख्य शाखा से बहुत पीछे छूट गई है
definition: a branch nobody has touched for months, far behind the main branch and probably abandoned
example: Cleaning up stale branches revealed three rewrites of the billing system, all unfinished.

hindi: मानक उपचार — डॉक्टरों द्वारा आमतौर पर स्वीकृत इलाज
definition: the treatment physicians currently accept as appropriate for a condition, which trials compare against and challengers must beat
example: Every launch deck promises to redefine the standard of care, including the one for a slightly smaller pill.

hindi: मानक कार्यविधि — किसी काम को करने का सबसे अच्छा तय तरीका
definition: the documented best current method for performing a task, including sequence, timing and expected inventory at each step
example: Standard work says nine steps; the veteran operator does it in four and will not explain how.

hindi: स्टैंडअप — रोज़ की छोटी टीम बैठक जिसमें प्रगति और बाधाएँ बताते हैं
definition: a short daily meeting where each person shares progress, plans, and blockers
example: Our fifteen-minute standup has a forty-five-minute average.

hindi: स्थिति-कार्य-कदम-नतीजा ढांचे में जवाब देने की इंटरव्यू तकनीक
definition: answering behavioral questions as situation, task, action, result
example: He STAR-methoded 'tell me about a conflict' into a tidy fable.

hindi: 'क्यों' से शुरू करो — काम क्या और कैसे से पहले उसका उद्देश्य बताना
definition: leadership principle that inspiring teams and customers begins with explaining purpose before describing products or methods
example: Start with why, he urged, then refused to explain why the project was cancelled.

hindi: सांख्यिकीय शक्ति — असली असर को पकड़ पाने की प्रयोग की क्षमता
definition: an experiment's ability to detect a real effect if one exists
example: The test lacked statistical power, so we learned nothing with great precision.

hindi: सांख्यिकीय रूप से सार्थक — नतीजा संयोग नहीं, असल असर लगता है
definition: unlikely to be explained by random chance
example: It is statistically significant, just not significant in any other sense.

hindi: उपलब्धता की स्थिति — ऑनलाइन, व्यस्त या दूर
definition: the dot and label claiming whether you're available
example: His status says available; his replies say otherwise.

hindi: स्थिति बैठक — हर कोई अपने काम की प्रगति बताता है
definition: a recurring meeting where each person reports progress on their work, often readable in writing instead
example: The status meeting ran an hour so nine people could each say 'still on track'.

hindi: सेवा स्थिति पृष्ठ — आउटेज और घटनाओं की सार्वजनिक सूचना देने वाला पृष्ठ
definition: public webpage showing whether a service is operating normally and posting updates during outages or degraded performance
example: The status page stayed a reassuring green through the entire outage.

hindi: स्थिति रिपोर्ट — प्रगति की नियमित औपचारिक सूचना
definition: a recurring report on progress, risks, and how fine everything is
example: The status update says on track; the team says otherwise.

hindi: रुकाव साक्षात्कार — कर्मचारी छोड़े उससे पहले उसकी राय लेना
definition: a manager conversation asking valued employees what keeps them and what might make them leave
example: The stay interview came a week after his resignation, which slightly reduced its usefulness.

hindi: छिपी छँटनी — बिना घोषणा के लोगों को धीरे-धीरे हटाना
definition: cutting staff without announcing layoffs, through harsh ratings, relocation demands or office mandates
example: The return-to-office mandate was a stealth layoff with a free-lunch coupon attached.

hindi: गुप्त अवस्था — लॉन्च से पहले चुपचाप काम करना
definition: operating secretly before launch to avoid tipping off competitors
example: They're in stealth mode, which hasn't stopped the founder from tweeting hints daily.

hindi: संचालन समिति — परियोजना की निगरानी करती वरिष्ठ समिति
definition: the steering committee; senior people who meet monthly to redirect your project
example: Steerco approved the plan they rewrote at the last steerco.

hindi: छलांग-भर बदलाव — धीरे-धीरे नहीं, एकदम नए स्तर पर पहुंचना
definition: a sudden jump to a new level rather than gradual improvement
example: We need a step change, announced the same slide as last year.

hindi: अल्पकालिक प्रोत्साहन — एक वर्ष के प्रदर्शन पर मिलने वाला बोनस
definition: short-term incentive; the annual cash bonus paid against yearly company and individual performance targets
example: The STI formula has four weighted factors, and all of them are somehow the CFO's mood.

hindi: चिपकाव — आदत बनने का संकेत, अक्सर DAU बटा MAU
definition: how habitually users return, often measured as DAU over MAU
example: Our stickiness suggests users visit weekly, mostly to reset passwords.

hindi: रट्टू तोता — बिना समझे शब्द जोड़ने वाला मॉडल
definition: a dismissive description of language models as systems that stitch together plausible words without understanding meaning
example: He called the chatbot a stochastic parrot, then asked it to write his performance review.

hindi: तय दाम पर शेयर खरीदने का अधिकार
definition: the right to buy company shares later at a preset price
example: The stock options are either a house deposit or wallpaper.

hindi: कठोर यथार्थ और अटल आस्था — बुरे हालात को स्वीकारते हुए अंतिम जीत पर भरोसा
definition: the leadership discipline of confronting brutal current facts while keeping unwavering faith the company will prevail in the end
example: The CFO called it the Stockdale paradox; the team called it the layoff slide followed by the vision slide.

hindi: माल ख़त्म — माँग होने पर भी भंडार में वस्तु न होना
definition: running completely out of inventory for an item while customers are still ordering it, losing sales
example: Our bestseller hit a stockout the same morning the ad campaign went live.

hindi: रोको, शुरू करो, जारी रखो — प्रतिक्रिया या रेट्रो के तीन खाने
definition: feedback format listing what a person or team should stop doing, start doing and keep doing
example: The stop, start, continue board had one item under stop: this exercise.

hindi: स्टोरी मैपिंग — उपयोगकर्ता-यात्रा के क्रम में कहानियाँ सजाना
definition: arranging stories along the user journey to see releases and gaps
example: Story mapping covered a wall and humbled the roadmap.

hindi: स्टोरी पॉइंट — कार्य के सापेक्ष आकार की अमूर्त इकाई
definition: an abstract unit for estimating a task's relative size, deliberately not hours
example: Three story points, he said, with the confidence of a coin flip.

hindi: कथा-पट — अनुभव को दृश्य-दर-दृश्य चित्रों में दिखाना
definition: a comic-strip sketch of a user's experience, scene by scene
example: The storyboard has our user smiling by frame four; ambitious.

hindi: कथा-क्रम — प्रेज़ेंटेशन के तर्कों की सिलसिलेवार रूपरेखा
definition: the ordered sequence of messages a presentation will make, agreed before slides are built so each page advances one argument
example: The storyline changed at midnight, so the slides now argue for the opposite recommendation with the same charts.

hindi: फँसी संपत्तियाँ — जलवायु बदलाव से समय से पहले मूल्यहीन होती संपत्तियाँ
definition: investments such as fossil fuel reserves or plants that lose value early because climate policy, technology or markets shift
example: The board called the coal terminal strategic until the auditors started saying stranded assets.

hindi: रणनीतिक ग्राहक खाता — अत्यधिक राजस्व या महत्व वाला विशेष ग्राहक
definition: high-value customer account receiving dedicated attention because of large revenue, growth potential or reputational importance
example: Every account becomes a strategic account the week before it threatens to leave.

hindi: रणनीतिक विकल्प — कंपनी या उसका हिस्सा बेचने की खोज का शिष्ट नाम
definition: euphemism announcing a company is considering selling itself, merging, or divesting a division
example: The board is exploring strategic alternatives, so the team started exploring LinkedIn.

hindi: रणनीतिक खरीदार — अपने व्यवसाय में जोड़ने हेतु कंपनी खरीदने वाली कंपनी
definition: an operating company acquiring a business to combine with its own products, customers or technology
example: The strategic buyer promised we'd stay independent, then scheduled the logo migration.

hindi: अनौपचारिक मत — राय भाँपने का ग़ैर-बाध्यकारी वोट
definition: an informal, non-binding vote to gauge opinion
example: A straw poll before lunch showed the rename was doomed.

hindi: कच्चा ख़ाका — बहस शुरू करने के लिए बनाया शुरुआती प्रस्ताव
definition: a rough first proposal made to be criticized and improved
example: Here's a strawman for the pricing tiers; tear it apart.

hindi: सरल बनाना — प्रक्रिया से फ़ालतू क़दम हटाना
definition: to simplify a process by removing steps, meetings, or occasionally people
example: We streamlined expense approvals from five clicks to four.

hindi: क्षमता से बड़ा काम — तरक्की का (और थकान का) मौका
definition: a task above your current level, offered as growth, unpaid at the new level
example: The stretch assignment was staff-level work at senior-level pay.

hindi: अतिरिक्त लक्ष्य — क्षमता बचे तो करने योग्य महत्वाकांक्षी काम
definition: an ambitious extra target beyond the committed plan
example: The stretch goal became a commitment somewhere between drafts.

hindi: विकल्प भुनाते समय शेयर का पूर्व-निर्धारित दाम
definition: the fixed price you pay per share when exercising options
example: Great strike price, assuming the company is ever worth more than it.

hindi: पक्की सिफ़ारिश — साक्षात्कारकर्ता की सबसे ऊँची हाँ
definition: the highest interviewer rating on a scorecard, recommending an offer without reservation
example: Three strong hires and one lukewarm maybe, so naturally the debrief ran ninety minutes.

hindi: दृढ़ राय, लचीली पकड़ — ठोस राय रखना पर नए तथ्य आने पर बदलने को तैयार रहना
definition: thinking habit of committing firmly to a view while staying ready to change it when better evidence appears
example: He has strong opinions, loosely held, except the opinions, which are welded on.

hindi: दृढ़ राय, ढीली पकड़ — ठोस मत रखो पर नए प्रमाण पर बदलने को तैयार रहो
definition: the practice of arguing firmly for a position while remaining willing to change it when better evidence appears
example: He has strong opinions, weakly held, except about his own roadmap.

hindi: संरचित साक्षात्कार — हर उम्मीदवार से तय प्रश्न, तय मानदंड
definition: an interview asking every candidate identical questions scored against the same written rubric
example: In a structured interview you cannot spend forty minutes chatting about cricket and call it assessment.

hindi: शैली मार्गदर्शिका — रंग, टाइपोग्राफ़ी और लहजे के लिखित नियम
definition: the documented rules for colors, type, spacing, and tone
example: The style guide says sentence case; the app disagrees on every screen.

hindi: उप-ब्रांड — मूल ब्रांड से जुड़ा अलग पहचान वाला नाम
definition: a product brand with its own name and identity that still visibly connects to the parent brand within the brand architecture
example: The sub-brand needed a name, a logo and a launch party before it needed a product.

hindi: ईमेल का विषय — खुलने या दबने का फ़ैसला
definition: the email's title, deciding whether it gets opened or archived
example: The subject line said 'quick thing'; it was a reorg.

hindi: उप-प्रसंस्कर्ता — वेंडर का वह वेंडर जो ग्राहक का डेटा छूता है
definition: a third-party vendor that your vendor uses to process customer personal data, usually listed publicly and requiring notice before changes
example: Adding one analytics library meant emailing every customer about a new subprocessor.

hindi: सफलता योजना — ग्राहक के लक्ष्यों और उन्हें पाने के कदमों का लिखित दस्तावेज़
definition: shared document between customer success manager and customer listing the customer's business goals, milestones and responsibilities for achieving them
example: The success plan was signed off enthusiastically and opened again at renewal.

hindi: मुख्य भूमिकाओं के उत्तराधिकारी पहले से तैयार रखना
definition: preparing who takes over key roles before the current holders leave
example: Succession planning started the week after the CTO's surprise resignation.

hindi: किसी उत्पाद या टीम को धीरे-धीरे बंद करना
definition: gradually shutting down a product or team, with poetic lighting
example: They're sunsetting the app, along with the team that built it.

hindi: ऊँची दायित्व सीमा — डेटा उल्लंघन जैसे जोखिमों के लिए अलग, बड़ी हद
definition: a separate, higher liability cap carved out for specific risks such as data breaches, confidentiality or indemnity claims
example: The compromise was a super cap for data breaches, which both sides privately hoped never to test.

hindi: अंतिम साक्षात्कार दिवस — एक ही दिन में लगातार कई बैंकिंग इंटरव्यू
definition: the final-round recruiting day of back-to-back interviews with bankers, deciding analyst and associate offers
example: At the superday he walked through a DCF six times and was asked about his hobbies once.

hindi: सहायता अनुरोध — ग्राहक की दर्ज की गई समस्या
definition: a logged customer issue, numbered, queued, and prioritized
example: Ticket #4512 is marked urgent; it was filed in March.

hindi: वर्जित सूची — जिन लोगों को विज्ञापन या ईमेल नहीं भेजने हैं
definition: list of people deliberately excluded from advertising or email campaigns, such as existing customers or unsubscribers
example: Nobody updated the suppression list, so our loyal customers spent a week seeing the new-customer offer.

hindi: दबी बात सामने लाना — चर्चा में उठाना
definition: to bring a buried issue or fact into open view
example: Surfacing this from page six of the thread before it dies.

hindi: आवश्यकता से अधिक — ब्रिटिश उपयोग में, अब ज़रूरत नहीं रही
definition: in British workplace usage, a person or role is no longer needed, usually before layoffs
example: After the merger, his entire department was declared surplus to requirements over a sandwich lunch.

hindi: प्रतिनिधि मापदंड — असली परिणाम की जगह मापा जाने वाला संकेतक
definition: a measurable marker such as blood pressure or tumour shrinkage used in trials as a stand-in for outcomes patients care about
example: The surrogate endpoint improved beautifully, and the regulator politely asked whether anyone lived longer.

hindi: उत्तरजीविता खंड — अनुबंध खत्म होने के बाद भी लागू रहने वाली शर्तें
definition: the provision listing which contract obligations, such as confidentiality, indemnity and payment, continue after the agreement ends
example: The partnership ended in March, but thanks to the survival clause the arguing continues.

hindi: उत्तरजीवी पूर्वाग्रह — सिर्फ बचे हुओं को देखकर निष्कर्ष निकालना
definition: drawing conclusions only from what survived while ignoring what vanished
example: Retention looks great among users who stayed, notes the survivorship bias.

hindi: उपयोगिता मापक पैमाना — दस सवालों से उत्पाद की सरलता का अंक
definition: system usability scale; a standard ten-question survey scoring how usable people find a product, reported as a single number
example: Our SUS score rose four points after the redesign, largely because we removed the redesign's extra step.

hindi: स्थिरता-आधारित ऋण — ESG लक्ष्य पूरे करने पर ब्याज दर घटने वाला कर्ज़
definition: corporate loan whose interest rate adjusts depending on whether borrower meets agreed sustainability performance targets
example: The sustainability-linked loan saves three basis points if we hit targets we had already hit.

hindi: सतत गति — बिना थके लगातार निभाई जा सकने वाली रफ़्तार
definition: a working speed a team can maintain indefinitely without burning out
example: We believe in sustainable pace, except in Q4, Q2, and Q3.

hindi: मोटा अनुमान — बिना ठोस आधार का आत्मविश्वासी आकलन
definition: scientific wild-ass guess; an estimate with confidence but without evidence
example: That timeline was a SWAG, so treat the decimals with respect.

hindi: झुंड बनाना — पूरी टीम का एक काम पर टूट पड़ना
definition: for the whole team to jump on one item until it's finished
example: Drop everything and swarm the release blocker.

hindi: मेहनत की हिस्सेदारी — पैसे की जगह श्रम से कमाया स्वामित्व
definition: ownership earned through unpaid work instead of invested money
example: My salary is sweat equity and whatever's left in the snack drawer.

hindi: स्विमलेन — बोर्ड पर व्यक्ति या श्रेणी की अलग पंक्ति
definition: a horizontal row on a board separating work by person, team, or type
example: The urgent swimlane now contains most of the board.

hindi: अस्थायी कार्यस्थल — मरम्मत या स्थानांतरण के दौरान टीम को दी गई कामचलाऊ जगह
definition: temporary office space where teams work while their permanent floor is being refurbished or moved
example: We have been in swing space for fourteen months, which is long enough to call it home.

hindi: छेददार परतों का सिद्धांत — कई सुरक्षा परतों की कमियाँ एक सीध में आने से दुर्घटना होना
definition: the idea, used in postmortems, that incidents happen when holes in several safety layers happen to align at once
example: By the Swiss cheese model, our review, testing and alerting were all lined up and very holey.

hindi: ताकत-कमज़ोरी-अवसर-खतरा विश्लेषण — स्थिति का चार-खानों वाला आकलन
definition: strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats; a four-quadrant assessment of a company's internal position and external environment
example: The SWOT analysis listed 'our people' under strengths and 'retaining our people' under threats.

hindi: चापलूसी — मॉडल का उपयोगकर्ता की हर बात से सहमत हो जाना
definition: a model's tendency to flatter users and agree with their claims rather than correct them, even when they are wrong
example: The assistant called my plan brilliant twice; either it's sycophancy or I'm finally being appreciated.

hindi: तालमेल बैठक — जानकारी मिलाने की छोटी मीटिंग
definition: a short meeting to exchange updates
example: Can we do a quick sync before the client call?

hindi: निवेशकों का समूह — एक ही सौदे में मिलकर पैसा लगाना
definition: a group of investors joining together in one deal
example: The syndicate has eleven investors and one very tired lawyer.

hindi: तालमेल — मिलकर काम करने से बढ़ा हुआ असर
definition: combined effect greater than the sum of parts; the go-to justification for any merger or reorg
example: The acquisition deck promised synergies nobody has located since.

hindi: कृत्रिम डेटा — असली डेटा की कमी में मशीन से बनाया प्रशिक्षण डेटा
definition: artificially generated data used for training when real data is scarce or sensitive
example: We generated synthetic data for rare injuries rather than waiting for real ones.

hindi: प्रणाली-रचना साक्षात्कार — बड़े सॉफ़्टवेयर ढाँचे की रूपरेखा बनवाकर परखना
definition: an engineering interview where candidates sketch the architecture of a large-scale software system
example: In the system design interview he built a global messaging platform on the whiteboard in forty-five minutes.

hindi: सिस्टम प्रॉम्प्ट — एआई का व्यवहार तय करने वाले छिपे स्थायी निर्देश
definition: hidden standing instructions that set an AI product's behavior before users type anything
example: Someone edited the system prompt, and the coach turned aggressively cheerful overnight.

hindi: यात्रा और मनोरंजन — कर्मचारियों की यात्रा, भोजन, मेहमाननवाज़ी का खर्च
definition: travel and entertainment; the expense category for business trips, client meals and related reimbursements
example: T&E is under review, which means the client dinner is now a client coffee.

hindi: समय और सामग्री — लगे घंटों और ख़र्च के हिसाब से भुगतान
definition: time and materials; pricing where the client pays for actual hours worked plus expenses
example: On T&M, nobody on the vendor side seemed in a hurry.

hindi: T-आकार कौशल — एक गहरी विशेषज्ञता, बाकी में कामचलाऊ चौड़ाई
definition: deep in one specialty with working breadth across many others
example: We want T-shaped engineers: deep in one thing, dangerous in everything.

hindi: टी-शर्ट आकलन — कामों को S, M, L आकार देना
definition: estimating work as small, medium, or large before anyone commits to numbers
example: T-shirt sizing says it's a large; the deadline says medium.

hindi: स्थगित करना — मुद्दे को बाद के लिए टाल देना
definition: to postpone discussion of a topic until later
example: We tabled the pricing debate for the third straight week.

hindi: न्यूनतम शर्त — मुक़ाबले में बने रहने की बुनियादी ज़रूरत
definition: the bare minimum features required to compete at all
example: Dark mode isn't a differentiator anymore; it's table stakes.

hindi: टैब बनाम स्पेस — इंडेंटेशन पर अंतहीन धर्मयुद्ध
definition: the eternal indentation holy war no team fully survives
example: The style guide settled tabs vs spaces; the comments disagree.

hindi: साथ बेचने का अधिकार — बड़े शेयरधारक बेचें तो छोटे भी उसी शर्त पर बेच सकें
definition: a term sheet clause letting minority shareholders join a sale when major shareholders sell their shares, on the same terms
example: Thanks to the tag-along, the early employees got to ride the founder's exit instead of watching it from the platform.

hindi: साथ-चलन अधिकार — बहुमत बेचे तो अल्पांश भी उसी शर्त पर बेच सके
definition: rights letting minority shareholders join a majority holder's share sale on identical terms and price
example: Tag-along rights ensured that when the founder sold, the angels could leave the party too.

hindi: झटपट तालमेल — प्रगति मिलाने की बहुत छोटी बैठक
definition: a brief meeting where team members quickly compare progress and coordinate next actions
example: The daily tag-up is fifteen minutes, give or take forty.

hindi: ध्येय वाक्य — ब्रांड की एक-पंक्ति पहचान
definition: the short memorable phrase that sits under the company logo
example: After six workshops, the tagline is 'Work, but better.'

hindi: छोर का जोखिम — बहुत कम संभावना वाला पर भारी नुकसान वाला खतरा
definition: the small chance of a rare, extreme event causing outsized losses beyond normal expectations
example: The tail risk of one engineer owning the billing system is small until that engineer takes leave.

hindi: बिखरा छोटा ख़र्च — अनेक छोटे विक्रेताओं पर होने वाला अप्रबंधित ख़र्च
definition: the many small, low-value purchases spread across numerous suppliers that procurement rarely manages or negotiates
example: Tail spend is ten percent of the budget and ninety percent of the vendor list.

hindi: पीछे-पीछे घुसना — किसी और के बैज से बिना जाँच दफ़्तर में प्रवेश
definition: following someone through a badge-controlled office door without swiping your own access card
example: Security posters warn against tailgating, yet nobody wants to be the person who shuts the door on a colleague holding coffee.

hindi: अनुकूल हवाएँ — कारोबार को आगे बढ़ाने वाली बाहरी परिस्थितियाँ
definition: external business conditions boosting revenue growth or margins, independent of management decisions and product performance
example: The tailwinds did the heavy lifting; the press release thanked the leadership team.

hindi: अलग से बात करना — मीटिंग के बाहर चर्चा टालना
definition: to move a discussion out of the meeting, sometimes never to resume
example: Great question — let's take it offline.

hindi: मोर्चा सँभालना — किसी काम में अगुआ बनना
definition: to be the lead person on a task
example: Priya's taking point on the audit; direct all panic to her.

hindi: कमीशन दर — हर लेन-देन से प्लेटफ़ॉर्म का रखा हिस्सा
definition: the percentage of each transaction a marketplace keeps
example: We raised the take rate and the sellers took notice.

hindi: घर पर करने का इंटरव्यू-असाइनमेंट
definition: a coding or design assignment candidates complete on their own time
example: The take-home said two hours; the honest estimate was a weekend.

hindi: निजीकरण सौदा — सूचीबद्ध कंपनी को खरीदकर बाज़ार से हटाना
definition: an acquisition buying all public shares of a listed company so it leaves the stock exchange
example: After the take-private, quarterly earnings calls were replaced by quarterly anxiety.

hindi: पेशकश वापस लेने की चाल — छूट या विकल्प हटाकर ख़रीदने की इच्छा जगाना
definition: a closing technique where the seller withdraws a discount or option so the buyer wants it more
example: His takeaway close removed the discount, and the prospect removed themselves from the thread.

hindi: माँग-लय समय — ग्राहक माँग पूरी करने के लिए प्रति इकाई उपलब्ध समय
definition: available production time divided by customer demand, setting the pace each workstation must match to deliver
example: Takt time is ninety seconds, and the printer warm-up alone takes two minutes.

hindi: प्रतिभा अधिग्रहण — कंपनी का भर्ती विभाग
definition: the corporate recruiting function responsible for sourcing, interviewing and hiring employees
example: Talent acquisition says the role is open; finance says the headcount is not.

hindi: प्रति कर्मचारी प्रतिभा का अनुपात — छोटी पर दमदार टीम का आदर्श
definition: the idea that fewer, stronger people beat many average ones
example: The memo praised talent density; the team read it as a warning.

hindi: प्रतिभा भंडार — भविष्य की भर्ती के लिए सहेजे उम्मीदवार
definition: the saved group of qualified candidates a company keeps warm for future openings
example: He has been in our talent pool for two years and has never once been told about an opening.

hindi: प्रतिभा समीक्षा — नेतृत्व द्वारा कर्मचारियों की क्षमता पर चर्चा
definition: a leadership meeting assessing employees' performance, potential and succession readiness, usually without them present
example: Somewhere in a talent review, a slide decided his next three years.

hindi: बोलने की तय पंक्तियाँ — सेल्स कॉल में इस्तेमाल होने वाली मानक बातें
definition: the approved wording and messaging sales reps repeat during calls, demos and objection handling for consistency
example: The new talk track was so polished that nobody could tell what the product actually did.

hindi: अपने सौदे की वकालत — अपनी निवेश स्थिति के हित में राय देना
definition: publicly promoting investments or positions you already hold, so the opinion quietly serves your personal financial interest
example: Of course the VC says the sector is undervalued; he's talking his book.

hindi: कुल संभावित बाज़ार — हर संभव ग्राहक मिलने पर कुल कमाई
definition: total addressable market; the full revenue opportunity if you captured every possible customer
example: Our TAM is huge if every human buys four subscriptions.

hindi: स्पर्श लक्ष्य — उंगली से दबाने लायक न्यूनतम जगह
definition: the touchable area of a control, ideally finger-sized
example: The tap targets are ant-sized, so users keep favoriting by accident.

hindi: लक्षित बोनस — पूर्ण प्रदर्शन पर मिलने वाला तय बोनस प्रतिशत
definition: the bonus percentage of base salary an employee earns when company and individual performance land exactly at plan
example: Target bonus is fifteen percent, which is the number you will hear once and never receive.

hindi: लक्षित संचालन मॉडल — भविष्य में संगठन कैसे काम करेगा, इसका खाका
definition: the designed future state of how an organisation will operate, covering structure, processes, technology, roles and governance
example: The target operating model had clean boxes and arrows, and none of them was the current team.

hindi: दलदल विचार — आसान दिखने वाला पर बार-बार विफल होने वाला स्टार्टअप विचार
definition: a startup idea that looks easy and appealing yet has repeatedly failed for structural reasons
example: A social app for planning dinners with friends is the tarpit idea every batch rediscovers.

hindi: पुष्टि बाकी — लगभग तय, मुहर बाकी
definition: to be confirmed — decided in spirit, unconfirmed on paper
example: Friday 3pm TBC, pending the one person who never confirms.

hindi: अभी तय नहीं — बाद में तय होगा
definition: to be determined — undecided, and staying that way for now
example: Venue TBD, which means nobody has booked one.

hindi: सच कहूँ तो — साफ़ बात की भूमिका
definition: to be honest — candor incoming, brace slightly
example: TBH the deck needs one more pass before the board sees it.

hindi: जलवायु-संबंधी वित्तीय जोखिम प्रकटीकरण ढाँचा — जलवायु जोखिमों की वित्तीय रिपोर्टिंग
definition: task force on climate-related financial disclosures; framework reporting climate risks across governance, strategy, metrics and targets
example: Our TCFD section models a four-degree world in exactly two optimistic paragraphs.

hindi: स्वामित्व की कुल लागत — खरीद के साथ चलाने, रखरखाव का पूरा खर्च
definition: total cost of ownership; the full lifetime cost of a purchase including licences, maintenance, support and staff
example: The cheaper vendor had a higher TCO once we counted the three people needed to babysit it.

hindi: कुल अनुबंध मूल्य — पूरी अवधि की अनुबंध-राशि
definition: total contract value — the full worth of a contract across its entire term
example: Sales quotes TCV, finance quotes ACV, and everyone quotes whichever is bigger.

hindi: दल कक्ष — ग्राहक दफ़्तर में सलाहकार दल को दिया गया कमरा
definition: room at the client site assigned to the consulting team for their daily project work
example: The team room had one socket, six laptops and a strict seniority order.

hindi: संक्षिप्त परिचय पत्र — बिक्री हेतु कंपनी का गुमनाम एक-पन्ने का विवरण
definition: a short anonymous summary sent to potential buyers to gauge interest before sharing confidential details
example: The teaser called the target 'a leading regional player', which narrowed it to one company.

hindi: तकनीकी जाँच — प्रस्तुति से पहले ऑडियो, वीडियो और स्क्रीन-शेयर का परीक्षण
definition: short rehearsal before a webinar or important video call to test audio, video and screen sharing
example: The tech check went perfectly, which is why the live presentation opened with twelve seconds of silence.

hindi: तकनीकी कर्ज़ — जल्दबाज़ी के शॉर्टकट जो बाद में महँगे पड़ते हैं
definition: the future cost of quick-and-dirty code choices made to ship faster today
example: We'll pay down the tech debt next quarter, said every quarter.

hindi: टीम की तकनीकी दिशा तय करने वाला इंजीनियर — बिना प्रबंधकीय अधिकार
definition: the engineer setting a team's technical direction, usually without people authority
example: As tech lead, she owns the architecture and none of the raises.

hindi: तकनीकी रडार — कंपनी में किन तकनीकों को अपनाना, आज़माना या छोड़ना है, इसकी सूची
definition: a published guide rating which technologies a company should adopt, trial, assess or phase out
example: The tech radar says 'hold' on the framework our entire product is built on.

hindi: तकनीक-आधारित ग्राहक सेवा — स्वचालित ईमेल और इन-ऐप संदेशों से सेवा
definition: customer success delivered through automated emails, in-product messages and webinars instead of personal account management, used for smaller accounts
example: Tech touch means the customer's success manager is a drip campaign named Kelly.

hindi: तकनीकी सह-संस्थापक — उत्पाद बनाने वाला, कोड लिखने वाला साझेदार
definition: a startup co-founder who builds the product and leads engineering, the partner non-technical founders search hardest for
example: He had the vision, the deck and the domain name; all he needed was a technical co-founder to do everything else.

hindi: तकनीकी मंज़ूरी — ग्राहक की तकनीकी टीम द्वारा उत्पाद को उपयुक्त घोषित करना
definition: the milestone in an enterprise sale when the buyer's technical evaluators confirm the product meets their requirements, leaving only commercial negotiation
example: We secured the technical win in March and have been losing the commercial one ever since.

hindi: तकनीकी-व्यावसायिक — प्रस्ताव के तकनीकी और मूल्य दोनों पहलुओं से जुड़ा
definition: used in Indian English for evaluation, discussion or proposals covering both technical suitability and commercial pricing terms together
example: The techno-commercial meeting was two hours of technical talk and five minutes of the only question anyone cared about.

hindi: भूमिका बाँधना — किसी काम या चर्चा को शुरू करने लायक़ तैयार करना
definition: to prepare something so it is ready to begin
example: I'll tee up the discussion with a short memo.

hindi: टेलीमेट्री — उत्पाद से अपने आप वापस भेजा गया उपयोग-डेटा
definition: usage data automatically sent back from the product
example: Telemetry says nobody uses the feature; the author disputes the telemetry.

hindi: तापमान — मॉडल के उत्तरों में यादृच्छिकता तय करने वाली सेटिंग
definition: a setting controlling how random or predictable a model's output is
example: Turn the temperature down; motivational quotes shouldn't rhyme with 'quadriceps'.

hindi: मन टटोलना — राय की त्वरित थाह
definition: a quick poll of how people feel about something
example: Temperature check on the new deadline: thumbs up or down?

hindi: निविदा प्रस्ताव — कंपनी या निवेशक द्वारा कर्मचारियों के शेयर खरीदने का सामूहिक प्रस्ताव
definition: an organised offer letting employees sell vested shares to the company or outside investors before any exit
example: The tender offer let us sell ten percent, which is exactly enough to feel poorer about the other ninety.

hindi: निवेश शर्तों का प्रारंभिक दस्तावेज़ — सौदे की मुख्य शर्तें
definition: a non-binding summary of the key terms of an investment deal
example: We got the term sheet Friday and stopped sleeping Saturday.

hindi: वह स्तर जिसके आगे पदोन्नति अनिवार्य नहीं
definition: the level where you may stay indefinitely without being pushed to advance
example: Senior is the terminal level; past that, promotion is optional ambition.

hindi: कारणसहित बर्ख़ास्तगी — दुराचार या गंभीर उल्लंघन पर निकालना
definition: firing for misconduct or serious policy violation, which typically forfeits severance and unvested equity
example: Expensing the yacht turned a quiet exit into termination for cause.

hindi: सुविधा हेतु समाप्ति — बिना कारण बताए अनुबंध तोड़ने का अधिकार
definition: a clause letting a party terminate the contract without any breach or stated reason, usually after giving written notice
example: The enterprise customer insisted on termination for convenience, which made our three-year revenue forecast a three-month one.

hindi: सेवा शर्तें — उत्पाद इस्तेमाल के नियमों का दस्तावेज़
definition: the legal rules users accept to use a product
example: Nobody reads the terms of service, including, occasionally, us.

hindi: बिक्री क्षेत्र — विक्रेता को सौंपा इलाक़ा या उद्योग
definition: the region, industry, or account list a salesperson is assigned to work
example: His territory is 'EMEA plus whatever nobody else wanted.'

hindi: उत्पादन में ही परीक्षण — असली उपयोगकर्ता ही अनजाने टेस्टर
definition: skipping proper testing and letting real users find the bugs
example: Everyone has a test environment; some teams also have production.

hindi: ग्राहक प्रशंसा-कथन — संतुष्ट ग्राहक की टिप्पणी
definition: a customer quote praising the product, used in marketing
example: The testimonial is glowing because we wrote it and they approved it.

hindi: पाठ-से-वाक् — लिखे शब्दों से स्वाभाविक आवाज़ बनाना
definition: generating natural-sounding spoken audio from written text
example: Text-to-speech gives the coach a voice; marketing spent a month choosing its vibe.

hindi: धन्यवाद और शुभकामनाएँ — भारतीय दफ़्तरी ईमेल का मानक समापन
definition: standard Indian English email sign-off placed before the sender's name and signature block
example: Even his two-word replies ended with thanks and regards.

hindi: परिवर्तन का सिद्धांत — गतिविधियों से अंतिम सामाजिक प्रभाव तक पहुँचने की कारण-श्रृंखला
definition: a mapped causal chain showing how programme activities are expected to produce outcomes and long-term social impact, with every assumption stated
example: Our theory of change had six arrows, and the donor wanted evidence for every single one.

hindi: नियंत्रणवादी प्रबंधन सोच — यह मान्यता कि कर्मचारी आलसी हैं और निगरानी से ही काम करते हैं
definition: management assumption that employees dislike work and need close supervision, control and incentives to perform
example: The mandatory screen tracking suggests someone upstairs is running on Theory X.

hindi: भरोसे पर टिका प्रबंधन सिद्धांत — यह मान्यता कि कर्मचारी स्वभाव से प्रेरित और ज़िम्मेदार होते हैं
definition: the management assumption that employees are self-motivated, enjoy meaningful work and perform best given trust and responsibility
example: The handbook preaches Theory Y; the badge reader logs Theory X.

hindi: लीक से हटकर सोचना — घिसे-पिटे ढर्रे छोड़कर सोचना
definition: to think unconventionally; the most conventional request in business
example: The brief just says: think outside the box, but cheaper.

hindi: बोलकर सोचना — परीक्षण में उपयोगकर्ता अपनी सोच ज़ोर से बताता है
definition: a usability method where participants narrate their thoughts aloud while attempting tasks with a product
example: During the think-aloud, the participant said 'where is it' eleven times and 'oh' once.

hindi: बाहरी डेटा — दूसरी कंपनियों से ख़रीदा या लिया गया ग्राहक डेटा
definition: customer information bought from outside data brokers or collected by other companies, rather than gathered directly by your own business
example: The third-party data insists our buyers are retired yacht owners, which explains the conversion rate.

hindi: विचार अग्रणी — जिसकी राय उद्योग में मानी जाती है
definition: someone whose opinions carry industry weight, sometimes self-declared
example: He became a thought leader by posting daily about leadership.

hindi: आपकी राय? — बिना संदर्भ के राय माँगना
definition: one-word email or chat request for opinions on something forwarded, usually with no context
example: He forwarded a ninety-slide deck with the single word 'thoughts?'.

hindi: जुड़ी बातचीत की कड़ी — एक विषय के जवाब एक जगह
definition: a chain of replies on one topic, kept out of the main channel
example: Answer in the thread so the channel stays readable.

hindi: तीन क्षितिज — आज, कल और परसों के कारोबार में निवेश संतुलन
definition: a growth framework balancing investment across today's core business, emerging opportunities and long-term speculative bets
example: In the three horizons model, horizon three is where ideas go to receive a slide and no budget.

hindi: तीन-तरफ़ा मिलान — भुगतान से पहले आदेश, माल-प्राप्ति और बिल का आपस में मिलान
definition: accounts payable check that the purchase order, goods receipt and supplier invoice agree before payment is released
example: The three-way match failed because the invoice said twelve and the warehouse counted eleven.

hindi: थ्रूपुट — प्रति अवधि पूर्ण कार्यों की संख्या
definition: how many items a team finishes per unit of time
example: Throughput doubled once we stopped starting things.

hindi: दीवार पार फेंकना — काम अगली टीम पर डालकर पल्ला झाड़ना
definition: handing work to the next team with zero context and zero responsibility
example: Dev threw it over the wall; ops threw it back with interest.

hindi: बलि चढ़ाना — ख़ुद बचने के लिए साथी पर दोष डालना
definition: to blame a colleague publicly to protect yourself
example: He threw the vendor under the bus in the client call.

hindi: अंगूठे की पहुँच — फ़ोन स्क्रीन का आसानी से छूने वाला हिस्सा
definition: the area of a phone screen reachable comfortably with one thumb, where key actions should live
example: The checkout button sat outside the thumb zone, reachable only by users with unusually ambitious thumbs.

hindi: अग्रिम धन्यवाद — काम से पहले आभार
definition: thanks in advance — gratitude paid before the work is done
example: Could someone rerun the numbers before noon? TIA.

hindi: टिकट — ट्रैकर में दर्ज एक कार्य-इकाई
definition: a single tracked unit of work in whatever tool the team uses
example: If it's not a ticket, it didn't happen.

hindi: टिकट टालना — ग्राहक को स्वयं-सेवा से हल देकर टिकट बनने से रोकना
definition: preventing support tickets by steering customers toward help articles, chatbots or community answers before they reach a human agent
example: Ticket deflection hit a record high the week the contact form disappeared behind four menus.

hindi: मिलान करना — हर आँकड़े को मूल स्रोत से जाँचकर पक्का करना
definition: to verify that a figure in a report matches its source ledger or schedule exactly, down to the last rupee
example: The deck goes to the board once someone ties out every number, including the one in the footnote.

hindi: प्रथम-स्तर सहायता — आम समस्याएँ सुलझाने वाली अग्रिम टीम
definition: first human support layer that handles common customer questions, password resets and known problems using scripts before escalating anything harder
example: Tier 1 support asked whether I had tried restarting it, which, to be fair, worked.

hindi: द्वितीय-स्तर सहायता — गहरी तकनीकी जाँच करने वाली टीम
definition: second support layer with deeper product knowledge that investigates customer problems escalated from first-line support agents
example: Tier 2 support read the ticket history, which already put them ahead of everyone else.

hindi: तृतीय-स्तर सहायता — इंजीनियरों तक पहुँची अंतिम सहायता
definition: final support layer, usually engineers or product specialists, handling escalated customer problems that need code changes or deep system access
example: By the time it reached tier 3 support, the customer had written their own root cause analysis.

hindi: विशेष दस्ता — एक अहम समस्या के लिए चुनी गई छोटी टीम
definition: a small hand-picked group assembled to attack one urgent problem
example: A tiger team formed at midnight to fix checkout.

hindi: आज मैंने सीखा — नई जानकारी साझा करना
definition: today I learned; chat opener for sharing a newly discovered fact, tool or shortcut
example: TIL we have had a staging environment all along.

hindi: समय आरक्षण — कैलेंडर में काम के लिए खंड पहले से बुक करना
definition: reserving blocks of calendar time for focused work before meetings claim those hours
example: My time blocking held for two days, then someone booked over it with a 'quick sync'.

hindi: स्तर पर बिताया समय — एक ही स्तर पर रहने की अवधि
definition: the duration someone has spent at their current career level, often an informal promotion requirement
example: The rubric says time in level doesn't matter, and the committee checks it first anyway.

hindi: पद भरने का समय — पद खुलने से प्रस्ताव स्वीकृति तक के दिन
definition: a recruiting metric counting days from requisition approval until a candidate accepts the offer
example: Time to fill looked great once we stopped counting the reqs nobody worked on.

hindi: भर्ती का समय — उम्मीदवार के आवेदन से स्वीकृति तक के दिन
definition: a recruiting metric counting days from a candidate entering the pipeline until accepting the offer
example: Our time to hire is forty days, thirty-one of which are scheduling.

hindi: समाधान का समय — टिकट खुलने से पूरी तरह सुलझने तक
definition: support metric measuring elapsed time between a customer opening a ticket and the problem being fully resolved and closed
example: Time to resolution improved dramatically once we started closing tickets the customer stopped replying to.

hindi: मूल्य मिलने तक का समय — साइनअप से पहले फायदे तक की देरी
definition: how long a new user takes to get real benefit
example: Our time-to-value is twenty minutes, nineteen of them onboarding.

hindi: समय-सीमा बाँधना — कार्य को निश्चित अवधि में सीमित करना
definition: to cap an activity at a fixed duration and stop when time expires
example: Let's timebox this debate to ten minutes and regret it later.

hindi: समय-पत्रक चूककर्ता — समय पर काम के घंटे दर्ज न करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: in Indian English, an employee who missed filling weekly hours in the timesheet system, publicly listed in reminder emails
example: Being named a timesheet defaulter is the fastest way to make the all-hands mailing list.

hindi: समय-क्षेत्र मेल — साझा कार्य-घंटे
definition: the shared hours when distributed teammates are all working
example: Our timezone overlap is ninety minutes, so we guard it.

hindi: सिर्फ़ देखने वाला — जो दिलचस्पी दिखाए पर ख़रीदने का इरादा न रखे
definition: a prospect who requests demos, pricing and trials with no real budget or intention of purchasing
example: He booked six demos, downloaded every white paper, and turned out to be a tire kicker writing a blog post.

hindi: पदनाम उन्नयन — पद का नाम ऊँचा होना
definition: a promotion in title, sometimes granted to retain someone when salary increases are frozen
example: Budgets were frozen, so everyone received a title bump and a heartfelt thank-you.

hindi: पद-नाम बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर देना — वेतन की जगह भारी टाइटल
definition: handing out impressive titles instead of pay or actual scope
example: Title inflation made him a VP of a team of one.

hindi: टीम प्रमुख — छोटी टीम का नेतृत्व करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: team lead; Indian English shorthand for the person directly leading a small team, often the first reporting manager
example: Ask your TL, the manager said, and the TL said ask the manager.

hindi: बहुत लंबा, नहीं पढ़ा — ऊपर लिखा छोटा सार
definition: too long; didn't read — a one-line summary placed above the detail
example: TL;DR: launch moved to Tuesday, nothing else changed.

hindi: यात्रा प्रबंधन कंपनी — बाहरी एजेंसी जो कंपनी की सारी व्यावसायिक यात्रा संभालती है
definition: travel management company; the outside agency that books and tracks all corporate business travel under company policy
example: The TMC found a fare forty dollars cheaper than mine and charged a thirty-five dollar booking fee.

hindi: क्षणिक सूचना-पट्टी — किनारे उभरकर अपने आप ग़ायब होने वाला संदेश
definition: a brief notification that pops up and fades away on its own
example: The toast confirmed the save and vanished before anyone could read it.

hindi: आज ही — बिना देरी, इसी दिन
definition: an Indian English emphasis meaning the work must happen today, without any further delay
example: The client wants it today itself, the email says, sent at 6:55 p.m.

hindi: बाद में करूँगा का निशान — कोड में छोड़ा गया शाश्वत वादा
definition: a comment marking work promised for later, where later means never
example: The TODO from 2016 celebrated its tenth anniversary untouched.

hindi: यांत्रिक मशक्कत — बार-बार का हाथ से होने वाला थकाऊ परिचालन काम
definition: repetitive manual operational work that automation should have eaten by now
example: Two hours of daily toil; automating it stays on the someday list.

hindi: टोकन — पाठ की सबसे छोटी इकाई जिसे मॉडल पढ़ता-लिखता है
definition: the small chunk of text a model reads and writes, roughly part of a word
example: Every emoji in the coach's pep talk costs us tokens.

hindi: खपत की सीमा — किसी सुविधा पर मॉडल के इस्तेमाल की तय हद
definition: a spending limit on how many model tokens a team, feature or request may consume
example: Finance approved the feature on the condition that its token budget fit on a napkin.

hindi: मॉडल ख़र्च की रफ़्तार — हर दिन मॉडल पर उड़ता पैसा
definition: the rate at which a product spends money on model tokens, watched like cash burn
example: The demo went viral and so did our token burn.

hindi: लक्षित संचालन मॉडल — बदलाव के बाद संगठन कैसे काम करेगा उसका ढाँचा
definition: target operating model; blueprint of how an organization's people, processes and systems should work after transformation
example: The TOM had seventeen boxes and no box labelled 'who actually decides'.

hindi: सौदा-स्मारक — पूरे हुए सौदे की घोषणा या उसकी स्मृति-वस्तु
definition: a formal announcement of a completed deal listing the banks involved, or the acrylic trophy commemorating it
example: His desk held eleven tombstones and no photographs of his family.

hindi: शीर्ष का रवैया — नेतृत्व का आचरण जो पूरी कंपनी की नैतिक संस्कृति तय करता है
definition: the ethical climate that senior leadership sets through its own behaviour, shaping how seriously employees treat integrity and controls
example: The ethics training stressed tone at the top, shortly before the CEO expensed his birthday party.

hindi: लहजा — स्थिति के अनुसार ब्रांड-लेखन का भाव
definition: guidelines describing how a brand's writing should sound and how that tone shifts between contexts, such as apologies, launches or error messages
example: The tone of voice guide says 'warm and human', so the outage notice opened with a pun.

hindi: कुल आमदनी — ख़र्च घटाने से पहले की कमाई
definition: total revenue, before any costs are subtracted
example: The top line looks great if you ignore everything below it.

hindi: बिक्री-कीप का ऊपरी हिस्सा — पहली बार रुचि दिखाने वाले
definition: the earliest stage of buyer interest, where awareness is broad and intent is thin
example: The blog drives top of funnel; whether anyone buys is a later problem.

hindi: ज़ेहन में सबसे ऊपर — जो सबसे पहले याद आए
definition: the first thing someone thinks of
example: Keep security top of mind, at least until the audit passes.

hindi: ऊपर से तय बजट — नेतृत्व द्वारा लक्ष्य तय कर नीचे बाँटा गया बजट
definition: a budget where leadership sets the total target first and then divides it among departments
example: The top-down budget arrived as one number and a memo saying teams should find efficiencies.

hindi: उद्धरण के ऊपर जवाब लिखना — पुराना नीचे छोड़कर
definition: to reply above the quoted email instead of point by point
example: He top-posts, so scroll down to find what actually happened.

hindi: विषय समूह — एक मुख्य लेख के चारों ओर जुड़े सहायक लेख
definition: group of supporting articles on narrower subtopics, all linking to one comprehensive pillar page to build search ranking
example: We built a topic cluster around invoicing and accidentally ranked for a bakery.

hindi: प्रारंभिक मुख्य परिणाम — ट्रायल के पहले सारांश नतीजे
definition: the first headline results from a clinical trial, reporting whether primary endpoints were achieved before detailed analysis
example: The share price moved on the topline data before anyone finished reading past the word 'positive'.

hindi: आँकड़ों को मरोड़ना — मनचाहा नतीजा पाने तक डेटा को तोड़ते-मरोड़ते रहना
definition: to keep slicing, filtering and reanalysing numbers until they support the conclusion someone wanted from the start
example: Torture the data long enough and it will confess to whatever the quarterly target needs.

hindi: कुल पारिश्रमिक — वेतन, बोनस और शेयर मिलाकर
definition: salary, bonus, and equity added together, the number that actually matters
example: Base looked modest until total comp included the equity refresh.

hindi: कुल पुरस्कार — वेतन, बोनस, इक्विटी और लाभ का पूरा पैकेज
definition: the full value employees receive, combining salary, bonuses, equity, benefits and perks, often presented as one statement
example: The total rewards statement valued the snack wall at forty thousand rupees a year.
