hindi: हाल-चाल लेना — काम के सिलसिले में छोटी-सी बातचीत
definition: to make brief contact to exchange updates
example: Just touching base on that invoice from March.

hindi: संपर्क बिंदु — ग्राहक या टीम से जुड़ने का हर मौक़ा
definition: any point of contact with a customer or team
example: The invoice email is a touchpoint, so stop making it ugly.

hindi: कठिन तुलना — पिछले साल के बहुत अच्छे आँकड़ों से मुक़ाबला
definition: strong prior-year results making current growth look weak when compared, cited to explain slower headline numbers
example: Every bad quarter faces tough comps, according to the same team that set them.

hindi: खुली सभा — नेतृत्व से सवाल-जवाब वाली कंपनी बैठक
definition: a company-wide meeting with leadership updates and open questions
example: Ask about the reorg at the town hall, not in chat.

hindi: ज़हरीली उत्पादकता — हर समय उत्पादक दिखने की अस्वस्थ मजबूरी
definition: an unhealthy compulsion to stay productive constantly, feeling guilty about rest, breaks or time away from work
example: His toxic productivity peaked when he color-coded the vacation itinerary as a Gantt chart.

hindi: तृतीय-पक्ष जोखिम प्रबंधन — विक्रेताओं से आने वाले सुरक्षा व अनुपालन जोखिम की जाँच
definition: third-party risk management; the function that assesses vendors for security, compliance, financial and operational risk before and after purchase
example: TPRM flagged the vendor as high risk because it wanted access to a spreadsheet.

hindi: अदृश्य निगरानी कोड — वेबसाइट पर छिपा कोड जो आगंतुकों की हरकतें विज्ञापन मंच को भेजता है
definition: tiny invisible code snippet on websites reporting visitor actions back to advertising platforms for measurement and targeting
example: The tracking pixel broke during the redesign, and for two weeks our advertisements were apparently perfect.

hindi: पकड़ — बाज़ार में मिलती स्वीकृति और रफ़्तार
definition: early evidence that customers actually want the thing
example: The side project got more traction than the main product.

hindi: ट्रेडमार्क — ब्रांड नाम या चिह्न का क़ानूनी संरक्षण
definition: legal protection for a brand name, logo, or slogan
example: Rename the feature; that word is someone's trademark.

hindi: शेयर लेन-देन अवधि — वह समय जब अंदरूनी कर्मचारी कंपनी के शेयर ख़रीद-बेच सकते हैं
definition: the period when insiders are permitted to trade company shares, closed around earnings to prevent insider trading
example: The trading window reopened on Thursday, and the parking lot filled with suspiciously new cars by Friday.

hindi: नीचे जुड़े पुराने ईमेल — पूरी मेल-शृंखला
definition: the quoted chain of earlier emails below; Indian English staple
example: Context is in the trail mail, all sixty screens of it.

hindi: प्रशिक्षण डेटा — वे उदाहरण जिनसे मॉडल सीखता है
definition: the examples a model learns from; its quality decides the model's quality
example: The model judges everyone's squat depth harshly; check the training data's gym.

hindi: किस्त या भाग — बड़े ऋण या सौदे का अलग शर्तों वाला हिस्सा
definition: a separate slice of a loan, bond deal or funding round with its own terms and seniority
example: The second tranche was released on hitting milestones, so the milestones were suddenly everyone's favourite topic.

hindi: परिवर्तनकारी नेतृत्व — प्रेरक दृष्टि से टीम को अपेक्षा से आगे ले जाना
definition: a leadership style that motivates teams through an inspiring vision, personal example and intellectual challenge rather than rewards alone
example: The offsite promised transformational leadership and delivered a keynote about sourdough.

hindi: बाहर की ओर संक्रमण — नरम शब्दों में विदाई
definition: remove someone from their role or the company gradually, usually after handing over their work
example: We'll transition him out after he finishes documenting everything he does.

hindi: यात्रा सहायता विभाग — कर्मचारियों के टिकट और होटल बुक करने वाली आंतरिक टीम
definition: the internal company team or service that books flights, hotels and cabs for employees travelling on business
example: The travel desk booked me into the right hotel in the wrong city with the same name.

hindi: श्रेणी-वृक्ष परीक्षण — मेनू ढांचे में चीज़ें मिलती हैं या नहीं जाँचना
definition: testing whether users can find things in your menu structure alone
example: Tree testing confirmed 'Preferences' and 'Settings' are a coin flip.

hindi: छाँटना — गंभीरता के आधार पर प्राथमिकता तय करना
definition: to sort incoming bugs or requests by urgency so the worst gets attention first
example: We triage bugs on Mondays; by Wednesday they've healed or multiplied.

hindi: परखने वाला सवाल — खरीदने की तैयारी जाँचने के लिए पूछा गया प्रश्न
definition: a question a seller asks midway through a conversation to test whether the buyer is ready to commit to purchasing
example: His trial close, 'So shall we pencil in a start date?', came four minutes into the intro call.

hindi: अनकहा ज्ञान — दस्तावेज़ों में नहीं, लोगों के दिमाग़ में बसी जानकारी
definition: unwritten know-how that lives in employees' heads
example: The deploy process is tribal knowledge and one shell script.

hindi: छँटाई करना — फ़ालतू ख़र्च या काम हटाना
definition: to cut whatever is deemed excess, from budgets to teams
example: Finance wants to trim the fat; everyone hides their snacks.

hindi: तिहरी कसौटी — लाभ के साथ लोग और पर्यावरण पर प्रदर्शन का हिसाब
definition: measuring company performance across profit, people and planet rather than financial results alone
example: We report on the triple bottom line, though only one of those lines appears in bonus calculations.

hindi: मोहभंग की घाटी — प्रचार के बाद निराशा का दौर
definition: the disappointed phase after inflated expectations, when pilots fail and budgets for the technology shrink
example: The chatbot project has entered the trough of disillusionment, also known as budget season.

hindi: दुख की घाटी — शुरुआती उत्साह के बाद लंबा, धीमा और निराशा भरा दौर
definition: the long discouraging period after a startup's launch hype fades, before real growth arrives
example: We're deep in the trough of sorrow; the launch tweet has more likes than we have users.

hindi: हिसाब मिलान — अनुमानित बनाम असल उपयोग का अंतर चुकता करना
definition: a periodic adjustment reconciling estimated versus actual usage or payment
example: The license true-up billed us for every laptop we forgot.

hindi: मुख्य शाखा पर विकास — सब डेवलपर छोटे बदलाव सीधे मुख्य शाखा में रोज़ मिलाते हैं
definition: a branching practice where every developer merges small changes into the main branch daily, avoiding long-lived branches
example: We adopted trunk-based development, so now the merge conflicts arrive in small, daily doses.

hindi: विश्वसनीय सलाहकार — ग्राहक का वह सलाहकार जिससे हर बड़ा फ़ैसला पूछा जाए
definition: consultant whose client relationship is deep enough that executives seek their counsel beyond any project
example: He became the CEO's trusted advisor, which mostly meant weekend phone calls.

term: turn it off and on again
hindi: बंद करके फिर चालू करो — तकनीकी सहायता का अमर पहला उपाय
definition: the immortal first remedy of all computing support
example: Our orchestration layer is just turning it off and on again, at scale.

hindi: ऋण गुणक — कर्ज़ EBITDA का कितने गुना है
definition: debt expressed as a multiple of EBITDA, the standard measure of how indebted a deal is
example: Six turns of leverage looked fine on the model and terrifying in the credit committee.

hindi: इस्तीफे की मानक सूचना — अमेरिकी दो-हफ़्ते की परंपरा
definition: the customary US resignation heads-up before departure
example: He gave two weeks' notice; his access lasted two hours.

hindi: दो-पिज़्ज़ा टीम — इतनी छोटी टीम कि दो पिज़्ज़ा में सबका पेट भर जाए
definition: a team small enough that two pizzas could feed everyone, kept small so ownership stays clear and communication stays fast
example: We're a two-pizza team, provided the pizzas are large and nobody from legal joins.

hindi: दोतरफ़ा दरवाज़ा — ऐसा फ़ैसला जिसे आसानी से पलटा जा सके, इसलिए जल्दी लिया जाए
definition: decision that is cheap and easy to reverse, which should be made quickly by small groups without heavy review
example: It's a two-way door, she said, closing the meeting before anyone could walk through it.

hindi: टाइपिंग के तीन बिंदु — जवाब लिखे जाने का संकेत
definition: the three dots showing someone is composing, or deleting, a reply
example: The typing indicator flickered for five minutes; the reply was 'ok'.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता स्वीकृति परीक्षण — ग्राहक द्वारा अंतिम जाँच
definition: user acceptance testing; the stage where real users confirm it actually works
example: It sailed through QA and sank in UAT.

hindi: X का उबर — किसी सफल मॉडल को नए बाज़ार पर लगाने वाली पिच
definition: a pitch template describing a startup as an existing successful business model applied to another market
example: Every pitch that morning was Uber for X, including one that was Uber for Uber drivers.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता-निर्मित सामग्री — ग्राहकों द्वारा बनाई गई ब्रांड-सामग्री
definition: user-generated content; photos, videos, reviews and posts created by customers rather than the brand, often reused in marketing with permission
example: The UGC campaign invited photos of happy customers and mostly received photos of broken parcels.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता इंटरफ़ेस — स्क्रीन पर दिखने-छूने वाली परत
definition: user interface; everything on screen the user sees and touches
example: The UI is clean because we moved the mess into settings.

hindi: बिना-संकेत पहचान — श्रेणी सुनते ही ब्रांड का नाम स्वयं लेना
definition: the share of surveyed people who name a brand spontaneously when asked about a product category, without seeing any list or prompt
example: Unaided awareness remains two percent, and one of those respondents was the founder's mother.

hindi: बाधा हटाना — रुके काम को आगे बढ़ने देना
definition: to remove whatever is preventing someone's work from proceeding
example: Can you unblock me before standup so I have something to say?

hindi: अल्प-अनुकूलन — इतना सरल मॉडल कि पैटर्न ही न पकड़ पाए
definition: a model too simple to capture the pattern, wrong on old and new data alike
example: It calls every exercise 'movement detected' — underfitting with confidence.

hindi: कम स्तर पर रखा गया — क्षमता से नीचे के स्तर पर नियुक्त
definition: hired or placed at a career level below what their skills and responsibilities warrant
example: She was underleveled at hiring and spent two years doing senior work at junior salary.

hindi: कम वादा करना — उम्मीदें जानबूझकर नीची रखना
definition: to set expectations deliberately low so results look better
example: He underpromises so hard his estimates need therapy.

hindi: बाज़ार-भाव से महँगे हो चुके स्टॉक विकल्प — फिलहाल बेकार
definition: options whose strike price exceeds the current share value, making them worthless
example: The options went underwater, and so did morale.

hindi: अलिखित फ़ीचर — बग का शिष्ट, आधिकारिक-सा नाम
definition: a bug wearing the polite official name of a feature
example: The crash on double-click is an undocumented feature, per marketing.

hindi: एक अरब डॉलर से अधिक मूल्य वाला निजी स्टार्टअप
definition: a private startup valued at one billion dollars or more
example: The founder says unicorn status changed nothing, from his new corner office.

hindi: इकाई अर्थशास्त्र — प्रति ग्राहक कमाई और लागत का हिसाब
definition: profit and cost calculated per customer or unit sold
example: The unit economics work at scale; the scale is theoretical.

hindi: एकल-स्तरीय ऋण — वरिष्ठ और अधीनस्थ कर्ज़ को मिलाकर एक सुविधा
definition: a single loan blending senior and subordinated debt into one facility with one blended interest rate
example: The unitranche lender promised simplicity and delivered a ninety-page intercreditor agreement anyway.

hindi: असीमित छुट्टी की नीति — जो अक्सर कम छुट्टी में बदलती है
definition: no fixed vacation allowance, which quietly means no payout and peer-pressured minimums
example: Unlimited PTO, and somehow everyone takes less than the old fifteen days.

hindi: अपूरित चिकित्सा आवश्यकता — जिस बीमारी का अभी तक अच्छा इलाज नहीं
definition: a medical condition for which existing treatments are absent or inadequate, used to justify investment, pricing and priority review
example: The unmet need was substantial right up until three competitors filed in the same quarter.

hindi: बिना संचालक का परीक्षण — उपयोगकर्ता अकेले रिकॉर्ड होकर काम करते हैं
definition: a usability test participants complete alone, recorded remotely, with no researcher present to guide them
example: The unmoderated test returned forty videos, six of which featured a cat walking across the keyboard.

hindi: खोलकर समझाना — बात की परतें अलग-अलग करना
definition: to break a statement down and examine it in detail
example: There's a lot to unpack in that one-line resignation.

hindi: मुक्त निधि — संस्था जहाँ ज़रूरी समझे वहाँ खर्च कर सकने वाला दान
definition: donated money a nonprofit may spend wherever it is needed most, including salaries, rent and other operating costs
example: The finance director greeted the unrestricted funds cheque with the reverence of a religious relic.

hindi: अनियुक्त — जिसे अभी किसी ग्राहक परियोजना पर नहीं लगाया गया
definition: describes a consultant not currently assigned to any client project, awaiting the next staffing decision
example: Being unstaffed in December felt restful until someone mentioned utilization.

hindi: ऊपर और दाहिनी ओर — लगातार बढ़त दिखाता आदर्श ग्राफ
definition: the chart shape every investor update strives to show
example: Up and to the right, provided the y-axis starts at ninety.

hindi: बढ़े मूल्य का दौर — पिछले दौर से ऊँची वैल्यूएशन पर निवेश
definition: a funding round at a higher valuation than the previous one
example: An up round in this market deserves its own press release, apparently.

hindi: पूरी जानकारी में — काम की ताज़ा स्थिति से वाक़िफ़
definition: fully informed and ready to contribute
example: Bring the new manager up to speed before Thursday.

hindi: पदोन्नत हो या निकलो — तय समय में ऊपर न बढ़ने पर विदाई
definition: requiring promotion within a set time, or departure
example: The junior levels are up-or-out; the clock starts on day one.

hindi: अद्यतन करना — किसी रिकॉर्ड या जानकारी को नया करने की प्रक्रिया
definition: an Indian English noun for the act of updating records, documents, sheets or system data
example: The tracker needs updation, a task that has itself been on the tracker since June.

hindi: शुरुआती सहमति — बैठक से पहले समय, उद्देश्य और संभावित परिणाम तय कर लेना
definition: a sales technique of agreeing at the start of a meeting on time, purpose, agenda and acceptable outcomes, including an explicit rejection
example: The upfront contract allowed a clear no, which the prospect exercised in minute four.

hindi: सुधार-बढ़त — प्रयोग में नियंत्रण समूह के मुकाबले मिला फायदा
definition: the measured improvement a change produces over the control
example: A two percent uplift, rounded up in every retelling.

hindi: महँगा संस्करण बेचना — मौजूदा ग्राहक को बड़ा प्लान
definition: to sell an existing customer a bigger or pricier version of what they have
example: The support call somehow ended with an upsell to the enterprise tier.

hindi: कौशल-वृद्धि — मौजूदा काम में नई क्षमताएँ सिखाना
definition: training current employees in newer skills for their existing roles, lately centred on working alongside artificial intelligence
example: The upskilling program was a two-hour video, now counted as our entire workforce strategy.

hindi: ऊपर वाले — शीर्ष नेतृत्व, जहाँ से आदेश आते हैं
definition: senior leadership treated as a vague collective source of decisions, whether or not their offices are literally above
example: Don't ask me why the project died; it came from upstairs.

hindi: मूल स्रोत — वह मूल प्रोजेक्ट जिससे आपकी प्रति निकली है
definition: the original project your copy derives from, where fixes should be sent
example: Send the fix upstream, or maintain your fork forever.

hindi: अमेरिकी पाली — भारत से अमेरिकी ग्राहकों के समय के अनुसार देर रात तक काम
definition: in Indian English, working evening or night hours in India to overlap with American clients' business hours
example: After a month on US shift he eats breakfast at four in the afternoon and calls it lunch.

hindi: उपयोगिता परीक्षण — असली लोगों से उत्पाद चलवाकर अड़चनें देखना
definition: watching real people attempt tasks to find where they struggle
example: Five minutes into the usability test, nobody had found the search bar.

hindi: उपयोग अधिकार — ब्रांड क्रिएटर की सामग्री कहाँ, कितने समय इस्तेमाल करे
definition: contract terms defining where, how long and in which channels a brand may reuse a creator's content
example: The brand wanted perpetual usage rights for the price of a sandwich.

hindi: उपयोग-आधारित मूल्य — जितना इस्तेमाल, उतना बिल
definition: software pricing charged by measured consumption, such as tokens, requests or tasks, rather than user licenses
example: Usage-based pricing is fair right up until the month finance opens the invoice.

hindi: उपयोग प्रसंग — उत्पाद से हल होने वाली ठोस परिस्थिति
definition: a specific situation in which a product gets used
example: Great feature — but what's the use case beyond the demo?

hindi: खर्च करो वरना गँवाओ — बचा बजट साल के अंत में वापस चला जाना
definition: the rule that unspent budget disappears at year-end, which pushes teams to spend whatever remains before the deadline
example: Use it or lose it explains why the team bought six standing desks in the last week of March.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता प्रवाह — एक काम के लिए स्क्रीन-दर-स्क्रीन रास्ता
definition: the screen-by-screen path a user takes through one task
example: The checkout user flow has a scenic detour through account creation.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता साक्षात्कार — ज़रूरतें समझने की आमने-सामने बातचीत
definition: a one-on-one conversation to understand a user's needs and habits
example: In the user interview she praised the feature she'd never once opened.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता यात्रा — लक्ष्य तक पहुँचने के सभी चरणों का नक्शा
definition: the full sequence of steps a user takes to reach a goal
example: The user journey has eleven steps and users quit at step three.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता शोध — असली उपयोगकर्ताओं की ज़रूरतें समझने का अध्ययन
definition: studying real users to learn their needs and behavior
example: We did user research after launch, which explains a lot.

hindi: यूज़र स्टोरी — उपयोगकर्ता की ज़रूरत के रूप में लिखा कार्य
definition: a requirement written from the user's perspective, typically 'as a user, I want...'
example: As a user, I want this user story to fit in one sprint.

hindi: उपयोग दर — कुल समय में ग्राहक-शुल्क वाले काम का प्रतिशत
definition: share of a consultant's working hours charged to client projects, tracked weekly as a performance measure
example: Her utilization rate hit 110 percent, which says more about the timesheet than the week.

hindi: उपयोग में लाना — 'use' का लंबा, दफ़्तरी रूप
definition: to use, but with three extra letters of professionalism
example: Please utilize the new template going forward.

hindi: ट्रैकिंग टैग — लिंक में जोड़े गए स्रोत-पहचान मानक
definition: urchin tracking module; tags appended to a link that record campaign, source and medium, so analytics can attribute visits to marketing activity
example: Half the traffic shows as 'direct' because someone pasted the link without UTMs again.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता अनुभव — उत्पाद इस्तेमाल का शुरू से अंत तक एहसास
definition: user experience; how using the product actually feels end to end
example: New coat of UI, same old UX underneath.

hindi: अनुभव जाँच — मौजूदा उत्पाद की उपयोगिता समस्याओं की सूची
definition: a structured review of an existing product against usability heuristics and standards to list problems
example: The UX audit ran to sixty pages, and the first recommendation was to read the previous audit.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता अनुभव शोध — लोग उत्पाद कैसे बरतते हैं इसका अध्ययन
definition: user experience research; the discipline and team studying how people actually behave when using a product
example: UXR flagged the problem in March; the post-mortem rediscovered it in September.

hindi: पहला संस्करण — शुरुआती, सीमित पर जारी करने लायक रूप
definition: the first shipped version, deliberately imperfect
example: v1 ships Friday; v2 is where the dreams live.

hindi: छुट्टी पर ताने — छुट्टी लेने वालों को टीम या बॉस द्वारा शर्मिंदा करना
definition: colleagues or managers making employees feel guilty or judged for taking their earned leave
example: The vacation shaming was subtle: 'Must be nice,' said three times in one standup.

hindi: मौत की घाटी — फ़ंडिंग और पर्याप्त आय के बीच का ख़तरनाक दौर
definition: the dangerous startup period between initial funding running out and revenue becoming sufficient to survive
example: Every founder's spreadsheet has a valley of death; ours had a canyon.

hindi: कंपनी का आँका गया मूल्य — निवेश के समय तय क़ीमत
definition: the negotiated worth of a company, often more art than math
example: Our valuation doubled; our revenue, less so.

hindi: अधिकतम मूल्य सीमा — जिस पर नोट या SAFE शेयरों में बदलता है
definition: the maximum valuation at which a convertible investment turns into equity
example: The angel wanted a lower valuation cap; we wanted his money anyway.

hindi: दाँव पर मूल्य — किसी फ़ैसले से जुड़ा संभावित लाभ या नुकसान
definition: the estimated revenue, profit or cost savings that depend on a decision or initiative, used to rank priorities
example: The value at stake justified the project, and the project fees quietly reduced the value at stake.

hindi: मूल्य श्रृंखला — कच्चे माल से ग्राहक तक मूल्य जुड़ने की कड़ियाँ
definition: the sequence of business activities, from sourcing to service, through which a company adds value and incurs cost
example: After mapping the value chain, the team found that most of the value was being added by one spreadsheet.

hindi: मूल्य-चालक वृक्ष — लाभ को उसके कारक आँकड़ों में तोड़ना
definition: a diagram decomposing a financial outcome such as profit into the operational metrics that drive it, branch by branch
example: The value driver tree traced margin loss to freight costs, which procurement had renamed 'logistics synergies'.

hindi: मूल्य प्रस्ताव — ग्राहक को क्या फ़ायदा मिलेगा
definition: the core promise of what a customer gets and why it beats alternatives
example: If the value proposition needs three slides, it isn't one.

hindi: मूल्य-आधारित बिक्री — फ़ीचर नहीं, ग्राहक के मापने योग्य व्यावसायिक लाभ पर बात करना
definition: a sales approach that frames every conversation around the buyer's measurable business outcomes rather than product features or price
example: Value selling means the ROI calculator now has more tabs than the pricing sheet.

hindi: मूल्य-प्रवाह नक्शा — शुरू से अंत तक हर कदम और प्रतीक्षा का चित्र
definition: a diagram tracing every step, handoff and waiting period from order to delivery, used to spot waste
example: The value stream map showed eleven minutes of work and nine days of waiting.

hindi: अतिरिक्त लाभ — किसी काम से जुड़ी बढ़ी हुई उपयोगिता
definition: the extra benefit something contributes; often invoked when it is unclear
example: What's the value-add of a third weekly status meeting?

hindi: मूल्य-मेहनत तालिका — फ़ीचरों को मूल्य और मेहनत के दो खानों में बाँटकर प्राथमिकता
definition: a two-by-two grid plotting features by customer value against engineering effort to prioritize quick wins and avoid costly projects
example: Every sticky note on the value-effort matrix somehow landed in high value, low effort.

hindi: दिखावटी आँकड़ा — प्रभावशाली दिखता है पर असली प्रगति नहीं बताता
definition: a number that looks impressive but reflects no real progress
example: Cumulative signups only go up; that is why the chart exists.

hindi: परिवर्तनीय वेतन — प्रदर्शन पर निर्भर तनख्वाह का हिस्सा
definition: the portion of compensation tied to individual or company performance, paid as bonus rather than fixed salary
example: Variable pay turned out to be very variable, mostly in the downward direction.

hindi: अंतर विश्लेषण — बजट और वास्तविक आँकड़ों के अंतर का कारण खोजना
definition: comparing actual results against budget or forecast and explaining each meaningful difference to leadership
example: Variance analysis revealed the marketing overspend was, technically, 'brand investment'.

hindi: प्रकार — प्रयोग में कुछ उपयोगकर्ताओं को दिखाया बदला हुआ संस्करण
definition: a modified version shown to some users in an experiment
example: Variant B won by a hair, so naturally we shipped variant C.

hindi: उद्यम पूँजीपति — जोखिम भरे स्टार्टअप्स में फ़ंड लगाने वाला पेशेवर निवेशक
definition: venture capitalist; a professional investor of pooled funds into high-risk, high-growth startups
example: The VC said 'interesting' four times, which means no.

hindi: सदिश डेटाबेस — अर्थ की समानता से खोज करने वाला भंडार
definition: a database that stores embeddings and finds items by similarity of meaning
example: Every FAQ lives in the vector database; the bot finds answers by vibes, mathematically.

hindi: वेग — प्रति स्प्रिंट पूरे हुए पॉइंट का औसत
definition: the average number of story points a team completes per sprint
example: Our velocity doubled after we doubled our estimates.

hindi: विक्रेता कोड — कंपनी की प्रणाली में आपूर्तिकर्ता की पहचान संख्या, बिना इसके भुगतान नहीं
definition: the supplier identifier created in the finance system after registration, without which no purchase order or payment can be raised
example: The workshop is tomorrow, but the facilitator's vendor code is 'in process' until next quarter.

hindi: विक्रेता एकीकरण — कई आपूर्तिकर्ताओं को घटाकर कुछ चुने हुए पर ख़रीद केंद्रित करना
definition: reducing the number of suppliers an organisation uses, concentrating purchasing with fewer vendors for leverage and simplicity
example: Vendor consolidation cut five tools down to one, which now does all five badly.

hindi: विक्रेता बंधन — सेवा बदलना इतना महँगा कि निकल न पाना
definition: being stuck with a supplier because switching would cost too much
example: It's not vendor lock-in, we just can't ever leave.

hindi: विक्रेता पंजीकरण — नए आपूर्तिकर्ता के काग़ज़, जाँच और खाते की स्थापना
definition: registering a new supplier: collecting documents, running compliance checks, and setting them up for purchase orders and payment
example: Vendor onboarding needed their tax forms, bank letter, and apparently a blood sample.

hindi: विक्रेता अंक-पत्र — गुणवत्ता, समयबद्धता और लागत पर आपूर्तिकर्ता का नियमित मूल्यांकन
definition: a periodic rating of supplier performance on delivery, quality, responsiveness and cost against agreed measures
example: Every vendor scorecard was green, which is how we knew nobody had filled them in.

hindi: विक्रेताओं का फैलाव — अनियंत्रित रूप से बढ़ते आपूर्तिकर्ता और एक जैसे उपकरण
definition: the uncontrolled growth of suppliers and overlapping tools as teams independently purchase their own vendors
example: Vendor sprawl means we pay for four whiteboard apps and still draw on paper.

hindi: विक्रेता-निरपेक्ष — किसी एक आपूर्तिकर्ता पर निर्भर न रहने वाला, कोई भी विक्रेता चल सके
definition: designed or chosen so that any supplier could be used, without depending on one particular vendor
example: Our architecture is vendor-agnostic, except for the parts that only work with one vendor.

hindi: बाहरी कोड की प्रति रखना — बाहरी लाइब्रेरी की प्रति सीधे अपने भंडार में शामिल करना
definition: copying an external library's source code directly into your own repository instead of fetching it as a dependency
example: Vendoring the library froze it in 2019, along with its bugs.

hindi: उद्यम ऋण — हिस्सेदारी दिए बिना रनवे बढ़ाने वाला क़र्ज़
definition: loans for venture-backed startups, extending runway without giving up equity
example: We took venture debt to avoid dilution; now the bank emails weekly.

hindi: वेंचर-पोषित — VC पूँजी से चलने वाली, ऊँची उम्मीदों समेत
definition: funded by venture capital, with the growth expectations that come attached
example: Venture-backed means the growth targets arrive before the revenue does.

hindi: मौखिक हाँ — ग्राहक ने कहा हाँ, पर हस्ताक्षर अभी नहीं
definition: customer's spoken agreement to purchase, given before any contract or purchase order is signed
example: We have a verbal, which is worth exactly the paper it isn't written on.

hindi: मौखिक प्रस्ताव — लिखित पत्र से पहले फ़ोन पर दिया प्रस्ताव
definition: an offer extended by phone before the written letter, used to gauge acceptance
example: The verbal offer was generous; the written one had apparently been through legal and a diet.

hindi: ऊर्ध्व खंड — हर परत से होकर बनी छोटी संपूर्ण कार्यक्षमता
definition: a thin piece of functionality cut through every layer, shippable end to end
example: Demo a vertical slice first; nobody claps for a database schema.

hindi: समय के साथ शेयरों का आपका होते जाना
definition: earning your equity gradually over time, usually four years
example: He counts vesting dates the way children count down to birthdays.

hindi: वाइब कोडिंग — एआई से कोड लिखवाकर बिना पूरा पढ़े अपनाना
definition: building software by prompting AI and accepting code you haven't fully read
example: The prototype was vibe coding at its finest; production has questions.

hindi: दर्शन-आधारित रूपांतरण — विज्ञापन देखा पर क्लिक नहीं किया, फिर भी बाद में ख़रीदा
definition: conversion credited to an advertisement someone viewed but never clicked, before later buying through another route
example: Half our display results were view-through conversions from people who scrolled past at speed.

hindi: प्रसार गुणांक — हर उपयोगकर्ता औसतन कितने नए उपयोगकर्ता जोड़ता है
definition: average number of new users each existing user successfully brings in; above one means self-sustaining growth
example: Our viral coefficient crossed one for a single afternoon, when an intern invited his entire contact list.

hindi: वायरल चक्र — उपयोग करते-करते नए उपयोगकर्ता अपने आप जुड़ना
definition: a built-in cycle where using the product naturally invites new users in
example: The viral loop works: every invoice we send advertises us to the client.

hindi: वायरल क्षमता — मौजूदा उपयोगकर्ताओं के ज़रिए नए उपयोगकर्ता आना
definition: growth driven by existing users bringing in new ones
example: We budgeted for virality; virality did not confirm.

hindi: ऑनलाइन कॉफ़ी — सहकर्मियों से अनौपचारिक बातचीत के लिए छोटी वीडियो कॉल
definition: short informal video call between remote colleagues for casual social chat rather than work
example: Our virtual coffee lasted fifteen minutes, twelve of which were about whose internet was worse.

hindi: ऑनलाइन मेलजोल — काम के बाद सहकर्मियों की अनौपचारिक सामाजिक वीडियो कॉल
definition: after-work social video call where remote colleagues gather informally with drinks and casual chat
example: The virtual happy hour peaked when everyone raised a glass and the audio lagged by two seconds.

hindi: वर्चुअल-प्रथम — जहाँ ऑनलाइन काम डिफ़ॉल्ट है और दफ़्तर केवल मिलने के लिए
definition: describing a company where remote online work is the default and offices exist mainly for occasional gatherings
example: We went virtual-first and turned the old office into a place where people meet twice a quarter to fix the printer.

hindi: दृश्यता — काम का ऊपर तक दिखना; जानकारी की पहुँच
definition: awareness of work by leadership; also access to information
example: The project needs more visibility, meaning a louder status email.

hindi: दृश्य पदानुक्रम — आकार-रंग से नज़र को महत्त्व का क्रम दिखाना
definition: arranging size, color, and position so the eye reads importance correctly
example: When everything is bold, the visual hierarchy is a flat line.

hindi: मिलान सूत्र — स्प्रेडशीट में एक तालिका से मेल खोजकर दूसरी से मान खींचने वाला फ़ॉर्मूला
definition: the spreadsheet formula that finds a matching value in one table and pulls related data from another, beloved of finance teams
example: Her real seniority showed when she fixed the broken VLOOKUP without saying a word.

hindi: ग्राहक की आवाज़ — ग्राहकों की राय, शिकायतें और ज़रूरतें एक जगह
definition: voice of the customer; structured collection of customer feedback, complaints and needs used to guide product decisions
example: The VoC report had one clear theme: stop changing the navigation.

hindi: लहजा और स्वर — ब्रांड कैसे बोलता है इसके नियम
definition: guidelines describing how a product's written language should sound, and how that shifts by situation
example: Voice and tone said 'friendly but professional', so the error messages now apologise with exclamation marks.

hindi: स्वैच्छिक पलायन — कर्मचारियों का स्वयं इस्तीफ़ा देकर जाना
definition: employee departures by their own choice, resignations and retirements counted apart from dismissals
example: Voluntary attrition rose right after the return-to-office announcement, entirely by coincidence.

hindi: स्वैच्छिक अतिरिक्तता — ब्रिटिश उपयोग में पैकेज लेकर स्वयं छँटनी स्वीकारना
definition: in British usage, employees volunteering to leave with a payout when roles must be eliminated
example: Voluntary redundancy was oversubscribed within an hour, which told management something.

hindi: स्वैच्छिक पृथक्करण — पैकेज लेकर अपनी मर्ज़ी से नौकरी छोड़ना
definition: leaving the company by choice, typically accepting an offered payout package during cost cutting
example: The voluntary separation offer was voluntary the way a fire alarm is optional.

hindi: जबरन स्वयंसेवक बनाया गया — मना करने का विकल्प नहीं
definition: assigned to 'volunteer' for something with no real option to decline
example: He was voluntold to organize the hackathon he'd voted against.

hindi: निजी सुरक्षित नेटवर्क सुरंग — घर से दफ़्तर के सिस्टम तक सुरक्षित जुड़ाव
definition: virtual private network; secure connection employees start to reach internal company systems from outside the office
example: Every support call opens by asking whether you are on the VPN and closes by suggesting you reconnect to the VPN.

hindi: स्वैच्छिक सेवानिवृत्ति योजना — भुगतान लेकर समय से पहले नौकरी छोड़ने का प्रस्ताव
definition: voluntary retirement scheme; Indian English for an early exit offer with a payout, common in banks and public sector firms
example: Half the branch took VRS, and the other half inherited their files.

hindi: अस्थिरता, अनिश्चितता, जटिलता, अस्पष्टता — अस्थिर कारोबारी माहौल का वर्णन
definition: volatility, uncertainty, complexity, ambiguity; shorthand for an unpredictable business environment that resists long-range planning
example: In this VUCA world, leadership said, reading the same slide from 2019.

hindi: प्रतीक्षा सूची — प्रवेश के इच्छुक उपयोगकर्ताओं की कतार
definition: a signup queue that rations access and manufactures demand
example: The waitlist has ten thousand people and, rumor has it, eleven users.

hindi: जागृति शब्द — जिस शब्द से वॉइस असिस्टेंट सक्रिय होता है
definition: the trigger phrase a voice assistant listens for before it starts responding
example: We tested wake words for months; everything sounds like 'okay' in a loud gym.

hindi: बोर्ड की सैर — स्टैंडअप में हर कार्ड की क्रमवार समीक्षा
definition: running standup by reviewing each card on the board instead of each person
example: We walk the board right to left, oldest regrets first.

hindi: पीछे हटने की सीमा — वह शर्त जिसके बाद सौदा छोड़ देना तय है
definition: the worst price or terms a negotiator will accept before abandoning the negotiation entirely
example: Our walk-away point was firm until the quarter had four days left.

hindi: खुला भर्ती अभियान — बिना पूर्व समय लिए सीधे आकर साक्षात्कार
definition: in Indian English, a hiring event where candidates attend interviews without prior appointments
example: The walk-in drive started at nine; the queue started at seven.

hindi: गोपनीयता रेखा पार करना — किसी को गैर-सार्वजनिक सौदे की जानकारी देकर प्रतिबंधित करना
definition: bringing an investor or colleague inside confidential deal information, restricting them from trading on it
example: After the wall-crossing call the fund manager could not trade the stock and could not say why.

hindi: बंद बगीचा — ऐसा विज्ञापन मंच जो अपना डेटा बाहर साझा नहीं करता
definition: large advertising platform keeping user data inside its own ecosystem, reporting results you cannot independently verify
example: The walled garden graded its own homework and, remarkably, gave itself full marks again.

hindi: इच्छुक उद्यमी — जो उद्यमी बनने की बातें करता है पर कुछ शुरू नहीं करता
definition: someone who talks constantly about launching a startup but never actually builds or ships anything
example: The wantrepreneur has eleven domain names, four logos and zero customers.

hindi: वॉर रूम — संकट के दौरान सबका एक जगह डेरा
definition: a room, physical or virtual, where a team camps until a crisis ends
example: We're in the war room until the migration lands; snacks provided.

hindi: सजीव हस्तांतरण — ग्राहक को संदर्भ के साथ सहकर्मी को सौंपना
definition: transferring customers to another agent or team while personally introducing them and passing along context, so customers never repeat themselves
example: It was a warm handoff: the next agent already knew the customer was furious.

hindi: परिचित के ज़रिए परिचय — भरोसे के साथ संपर्क
definition: an introduction to a prospect made by someone they already know and trust
example: One warm intro from an investor beat two hundred cold emails.

hindi: कर्मचारी समायोजन एवं पुनःप्रशिक्षण सूचना कानून — बड़ी छँटनी से पहले अग्रिम सूचना की अमेरिकी अनिवार्यता
definition: worker adjustment and retraining notification act; American federal rule requiring sixty days warning before large layoffs or plant closures
example: Thanks to the WARN Act, they gave sixty days notice and asked everyone to stop coming in after one.

hindi: आश्वासन अस्वीकरण — उत्पाद की गुणवत्ता पर कोई गारंटी न देने की शर्त
definition: the capitalized contract language stating the product is provided without implied promises of quality, fitness or uninterrupted operation
example: The warranty disclaimer was written entirely in capital letters, which legally counts as shouting.

hindi: संकटकालीन मुख्य कार्यकारी — संकट में तेज़, कठोर फ़ैसले लेने वाला प्रमुख
definition: a chief executive who leads through existential crisis with rapid, decisive and often unpopular decisions
example: He declared himself a wartime CEO, which mostly meant cancelling the offsite.

hindi: सफ़ाया दौर — इतनी कम कीमत का राउंड कि पुराने शेयरधारक लगभग मिट जाएं
definition: a financing priced so cheaply that existing shareholders, including founders and earlier investors, are almost entirely wiped out
example: Officially it was a strategic reset; the cap table called it a washout round.

hindi: रिकॉर्डिंग बाद में देखूँगा — लाइव बैठक छोड़ने का विनम्र तरीका
definition: promise to catch up later on a recorded video meeting instead of attending live, often a polite way of skipping it
example: I'll watch the recording, she said, adding it to the folder of forty-two other recordings.

hindi: देखने का कुल समय — दर्शकों द्वारा वीडियो पर बिताए मिनट
definition: total minutes audiences spend viewing a creator's videos, a signal platforms weigh heavily when recommending content
example: To boost watch time, the three-minute tutorial now has a nine-minute intro.

hindi: गपशप चैनल — काम से अलग अनौपचारिक बातचीत के लिए टीम चैट चैनल
definition: team chat channel reserved for informal social conversation, pets and weekend photos rather than work
example: The watercooler channel has more engagement than every project channel combined, mostly because of one cat.

hindi: गपशप — सहकर्मियों की अनौपचारिक बतकही
definition: unplanned casual conversation between colleagues, in person or in a channel
example: Remote teams schedule watercooler chat, which slightly defeats the point.

hindi: जलप्रपात मॉडल — चरण-दर-चरण, बिना लौटे विकास पद्धति
definition: the sequential plan-then-build-then-test method agile was invented to escape
example: It's waterfall with standups, which we call transformation.

hindi: सीढ़ीनुमा चार्ट — शुरुआती से अंतिम आँकड़े तक हर योगदान दिखाने वाला चार्ट
definition: a chart showing how a starting figure moves to an ending figure through a series of positive and negative contributions
example: The waterfall chart made the profit decline look almost like a staircase to success.

hindi: तरबूज़ परियोजना — बाहर से हरी, भीतर से लाल
definition: a project reported green outside while everything inside is red
example: That program is a watermelon; slice anywhere and it's red.

hindi: साप्ताहिक सक्रिय उपयोगकर्ता — हफ्ते में उत्पाद चलाने वाले लोग
definition: weekly active users; unique people active within a week
example: We report WAU because DAU was too honest.

hindi: साप्ताहिक व्यावसायिक समीक्षा — हर हफ्ते आँकड़ों की समीक्षा बैठक
definition: weekly business review; a recurring leadership meeting inspecting metrics and anomalies every single week
example: The WBR spent twenty minutes on a dip that turned out to be a holiday.

hindi: वेब सुगम्यता दिशानिर्देश — पहुँच के अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानक नियम
definition: web content accessibility guidelines, the standard rules for accessible interfaces
example: Legal asked if we meet WCAG; the contrast checker laughed first.

hindi: आपका क्या विचार है — राय की माँग
definition: what do you think — an invitation to weigh in
example: Draft attached — WDYT before I send it wider?

hindi: हम एक परिवार हैं — वफ़ादारी और अतिरिक्त काम माँगने वाली भावनात्मक कॉर्पोरेट बात
definition: company rhetoric claiming family-like bonds, often used to request unpaid loyalty, extra hours and sacrifice from employees
example: 'We're a family,' said the CEO, three weeks before the family held a restructuring.

hindi: कई भूमिकाएँ निभाना — एक व्यक्ति, कई ज़िम्मेदारियाँ
definition: to handle several roles at once, common at small companies
example: Our designer wears many hats, including support and payroll.

hindi: पहनने-योग्य डेटा — घड़ी-बैंड से मिले सेहत और गति के संकेत
definition: health and movement signals from watches, bands, and rings feeding AI features
example: The model saw your wearable data and gently suggests sleeping before midnight once.

hindi: ऑनलाइन संगोष्ठी — लीड जुटाने वाला वेब-सेमिनार
definition: an online seminar used to educate prospects and harvest their email addresses
example: Three hundred registered for the webinar, forty attended, twelve were employees.

hindi: प्रवेश औज़ार — बड़े अवसर में घुसने वाला छोटा शुरुआती उत्पाद
definition: the narrow initial product that gets you into a bigger opportunity
example: The expense tracker is just the wedge; the bank is the plan.

hindi: सप्ताह-दर-सप्ताह — पिछले हफ्ते से तुलना करके
definition: compared with the same measure one week earlier
example: Week-over-week we grew two percent, which annualizes into a fantasy.

hindi: भारित पाइपलाइन — हर सौदे का मूल्य उसकी जीत की संभावना से गुणा
definition: open pipeline value multiplied by each deal stage probability, giving an expected revenue figure
example: The weighted pipeline says forty million; the VP's gut says eleven, and the gut has a better record.

hindi: कल्याण अवकाश — सबके लिए कंपनी की ओर से दिया गया अतिरिक्त छुट्टी का दिन
definition: an extra paid company-wide day off granted for rest and recovery, separate from regular leave
example: The wellness day was a lovely idea, apart from the deadline moved to the morning after.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य भत्ता — जिम, योग या स्वास्थ्य पर ख़र्च के लिए कंपनी का पैसा
definition: a fixed allowance an employer pays toward gyms, therapy, fitness or other personal wellbeing expenses
example: He spent the wellness stipend on a standing desk to work longer hours standing up.

hindi: दिखावटी कल्याण — असली समस्याएँ सुलझाए बिना कर्मचारी कल्याण का प्रचार
definition: promoting employee wellbeing through apps, yoga and slogans while ignoring workloads, staffing and pay that cause burnout
example: The meditation app launch was pure wellness washing; the headcount freeze stayed firmly in place.

hindi: हस्तलिखित हस्ताक्षर — कागज़ पर स्याही से किया गया असली दस्तख़त
definition: a handwritten signature in physical ink on paper, still demanded by some banks, governments and notaries despite electronic signing
example: The bank required a wet signature, so the CFO spent Friday hunting for a working printer.

hindi: घर से काम करना
definition: work from home; doing the job outside the office
example: WFH Fridays survived three RTO memos and counting.

hindi: मुझे मंज़ूर है — बिना बहस सहमति
definition: works for me — agreement without further commentary
example: Tuesday at 11? WFM.

hindi: दफ़्तर से काम — घर के बजाय कार्यालय में बैठकर काम करना
definition: work from office; Indian English shorthand for working onsite at the company office rather than remotely from home
example: Tuesday is WFO for the whole team, so the one meeting room will host six video calls at once.

hindi: विशाल ग्राहक — पूरा साल बना देने वाला सौदा
definition: an unusually large customer or deal that could make the whole year
example: Land the whale and the quarter is saved; miss and we discuss 'learnings.'

hindi: क्या-होगा-अगर विश्लेषण — अलग-अलग मान्यताओं पर नतीजे आज़माना
definition: exploring how business results would change under different assumptions or scenarios, usually by adjusting inputs inside a spreadsheet model
example: After an hour of what-if analysis, the only scenario left untested was the actual one.

hindi: महारत का क्षेत्र — जिस काम में कोई सबसे सहज हो
definition: the area where someone is most skilled and comfortable
example: Pricing models are squarely in her wheelhouse.

hindi: कहाँ खेलें — किन बाज़ारों, ग्राहकों और चैनलों को चुनें
definition: the strategic choice of which markets, customer segments, geographies and channels a company will compete in and which it will avoid
example: Asked where to play, the leadership team chose every market, segment and channel at once.

hindi: दोनों ओर से मार — भाव के अचानक उलट-पलट से नुकसान झेलना
definition: to jerk people, plans or prices back and forth through sudden reversals of direction, causing losses each time
example: The roadmap was whipsawed by three strategy changes in one quarter, and so were the engineers.

hindi: फुसफुसाया आँकड़ा — अनौपचारिक, असली उम्मीद वाला अनुमान
definition: unofficial earnings expectation circulating among traders, often higher than published analyst forecasts and quietly decisive
example: They beat consensus and missed the whisper number, a result the press release omitted.

hindi: शिकायत हेल्पलाइन — कदाचार की गोपनीय सूचना देने की व्यवस्था
definition: a confidential channel where employees can report fraud, misconduct or policy breaches without fear of retaliation
example: The whistleblower hotline was anonymous, which is why everyone was nervous when the manager asked who had called it.

hindi: विशेष सत्कार सेवा — बड़े ग्राहक के लिए पूरी तरह हाथ से की गई सेवा
definition: premium, highly personalised service where staff handle setup, migration and support tasks personally for important customers
example: The white glove onboarding meant our CEO personally forwarded their password reset email.

hindi: रक्षक खरीदार — शत्रुतापूर्ण बोली से बचाने आया मित्र अधिग्रहणकर्ता
definition: a friendly acquirer invited by management to outbid a hostile bidder for the company
example: The white knight rode in with a lower price but a promise to keep the chairman.

hindi: श्वेत पत्र — शोध-शैली में लिखा मार्केटिंग दस्तावेज़
definition: a long, authoritative-looking document that makes a pitch feel like research
example: The white paper cites three analysts and one blog post from 2019.

hindi: ख़ाली मैदान — बाज़ार का अनछुआ अवसर
definition: an untapped market opportunity
example: The deck claims white space; the market claims otherwise.

hindi: बोर्ड पर मिलकर सोचना — आरेख बनाकर हल खोजना
definition: to sketch and think through a problem on a board together
example: Let's whiteboard the architecture before anyone writes code.

hindi: बोर्ड पर कोड लिखवाने वाला इंटरव्यू — बिना कंप्यूटर के
definition: an interview where candidates solve coding problems on a whiteboard, sans compiler
example: Ten years of shipping software, judged by a whiteboard interview about linked lists.

hindi: विज्ञापन अनुमति — ब्रांड द्वारा क्रिएटर के अकाउंट से विज्ञापन चलाना
definition: creator granting a brand permission to publish paid advertisements through the creator's social account and handle
example: Whitelisting meant the ad came from the creator's handle, so the angry comments did too.

hindi: अभी क्यों — पिच में यह बताना कि यह विचार इसी समय क्यों सफल होगा
definition: the pitch-deck question explaining which recent market or technology change makes this startup possible today
example: The why now slide said 'AI', which covered this year and apparently every year before it.

hindi: कर दूँगा — सहमति, समय बताए बिना
definition: cheerful acceptance of a task, timeline unspecified
example: Will do, right after the two things due before it.

hindi: जीत दर — कुल सौदों में से जीते गए सौदों का प्रतिशत
definition: percentage of qualified opportunities that close successfully rather than being lost or abandoned
example: Our win rate improved dramatically once we stopped counting the deals we lost.

hindi: खोए ग्राहक की वापसी — पुराने ग्राहक को फिर जोड़ना
definition: a campaign to bring back customers who cancelled
example: The win-back email offers the discount they asked for before leaving.

hindi: जीत-हार विश्लेषण — सौदे क्यों जीते या हारे, इसकी पड़ताल
definition: structured study interviewing buyers about why deals succeeded or failed, to improve sales strategy
example: The win-loss analysis found we lose on price, win on price, and occasionally lose because nobody called back.

hindi: विजेता-सर्वस्व — जहाँ बाज़ार का लगभग सब कुछ अगुवा ले जाता है
definition: describes markets where the leading player captures almost everything
example: In a winner-take-all market, second place is a case study.

hindi: प्रगतिरत कार्य — शुरू हुआ पर अधूरा काम
definition: work in progress; started but unfinished tasks, best kept few
example: Our WIP limit is six, and we're at fourteen.

hindi: पहले से तय सौदा — जिसमें विजेता विक्रेता पहले से चुना जा चुका हो
definition: a purchase whose winning vendor is chosen before the formal evaluation starts, often with requirements written around them
example: The RFP required integration with our competitor's proprietary format, a subtle sign of a wired deal.

hindi: रेखाचित्र खाका — स्क्रीन की संरचना दिखाने वाला सादा ढांचा
definition: a bare-bones sketch of a screen's layout, before visual design
example: Don't judge the colors; it's a wireframe, everything is gray on purpose.

hindi: पर्दे-पीछे मानव परीक्षण — स्वचालित दिखने वाला, इंसान से चलने वाला प्रोटोटाइप
definition: a prototype that looks automated but is secretly operated by humans
example: Our AI beta was a Wizard of Oz test named Kevin.

hindi: गोदाम प्रबंधन प्रणाली — भंडारण, माल निकालने और भेजने का सॉफ़्टवेयर
definition: warehouse management system; software tracking stock locations, receiving, picking, packing and shipping inside a warehouse
example: The WMS knows exactly where every pallet is, in the warehouse we closed last year.

hindi: ठीक नहीं करेंगे — टिकट पर लगी मुहर कि समस्या जानते हुए भी सुधारी नहीं जाएगी
definition: describing a reported defect or request deliberately closed without being repaired, because it is intended, too costly or unimportant
example: Closed as wontfix, which is engineering for 'we have made peace with this'.

hindi: भाड़े पर किया गया काम — ऐसा काम जिसका कॉपीराइट सीधे भुगतान करने वाले का होता है
definition: a legal category under which copyright in commissioned or employee-created work belongs to the paying company from creation
example: The agency assumed the logo was work for hire, right until the freelancer sent an invoice for the trademark.

hindi: कहीं से भी काम — स्थान की पूरी छूट
definition: a policy allowing work from any location, not just home or office
example: Work from anywhere lasted until payroll met tax law.

hindi: दफ़्तरी पति — दफ़्तर का सबसे करीबी, भरोसेमंद (गैर-रोमांटिक) पुरुष सहकर्मी
definition: a close, trusted, platonic male colleague who shares daily support, gossip and lunch at work
example: Her work husband saves her a seat in every all-hands and a cynical comment for every slide.

hindi: काम का शहीद — छुट्टी न लेकर और ज़्यादा काम करके त्याग जताने वाला
definition: an employee who skips leave and overworks visibly, treating personal sacrifice as proof of loyalty and value
example: The work martyr answered emails from his own wedding and still asked who had approved the cake.

hindi: दफ़्तरी पत्नी — दफ़्तर की सबसे करीबी, भरोसेमंद (गैर-रोमांटिक) महिला सहकर्मी
definition: a close, trusted, platonic female colleague who shares daily support, gossip and lunch at work
example: My work wife knew about the reorg before my actual manager did.

hindi: काम और निजी जीवन के बीच संतुलन
definition: the boundary between job and life, praised in postings, tested by pings
example: Work-life balance is in the job ad and off by the second sprint.

hindi: बग़ल का रास्ता — समस्या सुलझाए बिना उससे कतरा कर निकलना
definition: a way to avoid a problem without actually fixing it
example: The workaround is now five years old and load-bearing.

hindi: काम-सह-छुट्टी — सैरगाह से दफ़्तरी काम
definition: working remotely from a vacation spot
example: The workation was mostly work, with a view.

hindi: वर्कबैक अनुसूची — लॉन्च तिथि से पीछे की ओर बनी समय-योजना
definition: a timeline built backward from the launch date to today
example: The workback schedule says we needed to start last month.

hindi: उल्टा चलना — पहले ग्राहक के लिए घोषणा लिखो, फिर उत्पाद बनाओ
definition: the product process of writing the customer announcement and questions first, then deciding what to build to deliver it
example: Working backwards from the press release, we discovered the product had no customer.

hindi: कार्यशील पूंजी — रोज़मर्रा के कामकाज में फंसी नकदी
definition: current assets minus current liabilities; the cash tied up running daily operations through receivables, inventory and payables
example: Sales grew so fast that working capital swallowed every rupee of profit before it reached the bank.

hindi: खुलकर काम करना — अपनी प्रगति और सोच सार्वजनिक चैनलों में साझा करते रहना
definition: sharing progress, drafts and reasoning openly in public channels so remote colleagues can follow the work
example: He was working out loud so thoroughly that the channel became a diary of his lunch choices.

hindi: मेरी मशीन पर तो चलता है — क्लासिक बहाना जब बग सिर्फ़ दूसरों को मिले
definition: the classic developer defense when a bug refuses to appear locally
example: Works on my machine, he said, as production burned.

hindi: कार्यधारा — बड़ी परियोजना का समानांतर हिस्सा
definition: one parallel track of work inside a larger program
example: I'm on the migration workstream, whatever that turns out to be.

hindi: बिल कटौती — दर्ज किए गए घंटों में से ग्राहक को कम पैसा भेजना
definition: reduction of recorded billable hours before invoicing, because the client will refuse the full amount
example: The partner called it goodwill; finance called it a forty-hour write-down.

hindi: बट्टे खाते की रक़म — डूबी रक़म को घाटा मान लेना
definition: an amount accepted as a loss for accounting purposes
example: The failed pilot became a write-off and a cautionary tale.

hindi: लेखन-संस्कृति — जहाँ निर्णय और जानकारी बैठकों के बजाय लिखित दस्तावेज़ों में दर्ज होते हैं
definition: workplace norm where decisions, proposals and knowledge are recorded in documents rather than spoken in meetings
example: We have a strong written culture, which is why nobody can find anything among four thousand documents.

hindi: के संबंध में — किसी विषय का संदर्भ देना
definition: with regard to; shorthand that introduces the topic or earlier point a message is responding about
example: WRT your question from March, the answer is still no.

hindi: सबसे छोटा भारित काम पहले — देरी की लागत को काम के आकार से भाग देकर प्राथमिकता
definition: weighted shortest job first; scaled agile prioritization method that divides cost of delay by estimated work size to rank backlog features
example: WSJF said the tiny bug fix should ship first, and for once the math won the meeting.

hindi: अभी ज़रूरत नहीं — जो चाहिए ही नहीं उसे मत बनाओ (you aren't gonna need it)
definition: you aren't gonna need it; don't build for imagined future requirements
example: I was adding plugin support to a shell script when YAGNI intervened.

hindi: काम से पहले कामों की झड़ी — असल कार्य तक पहुँचने में उलझी छोटी पूर्व-तैयारियाँ
definition: the chain of small side tasks you must finish before the task you actually meant to do
example: I came to fix a typo and spent the morning yak shaving build scripts.

hindi: वर्ष-दर-वर्ष — पिछले साल की समान अवधि से तुलना करके
definition: compared with the same period a year earlier
example: Year-over-year hides a lot, which is why we love it.

hindi: कल का मौसम — पिछले स्प्रिंट जितना ही अगले में होगा, यह मानना
definition: predicting next sprint's output from last sprint's, whatever optimism says
example: Yesterday's weather says twenty points, not the forty in this plan.

hindi: आपका अनुभव अलग हो सकता है — परिणाम की कोई गारंटी नहीं
definition: your mileage may vary; caveat saying advice worked for the writer but results elsewhere could differ
example: Restarting fixed it for me, YMMV — the whole support forum in four letters.

term: you build it, you run it
hindi: जो बनाए वही चलाए — अपनी सेवा का संचालन और रात की ज़िम्मेदारी भी स्वयं उठाना
definition: the principle that the engineering team which builds a service also operates it in production and carries its on-call duty
example: You build it, you run it, and at three in the morning you also regret it.

hindi: आवाज़ कट रही है — ख़राब नेटवर्क की सूचना
definition: said when someone's audio keeps cutting out
example: You're breaking up; type it in the chat instead.

hindi: आपका माइक बंद है — हर कॉल की रस्मी टोक
definition: the ritual reminder that a speaker's microphone is off
example: She gave the whole update before the chorus of you're on mute.

hindi: वर्ष की शुरुआत से अब तक — साल के पहले दिन से आज तक का कुल
definition: year to date; results accumulated from the start of the fiscal year to the current reporting date
example: YTD we are on plan, provided nobody looks at the monthly trend.

hindi: ज़ेब्रा स्टार्टअप — मुनाफ़ा और सामाजिक उद्देश्य दोनों साधने वाली कंपनी
definition: a startup that pursues sustainable profit and social purpose together, rejecting the unicorn chase for blitz growth
example: We pitched ourselves as a zebra startup, and the VC politely asked where the horn was.

hindi: शून्य अवस्था — डेटा आने से पहले की स्क्रीन
definition: the screen users see before any content or data exists, designed to guide their first action
example: The zero state said 'Nothing here yet!' with an illustration, and no hint about what should be there.

hindi: शून्य से एक — नक़ल नहीं, बिल्कुल नई चीज़ रचना
definition: creating something genuinely new rather than improving what already exists
example: The keynote said zero to one; the roadmap said one point one.

hindi: शून्य विश्वास सुरक्षा — दफ़्तर के भीतर भी हर लॉगिन और डिवाइस की जाँच
definition: security approach verifying every user, device and request, never trusting anyone just for being inside the office network
example: Zero trust arrived, and now the badge reader, the laptop and the coffee machine all want his password.

hindi: शून्य-आधारित बजट — हर खर्च को हर साल शुरू से उचित ठहराना
definition: building each budget from nothing so every expense must be justified afresh, rather than adjusting last year's spending
example: Zero-based budgeting required justifying every expense, including the consultants explaining zero-based budgeting.

hindi: शून्य-क्लिक खोज — जवाब खोज पेज पर ही मिल जाना, वेबसाइट तक कोई न आए
definition: searches answered directly on the results page or by an assistant, so users never visit the publisher's website
example: Traffic fell thirty percent and marketing blamed zero-click search, which was convenient.

hindi: शून्य-उदाहरण — बिना कोई नमूना दिखाए सीधे काम करवाना
definition: handling a task with no examples provided, just instructions
example: Zero-shot it first; if the answers get weird, start showing examples.

hindi: शून्य ब्याज दर नीति — सस्ते पैसे का वह दौर जब स्टार्टअप में अंधाधुंध निवेश हुआ
definition: zero interest rate policy; shorthand for the cheap-money era when startups raised easily and spent freely
example: The nap pods and the forty-person marketing team were ZIRP artefacts, now quietly decommissioned.

hindi: मरी हुई पर चलती बैठक — उद्देश्य खत्म होने के बाद भी दोहराई जाने वाली मीटिंग
definition: a recurring meeting that keeps appearing on calendars long after its original purpose ended
example: The zombie meeting has no agenda and no owner, yet eight people attend faithfully.

hindi: ज़ॉम्बी स्टार्टअप — न बढ़ने वाली, न मरने वाली कंपनी
definition: a company alive enough to keep operating but too stalled to grow or exit
example: It's a zombie startup: payroll clears, and absolutely nothing else happens.

hindi: वीडियो-कॉल थकान — लगातार कैमरे के सामने मीटिंगों से होने वाली मानसिक थकावट
definition: mental exhaustion caused by back-to-back video calls, constant self-view and staring at faces on screen throughout the workday
example: By four o'clock his Zoom fatigue was so bad he nodded along to a slide that had not loaded.

hindi: ऊपर औपचारिक, नीचे घरेलू — वीडियो कॉल पर केवल कैमरे में दिखने वाला हिस्सा सजाना
definition: dressing formally above the desk for video calls while wearing pajamas or shorts below the camera frame
example: His Zoom mullet held up beautifully until he stood to fetch the charger.

hindi: संभावित समझौते का दायरा — वह सीमा जिसमें दोनों पक्ष सहमत हो सकते हैं
definition: zone of possible agreement; the price range where the buyer's maximum and the seller's minimum overlap in negotiation
example: After three calls we confirmed the ZOPA was roughly the width of a rounding error.
